updates.current_state_zh: 为何我本应爱上生物学：一篇关于教育的反思
updates.detailed_summary_en: In the 2020 essay 'I Should Have Loved Biology,' published on jsomers.net, James Somers argues that biology was made unlovable by rote memorization and should instead be taught through meaning and discovery. The piece earned 311 points and 118 comments on Hacker News, sparking substantive discussion about pedagogy. The essay resonates with a technology audience because it speaks to how intrinsic motivation and curiosity drive deep learning, values at the core of engineering culture. It also contributes to ongoing debates about STEM education by arguing that meaning-making is essential for genuine understanding, not just test performance. The Hacker News thread reached 311 points and 118 comments, with commenters weighing in on the 'meaning before mechanics' principle, connecting the argument to Seymour Papert and Jean Piaget. One life-science researcher offered a counterpoint, describing the essay as 'a very romantic view of life sciences' and emphasizing the unglamorous reality of research work.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: 詹姆斯·索默斯（James Somers）在 2020 年发表于 jsomers.net 的随笔《我本应爱上生物学》中提出，生物学因死记硬背而丧失了魅力，教学应当转向意义与探索。该文在 Hacker News 上获得 311 个赞与 118 条评论，引发了关于教学法的深入讨论。 这篇文章能引起科技界共鸣，因为它触及了内在动力与好奇心如何驱动深度学习——这正是工程师文化所看重的价值。它也回应了 STEM 教育的长期争论：意义建构是真正理解的关键，而不仅仅是为了应付考试。 Hacker News 讨论串获得了 311 个赞和 118 条评论，评论者围绕“意义先于技巧”这一原则展开讨论，并将其与西摩·帕尔特（Seymour Papert）和让·皮亚杰（Jean Piaget）的思想联系起来。一位生命科学研究者则提出不同意见，称这是“对生命科学非常浪漫的看法”，并强调科研工作并不光鲜的现实。

updates.current_state_zh: Kraken母公司Payward探索海外设立全能银行
updates.detailed_summary_en: Payward, the parent company of crypto exchange Kraken, is exploring becoming a full bank outside the US, expanding into banking, lending, and asset management, with mortgages a future possibility. This move signals further institutionalization of the crypto industry as major players push into traditional financial services. It could also set a precedent for other crypto firms seeking banking licenses abroad, blurring the line between crypto and conventional banking. The exploration is at a strategic stage, with no regulatory finality or immediate market impact. The bank would operate outside the US, though specific jurisdictions have not been disclosed.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: 加密货币交易所Kraken的母公司Payward正在探索在海外成为一家全能银行，业务范围将扩展至银行、贷款和资产管理，未来还可能涉及抵押贷款。 此举标志着加密货币行业进一步机构化，主要参与者正进军传统金融服务领域。这也可能为其他寻求在海外获得银行牌照的加密公司开创先例，模糊加密货币与传统银行之间的界限。 目前该探索仍处于战略阶段，尚未获得监管最终批准，也不会产生直接影响。该银行将在美国以外运营，但具体司法管辖区尚未披露。

updates.background_en: Kraken was co-founded in July 2011 with Payward as its parent company, and is legally named Payward, Inc. By 2025 it reported $207 billion in quarterly trading volume and was ranked the world's fourteenth-largest crypto exchange; in most US states it also facilitates trading of stocks, futures and ETFs. Payward describes itself as the parent behind Kraken and a portfolio of businesses spanning trading, custody, payments, lending, onchain finance and benchmarks.

updates.what_changed_en: Payward, the parent company of Kraken, is advancing an expansion strategy anchored by roughly $2B in acquisitions to grow the exchange's business.
updates.what_changed_zh:
据 Crypto News 报道，加密货币交易所 Kraken 的母公司 Payward 正在推进一项以约 20 亿美元收购为核心的扩张战略，目标是扩大该交易所的业务版图。

Payward 联合首席执行官 Arjun Sethi 曾表示，公司正在把交易、支付、资产管理与机构服务整合到共同的基础设施之上；此次报道的收购攻势，正属于这一“不止于加密货币交易所”的既定方向。

这一收购计划的主体是 Kraken 的母公司 Payward，而非 Kraken 交易所本身。

updates.background_en: Kraken is a US-based cryptocurrency exchange founded in 2011, and per Wikipedia it was the first crypto company to obtain a bank charter. Payward has been pushing into regulated financial infrastructure: it has applied for a US national trust bank charter, and CoinDesk reported in July that Kraken was seeking a banking license in Lithuania. Payward co-CEO Arjun Sethi said a regulated EU bank "is the piece that lets us serve European clients the way a primary financial institution should: one place to hold assets, move them freely, and put them to work."
updates.background_zh: Kraken 是一家成立于 2011 年的美国加密货币交易所，据维基百科介绍，它是首家获得银行牌照的加密公司。Payward 一直在推进受监管金融基础设施布局：它已申请美国的 national trust bank 牌照，CoinDesk 在 7 月报道称 Kraken 正在争取立陶宛的银行牌照。Payward 联合首席执行官 Arjun Sethi 表示，一家受监管的欧盟银行“让我们能够像主要金融机构那样服务欧洲客户：一个可以持有资产、自由转移资产并让资产产生收益的地方”。
updates.current_state_en: Payward has agreed to acquire Saldo Bank to obtain an EU banking license, pending regulatory approval, expected to close in 2027.
updates.current_state_zh: Payward已同意收购Saldo Bank以获得欧盟银行牌照，交易待监管批准，预计2027年完成。
updates.detailed_summary_en:
Payward, the parent company of crypto exchange Kraken, agreed to acquire Lithuania-based Saldo Bank for an undisclosed amount, a deal that would give it a European Union banking license. The acquisition is subject to regulatory approval and is expected to close in 2027.

The deal would let Payward offer EU customers interest-bearing deposits, loans, card services and euro payments, expanding it beyond crypto trading, and would make it the first crypto firm to buy a European bank, according to the Financial Times.

Saldo Bank had €163.9 million (about $180 million) in total assets at the end of 2025, up 22.7% year over year, and is licensed in Lithuania, Finland, Sweden and Germany with a passport to operate in the Netherlands; it offers deposits, consumer and business loans and payment services. Payward said its banking business has already originated more than $2 billion in loans and holds a Federal Reserve limited-purpose master account and an electronic money institution license in Ireland.
updates.detailed_summary_zh:
加密货币交易所 Kraken 的母公司 Payward 已达成协议，将以未披露的金额收购总部位于立陶宛的 Saldo Bank，这笔交易将使其获得欧盟银行牌照。该收购仍需监管批准，预计于 2027 年完成。

据《金融时报》报道，该交易将使 Payward 能够为欧盟客户提供计息存款、贷款、银行卡服务和欧元支付，从而把业务从加密货币交易扩展到传统金融服务，并使其成为首家收购欧洲银行的加密公司。

截至 2025 年底，Saldo Bank 的总资产为 1.639 亿欧元（约 1.8 亿美元），同比增长 22.7%；该行在立陶宛、芬兰、瑞典和德国持有牌照，并拥有在荷兰运营的通行证，提供存款、个人及企业贷款和支付服务。Payward 表示，其银行业务已发放超过 20 亿美元贷款，并持有美联储有限用途主账户以及爱尔兰的电子货币机构牌照。
updates.market_impact_en: The transaction channels crypto-native capital directly into EU-regulated banking infrastructure, giving Payward control of deposit-taking, lending and euro payment rails that compete with traditional lenders serving EU crypto users. The main exposure runs through EU-facing exchanges, custody and payments providers whose fiat on/off-ramp and yield products would face a licensed banking competitor, with the deal's 2027 closing and regulatory approval still pending.
updates.market_impact_zh: 这笔交易把加密行业的资金直接引入受欧盟监管的银行基础设施，使 Payward 掌握吸收存款、放贷和欧元支付通道，与面向欧盟加密用户的传统银行形成竞争。主要影响传导至面向欧盟市场的交易所、托管与支付服务商——其法币出入金和收益类产品将面对一家持牌银行的竞争；同时该交易预计 2027 年完成，并仍待监管批准。

updates.current_state_zh: Tether借NYSE壳公司买入并质押竞品USDS
updates.detailed_summary_en: Tether invested $134 million in the failing biopharmaceutical firm NovaBay in March and reverse-merged it into a NYSE-listed entity renamed Stablecoin Development Corporat. The vehicle has been used to purchase and stake a large amount of USDS, the decentralized stablecoin from the Sky Protocol (formerly MakerDAO). This is a notable market-structure shift because the world's largest centralized stablecoin issuer is using a public shell company to accumulate a rival decentralized stablecoin. It could reshape stablecoin competition, raise governance and transparency questions, and give USDS public-market exposure. Stablecoin Development Corporat's share price has collapsed from roughly $2.00 to $1.00, and unusual buy support has repeatedly pushed it back above $1.00, apparently to avoid NYSE delisting under the 30-day sub-$1 rule. The company says it has taken a 'greater than a 9% stake' in USDS, and its CEO, Michael Kazley, describes the position as 'wildly bullish' on the SKY Protocol.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Tether于3月向濒临破产的生物制药公司NovaBay投资1.34亿美元，并通过反向合并将其改造为在纽交所上市、更名为Stablecoin Development Corporat的实体。该实体已被用于购买并质押大量USDS——即来自Sky Protocol（原MakerDAO）的去中心化稳定币。 这是值得关注的市场结构变化，因为全球最大的中心化稳定币发行方正在利用上市壳公司来积累竞争对手的去中心化稳定币。此举可能重塑稳定币竞争格局，引发治理与透明度方面的疑问，并让USDS获得公开市场的敞口。 Stablecoin Development Corporat的股价已从约2.00美元跌至1.00美元，且多次出现异常买盘将其推回1.00美元上方，显然是为了避免触发纽交所“连续30日低于1美元”的退市规则。该公司表示已持有USDS“超过9%的份额”，其CEO Michael Kazley称对SKY Protocol“极度看多”。

updates.detailed_summary_en: Coinbase's CEO publicly stated that the CLARITY Act is expected to secure more than 60 Senate votes on September 15, signaling strong bipartisan support for the crypto market structure bill. The projection underscores growing momentum for the legislation. This development is significant because it suggests the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act could clear the 60-vote threshold needed to overcome a Senate filibuster. If enacted, it would define SEC and CFTC jurisdiction over digital assets, materially reshaping US crypto market structure and reducing regulatory uncertainty for exchanges and projects. The CLARITY Act, formally known as the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act of 2025, is a bipartisan bill introduced by Senate Banking Committee Chairman Tim Scott and Senator Cynthia Lummis. Its central aim is to clarify the respective roles of the SEC and the CFTC in overseeing digital assets and to establish a clearer market structure framework.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Binance has launched Agent OS, a developer platform that lets AI agents access market data, monitor accounts, and execute crypto trades on the exchange. The platform supports AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor, with user-configured permissions and limits. This marks a major step by a leading exchange toward autonomous AI-driven trading, potentially reshaping how crypto trades are executed and managed. It also accelerates the broader trend of AI agents participating in onchain and financial infrastructure, affecting traders, developers, and the AI-crypto ecosystem. Users can assign agents to dedicated subaccounts to isolate funds and activity, set permissions, and revoke access at any time. Binance can monitor trades placed through Agent OS but cannot see an agent's external data sources or decision-making, and the service is not available to users in the EEA.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance推出了Agent OS开发者平台，允许AI代理访问市场数据、监控账户并在交易所执行加密货币交易。该平台支持ChatGPT、Claude Code、Codex和Cursor等AI工具，并带有用户配置的权限和限额。 这标志着头部交易所向自主AI驱动交易迈出的重要一步，可能重塑加密货币交易的执行和管理方式。它还加速了AI代理参与链上和金融基础设施的更大趋势，影响交易者、开发者以及AI与加密生态。 用户可以将AI代理分配到专用子账户以隔离资金和活动，随时设置权限或撤销访问。Binance能监控通过Agent OS进行的交易，但看不到代理的外部数据源或决策过程，且该服务不面向欧洲经济区（EEA）用户。

The latest departure, Nethermind, terminated its role as a verifier on Wednesday and migrated to a competitor. This exodus signals declining trust in LayerZero's security model after the Lazarus Group incident, with billions in bridged assets moving off the protocol. As a leading interoperability platform, losing major enterprise and institutional users erodes network effects and could reshape the cross-chain bridge landscape. By early July, more than $7 billion in assets had already migrated off LayerZero, and BitGo's exit pushed the cumulative total toward $15 billion. In July, LayerZero announced it was winding down support for low-activity chains and set an August 3 deadline for teams still using v1 libraries.

updates.detailed_summary_en: At a White House meeting with crypto executives, President Trump said CFTC Chair Michael Selig is working to bring Hyperliquid into the United States in a fully compliant manner. HYPE jumped 23% and LIT rose 20% following the announcement, while Bitcoin climbed to $72k and Ether passed $2,300. The statement signals a potential regulatory pathway for offshore perpetual futures venues to operate in the US, which could reshape how Americans access leveraged crypto trading. It also shows the SEC and CFTC advancing their own rulemaking while the Clarity Act remains stalled in Congress. Hyperliquid is an offshore venue where traders use perpetual futures—contracts with no expiration date—by connecting a wallet, a structure that bypasses the intermediaries US derivatives rules assume exist. The CFTC has been building toward this by clearing Coinbase Derivatives and Kalshi for similar products, and its Innovation Advisory Committee meets Thursday.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: 在特朗普与加密高管的白宫会议上，总统表示CFTC主席Michael Selig正在努力以完全合规的方式将Hyperliquid带入美国。消息公布后，HYPE上涨23%，LIT上涨20%，比特币升至72,000美元，以太坊突破2,300美元。 这一表态标志着离岸永续合约交易平台可能获得进入美国市场的监管路径，可能重塑美国用户参与加密杠杆交易的方式。这也表明在《清晰法案》仍停滞于国会之际，SEC和CFTC正在自行推进规则制定。 Hyperliquid是一个离岸平台，用户通过连接钱包交易永续合约（无到期日的合约），这种结构绕开了美国衍生品规则所假设存在的中介机构。CFTC此前已批准Coinbase Derivatives和Kalshi提供类似产品，其创新顾问委员会将于周四召开会议。

updates.current_state_en: GitHub's August 17 Outage Postmortem: Capacity Failures and Scaling Challenges

updates.detailed_summary_en: GitHub published a postmortem for the August 17 outage, attributing it to capacity failures and scaling issues that disrupted services including GitHub Actions. Monthly commits reportedly doubled from 1.4 billion in April to 2.9 billion. The outage affected millions of developers and enterprise users who rely on GitHub for code hosting and CI/CD. It highlights the operational pressures of hyper-growth and raises questions about resource allocation, free-tier impacts, and infrastructure resilience in widely used developer platforms. The postmortem describes two capacity-related incidents and acknowledges that critical components were not scaled before demand exceeded capacity. Community commenters noted that the growth in commits, from 1.4 billion to 2.9 billion monthly since April, coincided with industry-wide 'productivity panic' around AI tooling.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: GitHub 发布了 8 月 17 日宕机事件的复盘报告，将其归因于容量故障和扩展问题，事件影响了包括 GitHub Actions 在内的服务。据报道，月度提交量从 4 月的 14 亿次翻倍增长至 29 亿次。 这次宕机影响了数百万依赖 GitHub 进行代码托管和 CI/CD 的开发者及企业用户。它凸显了超高速增长带来的运营压力，并引发了对资源分配、免费套餐影响以及广泛使用的开发者平台基础设施韧性的思考。 复盘报告描述了两次与容量相关的事件，并承认在需求超出容量之前未能扩展关键组件。社区评论者指出，自 4 月以来月度提交量从 14 亿增长到 29 亿，恰好与全行业围绕 AI 工具的“生产力焦虑”相吻合。

updates.current_state_en: Arbitrum Activates Elara Upgrade With Optional Compliance Filters
updates.current_state_zh: Arbitrum 激活 Elara 升级，为专属链引入可选合规过滤器
updates.detailed_summary_en: The Arbitrum platform activated the ArbOS 61 Elara upgrade, bringing optional compliance filtering, customizable priority fees, and an alternative data API to dedicated Arbitrum chains, while delivering a more efficient base fee mechanism on Arbitrum One. Chain owners—not the ArbitrumDAO—control compliance screening on dedicated networks, and priority fees remain disabled on Arbitrum One pending a further governance vote. This upgrade introduces protocol-level compliance tooling for Layer 2/3 chains without imposing screening on Arbitrum One, preserving DAO control and user neutrality. It could make the Arbitrum stack more attractive to institutions and regulated entities that need on-chain transaction filtering for dedicated chains. ArbOS 61 Elara also quadruples Stylus contract size limits, expanding smart-contract capacity on Arbitrum chains. Compliance filtering operates across two layers—the Sequencer and the State Transition Function (STF)—ensuring restricted activity is blocked regardless of how a transaction enters the system, and it remains off by default on Arbitrum One and Nova.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Arbitrum 平台已激活 ArbOS 61 Elara 升级，为专属 Arbitrum 链带来可选的合规过滤、可自定义优先费以及替代数据 API，同时为 Arbitrum One 提供了更高效的基准费用机制。合规筛查由链所有者而非 ArbitrumDAO 控制，而在 Arbitrum One 上，优先费仍处于禁用状态，等待进一步的治理投票。 此次升级在 L2/L3 链上引入了协议级合规工具，同时不将筛查强加于 Arbitrum One，从而保留了 DAO 的控制权和用户中立性。这可能使 Arbitrum 技术栈对需要专属链上交易过滤的机构和受监管实体更具吸引力。 ArbOS 61 Elara 还将 Stylus 合约大小上限提高了四倍，扩大了 Arbitrum 链上的智能合约容量。合规过滤在两层运作——定序器（Sequencer）和状态转换函数（STF）——确保无论交易如何进入系统，受限活动都会被阻止，并且该功能在 Arbitrum One 和 Nova 上默认保持关闭。

updates.current_state_en: Malicious Rust crate arrayref runs build-time payload
updates.current_state_zh: 恶意 Rust crate arrayref 构建时执行恶意负载
updates.detailed_summary_en: A malicious release of the popular Rust crate arrayref (version 0.3.10) added a first-ever dependency on a typosquatted crate, proc-macro1, whose build script downloads and executes a remote binary at compile time. The Rust team and RustSec advisory database issued official warnings on August 20, 2026, and the malicious version was removed from crates.io. Because arrayref is widely used and the malware executes during the build process, any developer or CI/CD system that builds the compromised version may be infected without running the project's own code. This highlights the systemic risk of supply-chain attacks on the Rust/crates.io ecosystem. The malicious arrayref 0.3.10 was published on 2026-08-20 by the legitimate maintainer account 'droundy', and it depends on proc-macro1 1.0.107, which was published minutes earlier by account 'dtolney'. The build.rs of proc-macro1 downloads and executes a remote payload; security researchers describe it as a multi-stage info-stealer with stage-2 backdoor capabilities.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: 流行的 Rust crate arrayref 的恶意版本 0.3.10 首次添加了对拼写错误仿冒 crate proc-macro1 的依赖，其 build 脚本会在编译时下载并执行远程二进制文件。Rust 官方团队和 RustSec 公告数据库已于 2026 年 8 月 20 日发出官方警告，该恶意版本也已从 crates.io 移除。 由于 arrayref 使用广泛，且恶意代码在构建过程中执行，任何编译了该恶意版本的开发者或 CI/CD 系统都可能被感染，而无需运行项目自身代码。这突显了针对 Rust/crates.io 生态系统的供应链攻击的系统性风险。 恶意版本的 arrayref 0.3.10 由合法维护者账号 'droundy' 于 2026-08-20 发布，其依赖的 proc-macro1 1.0.107 在几分钟前由账号 'dtolney' 发布。proc-macro1 的 build.rs 会下载并执行远程载荷；安全研究人员称这是一个多阶段信息窃取程序，并具备第二阶段后门能力。

updates.detailed_summary_en: Optimism's governance has approved a proposal to repurpose 546.9 million OP tokens previously reserved for user airdrops into a new Strategic Ecosystem Fund. The fund will back partnerships, incentives, and institutional adoption including OP Enterprise. This decision materially changes OP's token distribution and signals a shift from airdrop-driven user acquisition toward institutional and enterprise growth. It reshapes user expectations and may influence incentives across the OP Superchain ecosystem. Optimism said no additional airdrops are planned after distributing 269.1 million OP across five previous rounds. At current prices, the reallocated 546.9 million OP is worth about $50 million, close to a quarter of OP's roughly $211 million market cap.

updates.current_state_en: GnosisDAO Approves Gnosis Chain Transition to Ethereum Economic Zone Rollup
updates.current_state_zh: GnosisDAO 批准 Gnosis Chain 转型为以太坊经济区 Rollup
updates.detailed_summary_en: GnosisDAO approved GIP-153, passing with 123,158 GNO in favor, to transition Gnosis Chain from a standalone layer-1 into a ZK-proven Ethereum Economic Zone (EEZ) rollup that settles directly on Ethereum. The tentative launch window is late 2026 or early 2027, pending readiness of EEZ technology. This decision makes Gnosis Chain the first production EEZ instance, a significant step toward unifying Ethereum's fragmented L2 ecosystem by enabling synchronous composability across rollups without relying on bridges. It also changes Gnosis Chain's security and settlement model, shifting from its own validator set to Ethereum's validators. The proposal GIP-153 passed with 123,158 GNO in support, 115 against, and 151 abstentions across 54 voters, with turnout of 123,425 GNO exceeding the 75,000 quorum. Gnosis Chain will retire its validator set, retain xDAI as its gas token, and launch as the first deployed EEZ instance while keeping existing applications and balances.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: GnosisDAO 批准了 GIP-153，以 123,158 GNO 赞成票通过，将 Gnosis Chain 从独立的 Layer-1 转型为直接结算到以太坊的 ZK 证明以太坊经济区（EEZ）Rollup。暂定启动窗口为 2026 年底或 2027 年初，具体取决于 EEZ 技术是否就绪。 这一决定使 Gnosis Chain 成为首个生产级 EEZ 实例，是统一以太坊碎片化 L2 生态的重要一步，旨在让不同 Rollup 之间的智能合约无需依赖桥接即可同步交互。同时，Gnosis Chain 的安全与结算模式将从自有验证者集转变为依赖以太坊验证者。 提案 GIP-153 以 123,158 GNO 支持、115 反对和 151 弃权的结果通过，共 54 名投票者，总投票数 123,425 GNO，超过了 75,000 的法定人数。Gnosis Chain 将退役其验证者集，保留 xDAI 作为 Gas 代币，并作为首个部署的 EEZ 实例推出，同时保留现有应用和余额。

updates.detailed_summary_en: According to a CoinDesk report dated August 20, 2026, Elon Musk's X platform is exploring the use of stablecoins to pay influencers and content providers. The effort is still in an exploratory phase and no specific stablecoin or rollout timeline has been confirmed. If realized, this could give stablecoins a massively visible real-world payments use case on one of the world's largest social platforms. It also signals that mainstream internet companies are increasingly treating crypto-based payments as a viable infrastructure for creator monetization. The report emphasizes that the exploration is preliminary and that X has not publicly announced any partnership with a stablecoin issuer. The move would build on Musk's long-standing interest in integrating payments into X, which has already obtained money-transmitter licenses in several U.S. states.

updates.current_state_en: Solana Activates 350ms Slots on Mainnet, First Cut Since Genesis
updates.current_state_zh: Solana主网激活350毫秒时隙，创世以来首次缩减
updates.detailed_summary_en: Solana reduced its mainnet slot time from 400ms to 350ms, marking the first such reduction since the network's inception. The change begins an epoch-by-epoch path toward a 200ms target, with 300ms as the next milestone. Shorter slots reduce network latency and speed up transaction confirmation, improving the experience for users and applications built on Solana. It strengthens Solana's competitive position as a high-performance blockchain and signals continued protocol-level optimization. The reduction was enabled by SIMD-0525, which was approved and merged on May 14, and average slot times already stood at 360ms at press time. The remaining 50ms reductions toward 200ms are targeted for mainnet activation in Agave v4.2, the validator client developed by Anza, though the schedule is tentative.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Solana将主网时隙时间从400毫秒缩短至350毫秒，这是自网络创世以来的首次缩减。这一变化开启了逐epoch向200毫秒目标迈进的进程，下一里程碑为300毫秒。 更短的时隙降低了网络延迟，加快了交易确认速度，改善了Solana用户和应用的体验。这增强了Solana作为高性能区块链的竞争力，也表明协议层面的优化仍在持续推进。 此次缩减由SIMD-0525提案推动，该提案已于5月14日获批并合并，截至发稿时平均时隙时间已降至360毫秒。后续向200毫秒目标迈进的各次50毫秒缩减计划在Anza开发的验证器客户端Agave v4.2中激活主网，但时间表仍为暂定。

updates.background_en: Alpenglow is Solana's first major consensus replacement since TowerBFT and was presented by Anza in May 2025. It follows other performance work: Solana activated Transaction V1 this month, lifting maximum transaction size to 4,096 bytes from 1,232, and its slot-time roadmap has progressively cut the target from 400 milliseconds toward 200 milliseconds.
updates.background_zh: Alpenglow 是 Solana 自 TowerBFT 以来首次重大共识层替换，由 Anza 于 2025 年 5 月提出。它延续了此前的性能升级：Solana 本月激活 Transaction V1，将最大交易大小从 1,232 字节提升至 4,096 字节，其 slot 时间路线图也逐步把目标从 400 毫秒压缩至 200 毫秒。
updates.current_state_en: Solana began rolling its Alpenglow consensus upgrade onto testnet, the first public deployment of the TowerBFT replacement targeting roughly 150-millisecond finality while leaving the SVM, transactions, programs and fees unchanged.
updates.current_state_zh:
Solana 已开始将 Alpenglow 共识改造推进至测试网，这是该升级首次公开部署，其内容是以 Votor 投票机制取代 TowerBFT。Solana Agave 验证者客户端的开发方 Anza 表示，测试网正在进入部署流程，之后将依次推进至 devnet，最终到 mainnet-beta。

这是验证者与基础设施服务商在 Alpenglow 推进至 devnet 与主网之前，首次可以在大范围环境中运行该升级。此次迁移要求这些运营方调整其区块流传输、投票跟踪或依赖 Solana 现有确认层级的系统。

该升级的目标是将最终确认时间从 TowerBFT 下约 12.8 秒降至约 150 毫秒，同时不改变 Solana 虚拟机、交易、程序与费用。其第一阶段引入 Votor，把验证者当前上链的投票交易改为直接在验证者之间发送，并汇总为凭证，使区块可在一到两轮投票内完成最终确认，把等待不可逆交易的时间缩短约 99%；取代 Turbine 区块数据分发系统的 Rotor 则另行安排。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Solana began rolling its Alpenglow consensus upgrade onto testnet, the first public deployment of the TowerBFT replacement targeting roughly 150-millisecond finality while leaving the SVM, transactions, programs and fees unchanged.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Solana began rolling its Alpenglow consensus upgrade onto testnet, the first public deployment of the TowerBFT replacement targeting roughly 150-millisecond finality while leaving the SVM, transactions, programs and fees unchanged.
updates.market_impact_en: Alpenglow's transmission path to markets runs mainly through settlement latency: faster finality could affect market structure for Solana-based venues such as DEXs and tokenized real-world assets, as well as the operational requirements placed on validators and infrastructure providers. The article notes SOL traded around $117 after nearing $120 this week, up roughly 25% over the past month, and that real-world assets on the network reached about $4.6 billion in early September.
updates.market_impact_zh: Alpenglow 对市场的传导路径主要体现在结算延迟上：更快的最终确认可能影响 Solana 上 DEX 与代币化现实世界资产等场所的市场结构，以及验证者和基础设施服务商承担的运营要求。报道指出，SOL 在本周接近 120 美元后于发稿时报约 117 美元，过去一个月上涨约 25%，而网络上的现实世界资产规模在 9 月初达到约 46 亿美元。

updates.background_en: Alpenglow is Anza’s proposed replacement for Solana’s current TowerBFT consensus, introducing the Votor and Rotor design, per Anza’s and Solana’s upgrade materials. Devnet is the developer network where applications are tested with tokens of no real value, while the separate testnet is used mainly to stress-test network software and validator operations.
updates.background_zh: 根据 Anza 与 Solana 的升级资料，Alpenglow 是 Anza 提出的方案，用于取代 Solana 现行的 TowerBFT 共识，并引入 Votor 与 Rotor 设计。Devnet 是开发者网络，使用没有真实价值的代币测试应用；独立的 testnet 则主要用于对网络软件和验证者运维进行压力测试。
updates.current_state_en: Anza's Alpenglow consensus upgrade for Solana is now live on devnet, with developers asked to test programs and integrations while mainnet activation remains pending.
updates.current_state_zh:
Anza 于 9 月 25 日宣布，其针对 Solana 的共识改造 Alpenglow 已在 devnet 上线；此前一天，独立的 testnet 已完成切换，Solana 基金会的升级页面显示该升级在两个网络上均已激活。主网激活仍未有时间表。

Alpenglow 的目标是将最终确认时间从现行系统的大约 12.8 秒缩短到约 150 毫秒，这可能缩短交易所释放存款或支付应用向商户确认交易完成所需的时间。由于验证者投票移出区块，即使用户活动不变，报告的交易总量也会下降。

验证者将直接交换投票，而不再把投票作为交易记录在区块内，从而使共识在一到两轮投票内完成；Solana 基金会已要求数据服务商调整其对比口径。150 毫秒这一数字来自模拟结果，而非真实市场条件下的实测；钱包处理和交易所自身的入金审核还可能增加额外等待时间；仅发送交易和读取账户余额的应用无需迁移。

Because removing validator votes lowers reported transaction counts, data providers must adjust comparisons, which affects the on-chain activity metrics used in Solana market analysis.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导路径主要通过 SOL 以及基于 Solana 的资产，包括在该网络上结算的稳定币支付流：更快的最终确认针对的是交易所入金确认和支付受理时间，这属于基础设施与情绪渠道，而非供应或托管层面的变化。由于移除验证者投票会降低报告的交易总量，数据服务商必须调整对比口径，这会影响用于 Solana 市场分析的链上活动指标。

验证者将直接交换投票，而不再把投票作为交易记录在区块内，从而使共识在一到两轮投票内完成；Solana 基金会已要求数据服务商调整其对比口径。150 毫秒这一数字来自模拟结果，而非真实市场条件下的实测；钱包处理和交易所自身的入金审核还可能增加额外等待时间；仅发送交易和读取账户余额的应用无需迁移。

updates.background_en: The change completes a four-stage rollout that began in August, when Solana first reduced its slot target to 350 milliseconds, followed by 300ms and 250ms. Attention now turns to Alpenglow, Solana's planned consensus overhaul and its first major consensus replacement since TowerBFT, which targets transaction finality of about 150 milliseconds versus roughly 12.8 seconds under TowerBFT. Alpenglow has been deployed on testnet and devnet, but no mainnet activation date has been announced.

updates.market_impact_en: Solana's faster slot cadence reaches crypto markets mainly through validator operations and application-layer latency: tighter block-production and propagation deadlines plus more frequent blocks raise infrastructure and skipped-slot risks for validators and RPC providers, while the pending Alpenglow finality upgrade, still without a mainnet date, is the item the market is watching for any change to the confirmation times used by exchanges and market makers.

updates.background_en: TowerBFT has been Solana's consensus mechanism since mainnet launch, working alongside Proof of History (PoH), a cryptographic clock that orders events. Anza and Solana describe Alpenglow as the most significant overhaul of Solana's core protocol to date; the new voting protocol Votor ships in Agave 4.3.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Solana's Anza announced that the Alpenglow consensus upgrade, which replaces TowerBFT and Proof-of-History and reduces finality to about 150 milliseconds, will activate on Mainnet-beta around October 21 at 22:50 with a single-slot migration.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Solana's Anza announced that the Alpenglow consensus upgrade, which replaces TowerBFT and Proof-of-History and reduces finality to about 150 milliseconds, will activate on Mainnet-beta around October 21 at 22:50 with a single-slot migration.
updates.market_impact_en: The upgrade directly concerns SOL stakers and validators and the applications settling on Solana, since sub-second finality could change how exchanges, custodians and payment processors treat on-chain settlement. Because validator votes move off-chain, widely cited Solana transaction-count metrics may shift, affecting how data providers and market observers read network activity.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该升级直接关系到 SOL 质押者与验证者以及在 Solana 上结算的应用，因为亚秒级最终确认可能改变交易所、托管机构和支付处理方对链上结算的处理方式。由于验证者投票移至链下，被广泛引用的 Solana 交易量指标可能发生变化，从而影响数据服务商和市场观察者对网络活跃度的判断。

updates.background_en: TowerBFT had been Solana's consensus mechanism since the network launched in March 2020. Alpenglow's design was published in May 2025 by Anza's research team led by ETH Zurich professor Roger Wattenhofer with Quentin Kniep and Kobi Sliwinski. Before mainnet, the protocol went through public testing including red teaming, penetration testing, repeated migration rehearsals and a security competition, followed by testnet and devnet launches. Further upgrades — Rotor for block data propagation, geographically aware leader rotation, and a post-quantum research design called Quantumglow — are planned but have no committed dates.
updates.background_zh: TowerBFT 自 2020 年 3 月 Solana 网络启动以来一直是其共识机制。Alpenglow 的设计由 Anza 研究团队于 2025 年 5 月发表，团队由苏黎世联邦理工学院教授 Roger Wattenhofer 带领，成员包括 Quentin Kniep 和 Kobi Sliwinski。在上主网之前，该协议经历了公开测试，包括红队测试、渗透测试、多次迁移演练和一场安全竞赛，随后在测试网和开发者网上线。后续升级还包括改变区块数据传播方式的 Rotor、地理感知的领导者轮换，以及抗量子研究设计 Quantumglow，但均未公布确定时间表。

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Anza's Alpenglow consensus protocol went live on Solana mainnet-beta, replacing TowerBFT and cutting transaction finality from roughly 12.8 seconds to 150 milliseconds at genesis slot 459,653,000 with 654 validators participating in a 900 ms switchover.
updates.market_impact_en: The upgrade directly affects Solana's base-layer settlement speed, the channel through which exchanges, custodians and payment processors decide when a SOL or token transfer counts as settled; shorter finality could change deposit-crediting and withdrawal policies on centralized venues and reduce the confirmation wait baked into on-chain trading and bridging flows. It also alters validator vote mechanics, since votes are now sent directly between validators and weighted by stake rather than written into later blocks, which bears on validator operations and staking economics.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次升级直接影响 Solana 底层结算速度，而结算速度正是交易所、托管机构和支付处理方判断 SOL 或代币转账何时算作已完成的依据；最终性缩短可能改变中心化平台的充提确认策略，并压缩链上交易与跨链流程中的等待时间。升级同时改变了验证者的投票机制——投票不再写入后续区块，而是由验证者之间直接发送并按质押权重计算——这关系到验证者运维与质押经济模型。

updates.current_state_en: Maya Protocol Exploit Leaves $11M Pool Damage Unresolved; Attacker Still Holds 20.83 BTC
updates.current_state_zh: Maya Protocol 遭攻击约1100万美元缺口未解，攻击者仍持20.83 BTC
updates.detailed_summary_en: On Aug. 18, Maya Protocol suffered an exploit in which an attacker chained six accounting flaws to drain roughly 48.87 million CACAO and extract about $1.65–$1.7 million in assets. As of Aug. 21, the suspected attacker's Bitcoin address still holds 20.8273 BTC with no outgoing transactions, and Maya has not published a recovery plan for the wider ~$10.9 million pool impact. This exploit underscores persistent security risks in cross-chain liquidity protocols, where a single crafted transaction can trigger cascading pool losses. With ~$11 million in impact still unresolved and CACAO's price down 88.7%, user confidence in Maya Protocol and similar THORChain-based networks may be shaken. SigIntZero's technical reconstruction attributes the exploit to six accounting and state-handling flaws chained inside one 23-message transaction, which produced a false missing-transfer signal and credited ~49.45 million CACAO to a thin ARB.LINK pool. CryptoSlate analysis attributes ~$6.4 million of pool impact to CACAO repricing (from ~$0.115 to $0.013, an 88.7% decline) and ~$2.9 million to arbitrage.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: 8月18日，Maya Protocol 遭到攻击，攻击者串联六个会计漏洞，盗走约4887万枚CACAO，并提取约165万至170万美元的资产。截至8月21日，疑似攻击者的比特币地址仍持有20.8273 BTC且无任何转出交易，Maya也未公布针对约1090万美元更大范围池损失的恢复计划。 此次攻击凸显了跨链流动性协议中持续存在的安全风险——单笔精心构造的交易就能引发连锁性的池损失。由于约1100万美元的影响仍未解决，且CACAO价格已下跌88.7%，用户对Maya Protocol及类似基于THORChain的网络的信心可能受到动摇。 SigIntZero的技术重建将攻击归因于一笔23条消息交易中串联的六个会计与状态处理缺陷——错误的重置状态触发了虚假的“转账缺失”信号，向一个薄弱的ARB.LINK池注入了约4945万枚CACAO。CryptoSlate分析认为，约640万美元的池损失来自CACAO重定价（从约0.115美元跌至0.013美元，跌幅88.7%），约290万美元来自套利。

updates.current_state_en: Washington Goes All-In on Crypto: Trump, SEC, CFTC Advance New Rules
updates.current_state_zh: 华盛顿全力拥抱加密：特朗普、SEC、CFTC齐推新规
updates.detailed_summary_en: This week, the SEC proposed its first crypto-specific rulemaking, Regulation Crypto Assets, allowing certain offerings of up to $5 million over four years or $75 million annually without full registration. President Trump hosted crypto executives at the White House and pressed Congress to pass a "fair version" of the Clarity Act, while CFTC Chairman Mike Selig launched the Innovation Advisory Committee and warned that the CFTC would use existing authorities to build its own crypto regime if the Act stalls. This marks a coordinated shift in U.S. crypto policy from enforcement toward formal rulemaking across both the SEC and CFTC, with White House backing. If enacted, these proposals could materially reshape how digital assets are issued and traded in the U.S., affecting issuers, exchanges, and investors. The SEC proposal includes a conditional safe harbor for crypto assets once an issuer's essential managerial efforts have ended, and it would preempt certain state securities registration requirements. The proposal was formally issued days after the scheduled vote was abruptly cancelled, and CFTC Chairman Selig has already directed staff to explore crypto-asset rules.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: 本周，SEC首次推出针对加密资产的规则提案“Regulation Crypto Assets”，允许特定项目在四年内募资不超过500万美元或每年不超过7500万美元而无需完全注册。特朗普总统在白宫会见加密行业高管，敦促国会通过“公平版本”的Clarity Act；CFTC主席Mike Selig则启动创新咨询委员会，并警告若法案受阻，CFTC将利用现有权力自行建立加密监管框架。 这标志着美国加密政策从“以执法为主导”转向SEC和CFTC的正式规则制定，并获得白宫支持。若这些提案落地，将实质性改变数字资产在美国的发行与交易方式，影响发行方、交易所和投资者。 SEC提案包含一个有条件的“安全港”条款：当发行方的关键管理努力结束后，相关加密资产可获豁免；同时该提案将优先于部分州的证券注册要求。该提案在预定投票被突然取消几天后正式发布；CFTC主席Selig已指示工作人员研究加密资产规则。

updates.background_en: The Senate failed to reach the 60 votes needed to advance the CLARITY Act, which would have created a statutory framework for digital assets. Crypto trading in the US currently runs under rules built for other markets or under state licenses that vary by state. The CFTC notice also disowns the agency's Biden-era cases against Kraken, Ooki DAO and Uniswap as regulation by enforcement.
updates.background_zh: 参议院未能达到推进《CLARITY 法案》所需的 60 票门槛，该法案本将为数字资产建立法定框架。美国加密交易目前要么适用为其他市场制定的规则，要么适用各州不一的地方牌照。CFTC 的这份通知还否定了该机构在拜登时期对 Kraken、Ooki DAO 和 Uniswap 的执法案件，称其为“以执法代替监管”。
updates.current_state_en: The CFTC published a preliminary plan to federally license and regulate crypto exchanges via proposed Regulations CTX and CAM and opened a 60-day public comment period, while the SEC cleared 3x levered Bitcoin and Ether funds for trading.
updates.current_state_zh:
CFTC 公布了一份初步提案，拟通过两项新规——Regulation CTX 与 Regulation CAM——建立加密交易所的联邦许可框架，文件在《联邦公报》刊登后将开启为期 60 天的公众意见征询期。此时距《Clarity 法案》在参议院夭折已有三周，同日 SEC 还批准了 3 倍杠杆的 BTC 和 ETH 基金上市交易。

该计划提出了单一的联邦许可选择，并以是否涉及杠杆来决定谁需要持牌，这是国会未能通过的框架，将允许美国交易平台提供目前无法提供的保证金类产品。不过这是一份征求意见的初步概念文件，并非具有约束力的规则文本。

牌照将覆盖撮合买卖双方、托管客户资金与加密资产、结算交易以及借贷，每项业务需分别获批；交易将通过已受反洗钱规则约束的经纪商进行，且只有这些经纪商或其保荐银行可以提供杠杆。该机构还在考虑储备金证明要求，以及针对易被操纵代币的上市标准；CFTC 主席 Mike Selig 表示，这些规则的目的是防止类似 FTX 的欺诈，而非事后追诉。
updates.detailed_summary_en: The CFTC published a preliminary plan to federally license and regulate crypto exchanges via proposed Regulations CTX and CAM and opened a 60-day public comment period, while the SEC cleared 3x levered Bitcoin and Ether funds for trading.

updates.background_en: The 2010 Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act is the law at the center of the argument over the CFTC's authority here. Prediction market providers operate under designated contract market (DCM) licenses issued by the CFTC. An amicus brief is an advocacy filing by a party that is not formally part of the case; the Supreme Court receives thousands of certiorari petitions a year but grants review in only a small fraction. The CFTC had sent both prediction-market rulemakings to the White House Office of Information and Regulatory Affairs for review before they were issued.
updates.background_zh: 2010 年《多德-弗兰克华尔街改革与消费者保护法案》是这场围绕 CFTC 权限之争的核心法律。预测市场服务商持有 CFTC 颁发的指定合约市场（DCM）牌照。法庭之友意见书是由非案件正式当事方提交的倡导性文件；最高法院每年收到数千份调卷令申请，但仅受理其中很小一部分。在正式发布之前，CFTC 已将这两项预测市场规则制定案送交白宫信息与监管事务办公室（OIRA）审查。
updates.current_state_en: A coalition including former officials, the NFL, 39 states and 145 tribal nations filed amicus briefs urging the Supreme Court to weigh in on whether sports-based prediction market contracts are swaps, while the CFTC issued two proposals — one an interim final rule already in effect — setting out its own position on the question.
updates.current_state_zh:
上周，包括前参议员 Chris Dodd、前 CFTC 与 SEC 主席 Gary Gensler、美国职业橄榄球大联盟（NFL）、39 个州及哥伦比亚特区以及 145 个部落民族在内的一批相关方提交了法庭之友意见书，敦促美国最高法院受理“以体育为基础的预测市场合约是否属于互换（swap）”这一问题。上周五，CFTC 就同一问题发布了两项方案，其中一项为已即刻生效的临时最终规则。

目前上诉法院之间已出现重大分歧：两个上诉法院裁定涉及体育的预测市场属于博彩产品、应由各州监管，而另一个上诉法院则裁定这属于 CFTC 的管辖范围。

Dodd 的意见书主张，《多德-弗兰克法案》的立法本意并非赋予 CFTC 取代各州博彩监管的权力，并指出将多个投注串联起来的“串关”（parlay）并不具有对冲或价格发现功能，因此不属于《商品交易法》下的互换；他还反驳了 CFTC 所获“专属管辖权”构成明确优先适用（preemption）条款的说法。据 CFTC 称，该临时最终规则将其长期立场成文化，即包括体育博彩和赌场投注在内的赌场式博彩产品被排除在“互换”定义之外，而另一项提案则将进一步把事件合约纳入互换的定义。
updates.detailed_summary_en: A coalition including former officials, the NFL, 39 states and 145 tribal nations filed amicus briefs urging the Supreme Court to weigh in on whether sports-based prediction market contracts are swaps, while the CFTC issued two proposals — one an interim final rule already in effect — setting out its own position on the question.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: A coalition including former officials, the NFL, 39 states and 145 tribal nations filed amicus briefs urging the Supreme Court to weigh in on whether sports-based prediction market contracts are swaps, while the CFTC issued two proposals — one an interim final rule already in effect — setting out its own position on the question.
updates.market_impact_en: The dispute determines which regulator — the CFTC or individual states — sets the listing and access rules for sports-based event contracts, so prediction-market platforms and other venues offering event contracts, including crypto-adjacent derivatives venues, carry the direct regulatory exposure. The interim final rule's exclusion of casino-style gambling products from the swap definition, and the companion proposal to define swaps to include event contracts, change the compliance baseline those venues operate under.
updates.market_impact_zh: 这场争议决定的是由 CFTC 还是由各州来制定体育类事件合约的上架与准入规则，因此直接承受监管风险的是预测市场平台以及其他提供事件合约的场所，包括与加密相关的衍生品交易场所。临时最终规则将赌场式博彩产品排除在互换定义之外，而配套提案又拟将事件合约纳入互换定义，这改变了上述场所所适用的合规基准。

updates.detailed_summary_en: CNBC reports that the rise of 24/7 perpetual futures trading has made Wall Street's adjustment to crypto derivatives 'urgent,' framing perpetuals as a '24/7 security on steroids.' The article signals growing institutional recognition that traditional trading models must adapt to round-the-clock digital asset markets. Perpetual futures are the most actively traded crypto derivatives, so any structural shift in Wall Street's stance can influence liquidity, price discovery, and volatility across digital assets. The urgency reflects competitive pressure on traditional exchanges and the growing mainstream relevance of crypto-native market infrastructure. Perpetual futures have no expiration date and rely on a funding rate mechanism to keep contract prices anchored to spot markets, enabling leveraged positions that can be held indefinitely. The CNBC headline emphasizes that this product class now represents a structural challenge to conventional market hours, clearing, and risk frameworks.

updates.detailed_summary_en: The Alignment Science blog introduces a method for evaluating explanations of large language model behavior using counterfactual experiments, rather than relying on intuition or surface-level plausibility. The paper, titled 'Would this change your answer? Evaluating Explanations of LLM Behavior In The Wild with Counterfactual Experiments,' is authored by Adam Karvonen and colleagues. This matters because the AI interpretability and alignment fields lack rigorous standards for judging whether an explanation of model behavior is actually correct. Counterfactual testing offers a more scientific way to validate explanations, which could improve trust and safety in deployed LLMs. The approach applies counterfactual experiments 'in the wild,' meaning it tests explanations on real model behaviors rather than synthetic or controlled cases. The paper appears on arXiv under identifier 2608.16747, with Adam Karvonen as the first author.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: 该 Alignment Science 博客提出用反事实实验来评估大语言模型行为的解释，而不是依赖直觉或表面合理性。相关论文由 Adam Karvonen 等人撰写。 这很重要，因为 AI 可解释性和对齐领域缺乏判断模型行为解释是否正确严谨的标准。反事实测试提供了一种更科学的验证方式，有助于提升已部署 LLM 的可信度与安全性。 该方法将反事实实验应用于'真实场景'，即在真实模型行为上检验解释，而非合成或受控案例。论文在 arXiv 上的编号为 2608.16747，第一作者为 Adam Karvonen。

updates.current_state_en: Coldcard Firmware Update Mitigates $130M Bitcoin Seed-Entropy Exploit
updates.current_state_zh: Coldcard发布固件更新修复致1.3亿美元比特币被盗的种子熵漏洞
updates.detailed_summary_en: Coinkite released firmware 5.6.1 for Coldcard Mk4/Mk5 and 1.5.1Q for Coldcard Q after a three-week security review, fixing a seed-generation entropy flaw. Users now must add at least 65 key presses, 50 dice rolls, or 128 coin flips when generating a new seed, and affected users are told to migrate to a fresh seed. This exploit directly contradicts the core promise of hardware wallets—that private keys remain safe even when the device is offline—by allowing attackers to guess keys generated with insufficient randomness. The incident highlights that a hardware wallet's security is only as strong as its random number generation, and it may push vendors and users to demand verifiable entropy sources. The flaw reduced effective entropy from 128 bits to roughly 40 bits on some devices and dates back to 2021, according to Coinkite. The update also replaces the Yasmarang backup pseudo-random number generator with SHA-256 Hash_DRBG, adds hardware RNG failure checks, verifies PSBTs immediately before signing, and tightens USB and Delta Mode handling.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Coinkite公司在为期三周的安全审查后，为Coldcard Mk4/Mk5发布了5.6.1固件、为Coldcard Q发布了1.5.1Q固件，修复了种子生成过程中的熵缺陷。现在用户生成新种子时必须至少加入65次按键、50次掷骰子或128次抛硬币的随机输入，受影响用户被要求迁移到全新的种子。 这一漏洞直接违背了硬件钱包的核心承诺——即使设备离线，私钥也是安全的——因为攻击者可以猜出因随机性不足而生成的密钥。该事件凸显出硬件钱包的安全性完全取决于其随机数生成强度，可能促使厂商和用户要求可验证的熵来源。 据Coinkite称，该漏洞使部分设备的有效熵从128比特降至约40比特，且可追溯到2021年。此次更新还以SHA-256 Hash_DRBG替换了Yasmarang备用伪随机数生成器，增加了硬件随机数生成器故障检查，在签名前立即验证PSBT，并加强了USB和Delta Mode的处理。

updates.background_en: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong has argued publicly that AI agents could reshape how corporate software is built and bought, saying companies could move faster if internal platforms had to compete for internal users the way products compete for external customers. Through 2026, regulated exchanges including Coinbase and Gemini have enabled crypto trading through APIs that AI agents can call, with stablecoins playing a dominant role in autonomous agent payments.
updates.background_zh: Coinbase 首席执行官 Brian Armstrong 曾公开表示，AI 智能体可能重塑企业软件的构建与采购方式，他认为如果内部平台必须像面向外部客户的产品那样争夺内部用户，企业推进速度会更快。进入 2026 年，包括 Coinbase 和 Gemini 在内的受监管交易所已通过 API 支持加密交易，使 AI 智能体可以调用，而稳定币在自主智能体支付中扮演主导角色。
updates.current_state_en: Coinbase Launches AI Agent Platform for Crypto Payments, COIN Rises 3%
updates.current_state_zh: Coinbase推出AI代理交易平台，COIN股价上涨3%
updates.detailed_summary_en: Coinbase introduced a payments platform that lets AI agents autonomously buy, sell, and pay using cryptocurrency, and COIN stock gained over 3% on the news. This marks a concrete step toward 'agentic finance,' where autonomous AI systems use crypto as their financial backend. It also positions Coinbase at the intersection of AI and crypto, potentially opening new revenue streams from machine-to-machine payments. According to Decrypt, Coinbase's new tool is an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that allows AI agents to hold wallets and send stablecoin payments, and it builds on Coinbase's x402 protocol for machine-to-machine transfers.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Coinbase推出了一个允许AI代理自主买卖和支付加密货币的平台，消息公布后COIN股价上涨超过3%。 这标志着向‘代理金融’（agentic finance）迈出了切实一步，自主AI系统将加密货币作为其金融后端。同时，这也让Coinbase占据了AI与加密的交汇点，可能从机器对机器支付中开辟新的收入来源。 据Decrypt报道，Coinbase的新工具是一个MCP（模型上下文协议）服务器，允许AI代理持有钱包并发送稳定币支付，它建立在Coinbase用于机器对机器转账的x402协议之上。
updates.market_impact_en: The story transmits mainly through sentiment and positioning: COIN's equity move reflects how investors price exchange exposure to AI-agent order flow, while broader agent-commerce narratives touch exchange API volumes, stablecoin payment rails used by agents, and AI-agent-related crypto tokens. Any effect on volumes or fees is not yet evidenced by the source.
updates.market_impact_zh: 这条消息主要通过情绪与仓位传导：COIN 的股价变化体现投资者如何为交易所承接 AI 智能体订单流的敞口定价；而更广泛的智能体商业叙事则涉及交易所 API 交易量、智能体使用的稳定币支付通道以及 AI 智能体相关加密代币。至于对交易量或手续费收入的实际影响，目前尚无来源证据支持。

updates.detailed_summary_en: Bitcoin jumped to a three-month high of $78,449, erasing more than $4 billion in short positions over a three-day rally. The move was fueled by Treasury buyback announcements and over $1 billion in spot Bitcoin ETF inflows, with CryptoQuant's Bull Score Index returning to bullish territory at 60. The rally shows how macro policy shifts and institutional demand can combine to trigger sharp derivatives repricing in crypto. The Bull Score's return to bullish after failing at May's highs signals stronger underlying market conditions, though the sustainability of the move now depends on sustained spot buying rather than short covering. CryptoQuant's Bull Score Index climbed to 60, its first bullish reading since October 2025, with six of its ten components turning positive, including demand growth, stablecoin liquidity, and trader realized price. Analysts are divided: Nansen's Nicolai Søndergaard noted ETF inflows helped reclaim key moving averages, while Alphractal CEO Joao Wedson called the move 'a relief rally' and said nothing has fundamentally changed.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: 比特币在三天涨势中升至三个月高点78,449美元，抹去超过40亿美元的空头头寸。美国财政部回购公告和超过10亿美元的现货比特币ETF流入推动了这波行情，CryptoQuant的牛市评分指数也重新回到60的看涨区域。 这轮涨势表明宏观政策变化与机构需求相结合，可能引发加密货币衍生品市场的剧烈重新定价。牛市评分在5月高点时未能突破后重回看涨区域，表明市场基本面有所改善，不过行情的可持续性现在依赖于持续的现货买盘而非空头回补。 CryptoQuant的牛市评分指数升至60，为2025年10月以来首次进入看涨区域，十个指标中有六个转为正面，包括需求增长、稳定币流动性和交易者实现价格。分析师观点存在分歧：Nansen的Nicolai Søndergaard指出ETF流入帮助收复关键均线，而Alphractal首席执行官Joao Wedson称这不过是'救济性反弹'，基本面并未改变。

The charges could set a chilling precedent for digital privacy and civil liberties at U.S. borders, where the government asserts sweeping powers to inspect electronic devices. If the prosecution succeeds, it may deter travelers from exercising control over their personal data and escalate concerns about government overreach. The available reporting identifies Samuel Tunick as the person charged but does not disclose the specific felony counts or the legal theory behind them. The case has become a flashpoint in the ongoing debate over the scope of border-search powers and the right to data privacy.

events.title_en: Cosmos EVM shared-module flaw and multi-chain losses
events.title_zh: Cosmos EVM 共享模块漏洞与多链损失

updates.current_state_en: The impact initially appeared limited to one chain.
updates.current_state_zh: 影响最初被视为单链事件。
updates.detailed_summary_en: On August 21, 2026, MANTRA Chain halted all transactions, transfers, and staking after an attacker exploited a vulnerability in an upstream dependency linked to its Cosmos EVM module. The patched release v8.4.0 is being tested on the DuKong testnet before a coordinated mainnet restart can occur. This is a high-impact security event for MANTRA users and the broader Cosmos ecosystem, as the network-wide freeze silences all onchain activity and raises questions about the security of third-party dependencies. The incident could affect trust in Cosmos-based EVM chains and in the safety of upstream open-source components. The MANTRA team says the halt itself did not affect user funds, but the full asset impact of the attacker's activity remains unconfirmed and fund movements are being traced. Validators are instructed to keep mainnet nodes offline until a coordinated restart is announced, with DuKong testnet testing serving as the gate for the patched release.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: 2026年8月21日，MANTRA Chain在发现攻击者利用与其Cosmos EVM模块相关的上游依赖漏洞后，暂停了所有交易、转账和质押。修复版本v8.4.0正在DuKong测试网上测试，之后才能进行协调的主网重启。 此次事件对MANTRA用户和整个Cosmos生态系统影响重大，因为全网暂停使所有链上活动停止，并引发了对第三方依赖安全性的质疑。这一事件可能影响市场对基于Cosmos的EVM链及上游开源组件安全的信任。 MANTRA团队表示，暂停本身并未影响用户资金，但攻击者活动的完整资产影响尚未确认，资金流向正在追踪中。验证者被要求在官方宣布协调重启前保持主网节点离线，DuKong测试网的测试是补丁版本上线的门槛。
updates.title_en: MANTRA halted its network over a Cosmos EVM module incident.
updates.title_zh: MANTRA 因 Cosmos EVM 模块事件暂停网络。
updates.what_changed_en: MANTRA halted its network over a Cosmos EVM module incident.
updates.what_changed_zh: MANTRA 因 Cosmos EVM 模块事件暂停网络。

updates.current_state_en: The incident expanded into a multi-chain shared-component failure.
updates.current_state_zh: 事件扩大为共享组件导致的多链安全事故。
updates.detailed_summary_en:
Cosmos Labs recommended that EVM chains built on its shared stack halt operations after a vulnerability drained three networks. KiiChain, one of the affected chains, reported losing 148 million tokens, and the halt advisory came six days after a patch shipped without a public security advisory.

A shared vulnerability in the Cosmos EVM stack means many chains may be exposed at once, not just a single network. This incident can undermine trust in the ecosystem and highlights the critical need for coordinated security disclosure across interconnected chains.

KiiChain stated that two of the three underlying defects remain unfixed upstream. The delay between the patch release and the public advisory may have left other chains unaware of the critical risk.
updates.detailed_summary_zh:
Cosmos Labs 呼吁基于其共享堆栈构建的 EVM 链暂停运营，因为一个漏洞导致三条网络被盗。受影响链之一 KiiChain 报告损失了 1.48 亿枚代币，而暂停建议是在补丁发布六天后才发出，且当时未发布公开安全公告。

Cosmos EVM 堆栈的共享漏洞意味着许多链可能同时暴露在风险中，而不仅仅是单个网络。此类事件可能削弱用户对生态系统的信任，并凸显跨链协调安全披露的迫切必要性。

KiiChain 表示，三个底层缺陷中有两个在上游仍未修复。补丁发布与公开安全公告之间的延迟，可能让其他链未能及时意识到这一严重风险。
updates.title_en: Cosmos Labs urged affected EVM chains to halt after losses were confirmed across at least three networks.
updates.title_zh: Cosmos Labs 要求采用该 EVM 模块的链暂停运行，已确认至少三条网络受损。
updates.what_changed_en: Cosmos Labs urged affected EVM chains to halt after losses were confirmed across at least three networks.
updates.what_changed_zh: Cosmos Labs 要求采用该 EVM 模块的链暂停运行，已确认至少三条网络受损。

updates.current_state_en: Scope and accountability are clearer; remediation remains under observation.
updates.current_state_zh: 影响范围和责任已经进一步确认，修复情况仍需观察。
updates.detailed_summary_en:
On August 28, Cosmos Labs disclosed that a misjudged EVM vulnerability was exploited across six networks, including MANTRA, TAC, and KiiChain, causing nearly $6 million in losses. The flaw was first reported on April 25 but was deemed low-risk due to decimal assumptions; a silent patch was merged on May 15, and the real exploit began on August 20 after the assessment was revised.

This incident exposes a months-long triage failure in a shared software layer — Cosmos EVM — that provides Ethereum compatibility to Cosmos SDK chains. With roughly 40 networks potentially affected and 11 previously unknown deployments discovered, it raises urgent questions about security disclosure and patch distribution across the broader Cosmos ecosystem.

The exploit combined two accounting failures: an unsigned-integer underflow created an abnormally large balance, which was then used to overflow another account and extract its legitimate balance without increasing total token supply. Cosmos Labs contacted 40 networks, with 13 potentially exposed chains patching, halting, or applying mitigations; MANTRA suffered the largest disclosed hit, with about 720.9 million tokens moved from two unauthorized addresses.
updates.detailed_summary_zh:
8 月 28 日，Cosmos Labs 披露一个被误判的 EVM 漏洞在包括 MANTRA、TAC 和 KiiChain 在内的六个网络上被利用，造成近 600 万美元损失。该漏洞于 4 月 25 日首次上报，但因小数位假设被评估为低风险；5 月 15 日合并了静默补丁，而在评估修正后，实际攻击始于 8 月 20 日。

该事件暴露出共享软件层 Cosmos EVM 在数月内的安全分级失误，而这一层为 Cosmos SDK 链提供以太坊兼容性。由于约 40 条网络可能受影响，并在响应过程中发现 11 个此前未知的部署，这引发了关于整个 Cosmos 生态中安全披露和补丁分发的紧迫问题。

该漏洞利用结合了两个记账缺陷：无符号整数下溢生成了异常巨大的余额，随后利用该状态使另一个账户溢出，从而在不增加总代币供应量的情况下提取其合法余额。Cosmos Labs 联系了 40 条网络，其中 13 条潜在暴露的链进行了修补、暂停或部署缓解措施；MANTRA 遭受了已披露的最大损失，约有 7.209 亿枚代币从两个未授权地址被转出。
updates.title_en: Later reporting said the flaw was underestimated for months, affected six chains, and prompted Cosmos Labs to acknowledge its error.
updates.title_zh: 后续调查称漏洞曾被低估数月，影响扩大到六条链，Cosmos Labs 承认判断失误。
updates.what_changed_en: Later reporting said the flaw was underestimated for months, affected six chains, and prompted Cosmos Labs to acknowledge its error.
updates.what_changed_zh: 后续调查称漏洞曾被低估数月，影响扩大到六条链，Cosmos Labs 承认判断失误。

updates.current_state_en: Munder Difflin: Run an Office of Your Own AI Coding Agent Clones
updates.current_state_zh: Munder Difflin：用AI克隆体组建“办公室”的多智能体编排工具
updates.detailed_summary_en: Munder Difflin is a free, open-source local desktop app that wraps existing terminal coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Copilot into a 'hive mind,' letting a single manager agent (Michael) coordinate an office of cloned agents. The project claims deterministic simulations that consume no tokens and has reportedly attracted 20K+ users within a week of launch. This tool addresses a pain point in multi-agent AI coding: coordinating multiple agents without wastefully burning tokens. It shows how existing coding-agent subscriptions can be repurposed into deterministic, reusable agent teams, potentially changing how developers think about agent orchestration and cost efficiency. The harness wraps the user's existing CLI coding agents and uses their hourly subscription limits, rather than charging separately. It claims deterministic simulations (same inputs produce same outcomes), token-free operation, and support for 'almost all' coding-agent harnesses, with the site listing Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, and nine more.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Munder Difflin 是一款免费开源本地桌面应用，将 Claude Code、Codex、Copilot 等现有终端编码代理封装成“蜂巢思维”，让一个管理者代理（Michael）协调一群克隆代理。该项目宣称支持确定性模拟、不消耗 token，并且上线一周内已吸引超过 2 万名用户。 该工具解决了多智能体 AI 编程中的一个痛点：在协调多个代理时不浪费 token。它展示了如何将已有的编码代理订阅重新用于确定性的、可复用的代理团队，可能改变开发者对代理编排和成本效率的思考方式。 该工具包装用户现有的 CLI 编码代理，并使用其每小时订阅限制，而非单独收费。它宣称具备确定性模拟（相同输入产生相同结果）、无 token 消耗，并支持“几乎所有”编码代理；官网列出了 Claude Code、Codex、Copilot 等九种以上代理。

events.current_state_en: BitMart unveiled a preliminary, court-approval-dependent plan to compensate users for an estimated $319.5M reserve shortfall, offering choices between front-end distributions in fiat/stablecoins/major tokens, 1:1-per-dollar recovery tokens for hack asset tracing, or DEX-tradeable continuation tokens tied to investment and illiquid-asset recoveries and potential future profit sharing.
events.current_state_zh: BitMart公布了一项初步的、需经法院批准的计划，以补偿用户约3.195亿美元的储备金缺口，提供多种选择：以法币/稳定币/主流代币进行前端分配，按1美元兑1美元发行的用于追踪被盗资产的恢复代币，或与投资和流动性不足资产回收及潜在未来利润分成挂钩、可在DEX交易的延续代币。
events.title_en: BitMart shutdown, withdrawal restrictions and restructuring
events.title_zh: BitMart关闭、提现限制与法院监督重组及资产分配方案

updates.current_state_en: A restructuring direction exists, but payout terms and timing were still unknown.
updates.current_state_zh: 重组方向已提出，但偿付条款和时间表尚未公布。
updates.detailed_summary_en: BitMart is reportedly considering a partial restart and creditor payouts weeks after it announced it would shut down, according to CoinDesk. This matters because it could determine whether BitMart's users recover funds and whether the exchange retains any viability. It also affects confidence in centralized crypto exchanges during a period of consolidation and insolvencies. The report says the exchange is weighing options for a partial restart alongside creditor payouts, weeks after the shutdown announcement. Specific terms, amounts, and timelines have not been disclosed.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: 据 CoinDesk 报道，BitMart 在宣布关闭数周后，正考虑部分重启并向债权人进行偿付。 这很关键，因为它可能决定 BitMart 用户能否收回资金，以及该交易所是否仍具备存续能力。在行业整合与破产频发的背景下，这也会影响用户对中心化加密货币交易所的信心。 报道称，这家交易所在宣布关闭数周后，正在权衡部分重启以及债权人偿付等选项。具体条款、金额和时间表尚未公布。
updates.title_en: After announcing a shutdown, BitMart began considering a partial restart and creditor payouts.
updates.title_zh: BitMart 在此前宣布关闭后，开始考虑部分重启和债权人偿付方案。
updates.what_changed_en: After announcing a shutdown, BitMart began considering a partial restart and creditor payouts.
updates.what_changed_zh: BitMart 在此前宣布关闭后，开始考虑部分重启和债权人偿付方案。

updates.current_state_en: Access to user funds faced additional uncertainty.
updates.current_state_zh: 用户资金可用性出现新的不确定性。
updates.detailed_summary_en: CryptoTicker reports that BitMart has blocked withdrawals for many coins, prompting immediate speculation about a possible security incident or liquidity shortage. No official statement had been released at the time of the report. Withdrawal freezes on a major centralized exchange directly affect users' ability to access their funds and are often viewed as an early warning sign of security breaches or solvency problems. The incident could erode trust in centralized exchanges and push more users toward self-custody. The report from CryptoTicker does not specify which coins are affected or whether the freeze is temporary. BitMart has a history of security problems, including a December 2021 breach in which a large portion of its crypto assets were stolen.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: CryptoTicker 报道称，BitMart 已暂停多种币种的提现，引发外界对其可能遭遇安全事件或流动性短缺的猜测。截至报道发布时，BitMart 尚未发布官方声明。 主要中心化交易所暂停提现将直接影响用户动用资金的能力，并常被视为安全漏洞或偿付能力问题的早期预警信号。这一事件可能削弱用户对中心化交易所的信任，推动更多人转向自我托管。 CryptoTicker 的报道未指明哪些币种受影响，也未说明暂停是否为临时性措施。BitMart 曾有安全事件记录，包括 2021 年 12 月发生的一起重大黑客攻击，导致其大量加密资产被盗。
updates.title_en: Withdrawals for multiple assets were restricted without an official explanation at publication.
updates.title_zh: 多种资产的提现被限制，且当时没有官方解释。
updates.what_changed_en: Withdrawals for multiple assets were restricted without an official explanation at publication.
updates.what_changed_zh: 多种资产的提现被限制，且当时没有官方解释。

updates.current_state_en: The trading shutdown remained; restructuring and creditor-distribution details awaited disclosure.
updates.current_state_zh: 交易停运安排未变，重组和债权人分配方案等待进一步披露。
updates.detailed_summary_en:
On Aug. 21, BitMart announced it is exploring a restructuring with White & Case that could allow phased service resumption alongside creditor distributions, while maintaining its prior Aug. 26 trading shutdown and recommended withdrawal deadline.

This matters because it attempts to offer an alternative to a full wind-down, yet customers still lack a concrete repayment framework, recovery estimate, or timetable. The uncertainty could erode trust in centralized exchanges and intensify regulatory and user pressure on BitMart.

The proposal does not change the 01:00 UTC Aug. 26 halt of spot, futures, and other trading, nor the recommended 05:00 UTC withdrawal submission time. BitMart says late withdrawal requests will move to a separate processing procedure, and the exchange expects to provide another update by Sept. 9.
updates.detailed_summary_zh:
8月21日，BitMart宣布正与White & Case探讨重组方案，可能在向债权人分配的同时分阶段恢复部分服务；但先前宣布的8月26日交易关闭和提现建议时限保持不变。

此事之所以重要，是因为BitMart试图提供全面清盘之外的替代方案，但用户仍缺乏具体的偿还框架、回收率预估或时间表。这种不确定性可能削弱用户对中心化交易所的信任，并加大监管与用户对BitMart的压力。

该方案并未改变8月26日01:00 UTC现货、合约及其他交易停运的安排，也未改变建议用户在05:00 UTC前提交提现的时间。BitMart表示，逾期提交的提现请求将转入单独处理流程，并预计在9月9日前提供进一步更新。
updates.title_en: BitMart engaged White & Case to assess restructuring and said a roadmap was due by Sept. 9.
updates.title_zh: BitMart 聘请 White & Case 评估重组，并承诺最迟 9 月 9 日给出路线图。
updates.what_changed_en: BitMart engaged White & Case to assess restructuring and said a roadmap was due by Sept. 9.
updates.what_changed_zh: BitMart 聘请 White & Case 评估重组，并承诺最迟 9 月 9 日给出路线图。

updates.background_en: BitMart announced a wind-down on July 26 after users reported withdrawal delays and scrutiny intensified over its financial condition and handling of customer assets. The exchange later indicated it was weighing a restructuring or restart rather than liquidation and pledged a roadmap by September 9. Alvarez & Marsal is known for corporate restructuring and interim management, so its involvement typically points to formal financial rehabilitation work. Echo Base organized an ad hoc committee of BitMart claimholders to coordinate claims and discussions with the exchange.
updates.background_zh: BitMart在用户报告提现延迟、其财务状况和客户资产处理受到质疑之后，于7月26日宣布停业清算。该交易所随后表示正在权衡重组或重启而非清盘，并承诺在9月9日前拿出路线图。Alvarez & Marsal以企业重组与临时管理著称，其介入通常意味着正式财务重整工作已启动。Echo Base则组织了BitMart非正式债权人委员会，以协调债权主张和与平台的交涉。
updates.current_state_en: BitMart's restructuring continues; it missed its Sept. 9 roadmap deadline and has appointed Alvarez & Marsal as financial adviser to evaluate assets and possible paths forward. A user feedback portal is planned within five working days, with further updates expected in the coming weeks.
updates.current_state_zh: BitMart 重组仍在进行；它错过了 9 月 9 日的路线图截止日期，并已聘请 Alvarez & Marsal 作为财务顾问评估资产和潜在路径，计划在五个工作日内上线用户反馈门户，未来数周将公布更多进展。
updates.detailed_summary_en: BitMart misses its restructuring roadmap deadline and appoints Alvarez & Marsal as financial adviser to evaluate its assets and options.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: BitMart misses its restructuring roadmap deadline and appoints Alvarez & Marsal as financial adviser to evaluate its assets and options.
updates.market_impact_en: The news directly affects confidence in BitMart and the broader centralized-exchange sector: when a platform misses restructuring deadlines and brings in a restructuring adviser, customer funds face elevated risk of prolonged freezing or impairment, which can push sentiment toward self-custody or competing exchanges. Holders of BitMart's BMX token and users with assets deposited on the exchange are the most directly exposed to the restructuring outcome.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该消息直接影响信心，涉及BitMart乃至更广泛的中心化交易所板块：当一家平台错过重组期限并引入重组顾问时，客户资金面临长期冻结或受损的风险上升，这种情绪可能促使市场倾向自我托管或转向其他交易平台。BitMart代币BMX的持有者以及在该平台存入资产的用户，最能直接受到重组结果的影响。

updates.title_en: BitMart misses roadmap deadline, appoints financial adviser
updates.title_zh: BitMart错过重组路线图期限，任命艾睿铂为财务顾问
updates.what_changed_en: BitMart missed its self-imposed Sept. 9 deadline for a restructuring roadmap and instead appointed Alvarez & Marsal as financial adviser to evaluate its assets and options, with a user feedback portal to launch within five working days and further updates over the next three weeks.
updates.what_changed_zh: BitMart 错失自行设定的 9 月 9 日重组路线图截止日期，改聘请 Alvarez & Marsal 作为财务顾问评估资产与可选方案，并计划在五个工作日内推出用户反馈门户，未来三周将滚动公布进展。

updates.background_en: BitMart is a digital asset trading platform operated by bachi.tech in the Cayman Islands, known for a December 2021 security breach in which hackers used stolen private keys to take assets from hot wallets. HackenProof's post-incident bounty listing puts the December 2021 loss at roughly $196 million, while BitMart's proposal values the resulting reserve loss and balance-sheet gap at about $319.5 million using Dec. 4, 2021 prices.
updates.background_zh: BitMart 是由 bachi.tech 在开曼群岛运营的数字资产交易平台，因 2021 年 12 月的安全事件而受到关注，当时黑客利用窃取的私钥从热钱包转走资产。HackenProof 的事件后悬赏页面将 2021 年 12 月的损失列为约 1.96 亿美元，而 BitMart 的方案按 2021 年 12 月 4 日价格将由此造成的储备损失及资产负债表缺口折算为约 3.195 亿美元。
updates.current_state_en: BitMart's restructuring has entered a court-supervised initial proposal stage, with an asset distribution plan and three user exit options presented; it will consult its top 50 users over the next three to four weeks.
updates.current_state_zh: BitMart 重组进入法院监督下的初步方案阶段，已提出资产分配意向和三种用户退出选项，并将在未来三至四周征询前 50 大用户意见。
updates.detailed_summary_en: BitMart has published an initial court-supervised plan to address its balance sheet gap, converting user balances to USD and offering three exit routes — an immediate pro-rata payout in fiat, stablecoins and major tokens, a recovery token tied to stolen-asset clawbacks, or a DEX-tradable continuation token backed by investment rights and illiquid assets.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: BitMart has published an initial court-supervised plan to address its balance sheet gap, converting user balances to USD and offering three exit routes — an immediate pro-rata payout in fiat, stablecoins and major tokens, a recovery token tied to stolen-asset clawbacks, or a DEX-tradable continuation token backed by investment rights and illiquid assets.
updates.market_impact_en: BitMart is a mid-tier centralized exchange, so direct exposure is concentrated in its own users and balances; the transmission channel is counterparty and custody risk sentiment, which can prompt scrutiny of other venues carrying unresolved hack-related liabilities or large balance-sheet gaps. If the DEX-tradable continuation token is issued, it would create a separate secondary-market instrument whose value would depend on recovery outcomes under the court-supervised process.
updates.market_impact_zh: BitMart 属于中型中心化交易所，直接风险敞口集中在其自身用户与余额之上；传导渠道主要是交易对手与托管风险情绪，可能促使市场审视其他仍背负未了结黑客损失或较大资产负债表缺口的平台。若可 DEX 交易的延续代币最终发行，将形成一个新的二级市场标的，其价值取决于法院监督下追索与变现的进展。

updates.detailed_summary_en: The Sandbox, a Web3 gaming network, stopped bridging to Base and BNB Chain after discovering an exploit. South Korean exchanges Upbit and Bithumb froze SAND transfers, with Upbit also halting deposits and withdrawals on Ethereum, which the studio says was not affected. Bridge exploits can directly jeopardize user funds and are among the highest-value targets in crypto, so any halt in a prominent gaming network raises security concerns across the ecosystem. The exchange freeze in South Korea also shows how national user-protection rules can interrupt trading in affected tokens. The Sandbox said the exploit affected bridging to Base and BNB Chain, while Ethereum was reportedly not impacted. Upbit's action followed South Korea's user-protection law, under which exchanges may block transfers when a hack has occurred or is clearly expected to occur; no loss figure has been published.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Web3游戏网络The Sandbox在发现漏洞后，暂停了与Base和BNB Chain的桥接。韩国交易所Upbit和Bithumb冻结了SAND的转账，其中Upbit还暂停了以太坊链上的充提及提现，而The Sandbox表示以太坊链并未受影响。 桥接漏洞可能直接危及用户资金，是加密领域价值最高的攻击目标之一，因此知名游戏网络暂停桥接会在整个生态中引发安全担忧。韩国交易所的冻结也显示，国家层面的用户保护法规可能中断受影响代币的交易。 The Sandbox表示，漏洞影响了与Base和BNB Chain的桥接，而以太坊据称未受影响。Upbit的行动依据韩国用户保护法，该法允许交易所在黑客攻击已发生或明显可能发生时阻止转账；目前尚未公布具体损失金额。

updates.detailed_summary_en: Zcash's price reached an eight-year high near $850, with 24-hour futures volume hitting nearly $10 billion and open interest at $1.76 billion, according to CoinGlass. The surge came as Grayscale pushed forward with a Zcash ETF filing. This surge signals growing mainstream interest in privacy-focused cryptocurrencies and could pave the way for the first privacy-coin ETF in the US. The high futures volume shows derivatives, not spot trading, are driving the rally, which also carries volatility risks. Derivatives accounted for the bulk of activity, with nearly $10 billion in 24-hour futures volume and $1.76 billion in open interest, per CoinGlass. Grayscale's ETF filing would be the first for a privacy-focused digital asset, and Zcash's previous price around this level dates back to its early trading days in 2018.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: 据CoinGlass数据，Zcash价格已创下约850美元的八年新高，24小时期货交易量接近100亿美元，未平仓合约达17.6亿美元。此次上涨恰逢Grayscale推进Zcash ETF的申报。 此次飙升表明市场对隐私加密货币的兴趣上升，并可能为美国首只隐私币ETF铺平道路。高期货交易量显示当前涨势主要由衍生品而非现货交易驱动，这同时也带来了波动性风险。 据CoinGlass数据，衍生品占据大部分交投活动，24小时期货交易量接近100亿美元，未平仓合约达17.6亿美元。Grayscale的ETF申报将是首个面向隐私型数字资产的产品，而Zcash上一次接近该价位还需追溯至2018年的早期交易时期。

updates.background_en: Zcash is a privacy-centric cryptocurrency that uses zero-knowledge proofs to shield transaction details, unlike Bitcoin's transparent ledger. Grayscale converted its nine-year-old Zcash Trust into ZCSH, the first US-listed spot ETF for a privacy coin, which started trading on NYSE Arca on August 25 with roughly $304 million in inherited assets. Proponents argue Zcash has Bitcoin-like features including a fixed 21 million supply and a tail emission schedule, while also working on higher throughput and formal verification of its shielded pool. Grayscale's research also frames AI-driven blockchain analysis as a new wave of financial-privacy concerns that could favor Zcash.
updates.background_zh: Zcash 是一种以隐私为核心的加密货币，利用零知识证明隐藏交易详情，不同于 Bitcoin 的透明账本。灰度将其成立九年的 Zcash Trust 转换为 ZCSH，成为美国首只上市交易的隐私币现货 ETF，于 8 月 25 日在 NYSE Arca 开始交易，初始继承了约 3.04 亿美元资产。支持者认为，Zcash 具备类似 Bitcoin 的固定 2100 万枚总量和尾随排放（tail emission）等特性，同时还在致力于提高交易吞吐量并对屏蔽池进行形式化验证。灰度研究还认为，AI 驱动的区块链分析将引发新一轮金融隐私担忧，这可能有利于 Zcash。

With Bitcoin still around 93% of Grayscale's Currencies Crypto Sector, this is largely an asset-specific event whose broader market effect hinges on whether sustained ETF inflows persist rather than on immediate contagion to major cryptocurrencies.
updates.market_impact_zh: 市场传导可通过 ETF 资金流入、期货持仓和清算潮体现：ZCSH 为传统投资者提供了受监管的 ZEC 敞口，而 CoinGlass 数据显示未平仓合约超 20 亿美元，表明杠杆衍生品资金会同时放大上行和下行波动。由于 Bitcoin 在灰度加密板块中的占比仍约为 93%，这更多是单一资产事件，其对整体市场的广泛影响取决于 ETF 资金流入能否持续，而非对主流加密货币形成直接传染效应。

updates.detailed_summary_en: The article breaks down why local LLMs often underperform expectations, focusing on quantization, context window management, and inference configurations. It includes community benchmarks and practical deployment tips. Understanding these performance factors is crucial for anyone deploying local LLMs, as poor setup can make capable models appear weak. It highlights the growing maturity of local inference as a practical alternative to cloud APIs. The discussion covers quantization formats such as NVFP4 and AWQ W4A16, noting that low-quality quants can lead to tool-call failures. Community members report that using Q8 quantization and avoiding KV cache compression help preserve accuracy, while llama.cpp's grammar enforcement can prevent malformed tool calls.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: 这篇文章剖析了本地大模型为什么常常表现不如预期，重点讨论了量化、上下文窗口管理和推理配置。文中还包含了社区基准测试和实用的部署建议。 理解这些影响性能的因素，对任何部署本地大模型的人都很重要，因为不合理的配置会让能力很强的模型显得很弱。这也反映了本地推理正逐渐成熟，成为云端 API 之外的实用替代方案。 讨论中提到了 NVFP4 和 AWQ W4A16 等量化格式，并指出低质量量化可能导致工具调用失败。社区成员报告称，使用 Q8 量化并避免对 KV 缓存进行压缩有助于保持准确性，而 llama.cpp 的语法约束机制可以防止格式错误的工具调用。

updates.background_en: The CFTC oversees Bitcoin, Ether and other assets designated as digital commodities, along with regulated derivatives venues in the US. Perpetual futures differ from traditional futures in that they have no expiry date and instead use periodic funding payments to keep the contract anchored to spot prices, which is why they have become the most heavily traded crypto derivatives instrument globally.
updates.background_zh: CFTC 负责监管比特币、以太坊等被认定为数字商品的资产，以及美国受监管的衍生品交易场所。永续期货与传统期货的区别在于没有到期日，而是通过定期资金费率使合约价格锚定现货价格，这也使其成为全球成交最活跃的加密衍生品品种。
updates.current_state_en: CFTC Clears Bitcoin Perpetual Futures for US Markets
updates.current_state_zh: CFTC为美国市场扫清比特币永续期货障碍
updates.detailed_summary_en: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) has cleared the way for Bitcoin perpetual futures trading in U.S. markets, marking a significant regulatory milestone for crypto derivatives. This opens the door for a popular derivative product that had limited availability to U.S. traders. This decision materially expands market access for Bitcoin perpetual futures in the U.S., one of the world's largest derivatives markets. It could channel more institutional liquidity into crypto derivatives and influence how crypto assets are traded and hedged in regulated venues. Perpetual futures differ from traditional futures in having no expiry date, so positions can be held indefinitely and are settled in cash. The CFTC's clearance implies U.S.-regulated venues can now offer these contracts, though the exact mechanics and which platforms are eligible were not detailed in the announcement.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: 美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）已为比特币永续合约在美国市场的交易扫清障碍，成为加密货币衍生品监管的一个重要里程碑。这为过去美国交易者难以接触的这一热门衍生品打开了大门。 该决定实质性扩大了比特币永续合约在美国这一全球最大衍生品市场之一的市场准入。它可能为加密货币衍生品带来更多机构流动性，并影响加密资产在受监管场所的交易和对冲方式。 永续合约与传统期货不同，没有到期日，可以无限期持有并以现金结算。CFTC的批准意味着受美国监管的交易平台现在可以提供这类合约，但公告未详细说明具体机制及哪些平台有资格。
updates.market_impact_en: The channel is market structure and access: a CFTC-cleared Bitcoin perpetual contract would be exposed to the same underlying BTC price as offshore perpetuals, but would sit inside US clearing and supervision, potentially shifting some perpetual-related volume, liquidity and custody arrangements toward regulated US venues while offshore venues continue to dominate the product today.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道在于市场结构与准入：获得 CFTC 批准的比特币永续合约与离岸永续合约挂钩同一 BTC 标的，但被纳入美国的清算与监管框架，可能使部分永续合约相关的成交量、流动性与托管安排向美国合规场所转移，而离岸场所目前仍主导这一产品。

updates.current_state_en: HSBC and Standard Chartered Complete First Interbank Transaction on SWIFT Ledger
updates.current_state_zh: 汇丰与渣打完成SWIFT区块链账本首笔银行间交易
updates.detailed_summary_en: Standard Chartered and HSBC completed the first interbank transaction on SWIFT's blockchain-based ledger. This marks a milestone in institutional blockchain adoption following SWIFT's plan to embed a DLT-based ledger into its core infrastructure. This is significant because two global systemically important banks are transacting on a blockchain ledger within the existing SWIFT framework, bridging traditional finance and DLT. It could accelerate institutional adoption of tokenised cross-border payments and validate SWIFT's role as a trusted neutral infrastructure. SWIFT announced in September 2025 that it would embed a blockchain-based shared ledger into its core. Seventeen banks from six continents are preparing to pilot live tokenised cross-border payment transactions on the ledger, and the Standard Chartered–HSBC transaction is the first interbank transaction on it.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: 渣打银行与汇丰银行在SWIFT基于区块链的账本上完成了首笔银行间交易。这标志着在SWIFT计划将基于DLT的账本嵌入核心基础设施之后，机构区块链采用迎来一个里程碑。 此事意义重大，因为两家全球系统重要性银行在现有SWIFT框架内通过区块链账本完成交易，将传统金融与DLT连接起来。它可能加速机构采用代币化跨境支付，并巩固SWIFT作为可信中立基础设施的地位。 SWIFT于2025年9月宣布将基于区块链的共享账本嵌入其核心系统。来自六大洲的17家银行正准备在该账本上试点代币化跨境支付的实时交易，而渣打与汇丰的这笔交易是该账本上的首笔银行间交易。

updates.current_state_en: SEC proposes $75M crypto fundraising path with safe harbor to end securities contract
updates.current_state_zh: SEC提议加密项目融资7500万美元并设安全港终止证券合约
updates.detailed_summary_en: The SEC has proposed Regulation Crypto Assets, creating crypto-specific fundraising exemptions that allow projects to raise up to $75 million over 12 months, along with a conditional safe harbor (Rule 400) that lets issuers end the token's securities contract after fulfilling their promises. Comments are due October 20, and no project can use the exemptions until the SEC adopts a final rule. This is a landmark regulatory effort to give crypto projects a compliant on-ramp for capital formation and an off-ramp from securities status, potentially reshaping how tokens are issued, listed, and traded in the US. If finalized, it would reduce legal uncertainty for issuers and exchanges and clarify the dividing line between a security sale and a functional token ecosystem. The proposal includes three fundraising lanes: a startup exemption up to $5 million over a four-year period, a Tier 1 exemption up to $20 million in 12 months, and a larger path up to $75 million, with disclosures and retail limits scaled to each tier. The Rule 400 safe harbor is available to any qualifying issuer, even if it raised capital through Regulation D or other exemptions, and requires a public filing and written explanation.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: 美国SEC提出了《Regulation Crypto Assets》加密资产条例，创建了加密项目专用融资豁免路径，允许项目在12个月内最高募集7500万美元，并提供有条件的Rule 400安全港，使发行人在完成承诺后可终止代币的证券合约。公众意见将于10月20日截止，在SEC通过最终规则前任何项目都不能使用该豁免。 这是一项具有里程碑意义的监管举措，为加密项目提供了合规的融资入口，以及退出证券状态的出口，可能重塑美国代币发行、上市和交易的方式。如果最终通过，将降低发行人和交易所的法律不确定性，并明确证券销售与功能性代币生态之间的分界线。 该提案包含三条融资通道：初创企业豁免在四年内最高500万美元，第一层（Tier 1）豁免在12个月内最高2000万美元，以及最高7500万美元的更大路径，并针对各层级设置了披露和散户购买限制。Rule 400安全港适用于任何合格的发行人，即使其通过Regulation D或其他豁免融资，也需提交公开文件并附书面说明。

updates.current_state_en: Microsoft Patches 'Perfect 10' Remote Code Execution Flaw in Entra ID
updates.current_state_zh: 微软修复Entra ID中“满分10分”的远程代码执行漏洞
updates.detailed_summary_en: Microsoft disclosed and patched CVE-2026-69836, a critical CVSS 10.0 remote code execution vulnerability in Microsoft Entra ID. The flaw requires no privileges or user interaction and is caused by insecure deserialization of untrusted data; Microsoft confirmed it was not exploited in the wild. Entra ID is the core cloud identity and access management service behind Microsoft 365, Azure, and thousands of third-party applications, so a privilege-free RCE in that platform is exceptionally dangerous even if already patched. The disclosure also shows the growing role of AI in discovering vulnerabilities that human reviewers may miss. The vulnerability stems from deserialization of untrusted data, allowing an unauthorized attacker to execute code over the network with low attack complexity. CVE-2026-69836 was published on August 20, 2026, and Microsoft later revised its exploitation status from 'Yes' to 'No,' calling the change informational only. No customer action is required.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: 微软披露并修复了Microsoft Entra ID中的一个严重漏洞CVE-2026-69836，其CVSS评分为10.0，属于远程代码执行漏洞。该漏洞无需任何权限或用户交互即可利用，根源是对不可信数据的反序列化处理不安全；微软确认该漏洞未被野外利用。 Entra ID是Microsoft 365、Azure及众多第三方应用背后的核心云身份与访问管理服务，因此该平台中出现无需权限的远程代码执行漏洞，即使已被修复也极其危险。此次披露也显示出AI在发现人工审查可能遗漏的漏洞方面发挥越来越重要的作用。 该漏洞源于对不可信数据的反序列化处理，攻击者可在低攻击复杂度下通过网络在未授权的情况下执行代码。CVE-2026-69836于2026年8月20日发布，微软随后将其利用状态从“是”改为“否”，仅称这是信息性修订。客户无需采取任何行动。

updates.current_state_en: AI Models Root Amazon Fire HD Tablet for $266; GLM-5.3 Finishes in a Day
updates.current_state_zh: 四款AI模型花266美元破解Fire HD平板：GLM-5.3一日搞定
updates.detailed_summary_en: An independent researcher spent $266 in AI API credits and used four AI models to reverse-engineer an Amazon Fire HD tablet, uncovering unpatched vulnerabilities and building a working root exploit. Chinese-model GLM-5.3 completed the job in a single day, while American frontier models declined the task due to safety guardrails. This demonstrates that large language models can now carry out sophisticated offensive security work with minimal human guidance, potentially democratizing vulnerability research. It also spotlights a behavioral divide between Chinese and American AI models on safety policies, a key debate in AI alignment. The exploit chain targets unpatched vulnerabilities in the Fire HD tablet's firmware. According to Z.ai, GLM-5.3 shares its base model with GLM-5.2, with all improvements coming from post-training; open weights are expected on Hugging Face within two weeks of its announcement.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: 一位独立研究者花费266美元的AI API额度，使用四款AI模型对亚马逊Fire HD平板进行逆向工程，发现了未修补的漏洞并构建出可用的root权限利用链。中国模型GLM-5.3在一天内完成了任务，而美国的前沿模型因安全护栏而拒绝执行。 这表明大语言模型如今能在极少人工指导下完成复杂的攻防安全研究，可能让漏洞研究更加普及。同时，它也凸显了中国与美国AI模型在安全策略上的行为差异，这是AI对齐领域的关键辩论。 该利用链针对Fire HD平板固件中的未修补漏洞。据Z.ai介绍，GLM-5.3与GLM-5.2共享同一基础模型，所有改进均来自后训练；其开放权重预计在发布后两周内上架Hugging Face。
