updates.detailed_summary_en: An on-chain analyst reports that about 19 MetaMask validators appear to have been compromised with reward fees diverted to a Tornado Cash-funded address, prompting roughly 17,000 validators (~523k ETH) to voluntarily exit even though only ~0.36 ETH was actually stolen.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: An on-chain analyst reports that about 19 MetaMask validators appear to have been compromised with reward fees diverted to a Tornado Cash-funded address, prompting roughly 17,000 validators (~523k ETH) to voluntarily exit even though only ~0.36 ETH was actually stolen.
updates.title_en: 分析师：疑似19个MetaMask验证者遭攻击，攻击者仅窃取约0.36 ETH奖励
updates.title_zh: 分析师：疑似19个MetaMask验证者遭攻击，攻击者仅窃取约0.36 ETH奖励
updates.what_changed_en: On-chain analyst reports about 19 MetaMask validators appear compromised with reward fees diverted to a Tornado Cash-funded address; roughly 17,000 validators (~523k ETH) voluntarily exited, though only ~0.36 ETH was actually stolen; some suspected affected validators remain unexited.
updates.what_changed_zh: 链上分析师报告约19个MetaMask验证者疑似遭攻击，奖励费用被转入Tornado Cash资助的地址；约1.7万个验证者主动退出，涉及约52.3万枚ETH，但攻击者实际窃取奖励仅约0.36 ETH；仍有部分疑似受影响验证者未退出。

updates.current_state_en: MetaMask disclosed a security incident affecting part of its infrastructure and is preemptively exiting roughly 17,000 validators holding about 523,000 ETH; on-chain researcher Kaden said that out of 19 validators receiving block rewards, 18 rewards were not sent to the intended fee recipient and instead went to an address funded by Tornado Cash, with the attacker actually obtaining about 0.36 ETH; about 821 potentially affected validators have not yet exited, and compromised signing keys could pose residual slashing risk; MetaMask said its staking service is non-custodial and it does not control users’ withdrawal keys, but has not disclosed the cause, full scope, or whether signing keys were exposed; new information shows Ethereum’s validator exit queue swelled to 773,447 ETH, the largest backlog since December 2025, implying about a 13-day 10-hour exit wait plus a 7.6-day sweep, with an entry queue of about 27 days; Lido previously said the full exit, withdrawal and re-entry cycle could take up to about 45 days.
updates.current_state_zh: MetaMask 披露影响部分基础设施的安全事件，并正预防性退出约 1.7 万个验证者，涉及约 52.3 万枚 ETH；链上研究者 Kaden 称 19 个获得区块奖励的验证者中 18 笔奖励未发送至原定 fee recipient，而是流向由 Tornado Cash 资金支持的地址，攻击者实际获取约 0.36 ETH；约 821 个可能受影响的验证者仍未退出，受损签名密钥可能带来残余罚没风险；MetaMask 称其质押服务为非托管且不控制用户提款密钥，但未披露事件原因、受影响范围或签名密钥是否暴露；新增信息显示以太坊验证者退出队列因此升至 773,447 ETH，为 2025 年 12 月以来最大积压，等待约 13 天 10 小时外加约 7.6 天 sweep，进入队列约 27 天；Lido 此前称退出、提取和重新进入周期可能长达约 45 天。
updates.detailed_summary_en: MetaMask is exiting roughly 17,000 validators (~523,000 ETH) after an on-chain analysis found block-proposal fee rewards diverted to a Tornado Cash-funded address, swelling Ethereum's validator exit queue to a nine-month high of 773,447 ETH while the scope of the breach and slashing risk remain undisclosed.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: MetaMask is exiting roughly 17,000 validators (~523,000 ETH) after an on-chain analysis found block-proposal fee rewards diverted to a Tornado Cash-funded address, swelling Ethereum's validator exit queue to a nine-month high of 773,447 ETH while the scope of the breach and slashing risk remain undisclosed.

updates.what_changed_en: Ethereum’s validator exit queue reached 773,447 ETH, the largest backlog since December 2025, implying about a 13-day 10-hour exit wait plus a 7.6-day sweep; the entry queue is about 27 days.
updates.what_changed_zh: 以太坊验证者退出队列升至 773,447 ETH，为 2025 年 12 月以来最大积压，等待约 13 天 10 小时外加约 7.6 天 sweep；进入队列约 27 天。

updates.background_en: Ethereum staking separates a validator's signing key from the withdrawal key that controls the staked ETH, so rotating signing keys does not by itself move funds. Because a validator key change means the existing validator is retired and a new one activated, the operator must go through Ethereum's validator exit and entry queues.
updates.background_zh: 以太坊质押将验证者的签名密钥与控制质押 ETH 的提款密钥分开，因此轮换签名密钥本身并不会转移资金。由于更换验证者密钥意味着旧验证者退出、新验证者启用，运营方须经过以太坊的验证者退出与进入队列。
updates.current_state_en: Consensys founder Joseph Lubin publicly stated that MetaMask wallets and customer funds were not affected by the infrastructure security incident; validator keys have been rotated as a precaution, and withdrawal keys remain separately held by clients, so no unauthorized transfers of staked ETH occurred.
updates.current_state_zh: Consensys 创始人 Joseph Lubin 公开表示，MetaMask 钱包和客户资金未受该基础设施安全事件影响，相关方已预防性轮换验证者密钥，且提款密钥由客户独立持有，因此未发生未经授权的质押 ETH 转移。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Consensys founder Joseph Lubin said a security incident hit part of the company's infrastructure but that no MetaMask wallets or customer funds appear affected, with validator keys rotated as a precaution and withdrawal keys held separately to prevent unauthorized staked-ETH transfers.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Consensys founder Joseph Lubin said a security incident hit part of the company's infrastructure but that no MetaMask wallets or customer funds appear affected, with validator keys rotated as a precaution and withdrawal keys held separately to prevent unauthorized staked-ETH transfers.
updates.market_impact_en: The incident is confined to Consensys-operated staking infrastructure rather than user custody, so the direct channel to markets runs through Ethereum validator operations: rotating keys sends affected validators through the exit and entry queues, which can shift queue waits and staking flows. Wallet-side exposure is limited to sentiment around self-custody tools, since Lubin said user keys and assets were not involved.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该事件局限于 Consensys 运营的质押基础设施，而非用户托管环节，因此对市场的直接传导渠道在于以太坊验证者运营：轮换密钥会使相关验证者经历退出与进入队列，可能影响队列等待时间与质押流向。钱包层面的影响主要限于自托管工具的市场情绪，因为 Lubin 表示用户密钥与资产未被涉及。

updates.what_changed_en: Consensys founder Joseph Lubin publicly responded for the first time, saying there is no indication that MetaMask wallets or customer funds were affected by the infrastructure security incident; as a precaution, his team and partners rotated validator keys, and he emphasized that validator and withdrawal keys are separate and the team does not hold clients' withdrawal keys, preventing unauthorized transfers of staked ETH.
updates.what_changed_zh: Consensys 创始人 Joseph Lubin 首次公开回应称，没有迹象显示 MetaMask 钱包或客户资金受到该基础设施安全事件影响；作为预防措施，团队与合作伙伴已轮换验证者密钥，并强调验证者密钥与提款密钥分离，团队不持有客户提款密钥，可防止未经授权的质押 ETH 转移。

updates.current_state_en: The precautionary validator exits tied to MetaMask’s infrastructure security incident pushed Ethereum’s exit queue to a 2026 peak of about 851,000 ETH on Oct. 2; about 786,000 ETH remained queued on Oct. 5 with an estimated wait of nearly 14 days. Lido expects the affected ETH to be gradually restaked over a process that could take up to about 45 days, with the last affected MetaMask validators expected to stop staking by Oct. 7. MetaMask said it found no indication wallets or customer funds were affected, and client withdrawal keys remain outside its control.
updates.current_state_zh: MetaMask 基础设施安全事件引发的预防性验证者退出已把以太坊退出队列推高至 2026 年峰值约 851,000 ETH（10 月 2 日），10 月 5 日仍有约 786,000 ETH 排队，等待接近 14 天；Lido 预计相关 ETH 将逐步重新质押，过程可能长达约 45 天，最后一批受影响 MetaMask 验证者预计 10 月 7 日前退出质押。MetaMask 表示未发现钱包或客户资金受影响，客户提款密钥不受其控制。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Ethereum's validator exit queue reached its longest of 2026 with about 786,000 ETH (~$2 billion) awaiting withdrawal and a nearly 14-day wait, after MetaMask began pulling validators as a precaution following a security incident, while entry queues fell over a quarter since early September.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Ethereum's validator exit queue reached its longest of 2026 with about 786,000 ETH (~$2 billion) awaiting withdrawal and a nearly 14-day wait, after MetaMask began pulling validators as a precaution following a security incident, while entry queues fell over a quarter since early September.

updates.what_changed_en: Ethereum’s validator exit queue became the longest of 2026 after MetaMask’s precautionary validator exits: about 851,000 ETH on Oct. 2, with about 786,000 ETH still queued on Oct. 5 and an estimated nearly 14-day wait; Lido expects the affected ETH to be gradually restaked over a process that could take up to about 45 days, with the last affected MetaMask validators expected to stop staking by Oct. 7. The entry queue separately fell to about 1.5 million ETH/25 days, down from about 2 million ETH/35 days in early September.
updates.what_changed_zh: 以太坊验证者退出队列在 MetaMask 预防性退出验证者后升至 2026 年最长：10 月 2 日约 851,000 ETH，10 月 5 日仍有约 786,000 ETH 排队，等待约 14 天；Lido 预计受影响 ETH 将逐步重新质押，整个过程可能长达约 45 天，最后一批受影响的 MetaMask 验证者预计在 10 月 7 日前停止质押。同时进入质押队列降至约 150 万 ETH、等待约 25 天，较 9 月初约 200 万 ETH/35 天降温。

updates.background_en: Gemini 4 Argon uses a new naming scheme and follows the cancellation of Gemini 3.5 Pro, with Google having focused on Gemini 3.8 Flash, according to 9to5Google. Frontier models are typically trained on vast datasets at very high cost, covering data acquisition and processing plus compute. Third-party comparison coverage places Gemini 4 Argon alongside OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra as a same-generation rival.
updates.background_zh: 据 9to5Google 报道，Gemini 4 Argon 采用了新的命名体系，此前谷歌取消了 Gemini 3.5 Pro，并将重心放在 Gemini 3.8 Flash 上。前沿模型通常基于海量数据训练，成本极高，涵盖数据获取与处理以及算力开支。第三方对比报道将 Gemini 4 Argon 与 OpenAI 的 GPT-6 Astra 视为同代竞争对手。
updates.current_state_en: Google released Gemini 4 'Argon', which it markets as its most powerful model to date and pitches as a workhorse for coding and cybersecurity tasks.
updates.current_state_zh:
谷歌于 2026 年 9 月 30 日（周三）发布 Gemini 4 Argon，将其宣传为迄今最强大的模型，并定位为面向编程与网络安全工作的主力模型。据 CNBC 报道，该模型首先面向选定的网络安全合作伙伴推出，而非全面开放。

这是谷歌在前沿模型竞争中的最新一次发布；据 CNBC 报道，其初始投放仅面向选定的网络安全合作伙伴，而非所有开发者。谷歌将其定位为开发者、专业人士与企业解决难题的伙伴。

谷歌博客称，Gemini 4 Argon 在编程、知识工作、网络安全防御和创意写作方面具备“前沿级能力”。第三方评测机构 Artificial Analysis 将“Gemini 4 Argon (High)”列为智能水平领先的模型之一，并称其相对同类模型定价合理。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Google released Gemini 4 'Argon', which it markets as its most powerful model to date and pitches as a workhorse for coding and cybersecurity tasks.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Google released Gemini 4 'Argon', which it markets as its most powerful model to date and pitches as a workhorse for coding and cybersecurity tasks.
updates.market_impact_en: The release has no direct on-chain, custody or token-supply linkage; any crypto read-through runs through sentiment in AI-narrative assets such as decentralized-compute and AI-agent tokens, which have historically reacted to frontier-model announcements from major labs. Because availability is initially gated to select partners, no immediate developer-demand shift is established.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该发布与链上资产、托管或代币供给没有直接关联；对加密市场的可能传导渠道是情绪面，即去中心化算力、AI 代理等 AI 叙事类资产历来会对头部实验室的前沿模型发布作出反应。由于模型初期仅面向选定合作伙伴开放，目前尚不能确立开发者需求层面的即时变化。

updates.current_state_en: Google DeepMind's Gemini 4 Argon is now open to global paid users after initially being limited to selected cybersecurity partners. It is available via the Gemini App (Google AI Pro/Ultra), Antigravity (Ultra only), and paid API; introductory API pricing is $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens until Nov 30, after which it doubles. Google also showcased video-driven robot skill learning, automated simulation generation, and an 87% score on the ERQA physical-reasoning benchmark.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Google has opened Gemini 4 Argon to all global paid users, showcasing video-driven robot skill learning (Apptronik's Apollo landing 7 straight sandbag throws), automated simulation generation, 87% on the ERQA physical-reasoning benchmark, and launch API pricing of $2/$10 per million tokens that doubles after November 30.

updates.what_changed_zh: Gemini 4 Argon 从仅面向部分网络安全合作伙伴，扩大至向全球所有付费用户正式开放；可在 Gemini App（Google AI Pro/Ultra）、Antigravity（仅 Ultra）和付费 API 使用；API 首发价每百万输入 2 美元、输出 10 美元，优惠持续至 11 月 30 日后翻倍。谷歌还展示了其视频驱动机器人技能学习和仿真生成能力，ERQA 得分 87%。

updates.background_en: The Ender Dragon is Minecraft's final boss, fought in the End dimension after locating a stronghold and activating a portal; in this run one agent threw Eyes of Ender twice to calculate a target about 43 meters away. Mineflayer is an open-source JavaScript framework for building Minecraft bots, which the agents used to read coordinates, inventory and surroundings, while a dedicated plugin handled pathfinding. Gemini 4 Argon is described in Google's developer documentation as a flagship reasoning model built for autonomous multi-step agents with a 1M-token context window, and Vals AI lists it at $4.00 per million input tokens and $20.00 per million output tokens.
updates.background_zh: 末影龙是《我的世界》的最终 Boss，玩家需先找到要塞、激活传送门才能进入末地；本次实验中一名 Agent 通过两次投掷末影之眼，计算出距目标仅 43 米的位置。Mineflayer 是一个用于构建《我的世界》机器人的开源 JavaScript 框架，Agent 借助它读取坐标、背包与周围环境，寻路则由现成插件负责。根据谷歌开发者文档，Gemini 4 Argon 是面向自主多步骤 Agent 的旗舰推理模型，具备 100 万 Token 上下文窗口；Vals AI 列出的价格为每百万输入 Token 4 美元、每百万输出 Token 20 美元。

updates.market_impact_en: The run's disclosed cost and token-consumption data provide a concrete reference point for the economics of long-horizon agentic inference, a channel that feeds the prevailing AI-compute and autonomous-agent narratives in crypto markets. There is no direct exposure to a specific protocol or token; the effect runs through sentiment around agent-themed and decentralized compute/inference segments rather than through any on-chain flow described here.
updates.market_impact_zh: 本次实验披露的成本与 Token 消耗数据，为长周期 Agent 推理的经济性提供了一个具体参照，这类信息会通过 AI 算力与自主 Agent 叙事影响加密市场的情绪。事件本身不直接涉及具体协议或代币，其传导路径是围绕 Agent 概念及去中心化算力／推理板块的市场情绪，而非文中描述的任何链上资金流动。

updates.what_changed_zh: 菲律宾中央银行部分暂停了向DCPay Philippines的InstaPay和PESONet入账银行转账，DCPay Philippines是当地领先加密平台Coins.ph的电子货币运营商，而转出转账以及单独持牌的Betur Inc.交易实体不受影响。

updates.background_en: Coins.ph is one of the earliest crypto wallets and exchanges in the Philippines, has a 24-hour spot trading volume of about $50 million and reportedly controls some 75%-80% of peso-to-stablecoin liquidity in the country, the world's fourth-largest remittance recipient. A little over a year ago the BSP clamped down on the use of e-wallet apps for gambling, requiring supervised institutions to cut in-app access to gambling sites; several gambling entities then migrated to Coins.ph, according to the sources, which also gave them access to crypto and stablecoins for paying offshore partners, according to a third person. Several high-profile compliance staff left the exchange this year, including chief compliance officer Lexi Herrera, AML transaction monitoring head Chris Beaño and money laundering reporting officer Irish Calagui.
updates.background_zh: Coins.ph 是菲律宾最早的加密货币钱包和交易所之一，24小时现货交易量约为5000万美元，据称控制着该国约75%-80%的比索兑稳定币流动性；菲律宾是全球第四大汇款接收国。大约一年多前，BSP 收紧了对电子钱包应用用于赌博的管制，要求受其监管的机构切断应用内访问赌博网站的通道；据消息人士称，此后若干赌博实体迁移至 Coins.ph，而第三位知情人士表示，这也让这些公司获得加密货币和稳定币渠道，用于向离岸合作方付款。今年，该交易所多位知名合规人员离职，包括首席合规官 Lexi Herrera、反洗钱交易监控负责人 Chris Beaño 以及洗钱报告官 Irish Calagui。
updates.current_state_en: BSP's inbound InstaPay/PESONet transfer restrictions on DCPay Philippines remain, reportedly not time-bound; Coins.ph faces broader reported BSP enforcement over allegedly serving restricted offshore gambling operators, with potential license revocation.
updates.current_state_zh: BSP 对 DCPay Philippines 的入站 InstaPay/PESONet 转账限制仍在，且据报道该限制并非临时措施；Coins.ph 因涉嫌服务受限离岸博彩运营商而面临更广泛的 BSP 执法行动，并可能被吊销牌照。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Coins.ph, the Philippines' largest crypto exchange with more than 18 million customers, is reportedly facing central bank enforcement over serving restricted offshore gambling operators — involving deposit restrictions and a potential license revocation.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Coins.ph, the Philippines' largest crypto exchange with more than 18 million customers, is reportedly facing central bank enforcement over serving restricted offshore gambling operators — involving deposit restrictions and a potential license revocation.
updates.market_impact_en: The report centers on deposit access at a venue that reportedly handles the bulk of Philippine peso-to-stablecoin flow, so any limits on deposits or withdrawals through Coins.ph and DCPay Philippines would transmit through the fiat on/off-ramp and stablecoin liquidity channel, with possible spillover to regional exchanges and to the roughly $43 billion annual remittance corridor. The story rests on anonymous sourcing and unconfirmed regulatory action, so the exposure is contingent on whether any enforcement is formally announced.

events.current_state_en: Marinade disclosed that an attacker exploited a flaw in its DAO voting program to gain inflated voting power and filed two malicious proposals — one to swap out the voting program and one to drain the treasury — both of which were rejected with no funds lost, followed by a hotfix, plans for a permanent code fix, added safeguards for sensitive proposals, AI-driven proposal review, and a heads-up to Realms DAO maintainers.

events.current_state_en: Project North Star financing remains in syndication; Blackstone has warned investors that Anthropic may receive a junk-grade rather than investment-grade rating after IPO, potentially limiting its funding sources and raising borrowing costs for its $800 billion compute buildout. More than $42 billion in senior loans are Broadcom-backed; the $18 billion subordinated debt has been rated BB+ by KBRA and BB by Morningstar DBRS; Blackstone funds invested $9 billion of it at a yield above 10%; Fitch, Moody's and S&P have not yet formally assigned Anthropic a credit rating.
events.current_state_zh: “北极星项目”融资仍处于银团分销阶段；黑石已向投资者提示Anthropic在IPO后可能仅获垃圾级评级而非投资级，这可能限制其融资来源并推高其8000亿美元算力建设计划的借款成本。超过420亿美元高级贷款由博通担保，180亿美元次级债已获KBRA的BB+评级和Morningstar DBRS的BB评级，黑石基金投资其中90亿美元、收益率超过10%，惠誉、穆迪和标普尚未正式对Anthropic给出信用评级。

updates.what_changed_en: The $60B chip financing plan is called "Project North Star"; Anthropic is offering Blackstone a yield above 10%; Blackstone funds commit $9B to purchase debt backed by Anthropic's future five-year chip lease payments, half of the ~$18B subordinated tranche; proceeds to acquire ~1.5 GW of Google TPUs.
updates.what_changed_zh: 该600亿美元芯片融资计划被称为“北极星项目”，Anthropic向黑石提供超过10%的收益率，黑石基金承诺投资90亿美元购买以Anthropic未来五年芯片租赁付款为支持的债务，占约180亿美元次级贷款的一半；资金用于采购约1.5吉瓦谷歌TPU。

updates.current_state_en: Project North Star financing remains in syndication; Blackstone has warned investors that Anthropic may receive a junk-grade rather than investment-grade rating after IPO, potentially limiting its funding sources and raising borrowing costs for its $800 billion compute buildout. More than $42 billion in senior loans are Broadcom-backed; the $18 billion subordinated debt has been rated BB+ by KBRA and BB by Morningstar DBRS; Blackstone funds invested $9 billion of it at a yield above 10%; Fitch, Moody's and S&P have not yet formally assigned Anthropic a credit rating.
updates.current_state_zh: “北极星项目”融资仍处于银团分销阶段；黑石已向投资者提示Anthropic在IPO后可能仅获垃圾级评级而非投资级，这可能限制其融资来源并推高其8000亿美元算力建设计划的借款成本。超过420亿美元高级贷款由博通担保，180亿美元次级债已获KBRA的BB+评级和Morningstar DBRS的BB评级，黑石基金投资其中90亿美元、收益率超过10%，惠誉、穆迪和标普尚未正式对Anthropic给出信用评级。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Blackstone has told investors in Anthropic's $63 billion chip-financing deal that the AI lab may receive a junk-grade credit rating after IPO rather than investment grade, potentially limiting its funding sources and raising borrowing costs for its planned $800 billion compute buildout.

updates.current_state_en: Near Intents has confirmed an exploit exceeding $3.8M caused by flaws in its Omni deposit/withdrawal infrastructure and contract interactions; the contract flaw is patched, core services are expected to resume within ~1 hour, BSC/Polygon/TON deposits and withdrawals remain paused for an additional ~12 hours, full reimbursement is pledged, a report has been filed, and stolen funds were routed to KuCoin and bridged to Bitcoin.
updates.current_state_zh: Near Intents 已确认其 Omni 充提基础设施与合约交互缺陷导致的攻击，损失超 380 万美元；合约漏洞已修复，核心服务预计 1 小时内恢复，BSC、Polygon、TON 充提额外暂停约 12 小时，承诺全额赔付，并已报案，被盗资金仍流向 KuCoin 并跨链至比特币。
updates.detailed_summary_en: NEAR Intents confirmed an exploit exceeding $3.8M caused by flaws in its Omni deposit/withdrawal infrastructure and contract interactions, has patched the contract and pledged full reimbursement while pausing BSC, Polygon and TON deposits/withdrawals for roughly 12 hours, as on-chain sleuth ZachXBT tracked stolen funds moving to KuCoin and across a bridge to Bitcoin.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: NEAR Intents confirmed an exploit exceeding $3.8M caused by flaws in its Omni deposit/withdrawal infrastructure and contract interactions, has patched the contract and pledged full reimbursement while pausing BSC, Polygon and TON deposits/withdrawals for roughly 12 hours, as on-chain sleuth ZachXBT tracked stolen funds moving to KuCoin and across a bridge to Bitcoin.
updates.title_en: NEAR Intents确认遭攻击，涉案金额超380万美元
updates.title_zh: NEAR Intents确认遭攻击，涉案金额超380万美元
updates.what_changed_en: NEAR Intents formally confirmed the exploit, attributing it to flaws in its Omni deposit/withdrawal infrastructure and contract interactions; it has patched the contract, expects core services back within ~1 hour, pledged full reimbursement of affected assets, paused BSC/Polygon/TON deposits and withdrawals for an additional ~12 hours, and filed a report while pursuing on-chain tracing.
updates.what_changed_zh: NEAR Intents 正式确认攻击，指漏洞源于 Omni 充提基础设施与合约交互缺陷；已完成合约修复，预计 1 小时内恢复核心服务，承诺全额赔付受损资产，BSC、Polygon、TON 充提额外暂停约 12 小时，并已报案并展开链上追踪。

updates.current_state_en: Near Intents has confirmed an exploit exceeding $3.8M caused by flaws in its Omni deposit/withdrawal infrastructure and contract interactions; the contract flaw is patched, core services are expected to resume within ~1 hour, but deposit/withdrawal disruptions now affect multiple networks including BSC, Polygon, TON, Optimism, Avalanche, Stellar, Monad, X Layer, ADI, Scroll, and Plasma, with pauses potentially prolonged; full reimbursement is pledged, a report has been filed, stolen funds were routed to KuCoin and bridged to Bitcoin, and law enforcement and security firms are tracing.
updates.current_state_zh: Near Intents 已确认其 Omni 充提基础设施与合约交互缺陷导致的攻击，损失超 380 万美元；合约漏洞已修复，核心服务预计 1 小时内恢复，但充提中断已波及 BSC、Polygon、TON、Optimism、Avalanche、Stellar、Monad、X Layer、ADI、Scroll 和 Plasma 等多条网络，暂停时间可能延长；承诺全额赔付，已报案，被盗资金仍流向 KuCoin 并跨链至比特币，执法与安全公司正在追踪。
updates.detailed_summary_en: NEAR Intents suffered a ~$3.8 million exploit traced to a bug in its Omni system and smart contract, prompting it to pause services, restrict deposits and withdrawals on several networks, and pledge full reimbursement while law enforcement and security firms trace funds routed through KuCoin and converted to bitcoin.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: NEAR Intents suffered a ~$3.8 million exploit traced to a bug in its Omni system and smart contract, prompting it to pause services, restrict deposits and withdrawals on several networks, and pledge full reimbursement while law enforcement and security firms trace funds routed through KuCoin and converted to bitcoin.
updates.title_en: NEAR Intents hit by $3.8 million exploit as crypto's rough year of hacks continues
updates.title_zh: NEAR Intents 遭 380 万美元漏洞利用，加密行业黑客频发的一年仍在继续
updates.what_changed_en: New report discloses expanded affected network scope: in addition to BSC, Polygon, and TON, deposit/withdrawal disruptions also affect Optimism, Avalanche, Stellar, Monad, X Layer, ADI, Scroll, and Plasma; details that the platform has processed over $30B across 35 chains are also mentioned.
updates.what_changed_zh: 新报道披露受影响网络范围扩大：除 BSC、Polygon、TON 外，Optimism、Avalanche、Stellar、Monad、X Layer、ADI、Scroll 和 Plasma 的充提也出现中断；平台跨链交易量超 300 亿美元、覆盖 35 条链的细节也被提及。

updates.background_en: NEAR Intents is a cross-chain swap service that routes orders through competing market makers and says it has handled more than $30 billion in swaps across 35 blockchains. Two days before the exploit it blocked a $50 million swap attempt from the Bitget hacker. Bitget CEO Gracy Chen and analytics firm Elliptic pointed to North Korea as the likely culprit behind the Bitget exchange hack, which has also not been confirmed. Cross-chain bridging layers have repeatedly been targeted, as in the 2022 Harmony bridge hack that cost about $100 million.
updates.background_zh: NEAR Intents 是一项跨链兑换服务，订单由相互竞争的市场做市商撮合，官方称其已处理超过 300 亿美元、覆盖 35 条区块链的兑换。在本次漏洞利用发生前两天，它拦截了来自 Bitget 黑客的 5000 万美元兑换尝试。Bitget 首席执行官陈雅琪（Gracy Chen）与区块链分析公司 Elliptic 均指朝鲜可能是上周 Bitget 交易所被盗事件的幕后黑手，但同样未获证实。跨链桥接层屡屡成为攻击目标，例如 2022 年 Harmony 跨链桥被盗约 1 亿美元。
updates.current_state_en: Investigation into the NEAR Intents exploit continues; the attacker's address has been linked to a wallet flagged as North Korea's Lazarus Group, suggesting the attacker may be Lazarus Group. Previously confirmed: over $3.8M loss, deposits/withdrawals suspended across 11 networks, and full compensation pledged.
updates.current_state_zh: NEAR Intents 攻击事件持续调查中，攻击者地址被指与朝鲜 Lazarus Group 标记地址交互，攻击者或为 Lazarus Group；此前已确认损失超 380 万美元、暂停 11 个网络充提并承诺赔偿。
updates.detailed_summary_en: The NEAR Intents attacker moved stolen funds to KuCoin and bridged them into BTC, with the attacker's address interacting with a wallet flagged as North Korea's Lazarus Group.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The NEAR Intents attacker moved stolen funds to KuCoin and bridged them into BTC, with the attacker's address interacting with a wallet flagged as North Korea's Lazarus Group.
updates.market_impact_en: The incident bears directly on the NEAR token and on the Bitwise NEAR ETF launched two days earlier, both of which declined after the exploit, while the routing of funds through KuCoin and into BTC touches exchange custody and cross-chain bridging as laundering channels. The disclosed loss of roughly $3.8 million is small relative to overall market liquidity, so any wider effect would travel through sentiment toward bridge and intent-based infrastructure rather than through systemic fund flows.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该事件直接影响 NEAR 代币以及两天前刚推出的 Bitwise NEAR ETF，二者在漏洞事件后均出现下跌；资金经由 KuCoin 转移并换成 BTC，则涉及交易所托管和跨链桥这一洗钱通道。已披露的约 380 万美元损失相对整体市场流动性规模较小，因此更广泛的影响更可能通过市场对跨链桥与意图（intents）类基础设施的情绪传导，而非系统性的资金流动。

updates.detailed_summary_en: NEAR Intents paused services and lost $3.8 million in user funds after a bug in its Omni deposit/withdrawal infrastructure, and its general manager says the attacker has been identified and given 48 hours to return the funds under responsible disclosure.

updates.what_changed_en: NEAR Intents general manager Alex Shevchenko said the attacker has been identified and publicly shared three wallet addresses (BTC, BNB, SOL), issuing a 48-hour ultimatum for the funds to be returned under responsible disclosure before the window closes.

updates.current_state_en: In the NEAR Intents exploit, the attacker has sent on-chain messages offering cooperation and requesting a Signal contact, and the project has acknowledged and thanked them; previously the project identified the attacker and issued a 48-hour ultimatum to return funds; full funds have not yet been returned and the situation is ongoing.
updates.current_state_zh: NEAR Intents 攻击事件中，攻击者已通过链上转账留言表示愿意合作并请求 Signal 联系方式，项目方已确认收到并回复感谢合作；此前项目方已识别攻击者身份并发出 48 小时归还资金最后通牒，目前资金尚未全额归还，事件仍在处理中。
updates.detailed_summary_en: The NEAR Intents exploiter, who drained about $3.8M in user funds on October 1, sent on-chain transfers of 1 BNB and 0.295 ETH with messages offering to cooperate and asking for a Signal contact, prompting the project's acknowledgment a day after it identified the attacker and set a 48-hour return deadline.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The NEAR Intents exploiter, who drained about $3.8M in user funds on October 1, sent on-chain transfers of 1 BNB and 0.295 ETH with messages offering to cooperate and asking for a Signal contact, prompting the project's acknowledgment a day after it identified the attacker and set a 48-hour return deadline.

updates.background_en: NEAR Intents is an intent-based protocol for cross-chain swaps and unified liquidity across chains. Reports on the incident said the cross-chain swap service was exploited on October 1, that roughly $3.8 million was taken, and that Intents general manager Alex Shevchenko announced the funds had been returned after the team issued a 48-hour recovery deadline.
updates.background_zh: NEAR Intents是一个基于意图（intent）的跨链兑换与统一流动性协议。有关此次事件的报道称，该跨链兑换服务于10月1日遭到攻击，损失约380万美元；Intents总经理Alex Shevchenko在团队发出48小时追回期限后宣布资金已被归还。
updates.current_state_en: The stolen NEAR Intents funds have been fully recovered; the team says it identified and contacted the responsible party within 24 hours of the attack and credited the AI security layer SHIELD. NEAR says it will continue strengthening its security systems, and the incident has moved into post-recovery wrap-up.
updates.current_state_zh: NEAR Intents 被盗资金已全额追回；团队称在攻击发生后不到 24 小时内锁定责任方、建立沟通，并归功于 AI 安全层 SHIELD。NEAR 表示将继续强化安全系统，事件由此进入资金追回完成后的收尾阶段。
updates.detailed_summary_en: NEAR co-founder Illia Polosukhin said stolen NEAR Intents funds were fully recovered within 24 hours, crediting the protocol's AI security layer SHIELD and investigative work for identifying and recovering from the attacker.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: NEAR co-founder Illia Polosukhin said stolen NEAR Intents funds were fully recovered within 24 hours, crediting the protocol's AI security layer SHIELD and investigative work for identifying and recovering from the attacker.
updates.market_impact_en: NEAR Intents sits in the cross-chain swap and liquidity segment, so the recovery mainly transmits through confidence in intent-based cross-chain execution and in the security posture of the NEAR ecosystem, rather than through token supply or a change in issuance. The AI-defence angle may also shape how other protocols evaluate automated monitoring layers for cross-chain flows.
updates.market_impact_zh: NEAR Intents处于跨链兑换与流动性赛道，因此此次追回主要通过市场对基于意图的跨链执行，以及对NEAR生态安全状况的信心产生传导，而非通过代币供应或增发变化。AI防御这一角度也可能影响其他协议如何评估面向跨链资金流的自动化监控层。

events.current_state_en: The Drift Foundation disclosed that its DFX compensation token is not pegged to 1 USDT and that the current recovery pool covers only about 1% of total claims, while Tether has committed up to 127.5M USDT tied to Velocity net protocol revenue to support the restart and user repayment, with claims due by January 1, 2028.
events.current_state_zh: Drift基金会披露，其DFX补偿代币并非锚定1 USDT，当前恢复池仅覆盖约1%的总索赔，而Tether已承诺提供最高1.275亿USDT，与Velocity净协议收入挂钩，用于支持重启和用户偿还，索赔截止日期为2028年1月1日。
events.title_en: Drift Foundation上线DFX索赔与赎回，每损失1 USDT可领1 DFX
events.title_zh: Drift 基金会启动 DFX 索赔与赎回并披露恢复池覆盖有限

updates.background_en: The April 1 security incident drained roughly 295.4 million USDT in user assets, according to the recovery update Drift Foundation published the day before the claims launch. The foundation has engaged Mandiant, zeroShadow and SEAL 911 for the investigation and fund tracing, and Mandiant identified the attacker as UNC6862, a North Korean threat group.
updates.background_zh: 据Drift Foundation在索赔上线前一天公布的追回进展，4月1日安全事件中约2.954亿美元用户资产被盗。基金会已聘请Mandiant、zeroShadow及SEAL 911开展调查和资金追踪，其中Mandiant将攻击者识别为朝鲜威胁组织UNC6862。
updates.current_state_en: Drift Foundation launched DFX claims and redemption for verified victims of the April 1 exploit (~$295.4M stolen), granting 1 DFX per 1 USDT of loss redeemable against a Recovery Pool of ~3.11M USDT backed by up to $127.5M in Tether matching funds and up to $20M from strategic partners, with claims closing 2028-01-01 UTC.
updates.current_state_zh:
10月2日，Drift Foundation宣布DFX索赔与赎回已上线，在4月1日事件中经验证存在损失的用户可按每损失1 USDT领取1 DFX。每枚DFX对应Recovery Pool的索赔权，该池目前约有311万USDT。

此举把4月1日事件中的损失转化为一种由资金池支撑的索赔权结构，让经验证的受害者有了明确的赎回路径，而非无限期的追偿承诺。相对于全部损失规模，池内资金规模意味着每枚DFX的赎回金额取决于后续追回与承诺资金的到位情况。

DFX可按「Recovery Pool余额 ÷ DFX未偿供应量」计算的Redemption Amount兑换USDT，赎回后的DFX将被销毁且交易不可撤销。Recovery Pool的资金来源包括Velocity每日部分协议净收入、Tether最高1.275亿USDT的配套资金、战略合作伙伴最高2,000万USDT，以及后续追回的资产；索赔窗口将于2028年1月1日00:00 UTC关闭，届时未领取的DFX将被销毁。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Drift Foundation launched DFX claims and redemption for verified victims of the April 1 exploit (~$295.4M stolen), granting 1 DFX per 1 USDT of loss redeemable against a Recovery Pool of ~3.11M USDT backed by up to $127.5M in Tether matching funds and up to $20M from strategic partners, with claims closing 2028-01-01 UTC.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Drift Foundation launched DFX claims and redemption for verified victims of the April 1 exploit (~$295.4M stolen), granting 1 DFX per 1 USDT of loss redeemable against a Recovery Pool of ~3.11M USDT backed by up to $127.5M in Tether matching funds and up to $20M from strategic partners, with claims closing 2028-01-01 UTC.
updates.market_impact_en: The mechanism ties Drift's recovery directly to USDT: Tether's commitment of up to 127.5 million USDT in matching funds and the partner commitments would flow into the Recovery Pool, while the value of DFX is determined by pool balance against outstanding supply. Exposure concentrates in Drift's user base and the Solana DeFi segment, and the 2028 claim deadline sets the timeframe over which recovery proceeds can reach the pool.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该机制把Drift的追偿直接与USDT挂钩：Tether最高1.275亿USDT的配套资金及合作方承诺将流入Recovery Pool，而DFX的价值由池内余额与未偿供应量的比值决定。风险敞口主要集中于Drift用户群体与Solana DeFi板块，2028年的索赔截止日期界定了追回资金进入该池的时间范围。

updates.current_state_en: Drift Foundation has opened DFX claims and redemption, but the current redemption price is ~$0.0104, equating to roughly $1 recovered per $100 of loss and triggering community backlash. DFX secondary-market price is ~$0.03, up ~210% in 24 hours, with only ~$200K liquidity; future redemption value depends on whether up to $127.5M in Tether matching funds, up to $20M from partners, Velocity fee sharing, and recovered assets actually arrive, with the claim window still closing 2028-01-01.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Drift Foundation opened DFX claim redemptions for its April security incident with a ~$3.11M pool against ~$295M in verified losses, pricing each token near $0.0104 (roughly 1% recovery) — well below community expectations — while DFX's secondary-market price spiked ~210% on hopes of future recoveries, burn mechanics, and the January 2028 claim deadline.

Meanwhile DFX secondary-market price rose from ~$0.01 to ~$0.03, up ~210% in 24 hours, on only ~$200K liquidity; the move reflects expectations of future recoveries and burn mechanics, not an increase in the pool balance.
updates.what_changed_zh: 社区对DFX赎回定价反应强烈：按约311万USDT追偿池与约2.995亿枚DFX计算，赎回价约0.0104美元，即每100美元损失目前仅可兑回约1美元（约1%回收率）。同时DFX二级市场价格从约0.01美元升至约0.03美元，24小时涨幅约210%，但流动性仅约20万美元；上涨反映对未来追偿资金到账及销毁机制的预期，而非池内余额已增加。

updates.background_en: DFX is a standard SPL token on Solana issued to compensate verified USDT losses from the April incident affecting the Drift protocol. Tether, the issuer of USDT, is a major source of protocol revenue in the stablecoin sector, which underpins the arrangement linking its support to Velocity's net protocol revenue.
updates.background_zh: DFX 是 Solana 上的标准 SPL 代币，用于赔偿 Drift 协议在 4 月事件中已核实的 USDT 损失。USDT 发行方 Tether 是稳定币领域主要的协议收入来源之一，这构成了其支持与 Velocity 净协议收入挂钩安排的基础。

updates.background_en: Evernorth belongs to a crowded category known as digital asset treasuries (DATs): public companies whose main business is holding a cryptocurrency and raising money to buy more of it, a playbook pioneered by Strategy (formerly Microstrategy) with Bitcoin. The model turns on a ratio called mNAV — market-to-net-asset value — which divides a company's stock market value by the value of the crypto it holds; above 1 a DAT can issue shares at a premium and buy more tokens, while below 1 raising money means dilution. Evernorth says it is now the largest publicly traded company devoted to XRP. It spent roughly $947 million buying XRP in late October 2025, and by February that holding was worth about $446 million less than it paid; XRP hit an all-time high of $3.65 in July 2025, and the $1.43 closing reference price sits about 61% below that peak.
updates.background_zh: Evernorth属于被称为“数字资产储备公司”（DAT）的一类公司：其主营业务是持有某种加密货币并募集资金继续买入，这一模式由Strategy（原Microstrategy）以比特币率先开创。该模式依赖一个名为mNAV（市值对净资产价值比）的指标，即公司市值除以其持有加密资产的价值；高于1时，DAT可以溢价发行新股并买入更多代币，低于1时募资则意味着稀释。Evernorth称其目前是专注于XRP的最大上市企业。该公司在2025年10月下旬斥资约9.47亿美元买入XRP，到今年2月这批持仓的价值比买入成本低约4.46亿美元；XRP在2025年7月创下3.65美元的历史高点，1.43美元的交割参考价较该峰值低约61%。
updates.current_state_en: Evernorth completed its SPAC merger with Armada Acquisition Corp. II and began trading on Nasdaq under XRPN on October 12, 2026, holding about 473 million XRP and roughly $300 million in cash. About 80.3% of public shareholders redeemed, pulling out about $195 million; the $1.43 XRP reference price values the treasury at about $677 million, below the originally touted more than $1 billion raise; SBI holds 39.9% of voting shares, Arrington 19.9%, Larsen 9.9%, and Ripple and affiliates are capped at 9.9% with six-month lock-ups until April 2027.
updates.current_state_zh: Evernorth 已完成与 Armada Acquisition Corp. II 的 SPAC 合并，并于2026年10月12日开始在纳斯达克以 XRPN 交易；持有约4.73亿枚 XRP 和约3亿美元现金。约80.3%公众股东赎回，抽走约1.95亿美元；XRP 参考价1.43美元使财库估值约6.77亿美元，低于最初募资承诺超10亿美元；SBI 持39.9%投票权，Arrington 19.9%，Larsen 9.9%，Ripple 及关联方上限9.9%并有六个月锁定期至2027年4月。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Evernorth, the Ripple-backed XRP treasury company, began trading on Nasdaq under ticker XRPN after closing its SPAC merger, holding roughly 473 million XRP and $300 million cash, with its treasury marked at about $677 million — well below the more than $1 billion it raised — after XRP fell from $2.37 at signing to a $1.43 reference price.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Evernorth, the Ripple-backed XRP treasury company, began trading on Nasdaq under ticker XRPN after closing its SPAC merger, holding roughly 473 million XRP and $300 million cash, with its treasury marked at about $677 million — well below the more than $1 billion it raised — after XRP fell from $2.37 at signing to a $1.43 reference price.
updates.market_impact_en: XRPN creates a Nasdaq-listed equity route into XRP exposure for brokerage investors, a channel that runs through equity rather than spot crypto venues; the deal's heavy redemption and the fall in the reference price from $2.37 to $1.43 feed directly into how the digital-asset-treasury model and its mNAV economics are judged for XRP-linked and other crypto treasury vehicles. The thin post-redemption float also means XRPN's share price can move on small order flow, so its trading is not a clean read-through to XRP's own market.
updates.market_impact_zh: XRPN为券商投资者提供了一条通过纳斯达克股票获得XRP敞口的路径，这一渠道经由股权而非现货加密市场传导；此次交易的高赎回率和参考价从2.37美元跌至1.43美元，直接影响市场对数字资产储备模式及其mNAV经济性在XRP相关及其他加密储备公司上的评价。赎回后极小的流通盘也意味着XRPN股价会因小额订单而剧烈波动，因此其股价表现并不能直接等同于XRP本身的市场状况。

updates.background_en: A7 is described as enabling cross-border money transfers to Russian individuals and entities, including those under sanctions, using bank infrastructure in Russia and Kyrgyzstan, the Kyrgyzstan-based crypto exchange Grinex (a successor to the sanctioned Garantex), and a network of shell companies in third countries. It issues the ruble-pegged stablecoin A7A5. An October 2025 report by the Centre for Information Resilience described A7's use of foreign shell companies and promissory notes as a form of trade-based money laundering, and said A7 claims over 30 shell companies in its network of "payer companies."
updates.background_zh: 据描述，A7 为俄罗斯个人和实体（包括受制裁对象）提供跨境资金转移，依托俄罗斯和吉尔吉斯斯坦的银行基础设施、位于吉尔吉斯斯坦的加密交易所 Grinex（受制裁的 Garantex 的继任者）以及第三国的壳公司网络。A7 发行与卢布挂钩的稳定币 A7A5。信息韧性中心（Centre for Information Resilience）2025 年 10 月的报告将 A7 利用境外壳公司和本票的做法描述为一种贸易洗钱，并称 A7 宣称其“付款公司”网络中有 30 多家壳公司。
updates.current_state_en: The US sanctioned the A7 Network for laundering illicit proceeds and proposed a new rule barring payments to its sub-agents, citing more than $17 billion in dollar-denominated transactions processed from January 2025 through June 2026.
updates.current_state_zh:
美国对与俄罗斯相关的支付网络 A7 Network 实施制裁，美国财政部金融犯罪执法网络（FinCEN）同时提出一项规则草案，拟禁止涉及该网络“子代理”（Sub-Agents）的资金汇付。FinCEN 表示，2025 年 1 月至 2026 年 6 月期间，A7 的子代理处理了超过 170 亿美元的美元计价交易。

该规则草案把美国的限制范围从 A7 本身扩大到在 A7 相关发票和付款指令中充当签约方或付款方的境外子代理；FinCEN 称这一层被用来从非俄罗斯银行账户转移资金。该付款禁令目前仍属提案，尚未生效。

根据 FinCEN 的规则制定提案通知，A7 Network 会指派境外子代理作为发票、销售协议和付款指令上的签约方或付款方，从而使款项能够通过代理行和 SWIFT 渠道从非俄罗斯银行账户支付。该措施与美国财政部代号“Operation Economic Outcast”的行动一并公布。
updates.detailed_summary_en: The US sanctioned the A7 Network for laundering illicit proceeds and proposed a new rule barring payments to its sub-agents, citing more than $17 billion in dollar-denominated transactions processed from January 2025 through June 2026.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The US sanctioned the A7 Network for laundering illicit proceeds and proposed a new rule barring payments to its sub-agents, citing more than $17 billion in dollar-denominated transactions processed from January 2025 through June 2026.
updates.market_impact_en: The proposed prohibition targets the sub-agent layer that routes payments out of non-Russian bank accounts, so the direct exposure sits with correspondent-banking counterparties, crypto exchanges and ruble-pegged stablecoin settlement rails linked to A7A5 or Grinex, transmitted through compliance and de-risking pressure rather than any change to protocol rules. A7-linked flows reported through global banks also point to heightened screening risk for institutions handling related counterparties.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该禁令草案针对的是从非俄罗斯银行账户划出资金的子代理环节，因此直接敞口在于代理行交易对手、加密交易所，以及与 A7A5 或 Grinex 相关的卢布锚定稳定币结算通道，传导渠道是合规与去风险压力，而非协议规则的变化。此前有报道称 A7 相关资金流经全球银行，这也意味着处理相关交易对手的机构面临更高的筛查风险。

updates.background_en: OpenAI publishes a Preparedness Framework and accompanies major model releases with safety reports and system cards that document evaluated risks and mitigations. Robinson's role centered on that disclosure pipeline before his resignation.
updates.background_zh: OpenAI发布《前沿模型准备框架》（Preparedness Framework），并在重大模型发布时配套发布记录风险评估与缓解措施的安全报告和系统卡（system card）。在辞职之前，Robinson的职责正围绕这一信息披露流程展开。
updates.community_discussion_en: Commenters were divided: several questioned Robinson's motives, suggesting the timing coincided with vested equity and that he had retained a PR firm, while others argued the field needs more focus on present-day, concrete problems such as sandboxing and harmful model outputs rather than hypothetical future risks. Some said they doubted working at OpenAI is pleasant given the pressure employees are reported to face, and others shifted to unrelated complaints about ChatGPT's UI and conversation consistency.
updates.community_discussion_zh: 评论意见分歧明显：有人质疑Robinson的动机，认为离职时机与股权归属期重合，且他聘请了公关公司；也有人认为业界应更关注当下具体问题，如沙箱隔离和模型有害输出，而非假想的未来风险。部分评论表示，在据称员工承受巨大压力的情况下，很难想象在OpenAI工作会愉快；还有人转而抱怨ChatGPT的界面与会话一致性问题，与本次事件无直接关系。
updates.current_state_en: David Robinson, who wrote the safety reports accompanying OpenAI's major model releases, has resigned and is publicly warning about AI safety risks in an editorial for The Atlantic.
updates.current_state_zh:
曾为OpenAI重大模型发布撰写安全报告的David Robinson本周辞职，并在《大西洋月刊》（The Atlantic）刊发评论文章，公开就AI安全风险发出警告。据有关其离职的报道，他在OpenAI工作约三年半，主导起草了现行的《前沿模型准备框架》（Preparedness Framework），并负责监督12次前沿模型发布的安全报告工作。

Robinson是OpenAI重大模型发布配套安全文件的撰写者，因此他的公开批评会加剧外界对前沿实验室如何开展和披露安全监督的关注。有关其离职的报道称，他希望AI实验室借鉴航空与核能领域的安全实践。

据报道，Robinson负责OpenAI的安全透明度工作，并参与了介绍其模型情况的系统卡（system card）的编写。有报道标题称他将OpenAI的文化形容为“已崩坏”，这一说法来自媒体的引述。

Any transmission would run only through sentiment around AI-narrative tokens, which can be sensitive to headlines about how frontier labs manage safety oversight.

updates.background_en: OpenAI is an American AI public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco that develops the GPT series of large language models. The company has faced prior public scrutiny over its safety staffing, including reporting that its Mission Alignment team was disbanded roughly 16 months after being formed. Separately, more than 1,100 employees of frontier AI companies signed an open letter urging the US government to develop means of deliberately pacing AI development, according to a Wikipedia summary of a 2026 incident.
updates.background_zh: OpenAI是一家总部位于旧金山的美国AI公益公司，开发GPT系列大语言模型。该公司此前已因安全团队配置而受到公众审视，有报道称其“使命对齐”（Mission Alignment）团队在成立约16个月后被解散。另外，据维基百科对2026年一起事件的记述，超过1100名前沿AI公司员工签署公开信，敦促美国政府建立有意放缓AI发展速度的机制。
updates.current_state_en: A senior OpenAI safety leader resigned warning the internal culture is 'broken', while the three fired safety researchers publicly disputed misconduct allegations and warned their dismissals are chilling AI safety work.
updates.current_state_zh: OpenAI一位高级安全负责人辞职并警告公司文化“已崩坏”，三名被解雇的安全研究员则公开反驳不当行为指控，警告解雇事件正对AI安全工作产生寒蝉效应。
updates.detailed_summary_en:
Three fired OpenAI safety researchers publicly rejected allegations that they mishandled sensitive information, publishing an open letter that disputes the misconduct claims and warns their dismissals are chilling AI safety work inside the company. In the letter they wrote that "given the significant safety concerns surrounding the development of AI, employees must not be left working in an environment where fear and unclear rules stymie AI safety work and weaken third-party accountability."

The letter frames the dismissals as a governance issue rather than a purely personnel matter, arguing that the way the cases were handled affects how safety work and third-party accountability function at a leading AI lab.

The researchers dispute the characterization that they improperly shared sensitive information; earlier reporting linked the dismissals to allegations of sharing information with external safety groups.
updates.detailed_summary_zh:
三名被OpenAI解雇的安全研究员公开否认有关其不当处理敏感信息的指控，并发表公开信反驳这些不当行为说法，同时警告他们的解雇正在公司内部对AI安全工作产生寒蝉效应。他们在信中写道：“鉴于AI发展所带来的重大安全担忧，员工不应在一个由恐惧和模糊规则阻碍AI安全工作、削弱第三方问责的环境中工作。”

这封公开信将这些解雇事件界定为治理问题，而非单纯的人事问题，认为处理方式会影响这家领先AI实验室内部安全工作的开展以及第三方问责机制。

这些研究员否认“不当共享敏感信息”的定性；此前的报道称，这些解雇与涉嫌向外部安全组织分享信息有关。
updates.market_impact_en: The story has no direct asset exposure, but it feeds into the governance-and-regulatory-scrutiny narrative around frontier AI labs, a theme that can influence sentiment toward AI-related tokens and equity exposure to AI developers through perceived compliance and reputational risk.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该事件没有直接关联的资产敞口，但会强化围绕前沿AI实验室的治理与监管审视叙事；这一主题可能通过合规与声誉风险的认知，影响市场对AI相关代币以及AI开发企业股权敞口的情绪。

events.current_state_en: The Ethereum Foundation and Open Anonymity Project launched zkAPI on Ethereum mainnet, a zero-knowledge proof payment layer that lets metered API providers verify payment via onchain vault deposits and short-lived spending-capped keys without learning payer identity, initially targeting AI inference.
events.current_state_zh:
以太坊基金会与 Open Anonymity Project 推出 zkAPI，这是一个面向计量式 API 的隐私保护支付层，现已在以太坊主网上线。用户将 ETH、USDC 或其他额度存入链上金库（vault），并通过零知识证明授权支出，使服务提供方能够验证付款，而无需得知付款人身份或该笔用量由哪笔存款支付。

据 Coinotag 报道，此次上线为以太坊隐私技术栈提供了一个在主网运行的零知识支付范例，也让以太坊基金会拥有可供其他团队参考的部署案例；而 AI 推理这一侧仍需使用数据才能称得上被采用。

zkAPI 可签发短期有效、带支出上限的 API 密钥，并按实际用量结算，初期聚焦 AI 推理，也可扩展到其他按使用量付费的服务。该系统不提供网络层或内容层匿名性，意味着 IP 地址、时间模式和提示词中的身份信息仍可能被关联。

events.current_state_zh:
OpenAI表示，它已阻止了一场有组织地提取其模型在作答前所生成隐藏推理的活动，并称该活动始于7月1日。仅在7月24日和25日两天，OpenAI就记录到来自4000多名用户的1.6万次提取请求，而整个用户群超过1.5万人；OpenAI称该活动已于7月28日被完全阻断。

OpenAI称，这些被提取的隐藏推理可能被用来训练另一个模型，从而绕过原有的安全防护。OpenAI表示，此后已关闭一条路径——该路径曾允许已持有他人加密推理内容的人通过重放来还原其内容。

OpenAI称，相关操作者“没有破解我们的加密、入侵数据库，也没有直接访问已存储的用户对话”，而是通过操纵模型交互，使受保护的推理能够以可见形式被复制，违反了其服务条款；其中一种方法是把一段对话中的加密推理复制出来，再让模型在另一段对话中解码。OpenAI还表示，尚不清楚所观察到的所有操作者是否来自同一行为体，但将这一活动的“核心集群”归因于与Kimi开发者月之暗面有关联的个人。
events.title_en: OpenAI Says People Linked to China's Moonshot Tried to Copy Its AI's Hidden Reasoning
events.title_zh: OpenAI称与中国月之暗面有关联的人员试图复制其AI的隐藏推理

updates.background_en: OpenAI has made similar accusations before: in January 2025 it said it was reviewing signs that DeepSeek may have distilled its models, as Washington weighed national security risks. Anthropic followed in February, accusing Chinese labs of using about 24,000 fraudulent accounts to generate more than 16 million exchanges with Claude; by April the White House was describing industrial-scale distillation campaigns by foreign entities, primarily in China, and in June Anthropic asked Congress for penalties on large-scale model extraction. In August, researchers showed that OpenAI, Anthropic and Google each protected reasoning with a single provider-wide encryption key, and that attackers could coax models into outputting the hidden thoughts in plain text; all three deployed server-side patches after disclosure.
updates.background_zh: OpenAI此前有过类似指控：2025年1月，它表示正在审查DeepSeek可能蒸馏其模型的迹象，当时华盛顿正在评估国家安全风险。Anthropic随后在2月指控中国实验室使用约2.4万个欺诈账户与Claude进行了逾1600万次交互；到4月，白宫称外国实体——主要在中国——正在进行工业规模的蒸馏活动；6月，Anthropic呼吁国会对大规模模型提取行为施加处罚。8月，研究人员披露OpenAI、Anthropic和谷歌各自仅用一个覆盖全平台的加密密钥保护推理内容，攻击者可诱导模型以明文输出这些隐藏思路；三家公司在披露后均部署了服务端修复。

updates.market_impact_en: The disclosure does not directly involve crypto assets; any transmission runs through sentiment, as renewed attention to model-output provenance and cross-border AI IP disputes can affect the AI-narrative segment of crypto markets, including AI-themed tokens and decentralized inference or compute networks. The channel is narrative and regulatory attention rather than cash flows or custody, and the report itself contains no market data.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该披露并不直接涉及加密资产；其传导主要通过情绪面——围绕模型输出溯源和跨境AI知识产权争端的关注度上升，可能影响加密市场中的AI叙事板块，包括AI概念代币以及去中心化推理/算力网络。其传导渠道是叙事与监管关注，而非资金流或托管，且该报道本身不含任何市场数据。

events.current_state_en: Fiserv's digital asset platform is now live with financial institution clients, debuting with Bank of North Dakota's USD-backed Roughrider Coin stablecoin issued by VersaBank on Solana with Fireblocks infrastructure, targeting access for more than 90 banks and credit unions through Fiserv's Commercial Center.
events.current_state_zh:
Fiserv 的数字资产平台已面向金融机构客户上线，首个落地用例是北达科他州银行（BND）推出的美元支持稳定币 Roughrider Coin，由 VersaBank USA 发行，Fireblocks 提供代币化基础设施，Solana 处理交易。预计北达科他州超过 90 家银行和信用合作社将通过 Fiserv 已有的银行间转账系统 Commercial Center 接入。

BND 表示，该代币的发起、审批和结算都走银行处理 ACH 和电汇时所用的同一套操作通道，这为参与的北达科他州机构在公共区块链上增加了一条具备许可访问控制的银行间结算路径。

参与为自愿性质且仅限金融机构；BND 称每枚代币与美元一比一锚定，只有在机构运营账户向指定「for benefit of」账户完成转账后才会铸造，代币到达收款机构钱包时会通过智能合约指令自动销毁。Fiserv 将铸造、销毁、托管和储备管理职责交给 VersaBank USA，BND 提到可通过 Solana 的 Token-2022 扩展实现冻结和追回功能；Fiserv 称 Roughrider 为稳定币，而 BND 的部署页面称其为「美元支持的代币存款」，双方均未披露支付规模。
events.title_en: Payments Giant Fiserv Launches Digital Asset Platform, With Bank of North Dakota
events.title_zh: 支付巨头 Fiserv 推出数字资产平台，携手北达科他州银行

updates.background_en: The Bank of North Dakota is a state-owned bank that has partnered with Fiserv, its core banking services provider, to develop the state's own stablecoin. The production milestone follows an earlier BND and Fiserv announcement that planned availability in 2026. Fireblocks is a digital asset and stablecoin infrastructure provider, and Solana is a public blockchain on which the token is deployed as a permissioned asset.
updates.background_zh: 北达科他州银行是一家州属银行，与作为其核心银行服务提供商的 Fiserv 合作开发该州自己的稳定币。此次正式上线之前，BND 与 Fiserv 曾发布公告，计划在 2026 年提供相关服务。Fireblocks 是数字资产与稳定币基础设施提供商，Solana 是公共区块链，该代币在其上以许可资产形式部署。

updates.detailed_summary_en: Fiserv's digital asset platform is now live with financial institution clients, debuting with Bank of North Dakota's USD-backed Roughrider Coin stablecoin issued by VersaBank on Solana with Fireblocks infrastructure, targeting access for more than 90 banks and credit unions through Fiserv's Commercial Center.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Fiserv's digital asset platform is now live with financial institution clients, debuting with Bank of North Dakota's USD-backed Roughrider Coin stablecoin issued by VersaBank on Solana with Fireblocks infrastructure, targeting access for more than 90 banks and credit unions through Fiserv's Commercial Center.
updates.market_impact_en: The channel is bank settlement infrastructure: a state-chartered bank's dollar-backed token routed over Solana with Fireblocks custody adds an institutional tokenized-deposit rail that sits alongside existing ACH and wire transfers, potentially expanding on-chain transaction activity on Solana and the addressable market for bank-issued stablecoins versus existing stablecoin settlement networks. Exposure is concentrated in stablecoin and bank-payments infrastructure rather than in any single tradable asset.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道是银行结算基础设施：一家州特许银行的美元支持代币经由 Solana 和 Fireblocks 托管运行，在现有的 ACH 与电汇之外增加了一条机构级代币化存款通道，可能提升 Solana 上的链上交易活动，并扩大银行发行稳定币相对现有稳定币结算网络的可及市场。风险敞口主要集中在稳定币与银行支付基础设施，而非某一可交易资产。

events.current_state_en: Firmus Grid, the Australian bitcoin-mining firm turned AI data-center operator, priced its ASX IPO at A$11 per share to raise at least A$5 billion at a ~US$30.3 billion valuation, with listing moved to October 23.
events.current_state_zh:
由比特币矿企转型为 AI 基础设施公司的 Firmus Grid Ltd. 已将其首次公开募股定价为每股 11 澳元，寻求通过其在澳大利亚的 IPO 至少筹集 50 亿澳元，这将是澳大利亚有史以来规模最大的 IPO 之一。按此定价，公司估值约为 437 亿澳元（303 亿美元），其澳交所上市日期已更改为 10 月 23 日。

此次发行将是澳大利亚有史以来规模最大的 IPO 之一，也让一家由比特币挖矿起家的公司站到了人工智能与高性能计算投资周期的中心，报道提到其投资方包括 Jane Street、黑石集团和英伟达。该公司被视为受益于亚太地区人工智能基础设施需求的激增。

每股 11 澳元的定价低于此前最高 500 亿澳元的估值预期，上市日期也已更改为 10 月 23 日。中文报道将募资目标表述为 50 亿美元，而英文市场摘要给出的口径为 50 亿澳元，部分报道提及最高可达 55 亿澳元。

updates.background_en: Firmus started in 2019 in Tasmania, Australia, as a bitcoin-mining business and now has multiple data-center projects under way in Australia and Singapore. In August it secured US$2 billion in investment commitments from investors including Jane Street, Blackstone and Nvidia, after raising US$505 million in an April round led by Coatue Management. The pivot reflects a broader trend of bitcoin miners reallocating power contracts, land and cooling infrastructure to AI and high-performance computing workloads, particularly after the 2024 halving cut the block subsidy from 6.25 BTC to 3.125 BTC.
updates.background_zh: Firmus 于 2019 年在澳大利亚塔斯马尼亚州以比特币挖矿业务起家，目前在澳大利亚和新加坡有多个数据中心项目正在筹建。今年 8 月，该公司从包括 Jane Street、黑石集团和英伟达在内的投资者处获得 20 亿美元的投资承诺；此前在 4 月由 Coatue Management 领投的一轮融资中筹集了 5.05 亿美元。这一转型反映了更广泛的趋势：比特币矿企正把电力合同、土地和冷却设施转向人工智能与高性能计算负载，尤其是在 2024 年减半将区块补贴从 6.25 BTC 降至 3.125 BTC 之后。

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Firmus Grid, the Australian bitcoin-mining firm turned AI data-center operator, priced its ASX IPO at A$11 per share to raise at least A$5 billion at a ~US$30.3 billion valuation, with listing moved to October 23.
updates.market_impact_en: The listing channels institutional equity capital into a mining-origin company now building AI data centers, which bears on how listed bitcoin miners with comparable power and site assets are valued and how readily they can tap public markets. It also underscores the reallocation of mining-linked power and infrastructure toward AI/HPC workloads, a shift that feeds into bitcoin hashrate economics over time, although the IPO itself does not change crypto market access or protocol operations.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次上市把机构股权资本导入一家由挖矿起家、如今建设 AI 数据中心的公司，可能影响市场对拥有类似电力与场地资产的上市比特币矿企的估值方式，以及它们进入公开市场的难易程度。它同时凸显了与挖矿相关的电力与基础设施正转向 AI/HPC 负载，长期来看这一变化会影响比特币算力经济，但该 IPO 本身并未改变加密市场的准入或协议运行。

updates.background_en: Hyperliquid's AQAv2 stablecoin model received support from 19 of 26 validators, and the mechanism was expected to begin accruing yields on Aug 26. Circle has issued native USDC on Hyperliquid's HyperEVM network and made its first investment in the HYPE token. Hyperliquid routes the bulk of its perpetual and spot fees to the Assistance Fund, which buys back HYPE.
updates.background_zh: Hyperliquid的AQAv2稳定币模型此前已获得26个验证者中19个的支持，相关机制预计自8月26日起正式产生收益。Circle已在Hyperliquid的HyperEVM网络上发行原生USDC，并首次投资HYPE代币。Hyperliquid将绝大部分永续合约和现货手续费收入输送至援助基金，用于买入HYPE。
updates.current_state_en: Hyperliquid's AQAv2 treasury mechanism completed its first $14.58M USDC payment on Oct 3 — funds directed to the assistance fund for HYPE buybacks — establishing a reserve-yield revenue stream estimated at roughly $193M annualized at current scale.
updates.current_state_zh: Hyperliquid 的 AQAv2 国库机制于 10 月 3 日完成首笔 1458 万美元 USDC 支付——资金用于援助基金回购 HYPE——按当前规模估算，这建立了一条年化约 1.93 亿美元的储备收益收入流。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Hyperliquid's AQAv2 treasury mechanism completed its first $14.58M USDC payment on Oct 3 — funds directed to the assistance fund for HYPE buybacks — establishing a reserve-yield revenue stream estimated at roughly $193M annualized at current scale.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Hyperliquid's AQAv2 treasury mechanism completed its first $14.58M USDC payment on Oct 3 — funds directed to the assistance fund for HYPE buybacks — establishing a reserve-yield revenue stream estimated at roughly $193M annualized at current scale.
updates.market_impact_en: The AQAv2 payout ties USDC balances held on Hyperliquid to protocol revenue that flows into the Assistance Fund, so growth in bridged USDC supply and margin balances feeds directly into HYPE buyback activity. Because Circle issues the USDC on HyperEVM and Circle and Coinbase have each staked 500,000 HYPE with penalty provisions for late payment, those issuers also carry exposure to the mechanism's operation.
updates.market_impact_zh: AQAv2付款将Hyperliquid上持有的USDC余额与协议收入相连接，而收入进入援助基金，因此跨链USDC供应量和保证金余额的增长会直接传导至HYPE的回购活动。由于Circle在HyperEVM上发行USDC，且Circle与Coinbase各质押50万枚HYPE并附带逾期罚没条款，相关发行方也对这一机制的运行承担敞口。

updates.current_state_en: Supabase announced it is acquiring Turso to give every AI agent an instantly provisioned database; the products remain separate for now (Turso Database stays open source), with gradual integration planned (small agent tasks on Turso, scaling into Supabase's Postgres), Turso founder Glauber Costa joining Supabase to lead agent-related services, and the deal value undisclosed.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Supabase acquired database company Turso, whose Rust-based SQLite implementation can spin up millions of on-demand cloud databases per server, to give every AI agent its own instantly provisioned database, with the two products kept separate for now (Supabase on Postgres, Turso on SQLite, still open source) and gradual integration planned.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Supabase acquired database company Turso, whose Rust-based SQLite implementation can spin up millions of on-demand cloud databases per server, to give every AI agent its own instantly provisioned database, with the two products kept separate for now (Supabase on Postgres, Turso on SQLite, still open source) and gradual integration planned.
updates.title_en: Supabase收购Turso：要让每个Agent都能随手开数据库
updates.title_zh: Supabase收购Turso：要让每个Agent都能随手开数据库
updates.what_changed_en: Added deal details: the acquisition targets AI-agent workloads (Supabase says over 1M databases are created weekly, ~70% from agents/AI tools), Turso's Rust SQLite architecture can manage millions of on-demand databases per server; the products will not be merged immediately (Supabase stays on Postgres, Turso stays on SQLite, existing databases/APIs/workflows unchanged, Turso Database remains open source) with gradual integration planned; Turso founder Glauber Costa will join Supabase to lead agent-related services; deal value undisclosed.
updates.what_changed_zh: 补充收购细节：收购意在服务 AI Agent（Supabase 每周新建超 100 万个数据库，约 70% 来自 Agent/AI 工具），Turso 的 Rust 版 SQLite 架构可单机管理数百万按需数据库；两家产品暂不合并（Supabase 继续做 Postgres，Turso 继续做 SQLite，现有数据库/API/工作流不变，Turso Database 继续开源），计划逐步打通；Turso 创始人 Glauber Costa 将加入 Supabase 负责 Agent 相关服务；收购金额未披露。

events.current_state_en: Blast is ceasing operations because maintenance costs exceed revenue, and the standard withdrawal interface deadline passed on Oct 26; about $40.41 million remains in the bridge, and users must withdraw manually by interacting directly with Ethereum bridge contracts. Bithumb and Upbit added BLAST to trading-caution watchlists and suspended deposits; Upbit has further announced it will delist BLAST and will delist BLAST spot trading on Oct. 26 at 12:00 local time, with withdrawals halted during the associated network conversion. Coinbase requires users to move BLAST off Coinbase by Oct. 26 and is reported to suspend BLAST trading on Oct. 20.
events.current_state_zh: Blast 因维护成本超过收入而停止运营，常规提现界面已于 10 月 26 日截止；桥上仍有约 4041 万美元资产，用户需通过直接与以太坊桥接合约交互手动提现；Bithumb 与 Upbit 已将 BLAST 列入交易注意名单并暂停充值；Upbit 进一步宣布将下架 BLAST，并将在当地时间 10 月 26 日 12:00 下架 BLAST 现货交易，相关网络转换期间暂停提现；Coinbase 要求用户在 10 月 26 日前将 BLAST 转出，并据报道于 10 月 20 日暂停 BLAST 交易。

updates.background_en: Blast was once a closely watched Ethereum Layer 2 network holding more than $2 billion in crypto assets. It announced it is shutting down later this month because network revenue no longer covers maintenance costs, with CoinDesk reporting that its assets had plunged 98%. Bithumb is a Korean exchange offering spot trading, and a caution-list designation is its risk label ahead of a possible trading-support decision.
updates.background_zh: Blast 曾是备受关注的以太坊 Layer 2 网络，链上资产规模一度超过20亿美元。该项目宣布因网络收入无法覆盖维护成本，将于本月晚些时候停止运营，CoinDesk 报道称其资产已下跌98%。Bithumb 是提供现货交易的韩国交易平台，交易注意名单是其在下架决定前使用的风险标记。
updates.current_state_en: Bithumb placed BLAST on its trading caution list and suspended deposits after the Blast Foundation announced plans to end mainnet operations, with a decision on delisting expected in the third week of October.
updates.current_state_zh: 在 Blast 基金会宣布计划终止主网运营后，Bithumb 将 BLAST 列入交易警示名单并暂停充值，预计将在 10 月第三周决定是否下架。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Bithumb placed BLAST on its trading caution list and suspended deposits after the Blast Foundation announced plans to end mainnet operations, with a decision on delisting expected in the third week of October.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Bithumb placed BLAST on its trading caution list and suspended deposits after the Blast Foundation announced plans to end mainnet operations, with a decision on delisting expected in the third week of October.
updates.market_impact_en: BLAST's tradable liquidity is concentrated on Korean won spot pairs, so the deposit suspension and caution label directly narrow where holders can transact on those venues. The simultaneous wind-down of Blast mainnet and the exchange risk flags feed into sentiment across Layer 2 tokens, though the affected asset is small at roughly $20 million in market capitalization.
updates.market_impact_zh: BLAST 的可交易流动性集中于韩元现货交易对，充值暂停与注意名单指定直接压缩了持币者在这两家平台的交易渠道。Blast 主网停运计划与交易平台风险标记同时出现，也影响 Layer 2 板块代币情绪，不过该资产市值仅约2000万美元，规模较小。

updates.background_en: Blast was built as an Ethereum Layer 2 that offered native yield on ETH and stablecoins, positioning itself around returns for depositors rather than a distinct application ecosystem. It grew rapidly after launch and became one of the largest L2s by total value locked before deposits drained. TVL measures the combined value of crypto assets deposited into a protocol's smart contracts and does not by itself indicate profitability or user quality.

updates.background_en: Blast is an Ethereum layer-2 network that drew $2.3 billion in deposits by its February 2024 mainnet launch and initially pitched native yield on ETH and stablecoin holdings. Reports say the team announced the wind-down on October 2, 2026, citing operating costs that exceed L2 revenue with no credible path to economic sustainability.
updates.background_zh: Blast 是一条以太坊二层网络，在 2024 年 2 月主网上线时吸引了 23 亿美元存款，最初主打 ETH 与稳定币持仓的原生收益。有报道称，团队于 2026 年 10 月 2 日宣布逐步关停，理由是运营成本已超过二层网络收入，且看不到可信的经济可持续路径。
updates.current_state_en: Blast is ceasing operations because maintenance costs exceed revenue; users need to withdraw assets to Ethereum mainnet via the standard interface by Oct. 26; withdrawal wait time is planned to be shortened to 24 hours, but withdrawals are temporarily unavailable for about a week while Blast exits its Lido holdings, and after the deadline assets can still be withdrawn via the Blast Bridge contract on Ethereum L1. Bithumb and Upbit added BLAST to trading-caution watchlists and suspended deposits; Coinbase posted a status update requiring users to move BLAST off Coinbase by Oct. 26, with media reports that it will suspend BLAST trading on Oct. 20.
updates.current_state_zh: Blast 因维护成本超过收入而停止运营，用户需在 10 月 26 日前通过常规界面将资产撤回以太坊主网；提现等待时间计划缩短至 24 小时，但团队先退出其 Lido 资产，预计约一周内提现功能暂时不可用，截止后仍可通过以太坊 L1 上的 Blast Bridge 合约提取。Bithumb 与 Upbit 已将 BLAST 列入交易注意名单并暂停充值；Coinbase 发布状态更新，要求用户在 10 月 26 日前将 BLAST 转出，媒体报道其将于 10 月 20 日暂停 BLAST 交易。
updates.detailed_summary_en:
Coinbase posted a status update on October 7 (15:50 PDT) stating that the Blast project team is shutting down the Blast network and that users must act to avoid losing access to their funds. Coinbase said BLAST that is not moved off the exchange before October 26, 2026 will not be accessible to users after the network is shut down.

The notice turns the shutdown into a hard deadline for anyone still holding BLAST on Coinbase: assets left in place become inaccessible after October 26, 2026.

Coinbase labeled the entry as scheduled maintenance and said it would provide updates as necessary. Media reports on the shutdown state that Coinbase suspends BLAST trading on October 20, ahead of the October 26 withdrawal deadline.
updates.detailed_summary_zh:
Coinbase 于 10 月 7 日 15:50（太平洋时间）发布状态更新，称 Blast 项目团队正在关停 Blast 网络，用户必须采取操作以避免失去资金访问权限。Coinbase 表示，若未在 2026 年 10 月 26 日之前将 BLAST 转出该交易所，网络关停后将无法再访问这些资产。

该通知把网络关停变成了对仍将 BLAST 存放在 Coinbase 的用户的硬性截止期限：2026 年 10 月 26 日之后，未转出的资产将无法访问。

Coinbase 将该条目标注为计划内维护，并表示将按需提供更新。有关此次关停的媒体报道称，Coinbase 将于 10 月 20 日暂停 BLAST 交易，早于 10 月 26 日的提现截止日期。
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through exchange custody and withdrawal infrastructure: BLAST held on Coinbase must be moved before the deadline, which concentrates flow into the token's remaining trading venues and withdrawal rails as the network winds down. It also feeds sentiment about the economics of Ethereum layer-2 networks, though the shutdown is an orderly sunset rather than a failure or exploit.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导路径经由交易所托管与提现基础设施：存放在 Coinbase 的 BLAST 必须在截止日期前转出，随着网络关停，资金流将集中到该代币剩余的交易场所与提现通道。这也会影响市场对以太坊二层网络经济模型的情绪，不过此次关停属于有序退出，而非故障或漏洞事件。

events.current_state_en: Community banks have sued a US banking regulator over its approval of national charters for crypto firms, arguing the agency exceeded its statutory authority.
events.current_state_zh:
美国独立社区银行家协会（ICBA）于2026年10月2日（周五）在哥伦比亚特区联邦地区法院起诉美国货币监理署（OCC），指其依据《国民银行法》向加密公司发放全国性信托银行牌照属于越权。ICBA的诉状要求OCC撤销近期的一项牌照批准，并称这些数字资产信托银行并未受到与传统银行同等的监管约束。

该诉讼直接挑战OCC加密牌照路径的法律依据，而这一路径正是相关企业进入美国银行与支付体系的入口。ICBA称，这些牌照使社区银行处于“严重的竞争劣势”。

ICBA总裁兼首席执行官Rebeca Romero Rainey在声明中表示，“国会设立全国性信托牌照，并不是为了让寻求联邦银行牌照公信力的加密公司借此走后门进入银行体系”，并称这些公司在资本、流动性、监管以及联邦存款保险公司（FDIC）保险方面不承担同等义务。OCC发言人对CoinDesk表示，该机构“不对诉讼置评”。
events.title_en: Community banks sue US regulator over crypto firm charters
events.title_zh: 社区银行就加密公司牌照问题起诉美国监管机构

updates.background_en: The OCC has been granting a steady stream of trust charters to crypto firms, including Protego and Erebor as well as established crypto businesses such as Coinbase, Circle and Crypto.com; search results also point to conditional approvals for Ripple's National Trust Bank, BitGo, Paxos and Fidelity Digital Assets. The charter approval for World Liberty Financial, partly owned by President Donald Trump and his family, drew criticism from Democratic Senator Elizabeth Warren. The ICBA also played a significant role in pushing back against the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act, which failed to advance in the U.S. Senate last month partly over bankers' objections to its stablecoin provisions.
updates.background_zh: OCC此前持续向加密公司发放信托牌照，包括Protego、Erebor，以及Coinbase、Circle、Crypto.com等既有加密企业；搜索结果还显示Ripple的National Trust Bank、BitGo、Paxos和Fidelity Digital Assets获得有条件批准。由美国总统特朗普及其家族部分持股的World Liberty Financial获得牌照批准，引发民主党参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦的批评。ICBA还曾大力反对《数字资产市场清晰法案》，该法案上月未能在美国参议院推进，部分原因正是银行业者反对其中稳定币条款。

updates.market_impact_en: The case bears on whether crypto firms can obtain federal banking status, the channel through which they hold customer assets and access payment rails; a narrowing of that pathway would leave charter-dependent custody and payments businesses reliant on state licensing. Firms holding or awaiting national trust charters, and the stablecoin and custody segments built on them, are the most directly exposed to the litigation's outcome.

events.current_state_en: Arbitrum paused new Stylus activations on Arbitrum One and Nova on October 2 via Security Council emergency action, citing rising risks from AI-assisted attacks via hand-crafted WebAssembly. Existing Stylus programs keep running and can be renewed; ordinary Solidity contracts unaffected. Pause implemented by raising activation gas to prohibitively expensive level, no ArbOS upgrade. No attack enabling theft of user funds discovered. BoLD one-step proof guard can delay unconfirmed withdrawals if conflicting proofs accepted, but pause of settlement depends on condition. No date for restoring activations.
events.current_state_zh: Arbitrum已于10月2日通过安全委员会紧急暂停Arbitrum One和Nova上的新Stylus激活，原因是通过手写WebAssembly进行的AI辅助攻击风险上升。现有Stylus程序可继续运行并续期，普通Solidity合约不受影响；暂停通过提高激活Gas费实现，无需升级ArbOS。未发现可盗取用户资金的攻击。BoLD一步证明防护机制可在接受矛盾证明时延迟未确认的提款，但需满足冲突条件才会暂停结算。恢复激活的日期未定。
events.title_en: Arbitrum Pauses New Stylus Activations in Emergency Security Action
events.title_zh: Arbitrum因紧急安全行动暂停新的Stylus激活

updates.background_en: Stylus is Arbitrum's smart contract system that lets developers write EVM-compatible contracts in languages compiling to WebAssembly, such as Rust, C and C++. BoLD (Bounded Liquidity Delay) is Arbitrum's dispute protocol enabling permissionless validation, and it is active on Arbitrum One, Arbitrum Nova and Arbitrum Sepolia.
updates.background_zh: Stylus是Arbitrum的智能合约系统，允许开发者使用可编译为WebAssembly的语言（如Rust、C和C++）编写兼容EVM的合约。BoLD（Bounded Liquidity Delay，有界流动性延迟）是Arbitrum的争议协议，用于实现无需许可的验证，目前已部署在Arbitrum One、Arbitrum Nova和Arbitrum Sepolia上。
updates.current_state_en: Arbitrum paused new Stylus activations as an emergency security measure, while a new BoLD guard could delay unconfirmed withdrawals if contradictory proofs are accepted.
updates.current_state_zh:
Arbitrum已作为紧急安全措施暂停新的Stylus激活。此外，一项新的BoLD防护机制若接受相互矛盾的证明，可能会延迟尚未确认的提款。

此次暂停使新的Stylus合约无法在Arbitrum上激活，而现有合约仍可继续运行和续期；同时BoLD防护机制引入了一条新路径，可能使等待确认的提款被延迟。

现有活跃合约仍可继续运行和续期。此次行动中没有用户资金损失的报道。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Arbitrum paused new Stylus activations as an emergency security measure, while a new BoLD guard could delay unconfirmed withdrawals if contradictory proofs are accepted.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Arbitrum paused new Stylus activations as an emergency security measure, while a new BoLD guard could delay unconfirmed withdrawals if contradictory proofs are accepted.
updates.market_impact_en: Arbitrum is one of the largest Layer 2 networks, so a pause on new Stylus activations affects the developer-facing contract deployment pipeline, while the BoLD guard touches the withdrawal and bridging segment where unconfirmed exits could be slowed. Any market reaction would transmit mainly through sentiment toward ARB and through user and developer confidence in Arbitrum bridge latency.
updates.market_impact_zh: Arbitrum是规模最大的Layer 2网络之一，因此暂停新的Stylus激活会影响面向开发者的合约部署流程，而BoLD防护机制则涉及提款与跨链桥环节，未确认的提款可能被放慢。市场反应主要通过ARB情绪以及用户和开发者对Arbitrum跨链桥延迟的信心传导。

events.current_state_en: Anthropic announced Claude Frontier Academy, a $100M program to train 10,000 engineers on building with Claude.
events.current_state_zh:
Anthropic 宣布推出 Claude 前沿学院（Claude Frontier Academy），承诺投入 1 亿美元，到 2027 年底培养 1 万名“前沿部署工程师”（Frontier Deployed Engineer）。该项目被描述为一种驻留式培养计划而非普通课程，由各机构提名其最优秀的工程师参与，围绕 Claude 进行实操训练。

该项目把 Anthropic 的 Claude 生态与大规模企业工程团队直接挂钩，其公开目标是让参与者的能力达到 Anthropic 自家部署工程师的水平。

根据项目说明，参与机构需提名工程师，并在其所在组织内部构建真实的 Claude 项目；有介绍称该计划包含为期数天的线下环节，随后是 12 周的项目实践期。

events.current_state_en: Tavus unveiled Griffin-Lite, a real-time human interaction model that the company says fooled 48% of video-call participants into thinking it was human and topped Nvidia's VideoFDB benchmark, but access remains limited to trusted testers pending safety work.
events.current_state_zh:
Tavus于10月1日发布Griffin，称其为首个“人类交互模型”（Human Interaction Model），可实时理解并生成面对面对话。按该公司自己的测试，54名参与者中有26人（48%）在一分钟视频通话后认为Griffin-Lite版本是真人，而其上一代系统在41人中仅有1人（2.4%）被误认为真人；目前该模型仍仅向少数受信任测试者开放，安全措施仍在推进中。

这一结果出现之际，安全研究人员已记录到深度伪造被用于实时视频通话的案例：今年1月，与朝鲜有关联的黑客在Zoom或Teams通话中用AI生成的视频冒充可信联系人，研究人员将入侵归因于Lazarus Group下属的BlueNoroff，受害者被诱导安装伪装成音频修复程序的恶意软件。

Tavus称Griffin-Lite在英伟达VideoFDB基准测试中排名第一，生成能力项得分3.83（满分5分），次优系统为2.80，人类参考为3.92；在感知能力项上以3.73落后于人类的4.20。Tavus表示该评测由英伟达独立完成。测试并非经典图灵测试——参与者被告知将匹配到另一人进行一分钟通话，仅在最后才被问及是否曾怀疑对方不是真人；X平台上的一条社区注释已指出，上述结果未经独立验证，也不遵循标准测试流程。
events.title_en: This AI Is Already Fooling People on Video Calls Into Thinking It's Human, Company Says
events.title_zh: 公司称这款AI已能在视频通话中让人误以为自己是真人

updates.background_en: Tavus presents Griffin as a full-duplex system that listens, watches and talks simultaneously, with average audio-to-video delay of 0.43 seconds on Nvidia H100 chips, which Tavus says is half that of the next fastest method. Griffin is positioned as a new model class following earlier research into real-time perception and expressive video; a UC San Diego study found OpenAI's GPT-4.5 convinced judges it was human in 73% of text-only conversations. Nvidia's VideoFDB is described as the first benchmark evaluating full-duplex audio-visual conversational agents.
updates.background_zh: Tavus将Griffin定位为全双工系统，可同时听、看和说，在英伟达H100芯片上音视频平均延迟为0.43秒，Tavus称这是次快方法的一半。Griffin被描述为一个新的模型类别，建立在此前实时感知与富有表现力视频研究之上；加州大学圣地亚哥分校的一项研究发现，OpenAI的GPT-4.5在纯文本对话中让评判者认为它是真人的比例为73%。英伟达的VideoFDB被称为首个评估全双工音视频对话代理的基准测试。

events.current_state_en:
Researchers published a Nature paper — with an accompanying arXiv preprint (2511.07312) — describing an AI system, named Ataraxos, that beat the best human Stratego player in history. According to the reporting, it reached that level while playing roughly 34 times fewer games than DeepNash, DeepMind's 2022 Stratego agent.

Stratego is a hidden-information game in which the best move depends on facts a player cannot observe, making look-ahead search difficult; the paper presents general techniques for self-play reinforcement learning and test-time search under hidden information. Commenters on Hacker News pointed to the training efficiency — far fewer games for a stronger result — as the critical element of the work.

The Nature article describes Ataraxos as based on general techniques developed for both self-play reinforcement learning and test-time search under hidden information. According to the report, human players were surprised by how often the agent tucked its flag into a corner behind just two bombs, a rarely played setup.
events.current_state_zh:
研究人员在《Nature》发表论文（并附有 arXiv 预印本 2511.07312），介绍了一个名为 Ataraxos 的 AI 系统，它击败了历史上最强的 Stratego 人类棋手。据报道，它在达到这一水平时所玩的局数比 DeepMind 2022 年的 Stratego 智能体 DeepNash 少了约 34 倍。

Stratego 是一种信息不完全的博弈，最优走法取决于玩家无法观测到的信息，因此前瞻式搜索十分困难；该论文提出了用于隐藏信息条件下自我对弈强化学习与推理时搜索的通用技术。Hacker News 上的评论者认为，训练效率——用少得多的对局取得更强的结果——才是这项工作的关键所在。

《Nature》文章称 Ataraxos 基于为隐藏信息下的自我对弈强化学习和推理时搜索所开发的通用技术。据报道，人类棋手对这 AI 经常把军旗藏在角落、仅用两枚炸弹掩护的少见布局感到意外。
events.title_en: With most information hidden, the game Stratego had stumped AI until now
events.title_zh: 由于大部分信息被隐藏，棋盘游戏 Stratego 一直让 AI 束手无策——直到现在

updates.background_en: Stratego is a board game of imperfect information: players cannot directly observe the identities of their opponent's pieces. Before DeepNash, existing AI methods barely reached amateur level, and DeepMind's 2022 agent learned from scratch by combining game theory with model-free deep reinforcement learning. Game-playing systems have historically served as a benchmark for progress in AI.
updates.background_zh: Stratego 是一种信息不完全的棋盘游戏：玩家无法直接看到对方棋子的身份。在 DeepNash 之前，已有 AI 方法几乎只能达到业余水平，而 DeepMind 2022 年的智能体通过结合博弈论与无模型深度强化学习从零开始学习。博弈类 AI 系统历来被视为衡量 AI 进展的基准。
updates.community_discussion_en: Commenters focused on hidden-information search as the core difficulty, with one arguing the roughly 34-fold reduction in games played is what makes the result work. Others discussed practical strategy — trying a corner flag behind bombs and moving power pieces (1, 2, 3) to positions where they can attack safely — while some expressed surprise that Stratego, which feels simple, would be hard for models.
updates.community_discussion_zh: 评论者普遍认为隐藏信息下的搜索是核心难点，有人指出对局数减少约 34 倍才是这一结果得以成立的关键。也有人讨论实战策略——尝试把军旗放在角落并由炸弹掩护，以及把强力棋子（1、2、3）调到能够安全进攻的位置——还有人表示意外，觉得看似简单的 Stratego 竟会让模型如此吃力。

events.current_state_en: The SEC approved 3x leveraged long ETPs referencing bitcoin, ether, gold, silver, crude oil and natural gas under the Securities Act of 1933, per Bloomberg ETF analyst Eric Balchunas.
events.current_state_zh:
彭博ETF分析师Eric Balchunas表示，美国证券交易委员会（SEC）已依据《1933年证券法》批准3倍做多比特币、以太坊、黄金、白银、原油及天然气的ETP。他分享的文件显示，Cboe BZX交易所提出的上市与交易这六只产品的规则变更申请获得批准，他称这对发行方Volatility Shares而言是一次重大胜利。

这一批准使美国投资者可获得的交易所上市杠杆加密资产敞口，从现有的现货与期货产品进一步扩展。Balchunas将这一结果称为相关产品发行方Volatility Shares的重大胜利。

这批产品为3倍杠杆产品，标的涵盖六类资产：比特币、以太坊、黄金、白银、原油和天然气。获批的是Cboe BZX提出的允许其上市与交易的规则变更申请，依据为《1933年证券法》。
events.title_en: SEC Approves 3x Leveraged Bitcoin, Ether and Other ETPs

updates.background_en: 3x leveraged ETPs seek to deliver three times the daily return of an underlying asset, and similar products already trade in the U.S. for equities and commodities. Cboe BZX has been among the exchanges filing listing-rule changes for crypto-related products; exchanges including Nasdaq, NYSE Arca and Cboe BZX have also proposed generic listing frameworks that would let them list crypto ETPs without individual SEC approvals under Rule 19b-4.

events.current_state_en: BNY Mellon is reportedly negotiating a digital-asset infrastructure partnership with Kraken parent Payward that would cover custody, trading, payments and wealth management services delivered to banks, exchanges and asset managers via Payward Services.
events.current_state_zh:
据消息人士透露，纽约梅隆银行（BNY）正与Kraken母公司Payward洽谈一项潜在的数字资产基础设施合作，相关报道日期为10月3日。洽谈内容可能覆盖数字资产、托管、交易、支付、财富管理及其他金融市场基础设施，相关服务拟通过Payward Services向银行、交易所和资管机构提供。

若合作达成，全球最大的托管银行将与支撑Kraken的基础设施相连，把BNY现有的托管、清算、支付和财富管理业务延伸至数字资产轨道。不过相关洽谈尚未得到证实，且被描述为引述匿名人士的早期磋商。

据CoinDesk报道，该安排可能与Payward近期与纳斯达克达成的商业协议中的基础设施部分相似。BNY目前已在为机构客户提供托管、资产服务、清算、支付和财富管理服务，而Payward Services表示其让金融科技公司、银行、交易所和链上平台直接接入支撑Kraken的基础设施。

updates.market_impact_zh: 报道中的洽谈指向一条潜在的机构通道：银行、交易所和资管机构的资金流可能经由Payward的托管、交易和支付基础设施流转，从而把传统托管轨道与加密市场基础设施连接起来。其影响取决于尚未证实的洽谈能否推进，涉及的敞口主要集中在机构托管、支付与结算环节，而非某一特定代币。

updates.what_changed_en: Kraken parent Payward is exploring a crypto and payments partnership with custody banking giant BNY, signaling further institutional integration between crypto exchanges and traditional finance.
updates.what_changed_zh:
据消息人士透露，纽约梅隆银行（BNY）正与Kraken母公司Payward洽谈一项潜在的数字资产基础设施合作，相关报道日期为10月3日。洽谈内容可能覆盖数字资产、托管、交易、支付、财富管理及其他金融市场基础设施，相关服务拟通过Payward Services向银行、交易所和资管机构提供。

若合作达成，全球最大的托管银行将与支撑Kraken的基础设施相连，把BNY现有的托管、清算、支付和财富管理业务延伸至数字资产轨道。不过相关洽谈尚未得到证实，且被描述为引述匿名人士的早期磋商。

据CoinDesk报道，该安排可能与Payward近期与纳斯达克达成的商业协议中的基础设施部分相似。BNY目前已在为机构客户提供托管、资产服务、清算、支付和财富管理服务，而Payward Services表示其让金融科技公司、银行、交易所和链上平台直接接入支撑Kraken的基础设施。

events.current_state_en: AI startup Jev has reached a $10 billion valuation, and founder Diogo Almeida answers questions about the company and its direction.
events.current_state_zh:
AI 初创公司 Jev 估值达到 100 亿美元，创始人 Diogo Almeida 就公司及其发展方向回答了一系列问题。此次问答发生在 Jev 作为 TypeSafe 打造的模型结束隐身状态、公开亮相之后。

据报出的 100 亿美元估值，将使 Jev 跻身高估值的新兴 AI 公司之列，也反映出投资者注意力正向新一批模型厂商快速集中。

Jev 是由 TypeSafe 开发的模型，这家位于旧金山的初创公司由 Diogo Almeida、Erik Gafni 和 Sasha Sheng 于 2024 年创立，Jev 之名取自杰文斯悖论。TypeSafe 将 Jev 描述为一种“前沿智能函数调用”——输入非结构化状态，输出带类型的概率决策，而非对话式聊天机器人。
events.title_en: Jev估值100亿美元！创始人Diogo Almeida回答一切
events.title_zh: Jev估值100亿美元！创始人Diogo Almeida回答一切

updates.background_en: Diogo Almeida previously worked at OpenAI on reinforcement learning from human feedback and early ChatGPT research, and has described himself as a ChatGPT co-creator. Jev went viral over the past week on the promise of a cheaper and faster alternative to large language models, with supporters highlighting its roughly 70 ms decision latency while critics questioned claims that it cannot hallucinate.
updates.background_zh: Diogo Almeida 此前在 OpenAI 从事基于人类反馈的强化学习以及早期 ChatGPT 研究，并自称是 ChatGPT 的共同创造者。过去一周，Jev 凭借“比大语言模型更便宜、更快”的承诺迅速走红，支持者强调其约 70 毫秒的决策延迟，批评者则质疑其“不会产生幻觉”的说法。
