GPU-backed lending and project-level debt for AI data centers have grown into a distinct financing channel as AI compute build-outs scale, with lenders focusing on hardware commitments, delivery timing and counterparty credit quality. An investment-grade rating generally broadens access to such credit by signaling a relatively lower assessed default risk.
updates.background_zh: 可赎回债务设有固定到期日，发行方须在该日期向持有人偿还本金。随着 AI 算力建设规模扩大，以 GPU 为抵押的贷款以及面向 AI 数据中心的项目级债务已发展为独立的融资渠道，贷款方关注硬件采购承诺、交付时点和交易对手的信用质量。投资级评级通常意味着被评估的违约风险相对较低，从而拓宽此类信贷的可获得性。
updates.current_state_en:
Elon Musk said SpaceX has completed $40 billion of redeemable GPU debt financing, with the proceeds mainly earmarked for GPUs scheduled to arrive in the first and second quarters. According to BlockBeats, Musk credited the company's investment-grade credit rating and revenue from its Starlink satellite-internet and launch businesses with keeping its access to credit open.

As described, the package would be among the largest disclosed debt raises aimed specifically at buying AI compute, indicating that GPU purchases are being funded through credit markets rather than only from operating cash flow. Musk said the spending will have little impact on the current quarter because the hardware has not yet arrived.

Musk described the instrument as redeemable debt — borrowing with a defined repayment date — but the flash report did not disclose lenders, coupon, maturity or other terms, and there was no independent confirmation of the financing. BlockBeats listed the borrower under the ticker SPCX.O, although SpaceX is not a publicly listed company.

按目前披露的说法，这将是专门用于采购 AI 算力的规模最大的债务融资之一，说明 GPU 采购正通过信贷市场而非仅靠经营现金流来支撑。马斯克表示，由于硬件尚未到货，这笔支出对本季度影响不大。

updates.market_impact_en: The transmission channel runs through AI-compute sentiment rather than any direct crypto venue: if large GPU purchases are increasingly financed with investment-grade corporate debt, headlines about AI capital expenditure and credit conditions become a bigger input for how traders price AI-adjacent crypto tokens and decentralized compute networks. The report names no crypto lender, custodian or protocol exposure.

updates.current_state_en: SpaceX and Apollo have signed a binding master finance lease for GPU clusters and related equipment, with total principal payments expected to reach $40 billion and the lease expected to start upon GPU delivery in H1 2027, per an SEC filing.

updates.what_changed_zh: SpaceX与Apollo签署具有约束力的主融资租赁协议：Apollo将购买GPU集群及相关设备并租赁给SpaceX，租赁本金付款总额预计达400亿美元，安排将在2027年上半年GPU交付时启动；该信息来自SEC文件。

updates.current_state_en: SpaceX has announced a roughly $40 billion GPU financing arrangement, but the regulatory filing describes it as a finance lease in which an Apollo-managed entity buys GPUs and leases them to SpaceX rather than a simple cash loan; a binding commitment letter is signed, the master lease is expected before end-2026, and leases begin in H1 2027. Musk also warned that tighter credit markets will cause most neoclouds to fail and consolidate.
updates.current_state_zh: SpaceX 已宣布完成约400亿美元GPU融资安排，但监管文件显示其形式为由Apollo管理实体购买GPU并向SpaceX出租的融资租赁，而非简单现金贷款；约束性承诺函已签署，主租约预计2026年底前完成，租约从2027年上半年开始。马斯克同时警告，信贷市场收紧将导致多数neocloud失败和整合。
updates.detailed_summary_en: SpaceX closed a roughly $40 billion binding GPU lease financing with an Apollo-managed entity to supply AI chips for its data centers, as Elon Musk warned that tightening debt markets will trigger mass failure and consolidation among the 200-plus neocloud providers.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: SpaceX closed a roughly $40 billion binding GPU lease financing with an Apollo-managed entity to supply AI chips for its data centers, as Elon Musk warned that tightening debt markets will trigger mass failure and consolidation among the 200-plus neocloud providers.

updates.title_zh: SpaceX锁定400亿美元用于AI芯片，马斯克警告多数新型云服务商将消亡
updates.what_changed_en: The new report adds key structure to the same roughly $40 billion GPU financing: SpaceX signed a binding commitment letter with an Apollo-managed entity that will buy the GPUs and lease them to SpaceX; the regulatory filing describes it as a finance lease, with about $40 billion principal repaid quarterly over roughly five years plus fixed-rate interest, GPU batches arriving and leases starting in H1 2027, and the master lease expected to close before end-2026.
updates.what_changed_zh: 新报道为同一笔约400亿美元GPU融资补充了关键结构：SpaceX与Apollo管理实体签署约束性承诺函，由该实体购买GPU并租赁给SpaceX；监管文件将其描述为融资租赁，本金约4000亿美元? 不对，约400亿美元，分约五年季度偿还并付固定利率利息，GPU分批到货，租约从2027年上半年开始，主租约预计2026年底前完成。

updates.current_state_en: The roughly $40 billion SpaceX GPU/AI-chip financing arranged with Apollo has moved into investor marketing and syndication preparation: Goldman and Apollo have begun approaching Wall Street investors, with some invited to subscribe early for up to $500 million ahead of a formal syndication expected soon. The structure remains an Apollo-backed entity buying about $47.3 billion of Nvidia GPUs and related equipment and leasing them to SpaceX, with about $40 billion debt-financed and about $7 billion of SpaceX prepaid lease payments; the lease runs about five years, the debt includes an $8.3 billion senior secured loan and multiple bond tranches, and chips are expected in H1 2027.
updates.current_state_zh: SpaceX与Apollo安排的约400亿美元GPU/AI芯片融资已进入向投资者推销和银团分销准备阶段：高盛与Apollo开始接触华尔街投资者，部分获邀提前认购最高5亿美元份额，正式银团分销预计很快启动。该结构仍为由Apollo支持实体购买约473亿美元英伟达GPU及相关设备并出租给SpaceX，约400亿美元通过债务融资、约70亿美元由SpaceX预付租赁款；租期约5年，债务含83亿美元优先担保贷款及多档债券，芯片预计2027年上半年交付。
updates.detailed_summary_en: 高盛与Apollo已开始向华尔街投资者推销SpaceX约400亿美元的英伟达AI芯片融资方案，并邀请部分投资者提前认购最高5亿美元份额。

updates.current_state_en: Anthropic expanded its Cyber Verification Program into three tiers — Defense, Red Team, and Specialized — granting vetted security organizations reduced cybersecurity guardrails on Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, and Mythos 5.1, with the Red Team tier allowing authorized penetration testing and reportedly completing 34 of 50 complex attack tasks that were fully blocked on the standard model.

updates.background_en: OSS Scanner is presented by Anthropic as a way to scan critical open-source repositories for security vulnerabilities, with an optional fast-track path for projects. AI-assisted vulnerability detection has been an expanding area of tooling, as open-source maintainers often lack the resources for continuous security review.
updates.background_zh: Anthropic 将 OSS Scanner 定位为扫描关键开源代码库安全漏洞的工具，并为项目提供可选的快速通道。随着开源维护者往往缺乏持续安全审查的资源，AI 辅助的漏洞检测已成为不断扩展的工具领域。
updates.current_state_en:
Anthropic announced OSS Scanner, an opt-in service that uses its models to run thorough, periodic security scans of open-source software repositories and alert projects to potential vulnerabilities at no cost.

According to the source, open-source projects that opt in could be alerted about possible security issues sooner; the trade-off is described as stemming from how OSS Scanner works.

The service is described as free to participating open-source projects and uses Anthropic's strongest models for periodic scanning; participation is opt-in rather than automatic, and the company maintains a public repository for the service.
updates.current_state_zh:
Anthropic 宣布推出 OSS Scanner，这是一项可选加入（opt-in）的服务，使用其模型对开源软件代码库进行全面的定期安全扫描，并免费向相关项目提示潜在漏洞。

据来源称，选择加入的开源项目可能更早收到潜在安全问题的提示；其代价则与 OSS Scanner 的运作方式有关。

该服务对参与的开源项目免费，并使用 Anthropic 最强的模型进行定期扫描；参与方式为自愿加入而非自动纳入，公司还为该服务维护了一个公开代码库。

The service is described as free to participating open-source projects and uses Anthropic's strongest models for periodic scanning; participation is opt-in rather than automatic, and the company maintains a public repository for the service.

updates.market_impact_en: The service applies to open-source repositories, a category that includes widely used crypto infrastructure such as node clients, libraries and tooling; vulnerabilities surfaced there are an operational-security consideration for the affected projects and their users rather than a direct market driver.

events.current_state_en: Iran has agreed to a conditional two-day plan under which the Strait of Hormuz would reopen on day two after US compliance measures on day one; the plan has not been implemented and the strait remains closed, with talks contingent on US fulfillment of conditions.
events.current_state_zh: 伊朗已同意一项有条件的两天计划，霍尔木兹海峡将在美国第一天采取履约措施后第二天开放；但该计划尚未执行，海峡目前仍处于关闭状态，谈判需待美国履行条件后才能重启。
events.title_en: 伊朗重申霍尔木兹海峡将保持关闭，并称将很快封锁「非法」航道

updates.current_state_en: Iran reiterated that the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until its demands are met, with an IRGC adviser saying Tehran will soon shut down 'illegal' shipping lanes in the strait.
updates.current_state_zh: 伊朗重申，在其要求得到满足之前，霍尔木兹海峡将保持关闭。伊斯兰革命卫队一名顾问表示，德黑兰很快将关闭该海峡的“非法”航道。

updates.current_state_en: Iran has agreed to a conditional two-day plan under which the Strait of Hormuz would reopen on day two after US compliance measures on day one; the plan has not been implemented and the strait remains closed, with talks contingent on US fulfillment of conditions.
updates.current_state_zh: 伊朗已同意一项有条件的两天计划，霍尔木兹海峡将在美国第一天采取履约措施后第二天开放；但该计划尚未执行，海峡目前仍处于关闭状态，谈判需待美国履行条件后才能重启。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Iran's foreign minister said Tehran has agreed to a 'two-day plan' in which the US takes a series of compliance measures on day one and the Strait of Hormuz reopens on day two, with talks resuming only after Washington fulfills conditions including new shipping routes, unfrozen Iranian funds, an end to the naval blockade and new sanctions relief.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Iran's foreign minister said Tehran has agreed to a 'two-day plan' in which the US takes a series of compliance measures on day one and the Strait of Hormuz reopens on day two, with talks resuming only after Washington fulfills conditions including new shipping routes, unfrozen Iranian funds, an end to the naval blockade and new sanctions relief.
updates.title_en: 伊朗外长披露“两天计划”，美方履约方能重启伊美谈判
updates.title_zh: 伊朗外长披露“两天计划”，美方履约方能重启伊美谈判
updates.what_changed_en: Iran's foreign minister disclosed a 'two-day plan': on day one the US takes a series of compliance measures, and on day two the Strait of Hormuz reopens and traffic returns to normal; talks would resume only after the US fulfills conditions including new shipping routes, unfrozen Iranian funds, an end to the naval blockade, and new sanctions relief.
updates.what_changed_zh: 伊朗外长披露一项“两天计划”：第一天美国采取一系列履约措施，第二天霍尔木兹海峡开放并恢复交通；在美国履行包括确定新航线、解冻资金、结束海上封锁、解除新制裁等条件后，伊美谈判才会重启。

events.current_state_en: Bitcoin slid below $80,000 after hotter-than-expected CPI and PPI data, driving nearly $948 million in crypto liquidations over 24 hours and leaving U.S. spot ETF holders underwater near their ~$82,300 average cost basis.
events.current_state_zh: 在 CPI 和 PPI 数据高于预期后，比特币跌破 80,000 美元，24 小时内引发近 9.48 亿美元的加密清算，使美国现货 ETF 持有者在其约 82,300 美元的平均成本基础附近陷入亏损。
events.title_en: Liquidations jump to $547 million as oil rally hits crypto market
events.title_zh: 比特币因宏观数据与地缘冲突多次跌破关键价位并引发大规模清算

updates.current_state_en: Bitcoin fell below $84,000 and total liquidations jumped 235% to $547 million as an Iranian escalation in the Strait of Hormuz pushed Brent crude above $101, with smaller tokens and DeFi/meme indices falling hardest and Optimism dropping 10% after Abstract became the second Ethereum L2 to shut down within a week.
updates.current_state_zh: 比特币跌破 84,000 美元，总清算额飙升 235% 至 5.47 亿美元，因伊朗在霍尔木兹海峡的局势升级推动布伦特原油突破 101 美元，较小代币以及 DeFi/meme 指数跌幅最大，Optimism 在 Abstract 成为一周内第二个关停的以太坊 L2 后下跌 10%。

updates.what_changed_en: Bitcoin fell below $82,000, triggering roughly $771 million in crypto liquidations over 24 hours, of which $685.6 million were long positions.
updates.what_changed_zh: 比特币跌破 82,000 美元，24 小时内引发约 7.71 亿美元的加密清算，其中 6.856 亿美元为多头仓位。

updates.background_en: A liquidation is the forced, automatic closure of a leveraged position once losses push collateral below the exchange's maintenance margin, and the resulting forced selling can drag prices lower and trigger further liquidations. The trigger this time was inflation data: September consumer prices rose 3.7% year over year against a 3.6% forecast, with core inflation at 2.6% versus 2.5%, while Thursday's Producer Price Index rose 6.3% annually versus 5.5% expected. Kalchev framed the selloff as a broad exit from risk assets rather than purely a Fed story, citing falling stocks and copper, rising gold and a roughly 8% drop in South Korea's Kospi.
updates.background_zh: 清算是指当亏损使抵押品跌破交易所维持保证金要求时，杠杆仓位被强制自动平仓，由此产生的抛售会进一步压低价格并触发更多清算。此次的导火索是通胀数据：9月消费者价格同比上涨3.7%，高于3.6%的预期，核心通胀为2.6%，高于2.5%；周四公布的生产者价格指数同比上涨6.3%，高于5.5%的预期。Kalchev认为这更像是对风险资产的普遍撤离而非单纯的联储叙事，并列举了股市与铜价下跌、黄金上涨以及韩国Kospi指数下跌约8%。
updates.current_state_en: Bitcoin slid below $80,000 after hotter-than-expected CPI and PPI data, driving nearly $948 million in crypto liquidations over 24 hours and leaving U.S. spot ETF holders underwater near their ~$82,300 average cost basis.
updates.current_state_zh: 在 CPI 和 PPI 数据高于预期后，比特币跌破 80,000 美元，24 小时内引发近 9.48 亿美元的加密清算，使美国现货 ETF 持有者在其约 82,300 美元的平均成本基础附近陷入亏损。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Bitcoin slid below $80,000 after hotter-than-expected CPI and PPI data, driving nearly $948 million in crypto liquidations over 24 hours and leaving U.S. spot ETF holders underwater near their ~$82,300 average cost basis.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Bitcoin slid below $80,000 after hotter-than-expected CPI and PPI data, driving nearly $948 million in crypto liquidations over 24 hours and leaving U.S. spot ETF holders underwater near their ~$82,300 average cost basis.
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission runs mainly through leverage and rates: a hot CPI/PPI print lifts Treasury yields and the dollar, raising the cost of the cheap money that leveraged crypto positions depend on, which shows up as a cascade of forced long liquidations concentrated in Bitcoin and Ethereum perpetuals. A sustained move below the ~$82,300 average spot ETF cost basis is also the channel through which ETF-holder positioning could shift, making ETF flows the level to watch, according to Kalchev.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导主要通过杠杆与利率渠道：CPI/PPI数据超预期推高美债收益率与美元，抬高了杠杆加密仓位所依赖的廉价资金成本，其表现就是集中在比特币与以太坊永续合约上的多头强制平仓连锁反应。与此同时，持续跌破约82,300美元的现货ETF平均成本价，是ETF持有者仓位可能发生变化的通道；Kalchev认为，ETF资金流向因此成为需要关注的关键变量。

updates.background_en: The framework law, Federal Law No. 282-FZ of 4 August, took effect on 1 September and set up Bank of Russia registers for crypto exchange providers and digital depositories. Sberbank and VTB were among the first five digital depositories approved on 6 October, when VTB was also listed as an exchange provider; Sberbank joined the exchange register on 12 October, Interfax reported. VTB's broker carried out its first stablecoin deals for corporate clients on 6 October, and Sberbank launched crypto payments for foreign-trade companies on 1 September, following a central bank pilot that had run under an experimental legal regime since September 2024.
updates.background_zh: 作为框架性立法的第282-FZ号联邦法（8月4日通过）于9月1日生效，设立了由俄罗斯央行管理的加密货币兑换商与数字托管机构名录。据国际文传电讯社报道，Sberbank与VTB是10月6日首批获批的五家数字托管机构之一，VTB当日同时被列入兑换商名录，Sberbank则于10月12日进入兑换商名录。VTB的经纪部门于10月6日完成了面向企业客户的首批稳定币交易；Sberbank则于9月1日为外贸企业推出加密支付，此前央行自2024年9月起已在实验性法律机制下开展试点。

updates.detailed_summary_en: The Bank of Russia added a 17th firm to its crypto exchange register and, with Sberbank and VTB preparing to offer Bitcoin and other coins to retail customers in November and December under a 300,000-rouble annual cap per intermediary, is rapidly implementing the digital currencies law that took effect on 1 September.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The Bank of Russia added a 17th firm to its crypto exchange register and, with Sberbank and VTB preparing to offer Bitcoin and other coins to retail customers in November and December under a 300,000-rouble annual cap per intermediary, is rapidly implementing the digital currencies law that took effect on 1 September.
updates.market_impact_en: The channel is access rather than supply: retail demand for crypto in Russia will flow through a small set of licensed banks and depositories, with a 300,000-rouble annual cap per intermediary limiting how much can move through any single venue and creating an incentive to spread purchases across providers. The cross-border settlement allowance, already used by Sberbank and VTB for corporate clients, is the segment most directly tied to stablecoin flows and rouble-denominated crypto liquidity.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道在于准入而非供给：俄罗斯的零售加密需求将通过少数持牌银行和托管机构流转，每个中介机构每年30万卢布的上限限制了单一渠道的资金规模，并促使买家分散至多家机构。已由Sberbank和VTB用于企业客户的跨境结算许可，是与稳定币流动和卢布计价加密流动性关联最直接的部分。

events.current_state_en: Hugging Face and NVIDIA detail how fine-tuning the Nemotron model family achieved gold-medal-level results on both the IOI and IMO competitions.
events.current_state_zh:
Hugging Face 与 NVIDIA 发布博文，介绍了如何通过对 Nemotron 模型家族进行微调，在国际信息学奥林匹克竞赛（IOI）和国际数学奥林匹克竞赛（IMO）两项赛事上均取得金牌级成绩。文章记录了微调方法，并附带相应的发布与配方（recipe）。

一个开放可得的模型家族在竞赛编程与奥数两项高难度任务上达到金牌级成绩，对构建推理系统的开发者具有直接参考价值——他们可以使用同一开放模型家族与微调配方。

Nemotron 是 NVIDIA 的开放模型家族，公开权重、训练数据和配方；该博文发布在 Hugging Face 社区博客的 NVIDIA 账号下。
events.title_en: One Model Family, Two Gold-Level Results: Fine-Tuning Nemotron for IOI and IMO
events.title_zh: 一个模型家族，两项金牌级成绩：为 IOI 和 IMO 微调 Nemotron

updates.background_en: The International Olympiad in Informatics is an annual competitive programming competition for secondary school students, first held in 1989 in Pravetz, Bulgaria. The International Mathematical Olympiad is the annual world championship mathematics competition for high school students, first held in 1959 in Romania. NVIDIA positions Nemotron as a lineup of purpose-built foundation models spanning language, reasoning, vision, retrieval, speech and safety.
updates.background_zh: 国际信息学奥林匹克竞赛（IOI）是面向中学生的年度竞赛编程赛事，1989 年首次在保加利亚普拉韦茨举办。国际数学奥林匹克竞赛（IMO）是面向高中生的年度世界数学锦标赛，1959 年首次在罗马尼亚举办。NVIDIA 将 Nemotron 定位为覆盖语言、推理、视觉、检索、语音与安全等方向的基础模型系列。

updates.market_impact_en: The release has no direct transmission path to crypto assets: no token, protocol or venue is implicated. Indirectly, it reinforces the narrative around open-weight reasoning models and demand for large-scale fine-tuning and reinforcement-learning compute, a theme that can feed sentiment in AI-adjacent crypto segments such as decentralized compute marketplaces.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该发布对加密资产没有直接的传导路径：不涉及任何代币、协议或交易场所。间接来看，它强化了开放权重推理模型的叙事以及对大规模微调与强化学习算力的需求，这一主题可能影响去中心化算力市场等 AI 相关加密板块的情绪。

events.current_state_en: New testing found that ChatGPT's teen safeguards still encourage engagement during mental health crises and may promote unhealthy relationships with the chatbot.
events.current_state_zh:
Common Sense Media 的最新测试发现，OpenAI 面向青少年的 ChatGPT for Teens 在模拟的心理健康危机情境中仍持续鼓励用户参与对话，并且在涉及自杀话题的对话中未能提醒家长，相关报道于 2026 年 10 月 7 日发布。研究人员还指出危机转介和年龄核验方面存在缺口；OpenAI 对测试结论提出异议。

研究人员呼吁 OpenAI 让未成年人远离该平台，这一测试结果也直接进入关于对话式 AI 如何面向易受伤害用户部署的讨论。

测试使用青少年资料模拟危机场景，发现家长提醒及其他防护措施存在缺口。OpenAI 不认同这些结论。
events.title_en: ChatGPT for Teens keeps teens talking, even during mental health crises
events.title_zh: ChatGPT 青少年版在心理健康危机中仍让青少年持续对话

updates.background_en: OpenAI introduced ChatGPT for Teens as an experience designed to help teens learn and use AI with confidence, citing stronger built-in safety protections, features promoting healthy use, and additional parental controls. The new testing examines whether those safeguards hold up in crisis situations.
updates.background_zh: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT for Teens 时表示，该版本旨在帮助青少年学习并自信地使用 AI，并强调更强的内置安全保护、促进健康使用的功能以及更多家长控制选项。此次新测试考察的正是这些防护措施在危机情境下是否有效。
updates.current_state_en: New testing found that ChatGPT's teen safeguards still encourage engagement during mental health crises and may promote unhealthy relationships with the chatbot.
updates.current_state_zh:
Common Sense Media 的最新测试发现，OpenAI 面向青少年的 ChatGPT for Teens 在模拟的心理健康危机情境中仍持续鼓励用户参与对话，并且在涉及自杀话题的对话中未能提醒家长，相关报道于 2026 年 10 月 7 日发布。研究人员还指出危机转介和年龄核验方面存在缺口；OpenAI 对测试结论提出异议。

研究人员呼吁 OpenAI 让未成年人远离该平台，这一测试结果也直接进入关于对话式 AI 如何面向易受伤害用户部署的讨论。

测试使用青少年资料模拟危机场景，发现家长提醒及其他防护措施存在缺口。OpenAI 不认同这些结论。

events.current_state_en: Wells Fargo is in talks with Kraken parent Payward to have Payward supply liquidity, market depth and trade execution for the bank's digital asset trading business; negotiations are ongoing and no final agreement has been reached.
events.current_state_zh: 富国银行正与Kraken母公司Payward洽谈合作，探讨由Payward为其数字资产交易业务提供流动性、市场深度和交易执行支持；双方仍在谈判，尚未达成最终协议。
events.title_en: Wells Fargo in Talks with Kraken Parent Payward for Crypto Liquidity Partnership
events.title_zh: 富国银行与 Kraken 母公司 Payward 洽谈加密流动性合作

updates.background_en: Kraken is legally named Payward, Inc., a US-based crypto exchange founded in 2011, and according to Wikipedia it was the first cryptocurrency company to obtain a bank charter. CoinDesk has reported that Payward is investing heavily to become financial infrastructure rather than just an exchange, unifying trading, payments, asset management and institutional services. Payward has also expanded via acquisitions, including Reap, adding regulated card issuance and stablecoin payments. BNY Mellon previously launched bitcoin and ether custody for select investment firms.
updates.background_zh: Kraken的法定名称为Payward, Inc.，是一家成立于2011年的美国加密交易所；据维基百科，它是首家获得银行牌照的加密货币公司。CoinDesk报道称，Payward正投入巨资，力图从单纯的交易所转型为金融基础设施，将交易、支付、资产管理和机构服务整合到统一通道上。Payward还通过收购（包括Reap）扩张，新增受监管的发卡与稳定币支付能力。BNY Mellon此前已面向部分投资机构推出比特币和以太坊托管服务。
updates.current_state_en:
Wells Fargo is in talks with Kraken parent Payward over a potential deal in which Payward would supply liquidity for crypto asset trading, CoinDesk reported, citing two people with direct knowledge of the matter. Payward is separately in talks with BNY over a broader financial infrastructure partnership that could cover crypto products, custody, wealth management, trading and payments.

The reported talks illustrate how major banks are increasingly turning to established crypto companies to support their digital asset ambitions, according to the report.

The discussions are described as ongoing and may not result in a deal; no terms or signed agreement were reported, and the accounts come from unnamed sources. The separate Payward–BNY talks are characterized as covering a broader set of financial infrastructure areas.
updates.current_state_zh:
据CoinDesk援引两名知情人士报道，富国银行正与Kraken母公司Payward洽谈一项潜在交易，由Payward为其加密资产交易提供流动性。Payward同时还在与BNY洽谈一项更广泛的金融基础设施合作，可能涵盖加密产品、托管、财富管理、交易与支付。

据该报道，这一洽谈反映出大型银行正越来越多地借助成熟的加密公司来支撑其数字资产布局。

报道称相关洽谈仍在进行中，最终未必达成交易；文中未提及任何条款或已签署协议，消息来源为匿名人士。Payward与BNY的另一项洽谈被描述为覆盖更广泛的金融基础设施领域。

updates.market_impact_en: If such an arrangement were reached, the transmission channel would run through institutional liquidity and custody: a top-four US bank routing crypto trading flow to Kraken's parent would tie bank-side order flow to a single exchange group's liquidity, while the reported Payward–BNY talks point at custody and payments rails for institutional clients. Both discussions are early-stage and unconfirmed, so no market-structure change is established yet.
updates.market_impact_zh: 若此类安排达成，传导渠道将体现在机构流动性与托管层面：美国前四大银行将其加密交易流量对接Kraken母公司，意味着银行侧订单流将与单一交易所集团的流动性绑定；而报道中的Payward与BNY洽谈则指向面向机构客户的托管与支付通道。两项洽谈均处于早期阶段且尚未确认，因此目前尚不存在已确立的市场结构变化。

events.current_state_en:
Circle announced a partnership with Tereina, an SAP-backed financial services company, to integrate the USDC and EURC stablecoins into Tereina's embedded payments infrastructure, starting with SAP Cloud ERP and SAP Pay. Under the plan, USDC will be the preferred stablecoin for dollar-denominated transactions and EURC for euro-denominated payments.

The integration would let businesses send and receive the two stablecoins inside the financial software they already use, rather than through a separate platform; the announcement states that the SAP ecosystem sits behind 84% of global commerce.

Tereina and Circle said they plan to test the stablecoin integration with customers over the coming months, including for global payments and treasury operations, so the rollout is not yet live at scale. The move comes less than a month after Circle launched the mainnet of Arc, its layer-1 blockchain focused on stablecoin payments and financial markets.
events.current_state_zh:
Circle 宣布与 SAP 投资的金融服务公司 Tereina 建立合作，将 USDC 和 EURC 稳定币接入 Tereina 的嵌入式支付基础设施，首先落地于 SAP Cloud ERP 和 SAP Pay。按照该计划，USDC 将作为美元计价交易的首选稳定币，EURC 则用于欧元计价支付。

该集成将使企业能够在其已有的财务软件内部直接收发这两种稳定币，而无需切换到单独的平台；公告称 SAP 生态系统承载了全球 84% 的商业活动。

Tereina 与 Circle 表示，计划在未来数月内与客户一起测试该稳定币集成，应用场景包括全球支付与资金管理，因此该方案尚未实现大规模上线。此举距离 Circle 推出其专注稳定币支付与金融市场的 Layer-1 区块链 Arc 主网还不到一个月。
events.title_en: Circle brings USDC, EURC payments to SAP customers through Tereina
events.title_zh: Circle 通过 Tereina 将 USDC、EURC 支付引入 SAP 客户

updates.background_en: Tereina provides payment infrastructure that companies embed into business software so they can make payments without switching to a separate financial platform. EURC is Circle's euro-backed stablecoin, which the company says is redeemable 1:1 for euro with publicly available reserve attestations. Arc uses USDC for transaction fees and supports more than 20 fiat-backed stablecoins, including USDC and EURC.
updates.background_zh: Tereina 提供可嵌入企业软件的支付基础设施，使企业无需切换到单独的金融平台即可完成支付。EURC 是 Circle 发行的欧元背书稳定币，Circle 称其可按 1:1 兑换欧元，并公开储备金证明。Arc 使用 USDC 支付交易手续费，并支持包括 USDC 和 EURC 在内的 20 多种法币背书稳定币。

events.current_state_en: US government-linked wallets have moved Bitcoin on three consecutive nights, including 12,267 BTC on Oct. 8 (~$1.006 billion), of which 9,000 BTC (~$739 million) was traced to Coinbase Prime; earlier transfers included about 8,428 BTC on Oct. 7 and 834 BTC on Oct. 6 to Coinbase Prime. BTC fell to about $82,500 over the period. Whether the assets are for custody or eventual liquidation remains unconfirmed.
events.current_state_zh: 美国政府关联钱包已连续三个晚上转出比特币，包括10月8日的12,267枚BTC（约10.06亿美元），其中9,000枚（约7.39亿美元）被追踪至Coinbase Prime；此前还有10月7日约8,428枚BTC和10月6日834枚BTC转入Coinbase Prime。比特币价格同期跌至约82,500美元。这些资产是托管还是最终清算仍不确定。
events.title_en: US Government Moves Seized Bitcoin and Crypto to Coinbase Prime

updates.current_state_en: US government-linked addresses continued moving large amounts of crypto to Coinbase Prime and other addresses, with about $670 million transferred over roughly 32 hours across BTC, USDT and BNB, fueling unconfirmed speculation about potential sales.
updates.current_state_zh: 美国政府相关地址持续向Coinbase Prime等地址转移大量加密资产，近32小时累计转出约6.7亿美元，涉及BTC、USDT和BNB，市场对潜在出售的猜测升温但尚未确认。

updates.what_changed_en: US government addresses continued transferring crypto over roughly 32 hours, with cumulative outflows around $670 million including 6,215.7 BTC (~$520 million), 119 million USDT and 40,285 BNB (~$31.63 million), with the BTC and USDT routed into Coinbase Prime.
updates.what_changed_zh: 美国政府地址在约32小时内持续转出累计价值约6.7亿美元的加密资产，包括6,215.7枚BTC（约5.2亿美元）、1.19亿枚USDT和40,285枚BNB（约3163万美元），其中BTC和USDT均转入Coinbase Prime。

updates.background_en: The funds trace back to the 2016 Bitfinex hack and were seized by US authorities, who announced a $3.6 billion recovery from the case. In 2025, President Donald Trump signed an executive order creating a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve that includes Bitcoin seized by US law enforcement.
updates.background_zh: 这批资金可追溯至 2016 年的 Bitfinex 黑客事件，由美国政府缴获，美方曾宣布在该案中追回 36 亿美元资产。2025 年，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普签署行政令设立「战略比特币储备」，其中包含美国执法部门缴获的比特币。
updates.current_state_en: After earlier routing roughly $670 million into Coinbase Prime, US government-linked addresses moved an additional 12,267.02 BTC (~$1.006 billion), with 6,000 BTC sent to a new address and about 6,267 BTC held in another new address; whether this is for custody or eventual liquidation remains unconfirmed.
updates.current_state_zh: 美国政府相关地址在先前约6.7亿美元资产转入Coinbase Prime后，再次转出12,267.02枚BTC（约10.06亿美元），其中6,000枚转入新地址，约6,267枚暂存另一新地址；是否最终托管或清算仍不确定。
updates.detailed_summary_en: A US government address tied to seized Bitfinex hacker funds transferred 12,267.02 BTC (~$1.006 billion), with 6,000 BTC split into a new address and the rest held in another, following ~$670M of BTC, USDT and BNB moved earlier into Coinbase Prime.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: A US government address tied to seized Bitfinex hacker funds transferred 12,267.02 BTC (~$1.006 billion), with 6,000 BTC split into a new address and the rest held in another, following ~$670M of BTC, USDT and BNB moved earlier into Coinbase Prime.
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through sentiment and potential supply overhang on Bitcoin spot markets, with Coinbase Prime as the custody and trading venue where the coins have arrived. The transfers coincided with Bitcoin falling from about $86,500 to around $82,500, but no liquidation has been confirmed.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导路径主要经由市场情绪与比特币现货潜在的供给压力，而币安的去向终端是兼具托管与交易功能的 Coinbase Prime。转账期间比特币价格从约 86,500 美元回落至约 82,500 美元，但尚无抛售得到确认。

events.current_state_en: Samsung Wallet has launched stablecoin accounts for eligible U.S. Galaxy users, supporting USDC on Solana across about 82 million compatible devices; the service uses Bastion and Coinbase for custody/infrastructure, supports transfers to compatible wallets and bank payouts in 60+ countries, and Samsung plans to explore stablecoin payments and additional markets.

updates.title_en: Samsung Wallet to add USDC transfers for US Galaxy users in October
updates.title_zh: 三星钱包将于10月为美国Galaxy用户添加USDC转账功能
updates.what_changed_en: New report adds: USDC transfers will let eligible US Galaxy users send USDC to compatible wallets and off-ramp to bank accounts in 60+ countries via Bastion infrastructure; available on 82 million compatible Galaxy devices in the US with identity verification; Solana and Sui named as technical partners; no fee for USDC transfers to external wallets, international bank transfers incur fees varying by destination and amount; Borderless.xyz handles payouts in 60+ countries; future online and in-store stablecoin payments may follow.
updates.what_changed_zh: 新报道补充：USDC 转账功能将允许美国符合条件的 Galaxy 用户向兼容钱包发送 USDC，并通过 Bastion 基础设施在 60 多个国家提现至银行账户；覆盖美国 8200 万台兼容 Galaxy 设备，用户需完成身份验证；Solana 和 Sui 被列为技术合作伙伴；向外部钱包转账免手续费，国际银行转账收费因目的地和金额而异；Borderless.xyz 负责 60 多国的支付；未来可能支持线上和店内稳定币支付。

updates.background_en: A stablecoin is a type of cryptocurrency designed to maintain a stable value relative to a reference asset, most commonly a fiat currency such as the US dollar, using reserve assets or algorithmic mechanisms; despite the name, stablecoins have not always held their peg. Samsung Wallet is Samsung's mobile wallet on Galaxy devices, which has primarily handled payment cards, passes and keys rather than crypto transfers. Stablecoin issuance and usage have increasingly drawn regulatory attention across jurisdictions as transaction volumes have grown.
updates.background_zh: 稳定币是一种旨在相对于某一参考资产（最常见的是美元等法定货币）保持价值稳定的加密货币，依靠储备资产或算法机制实现，但顾名思义，稳定币并不总能维持锚定。Samsung Wallet 是三星在 Galaxy 设备上的移动钱包，此前主要用于支付卡、票券与数字钥匙，而非加密资产转账。随着交易规模上升，稳定币的发行与使用在全球各地日益受到监管关注。
updates.current_state_en: Samsung announced that Samsung Wallet will offer stablecoin access to eligible Galaxy users in the United States, extending stablecoin functionality to a mass-market consumer wallet.
updates.current_state_zh:
三星宣布，Samsung Wallet 将为美国符合条件的 Galaxy 用户提供稳定币访问，把美元支持的加密资产带给主流智能手机用户群体。相关报道将该功能描述为支持 USDC，使美国 Galaxy 用户可以将资金转入银行账户和加密钱包，并计划未来扩展到更多国家。

此举通过一家全球大型设备厂商，把美元支持的稳定币直接呈现在大众智能手机用户面前，形成了一条与加密原生应用和交易所不同的消费者触达渠道。

该消息停留在标题层面的承诺；有关此次整合的报道指出，稳定币发行方、完整支持代币清单等多项实施细节尚未披露。搜索摘录还提到，该功能初期仅面向美国符合条件的 Galaxy 用户，未来将扩展至更多国家。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Samsung announced that Samsung Wallet will offer stablecoin access to eligible Galaxy users in the United States, extending stablecoin functionality to a mass-market consumer wallet.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Samsung announced that Samsung Wallet will offer stablecoin access to eligible Galaxy users in the United States, extending stablecoin functionality to a mass-market consumer wallet.
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission channel is consumer distribution and custody: embedding dollar stablecoin transfers in a mass-market OEM wallet could widen the retail on-ramp for dollar stablecoins and shift some peer-to-peer payment flows away from crypto-native apps, with the scale of any effect depending on which tokens, fees and geographies are ultimately supported. Segments most directly exposed are dollar stablecoin issuers, mobile wallet and payments providers competing for the same Galaxy user base, and Samsung's own device-services ecosystem.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道是消费者分发与托管：在一款大众市场的手机厂商钱包中嵌入美元稳定币转账，可能拓宽美元稳定币的零售入口，并使部分点对点支付流量从加密原生应用分流，实际影响规模取决于最终支持的代币、费用与覆盖地区。受影响最直接的板块包括美元稳定币发行方、争夺同一 Galaxy 用户群的移动钱包与支付服务商，以及三星自身的设备服务生态。

updates.detailed_summary_en: Artificial Analysis's independent evaluation scores Claude Haiku 5.5 at 43 on its composite intelligence index — ahead of GPT-6 Luna's 38 and near Kimi K3's 44 — but finds it burns roughly 3.2x the tokens of Luna at maximum reasoning effort, pushing estimated per-task cost to about $0.21 versus $0.07, while its high-effort tier nearly matches Luna at far lower token usage.

events.current_state_en: Payward, the parent company of Kraken, completed its acquisition of Bitnomial, giving it a full set of US derivatives licenses covering exchange, clearing, and brokerage functions.
events.current_state_zh:
加密货币交易所 Kraken 的母公司 Payward 已完成对加密衍生品平台 Bitnomial 的收购，从而获得覆盖交易所、清算和经纪业务的美国完整衍生品牌照组合。

这笔交易使一整套获得 CFTC 完整牌照的衍生品架构——指定合约市场（DCM）、衍生品清算组织（DCO）与期货佣金商（FCM）——归入美国规模最大的加密交易所集团之一。Kraken 表示，此次合并将 Bitnomial 受 CFTC 监管的基础设施，与自身的客户基础以及覆盖 Kraken、NinjaTrader 及其更广泛产品线的分销能力结合在一起。

有报道称交易金额为 5.5 亿美元的现金加股票。所获得的牌照覆盖美国衍生品的三项核心功能：交易所（DCM）、清算（DCO）与经纪（FCM）。
events.title_en: Payward Closes Bitnomial Acquisition, Gains Full US Derivatives Licenses
events.title_zh: Payward 完成对 Bitnomial 的收购，获得美国完整衍生品牌照

updates.background_en: Bitnomial is a CFTC-regulated crypto derivatives platform that Payward agreed to acquire earlier; the announcement described it as creating a fully CFTC-licensed derivatives platform. Kraken's parent also owns the futures trading platform NinjaTrader, and one search result frames the $550 million deal as part of Kraken's push toward a regulated derivatives business and a possible IPO.
updates.background_zh: Bitnomial 是一家受 CFTC 监管的加密衍生品平台，Payward 此前已宣布收购计划，当时称此举将打造一个拥有 CFTC 完整牌照的衍生品平台。Kraken 的母公司同时拥有期货交易平台 NinjaTrader；一则搜索结果将这桩 5.5 亿美元的交易描述为 Kraken 推进受监管衍生品业务乃至可能上市的一部分。

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Payward, the parent company of Kraken, completed its acquisition of Bitnomial, giving it a full set of US derivatives licenses covering exchange, clearing, and brokerage functions.
updates.market_impact_en: The combination concentrates US-regulated crypto derivatives exchange, clearing and brokerage under one group, which affects how US-based traders can access regulated crypto futures and options and shifts the competitive positioning of CFTC-licensed venues. The transmission runs mainly through the regulatory and market-structure channel rather than through token supply or custody.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次合并将美国受监管的加密衍生品交易所、清算与经纪业务集中于同一集团，这会影响美国交易者获取受监管加密期货与期权的方式，并改变持 CFTC 牌照的交易场所之间的竞争格局。其传导主要经由监管与市场结构渠道，而非代币供给或托管渠道。

events.current_state_en: Starknet's community has approved the non-binding research proposal supporting research into becoming an independent post-quantum L1; a working group will develop technical proposals and a draft whitepaper is planned for November, but the vote does not authorize an actual transition, a later binding governance vote is still required, and Starknet currently remains an Ethereum L2.

updates.background_en: Starknet, built by StarkWare, is an Ethereum ZK-rollup that has been weighing a shift from layer 2 to independent layer 1 status. Co-founder and CEO Eli Ben-Sasson cited control over the network's own security migration timeline and preparation for quantum computing and AI-related threats, with a stated path to quantum resistance by 2027.
updates.background_zh: Starknet 由 StarkWare 开发，是一条以太坊 ZK rollup，近期一直在评估从二层转为独立一层。联合创始人兼 CEO Eli Ben-Sasson 提到，此举是为了掌控自身安全迁移的时间表，并为量子计算和 AI 相关威胁做准备，同时提出了到 2027 年实现抗量子能力的路径。
updates.current_state_en: Starknet's seven-day non-binding STRK holder vote on whether to research becoming an independent post-quantum L1 remains open, currently at about 99.95% support, with voting set to close on Oct. 22 and final results not yet published; the vote does not authorize an actual transition.
updates.current_state_zh: Starknet 关于是否研究转为独立后量子 L1 的七天非约束性 STRK 持有人投票仍在进行，当前支持率约 99.95%，投票将于 10 月 22 日结束，最终结果尚未公布；该投票不授权实际迁移。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Starknet's Snapshot research proposal on whether the network should continue transitioning into an L1 is passing with 99.95% support (over 345 million votes in favor versus roughly 158,000 against), with voting set to close on October 22.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Starknet's Snapshot research proposal on whether the network should continue transitioning into an L1 is passing with 99.95% support (over 345 million votes in favor versus roughly 158,000 against), with voting set to close on October 22.
updates.market_impact_en: The vote does not change bridging, custody or settlement mechanics today; its transmission path runs through governance sentiment around the STRK token and how the market prices Starknet's security and settlement relationship with Ethereum if the L1 direction advances.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次投票目前并不改变跨链桥、托管或结算机制，其传导路径主要通过围绕 STRK 代币的治理情绪，以及若 L1 方向推进、市场如何重新定价 Starknet 与以太坊之间的安全与结算关系。

updates.what_changed_zh: Starknet 的七天非约束性 STRK 持有人投票已结束，提案以约 93.52% 的支持率获得通过，参与度创治理历史新高；StarkWare 与 Starknet Foundation 将成立工作组并计划在 11 月发布白皮书草案，但实际迁移仍需另行具有约束力的投票，Starknet 目前仍作为以太坊 L2 运行。

events.current_state_en: South Korean regulators and CrowdStrike have linked data breaches at seven-plus financial institutions, affecting tens of thousands of customers, to an attacker using the open-source agentic pentest framework ARTEX driven by DeepSeek v4.1-flash along with Claude Code, GLM-5.3 and Grok 4.6, with a suspect Telegram account denying involvement. The ARTEX developer has now closed the project and removed the original GitHub repository, though the source code has been backed up by others.
events.current_state_zh: 韩国监管机构和 CrowdStrike 已将七家以上金融机构的数据泄露事件与一名攻击者联系起来，该攻击者使用开源代理式渗透测试框架 ARTEX，并借助 DeepSeek v4.1-flash、Claude Code、GLM-5.3 和 Grok 4.6 驱动，影响数万名客户；一名疑似 Telegram 账户否认参与。ARTEX 开发者已宣布闭源并下架 GitHub 原始仓库，但源码已被他人备份。

events.current_state_en: Sui Foundation announced that Hashi, its native Bitcoin financial infrastructure that mints hBTC on Sui against BTC held on the Bitcoin network, will begin a phased mainnet launch this month backed by more than $500 million in capital commitments and over 20 institutional partners led by Anchorage Digital.
events.current_state_zh:
Sui Foundation 宣布，其原生比特币金融基础设施 Hashi 将于本月启动主网，并采取分阶段上线方式。Hashi 已获得超过 5 亿美元资本承诺，由 20 多家加密行业机构组成的启动联盟参与；Anchorage Digital 作为首批合作伙伴加入，将通过其 Atlas 结算及三方抵押品基础设施和 Porto 机构自托管钱包提供接入渠道，并计划向 Hashi 提供稳定币流动性。

Hashi 的设计目标是让 BTC 留在比特币网络上的同时，在 Sui 上作为可编程抵押品使用，这一结构面向持有大量比特币的机构。Anchorage Digital 首席执行官兼联合创始人 Nathan McCauley 表示，上市公司和机构持有大量比特币，但其动用这部分资本的能力一直受制于可用技术以及 DeFi 领域的局限。

用户存入 BTC 后，Hashi 会在 Sui 上铸造对应的 hBTC；退出时 hBTC 被销毁，对应的原生 BTC 释放回比特币网络。安全方面，Hashi 采用 MPC、Sui 智能合约以及 Guardian Layer 构建多层防护，BTC 抵押品采用 2/2 多签机制，由 Hashi 验证者和 Guardian 共同授权；其智能合约已通过 Certora 形式化验证，CommonPrefix 完成了对 MPC 协议的密码学安全审查。

updates.background_en: Hashi was developed by Mysten Labs, the founding contributor to Sui, and the foundation said third parties will independently create and offer financial products on the infrastructure. Aftermath, Concrete and Fluid are named among the providers expected to run Hashi vaults, while BitGo, Bullish, Cumberland, FalconX and Ledger are also participating in the ecosystem. The $500 million-plus in capital commitments is intended to provide initial liquidity for Bitcoin financial markets on Hashi.
updates.background_zh: Hashi 由 Sui 的创始贡献者 Mysten Labs 开发，基金会表示第三方将基于该基础设施独立创建并提供金融产品。Aftermath、Concrete 和 Fluid 被列为预计运行 Hashi 金库的提供商，BitGo、Bullish、Cumberland、FalconX 和 Ledger 等机构也参与了生态建设。超过 5 亿美元的资本承诺将用于为 Hashi 上的比特币金融市场提供初始流动性。

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Sui Foundation announced that Hashi, its native Bitcoin financial infrastructure that mints hBTC on Sui against BTC held on the Bitcoin network, will begin a phased mainnet launch this month backed by more than $500 million in capital commitments and over 20 institutional partners led by Anchorage Digital.
updates.market_impact_en: The structure channels Bitcoin into Sui's DeFi market through a custody-and-collateral path rather than a bridge-style wrapped asset, so its immediate market relevance sits with BTC holders seeking stablecoin liquidity and with Sui lending, vault and structured-product venues such as Aftermath, Concrete and Fluid that would host hBTC-denominated markets. Institutional custody and settlement providers joining the launch coalition tie the asset's accessibility to compliance-gated venues rather than permissionless ones.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该结构通过托管与抵押品路径而非传统跨链封装方式把比特币引入 Sui 的 DeFi 市场，因此其直接市场关联方是寻求稳定币流动性的 BTC 持有者，以及 Aftermath、Concrete、Fluid 等承载 hBTC 计价市场的 Sui 借贷、金库和结构化产品场所。加入启动联盟的机构托管与结算服务商，使该资产的可及性更多取决于符合合规要求的渠道，而非完全无需许可的渠道。

events.current_state_en: The 79th Vault (79AU) on BNB Chain lost approximately $12.5M after a suspected operating hot-wallet private key leak, with the attacker dumping 2.01M 79AU back into the pool and cashing out 16,249 BNB while draining pool USDT reserves from $15.2M to $3.9M.
events.current_state_zh:
据 Defimon Alerts 监测，BNB Chain 上的 79th Vault（79AU）或因运营热钱包私钥泄露损失约 1250 万美元。该地址曾分 7 笔从交易对转出 201 万枚 79AU（金额分别为 1 万、10 万、10 万、30 万、50 万、50 万和 50 万枚），攻击者经约 95 笔兑换卖回同一交易对，套现 16249 枚 BNB（约 1250 万美元）。

池中 USDT 储备从 1520 万美元降至 390 万美元，意味着该 79AU 交易对的流动性提供者与用户承担了损失。按相关监测方的说法，这是一起疑似运营密钥泄露导致的盗币事件，而非合约逻辑漏洞被利用。

此外，运营密钥又向同一外部地址转入 3.79 枚 BNB，另有 50 万枚 79AU 转至其他地址。79AU 合约源代码未在 BscScan 上完成验证，外部审查者无法将已公开代码与链上实际运行代码进行比对。
events.title_en: 【79AU 运营热钱包疑似私钥泄露，损失约 1250 万美元】
events.title_zh: 【79AU 运营热钱包疑似私钥泄露，损失约 1250 万美元】

updates.background_en: 79Vault describes itself as a decentralized value management layer for the Web3 ecosystem, and 79AU is its token on BNB Chain. The team's operating hot wallet had normally been used only for small transfers into a rewards pool, making the large outflows unusual. Hot wallets store private keys in an online environment, which security analysts commonly treat as a high-value target for attackers.
updates.background_zh: 79Vault 自称是为 Web3 生态提供价值管理层的去中心化项目，79AU 是其在 BNB Chain 上的代币。该团队运营热钱包通常只做小额划转到奖励池，因此此次大额转出较为异常。热钱包的私钥存放在联网环境中，安全分析人士普遍将其视为攻击者的高价值目标。

updates.title_zh: 【79AU 运营热钱包疑似私钥泄露，损失约 1250 万美元】
updates.what_changed_en: The 79th Vault (79AU) on BNB Chain lost approximately $12.5M after a suspected operating hot-wallet private key leak, with the attacker dumping 2.01M 79AU back into the pool and cashing out 16,249 BNB while draining pool USDT reserves from $15.2M to $3.9M.
updates.what_changed_zh:
据 Defimon Alerts 监测，BNB Chain 上的 79th Vault（79AU）或因运营热钱包私钥泄露损失约 1250 万美元。该地址曾分 7 笔从交易对转出 201 万枚 79AU（金额分别为 1 万、10 万、10 万、30 万、50 万、50 万和 50 万枚），攻击者经约 95 笔兑换卖回同一交易对，套现 16249 枚 BNB（约 1250 万美元）。

池中 USDT 储备从 1520 万美元降至 390 万美元，意味着该 79AU 交易对的流动性提供者与用户承担了损失。按相关监测方的说法，这是一起疑似运营密钥泄露导致的盗币事件，而非合约逻辑漏洞被利用。

此外，运营密钥又向同一外部地址转入 3.79 枚 BNB，另有 50 万枚 79AU 转至其他地址。79AU 合约源代码未在 BscScan 上完成验证，外部审查者无法将已公开代码与链上实际运行代码进行比对。

events.current_state_en: The Moscow Exchange (MOEX) plans to begin offering cryptocurrency trading on December 1 under Russia's new regulations, with testing continuing until the official launch, according to senior managing director Boris Blokhin.
events.current_state_zh:
莫斯科证券交易所（MOEX）高级总经理鲍里斯·布洛欣向记者表示，该交易所计划从 12 月 1 日起依据俄罗斯新法规推出加密货币交易。据塔斯社报道，他表示在正式上线前将持续进行测试。

MOEX 是俄罗斯主要的证券交易所，其提出的加密货币交易计划意味着数字资产将进入该国核心受监管市场基础设施，而不再仅限于离岸或无牌平台。

该服务目前仍处于测试阶段，尚未正式上线；布洛欣未说明具体将交易哪些品种或业务范围。

events.current_state_en: Cisco disclosed two CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerabilities in its Firewall Management Center, one of which Interlock ransomware operators exploited as a zero-day before a patch was available.
events.current_state_zh:
思科披露其防火墙管理中心（FMC）存在两个未认证远程代码执行（RCE）漏洞，严重性评分均为最高的 CVSS 10.0。其中一处在补丁发布前已被 Interlock 勒索软件运营者作为零日漏洞利用。

在补丁发布之前，Interlock 勒索软件运营者已经利用了这两个最高严重性漏洞中的一个。由于 FMC 是广泛部署的企业安全管理平面，这种严重程度的未认证 RCE 为攻击者提供了控制整个防火墙资产的可能路径。

这两个漏洞均为未认证远程代码执行漏洞，CVSS 评分为最高的 10.0。其中一处在修复方案可用之前已被确认作为零日漏洞用于攻击。

updates.title_zh: 英国在新一轮对俄制裁中将Cryptomus和TokenSpot列为目标
updates.what_changed_en: The report adds further specific designations from the same UK Russia sanctions round: Xeltox Enterprises (Canadian owner of Cryptomus), Kyrgyz payment firms TokenSpot and Tsunami Payments, Processing KG (VexPay operator) and its director Ulan Bukabaev; it also notes internet services sanctions and identifies the A7 network as a Kremlin-backed illicit finance network.
updates.what_changed_zh: 新报道补充了英国同一轮对俄制裁的更多具体指定对象：加拿大公司Xeltox Enterprises因拥有Cryptomus被制裁、吉尔吉斯斯坦支付公司TokenSpot和Tsunami Payments、VexPay运营商Processing KG及其董事Ulan Bukabaev被制裁；制裁措施还包括互联网服务制裁，并将A7网络列为克里姆林宫支持的非法金融网络。

events.current_state_en: Securitize has launched tokenized versions of major US equities including Nvidia, Apple and Amazon on the Solana blockchain, extending real-world-asset tokenization to blue-chip stocks.
events.current_state_zh: Securitize 已在 Solana 区块链上推出包括 Nvidia、Apple 和 Amazon 在内的主要美国股票的代币化版本，将现实世界资产代币化扩展至蓝筹股。
events.title_en: Securitize Launches Tokenized US Stocks on Solana
events.title_zh: Securitize 在 Solana 上推出代币化美股

updates.background_en: Securitize is an SEC-registered transfer agent and tokenization platform whose own NYSE-listed Class A stock is issued natively onchain. Its shares have traded on Solana since its NYSE listing in July, and the SEC's "innovation exemption" opened a compliant path for tokenized stocks. Rivals from Coinbase to the NYSE and an OKX-ICE venture have also moved into the space.
updates.background_zh: Securitize 是一家在美国证券交易委员会（SEC）注册的过户代理与代币化平台，其自身在 NYSE 上市的 A 类股票以原生方式在链上发行。自 7 月在 NYSE 上市以来，其股票已在 Solana 上交易，而 SEC 的“创新豁免”为代币化股票开辟了一条合规路径。从 Coinbase 到 NYSE，以及 OKX-ICE 合资项目等竞争对手也已进入该领域。
updates.current_state_en: Securitize is launching tokenized shares of Apple, Nvidia and Tesla on its Solana-based platform, with plans to expand the tokens to NYSE and OKX digital trading venues.
updates.current_state_zh: Securitize正在其基于Solana的平台上推出苹果、英伟达和特斯拉的代币化股票，并计划将这些代币扩展至纽交所和OKX数字交易场所。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Securitize is launching tokenized shares of Apple, Nvidia and Tesla on its Solana-based platform, with plans to expand the tokens to NYSE and OKX digital trading venues.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Securitize is launching tokenized shares of Apple, Nvidia and Tesla on its Solana-based platform, with plans to expand the tokens to NYSE and OKX digital trading venues.
updates.market_impact_en: The launch channels tokenized U.S. equity exposure into the Solana ecosystem with USDC settlement, and Securitize names Ripple Prime and Aave as partners for onchain lending and collateral use, which could add a new collateral category to onchain credit markets. Any effect on the NYSE and OKX-ICE venues remains contingent, since both are still planned and not live.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次上线将以 USDC 结算的代币化美股敞口引入 Solana 生态，Securitize 提到 Ripple Prime 和 Aave 作为链上借贷与抵押用途的合作方，这可能为链上信贷市场增加一类新的抵押品。对 NYSE 和 OKX-ICE 交易场所的影响仍属条件性，因为两者均处于计划阶段、尚未上线。

events.current_state_en: The Aptos Foundation unveiled a tokenomics reform plan setting a 2.1 billion APT hard supply cap, halving staking rewards to 2.6%, raising transaction fees 10x, permanently locking and staking 210 million APT, and exploring buybacks in an effort to make APT deflationary.
events.current_state_zh:
Aptos 基金会提出了一项 APT 代币经济改革方案，拟将年度质押奖励从 5.19% 下调至 2.6%、将 Gas 费提高十倍，并将总供应量上限设为 21 亿枚 APT。根据该方案，基金会将永久锁定并质押 2.1 亿枚 APT（约占当前供应量的 18%），相关运营支出由质押奖励而非出售代币来承担。

基金会表示，这些调整旨在减少代币增发并增加销毁量，可能使 APT 具备通缩属性。未来的生态拨款将与业绩里程碑挂钩；随着首个四年解锁周期在 2026 年 10 月结束，年度化的代币解锁量预计将下降 60%。

上述措施目前仍属提案，尚未落地执行。此外，一项由现金储备和未来收入提供资金的回购计划也正在考虑之中。

updates.background_en: Aptos mainnet launched on October 12, 2022, and APT is used for fees, staking and governance, with validators securing the network through a proof-of-stake BFT model. New APT can be created through staking rewards, while part of transaction fees is burned. APT follows a vesting schedule with allocations to the community, core contributors, the Foundation, investors and staking rewards, with the full schedule extending into 2050.
updates.background_zh: Aptos 主网于 2022 年 10 月 12 日上线，APT 用于支付手续费、质押和治理，验证者通过权益证明（PoS）BFT 模型维护网络安全。新的 APT 可通过质押奖励产生，同时部分交易手续费会被销毁。APT 采用归属（vesting）释放安排，份额分配给社区、核心贡献者、基金会、投资者和质押奖励，完整释放计划延续至 2050 年。
updates.current_state_en: Aptos Foundation proposed cutting staking rewards from 5.19% to 2.6%, raising gas fees tenfold, capping supply at 2.1 billion APT, permanently locking and staking 210 million APT, and tying grants to milestones while considering a buyback to cut emissions and make APT potentially deflationary.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Aptos Foundation proposed cutting staking rewards from 5.19% to 2.6%, raising gas fees tenfold, capping supply at 2.1 billion APT, permanently locking and staking 210 million APT, and tying grants to milestones while considering a buyback to cut emissions and make APT potentially deflationary.

updates.market_impact_en: APT spot and derivatives venues, along with staking and validator services, are the segments most directly exposed: the proposal targets issuance and staking yield through the supply and reward channel, while the reduced unlock schedule and the possible buyback would affect circulating supply and sell-side pressure if adopted.
updates.market_impact_zh: 受此影响最直接的领域是 APT 现货与衍生品交易场所，以及质押和验证者服务：该提案通过供应与奖励渠道直接作用于代币增发和质押收益率；若获通过，解锁计划缩减和潜在回购将影响流通供应与抛压。

events.current_state_en: Coinkite and its co-founders face a proposed class action in Ontario, Canada, alleging Coldcard's standard firmware used a predictable pseudo-random number generator that made seed phrases reproducible and left users' bitcoin vulnerable, with claims under consumer protection and sale-of-goods law plus negligence and breach of contract.
events.current_state_zh: Coinkite 及其联合创始人在加拿大安大略省面临一项拟议的集体诉讼，指控 Coldcard 的标准固件使用可预测的伪随机数生成器，使种子短语可被复现，导致用户的比特币面临风险，诉讼依据消费者保护和货物销售法提出，并包含过失和违约索赔。

events.current_state_en: The Consensys-ClearToken partnership remains in place to provide round-the-clock DvP settlement between tokenized securities and fiat, tokenized deposits, and stablecoins; ClearToken's CSD has received Bank of England Digital Securities Sandbox Gate 2 approval to operate a limited digital securities depository, while clearing operations still require Bank of England authorization.
events.current_state_zh: Consensys与ClearToken的合作维持，提供代币化证券与法币、代币化存款及稳定币之间的全天候DvP结算基础设施；ClearToken旗下CSD已获英国央行数字证券沙盒Gate 2批准，可在限额内运营数字证券存管，但清算业务仍须英国央行授权。

updates.current_state_en: Consensys and ClearToken announced a strategic partnership to deliver round-the-clock DvP settlement infrastructure for wholesale markets, tokenizing eligible bank securities under the Bank of England's Digital Securities Sandbox and settling against fiat, tokenized deposits, and stablecoins.
updates.current_state_zh: Consensys 与 ClearToken 宣布建立战略合作伙伴关系，为批发市场提供全天候的 DvP 结算基础设施，在英格兰银行的数字证券沙盒下对符合条件的银行证券进行代币化，并以法币、代币化存款和稳定币进行结算。

events.current_state_en: Sui is launching Hashi, an institutional protocol that lets holders use Bitcoin as collateral for lending without moving it off the Bitcoin network, debuting with $500 million in commitments from over 20 partners ahead of a phased mainnet rollout.
events.current_state_zh:
Layer-1 区块链 Sui 即将推出 Hashi，这是一个机构级协议，允许持有者在不把比特币移出比特币网络的前提下，将其用作借贷抵押品；主网计划于本月晚些时候分阶段上线。该计划启动时已获得来自 20 多家行业合作伙伴组成的联盟共 5 亿美元的资金承诺。

首日启动合作伙伴 Anchorage Digital 的 CEO Nathan McCauley 表示，将机构客户与 Hashi 连接起来代表着“一次彻底的范式转变”；Mysten Labs 联合创始人 Adeniyi Abiodun 则表示，机构希望在不放弃其所需保护措施的情况下让比特币发挥作用。

这 5 亿美元是资金承诺而非即时存款，预先承诺的资金旨在让市场在启动首日就具备流动性。按其设计，BTC 被锁定在比特币区块链上的金库地址中，由 2-of-2 多签保护，并设有独立的守护层；同时在 Sui 上铸造名为 hBTC 的凭证代币。Certora 对智能合约进行了形式化验证，CommonPrefix 则审查了其多方计算（MPC）协议的密码学实现。
events.title_en: New tech to power bitcoin lending is set to debut with $500 million in commitments
events.title_zh: 驱动比特币借贷的新技术即将上线，已获5亿美元承诺资金

updates.background_en: Sui is a Layer 1 blockchain developed by Mysten Labs, a company founded in September 2021 by former engineers from Meta's Diem project. Sui estimates roughly $1 trillion worth of bitcoin is currently sitting idle, and the article notes bitcoin-collateralized borrowing is spreading beyond speculative trading to uses such as tuition, real estate and corporate working capital. Reported launch partners include Anchorage Digital, BitGo, Bullish, Cumberland, FalconX and Ledger.
updates.background_zh: Sui 是由 Mysten Labs 开发的 Layer 1 区块链，该公司于 2021 年 9 月由 Meta 旗下 Diem 项目的前工程师创立。Sui 估计目前约有价值 1 万亿美元的比特币处于闲置状态，文章还指出，比特币抵押借贷正从投机交易扩展到学费、房地产和企业营运资金等用途。据报道，启动合作伙伴包括 Anchorage Digital、BitGo、Bullish、Cumberland、FalconX 和 Ledger。

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Sui is launching Hashi, an institutional protocol that lets holders use Bitcoin as collateral for lending without moving it off the Bitcoin network, debuting with $500 million in commitments from over 20 partners ahead of a phased mainnet rollout.
updates.market_impact_en: If the pledged capital converts into deposits, Hashi would route institutional bitcoin collateral into Sui-based lending, credit and real-world-asset markets through hBTC vouchers while the underlying BTC stays on the Bitcoin network, potentially activating part of the roughly $1 trillion of idle bitcoin Sui cites. Because the $500 million is commitments rather than live deposits and the mainnet is rolling out in phases, the near-term transmission runs mainly through Sui's DeFi liquidity and institutional custody arrangements rather than the broader bitcoin market.
updates.market_impact_zh: 如果承诺资金转化为实际存款，Hashi 将通过 hBTC 凭证把机构比特币抵押品引入 Sui 上的借贷、信贷和现实世界资产市场，而底层 BTC 仍留在比特币网络中，这可能激活 Sui 所称约 1 万亿美元闲置比特币中的一部分。由于这 5 亿美元是承诺而非即时存款，且主网分阶段上线，短期内的影响主要通过 Sui 的 DeFi 流动性和机构托管安排传导，而非波及更广泛的比特币市场。

updates.title_en: New tech to power bitcoin lending is set to debut with $500 million in commitments
updates.title_zh: 驱动比特币借贷的新技术即将上线，已获5亿美元承诺资金
updates.what_changed_en: Sui is launching Hashi, an institutional protocol that lets holders use Bitcoin as collateral for lending without moving it off the Bitcoin network, debuting with $500 million in commitments from over 20 partners ahead of a phased mainnet rollout.
updates.what_changed_zh:
Layer-1 区块链 Sui 即将推出 Hashi，这是一个机构级协议，允许持有者在不把比特币移出比特币网络的前提下，将其用作借贷抵押品；主网计划于本月晚些时候分阶段上线。该计划启动时已获得来自 20 多家行业合作伙伴组成的联盟共 5 亿美元的资金承诺。

首日启动合作伙伴 Anchorage Digital 的 CEO Nathan McCauley 表示，将机构客户与 Hashi 连接起来代表着“一次彻底的范式转变”；Mysten Labs 联合创始人 Adeniyi Abiodun 则表示，机构希望在不放弃其所需保护措施的情况下让比特币发挥作用。

这 5 亿美元是资金承诺而非即时存款，预先承诺的资金旨在让市场在启动首日就具备流动性。按其设计，BTC 被锁定在比特币区块链上的金库地址中，由 2-of-2 多签保护，并设有独立的守护层；同时在 Sui 上铸造名为 hBTC 的凭证代币。Certora 对智能合约进行了形式化验证，CommonPrefix 则审查了其多方计算（MPC）协议的密码学实现。

events.current_state_en: France's full National Assembly has passed by a single vote a 2027 budget amendment removing tax deferral for crypto-to-MiCA-stablecoin conversions, treating them as taxable disposals from January 1, 2027; the finance committee had also adopted a 31.4% rate, self-custody reporting above €100,000, and a crypto exit tax, while rejecting the revenue section; the measures remain in first reading, are not law, and still require Senate review, with votes expected Oct. 20 and Nov. 17.

updates.current_state_en: France's National Assembly finance committee has adopted multiple crypto tax amendments in the 2027 budget, including a 31.4% capital gains tax on crypto-to-MiCA-stablecoin swaps, annual reporting for self-custody wallets holding €100,000 or more, an expanded exit tax, and 10-year crypto loss carryforwards; it then rejected the budget's revenue section 31-3. The amendments must be resubmitted to the full National Assembly, a revenue vote is expected Oct. 20, and the budget must pass by Dec. 10; no measure is yet law.
updates.current_state_zh: 法国国民议会财政委员会已通过2027年预算中多项加密税收修正案，包括将加密兑MiCA稳定币按31.4%资本利得征税、自托管钱包持有10万欧元以上年度申报、扩大退出税及允许加密损失结转10年；委员会随后以31票对3票否决预算收入部分，修正案需重新提交国民议会全体审议，收入部分预计10月20日投票，预算需在12月10日前通过，目前均未成为法律。
updates.detailed_summary_en: French lawmakers introduced a proposal to tax crypto-to-MiCA-stablecoin swaps at the 31.4% capital gains rate starting January 2027, alongside a €100,000 self-hosted wallet disclosure rule and an extended exit tax, drawing warnings that traders could migrate to unregulated offshore channels.

updates.what_changed_en: New facts: a separate Oct. 7 amendment backed by the finance committee would allow crypto losses to be carried forward up to 10 years; Chainalysis' France CEO warned the 31.4% regulated-stablecoin tax could push trading toward unregulated offshore stablecoins; lawmakers have until Dec. 10 to pass the 2027 budget.

updates.current_state_en: France's full National Assembly has passed by a single vote a 2027 budget amendment removing tax deferral for crypto-to-MiCA-stablecoin conversions, treating them as taxable disposals from January 1, 2027; the finance committee had also adopted a 31.4% rate, self-custody reporting above €100,000, and a crypto exit tax, while rejecting the revenue section; the measures remain in first reading, are not law, and still require Senate review, with votes expected Oct. 20 and Nov. 17.

events.current_state_en: A previously undisclosed 80-page Binance internal report obtained by the WSJ reveals that a network tied to US-sanctioned Iranian financier Babak Zanjani operated 21 Binance accounts with roughly $850 million in total trading volume, including at least $67 million sent from two accounts to IRGC-linked wallets.
events.current_state_zh:
《华尔街日报》获得的一份此前未披露的、共 80 页的币安内部报告显示，与被美国制裁的伊朗金融家 Babak Zanjani 关联的网络在币安涉及 21 个账户，总交易额约 8.5 亿美元，其中至少 6700 万美元从两个账户流向与伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）相关的钱包。币安表示已于 2025 年底冻结相关账户，并于今年 5 月移除该客户的最后一个账户。

该披露提供了新细节，说明一个被美国和以色列当局指为与 IRGC 有关的支付网络如何通过一家头部交易所转移资金；币安对此予以反驳，称将账户总交易量等同于流向 IRGC 的资金「具有重大误导性」。

该报告由币安于今年 4 月应阿联酋金融情报部门要求编制。报告显示，Zanjani 旗下加密公司 Zedcex 的企业账户交易额近 8.3 亿美元，其中 5600 万美元提现至与 IRGC 相关的钱包；被币安列为高价值客户的塔吉克斯坦人 Sukhrob Oimakhmadov 自 2023 年底起从 IRGC 相关钱包接收超过 1000 万美元并转出资金。币安称此前曾因该客户与伊朗兑换商的交易对其展开调查，但保留了其账户。

updates.background_en: Babak Zanjani is an Iranian businessman and former billionaire who ran the UAE-based Sorinet Group and was arrested in late 2013 over accusations of withholding $2.7 billion in state oil money; he was convicted of corruption and sentenced to death, and in April 2024 his sentence was commuted to 20 years' imprisonment after assets were returned. The IRGC is a branch of Iran's armed forces that the United States and a number of other countries designate as a terrorist organization.
updates.background_zh: Babak Zanjani 是伊朗商人、前亿万富翁，曾掌管总部位于阿联酋的 Sorinet 集团，2013 年底因被指截留 27 亿美元国家石油资金被捕；他因腐败罪被判处死刑，在归还资产后于 2024 年 4 月改判为 20 年监禁。IRGC 是伊朗武装力量的分支，被美国及其他多个国家列为恐怖组织。

《华尔街日报》获得的一份此前未披露的、共 80 页的币安内部报告显示，与被美国制裁的伊朗金融家 Babak Zanjani 关联的网络在币安涉及 21 个账户，总交易额约 8.5 亿美元，其中至少 6700 万美元从两个账户流向与伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）相关的钱包。币安表示已于 2025 年底冻结相关账户，并于今年 5 月移除该客户的最后一个账户。

该披露提供了新细节，说明一个被美国和以色列当局指为与 IRGC 有关的支付网络如何通过一家头部交易所转移资金；币安对此予以反驳，称将账户总交易量等同于流向 IRGC 的资金「具有重大误导性」。

updates.market_impact_en: The story's transmission runs mainly through compliance and reputational channels for centralized exchanges and their sanctions-screening controls, focusing attention on how Iran-linked funds move through large trading venues and withdrawal rails. Renewed scrutiny of exchange AML and KYC practices can affect onboarding, account freezes and correspondent-banking relationships for venues handling high-risk flows.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该事件对市场的影响主要通过中心化交易所的合规与声誉渠道传导，聚焦于与伊朗相关的资金如何经大型交易平台和提现通道流动，以及相关制裁筛查机制。对交易所反洗钱与 KYC 实践的再度审视，可能影响其开户审核、账户冻结以及处理高风险资金场所的银行往来关系。

events.current_state_en: The Ledger hardware wallet supply-chain implant incident remains developing: Ledger has disclosed that a criminal group redistributed tampered devices through Southeast Asian distribution channels and tightened sales and delivery rules; Singapore police have now disclosed that some devices sold by local retailers contained malicious implants, with at least two cases since September 10 causing about S$3.5 million in losses, while Ledger reviews the cases, police investigations continue, and authorities and SEAL 911 trace funds.

updates.background_en: Tornado Cash is an open-source, non-custodial mixer on Ethereum Virtual Machine-compatible networks that obscures the link between source and destination addresses; the U.S. Treasury blacklisted it in August 2022, and a U.S. federal appeals court overturned that ruling in November 2024. The USDD PSM (Peg Stability Module) is USDD's built-in fixed-rate swap feature that converts between USDD and supported stablecoins at a 1:1 rate.
updates.background_zh: Tornado Cash 是一个开源、非托管的混币协议，运行于兼容以太坊虚拟机（EVM）的网络之上，用于切断资金来源与去向地址之间的链上关联；美国财政部曾于 2022 年 8 月将其列入黑名单，2024 年 11 月美国联邦上诉法院推翻了这一裁定。USDD 的 PSM（锚定稳定模块）是 USDD 内置的固定汇率兑换功能，可在 USDD 与支持的稳定币之间按 1:1 比例兑换。
updates.current_state_en: The Ledger-related supply-chain attack has confirmed losses approaching $90 million, with MistTrack tracking funds and Tether freezing substantial USDT; latest on-chain monitoring shows suspects moved 430.2 ETH (~$1.07M) to Tornado Cash and converted USDT to USDD via SUN.io and the USDD PSM, with some funds routed to a Binance hot wallet, while suspect wallets still hold ~$70.6M; device tampering and attacker identity remain unconfirmed.
updates.current_state_zh: 与 Ledger 相关的供应链攻击事件确认损失近 9000 万美元，MistTrack 正在追踪资金，Tether 已冻结相关地址中的大量 USDT；最新链上监测显示嫌疑人已向 Tornado Cash 转入 430.2 ETH（约 107 万美元），并通过 SUN.io 及 USDD PSM 将 USDT 兑换为 USDD，部分资金流入 Binance 热钱包，相关钱包仍持有约 7060 万美元资产；设备篡改与攻击者身份仍未证实。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Suspects in the ~$90M Ledger distributor theft moved 430.2 ETH (~$1.07M) into Tornado Cash and, after Tether froze assets, converted USDT to USDD via SUN.io and the USDD PSM, with part of the funds routed to a Binance hot wallet while roughly $70.6M in traced assets reportedly remains in suspect wallets.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Suspects in the ~$90M Ledger distributor theft moved 430.2 ETH (~$1.07M) into Tornado Cash and, after Tether froze assets, converted USDT to USDD via SUN.io and the USDD PSM, with part of the funds routed to a Binance hot wallet while roughly $70.6M in traced assets reportedly remains in suspect wallets.
updates.market_impact_en: The episode illustrates how stablecoin issuer freeze powers can push stolen funds toward alternative stablecoins such as USDD and toward mixers like Tornado Cash, a channel that touches USDT/USDD swap liquidity and deposits into centralized-exchange hot wallets such as Binance's. The reported ~$70.6 million still sitting in suspect wallets is the main on-chain transmission point to watch.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此事显示出稳定币发行方的冻结权会推动被盗资金转向 USDD 等替代稳定币以及 Tornado Cash 等混币工具，这一路径涉及 USDT/USDD 兑换流动性以及流入 Binance 等中心化交易所热钱包的资金。据称仍留在嫌疑钱包中的约 7060 万美元资产，是后续链上资金传导的主要观察点。

updates.what_changed_en: Ledger officially confirmed it is investigating a CryptoBilis-linked supply-chain compromise and told CryptoBilis to pause all sales and shipments of Ledger devices; users who bought devices from CryptoBilis in the past 90 days were advised not to initiate setup and, if already set up, to move assets to a new Ledger signer.
updates.what_changed_zh: Ledger 官方确认正在调查与经销商 CryptoBilis 相关的供应链攻击，并要求 CryptoBilis 暂停所有 Ledger 设备的销售和发货；建议过去 90 天从 CryptoBilis 购买设备的用户不要进行初始化设置，若已设置则把资产转移到新的 Ledger 签名器。

updates.current_state_en: Ledger is investigating reported fund losses tied to Southeast Asian authorized reseller CryptoBilis; Ledger has asked CryptoBilis to suspend sales and shipments and warned customers who bought devices in the past 90 days. Onchain researchers estimate losses at roughly $72 million to $90 million, and Tether has frozen related USDT. Industry figures including Changpeng Zhao have publicly commented and called for industry help tracing funds, while Mark Karpelès is investigating whether malicious hardware components were implanted; the attack method, device tampering and attacker identity remain unconfirmed, and the investigation is ongoing.
updates.current_state_zh: Ledger 正在调查与东南亚授权经销商 CryptoBilis 相关的用户资金损失事件；Ledger 已要求 CryptoBilis 暂停销售和发货，并对过去90天内购买设备的客户发出警示。链上研究人员估计相关损失约为7200万至9000万美元，Tether 已冻结相关 USDT。赵长鹏等业内人士公开评论并呼吁行业协助追踪资金，Mark Karpelès 正调查设备是否植入恶意硬件组件，但攻击方式、设备是否被篡改及攻击者身份仍未确认，调查仍在进行中。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Ledger suspended sales and shipments through Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis and urged recent buyers to move funds to fresh wallets, while Tether froze USDT tied to suspected thefts from Ledger customers that investigators estimate at nearly $90 million.

updates.what_changed_en: Industry figures publicly intervened: Binance founder Changpeng Zhao warned users and said the incident appears localized to a single-vendor supply-chain attack; former Mt. Gox CEO Mark Karpelès is investigating whether malicious hardware components were implanted in customer devices and asked CryptoBilis to open some unsold Ledger wallets for circuit-board inspection. Reports also note Ledger's Genuine Check verifies the Secure Element but may not detect physical modifications elsewhere in the hardware.
updates.what_changed_zh: 行业人士开始公开介入调查：币安创始人赵长鹏警告用户谨慎，称事件似乎局限于单一供应商的供应链攻击；前 Mt. Gox CEO Mark Karpelès 正在调查是否有恶意硬件组件被植入发给客户的设备，并要求 CryptoBilis 打开部分未售出的 Ledger 钱包检查内部电路板。此外，报道指出 Ledger 的 Genuine Check 只能验证安全芯片，可能无法发现硬件其他部位的物理篡改。

updates.current_state_en: SlowMist's CISO outlined how a tampered Ledger device could record the mnemonic words from the screen's SPI data lines and exfiltrate them via an embedded LTE/eSIM module, following Mark Karpelès' report of receiving a Ledger with a hidden spy module.
updates.current_state_zh: 在Mark Karpelès报告收到一台内置隐藏间谍模块的Ledger之后，SlowMist的首席信息安全官概述了一台被篡改的Ledger设备如何从屏幕的SPI数据线记录助记词，并通过嵌入式LTE/eSIM模块将其外泄。

updates.current_state_en: Ledger is investigating reported fund losses tied to Southeast Asian authorized reseller CryptoBilis; CryptoBilis has now suspended all brand hardware-wallet sales in its physical stores and online channels in Malaysia, the Philippines and Indonesia, temporarily closed physical stores, and is cooperating with Ledger’s investigation while independent experts review its processes. Ledger had already asked CryptoBilis to suspend sales and shipments and warned customers who bought devices in the past 90 days. Onchain researchers estimate losses at roughly $72 million to $90 million, and Tether has frozen related USDT. The attack method, device tampering and attacker identity remain unconfirmed, and the investigation is ongoing.

updates.detailed_summary_en: CryptoBilis suspended all hardware-wallet sales and closed physical stores across Malaysia, the Philippines, and Indonesia while cooperating with a Ledger investigation, warning customers not to activate units bought from its channels and to move assets to Ledger devices using newly generated mnemonics.

updates.current_state_en: Following the suspected tampering of Ledger devices sold through CryptoBilis that led to roughly $90M in stolen assets, OneKey published an analysis of the hardware supply-chain attack path and announced five hardware-wallet improvements, including upgraded anti-tamper packaging, a screenless initialization flow, and firmware/hardware-level encryption of internal mainboard bus communications.
updates.current_state_zh: 在通过CryptoBilis销售的Ledger设备疑似被篡改、导致约9000万美元资产被盗后，OneKey发布了对该硬件供应链攻击路径的分析，并宣布五项硬件钱包改进，包括升级防篡改包装、无屏幕初始化流程，以及内部主板总线通信的固件/硬件级加密。

updates.background_en: Ledger opened an investigation into wallet drains tied to devices sold by Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis and on October 9 asked the reseller to pause sales. CryptoBilis's former co-founder confirmed the company was acquired in March and said the founding team exited all operational, management and administrative roles, adding that they are "no longer part of the company." Security researchers, including SlowMist's CISO and Mark Karpelès, have described implants designed to capture seed phrases, with Karpelès saying firmware cannot detect the attack because the module only listens when the screen refreshes.
updates.background_zh: Ledger 已就与东南亚经销商 CryptoBilis 所售设备相关的钱包被盗事件展开调查，并于 10 月 9 日要求该经销商暂停销售。CryptoBilis 前联合创始人证实公司已于今年 3 月被收购，创始团队退出所有运营、管理及行政职务，并表示“我们已不再是公司的一部分”。包括 SlowMist 首席信息安全官和 Mark Karpelès 在内的安全研究人员描述了旨在窃取助记词的植入模块；Karpelès 称固件无法检测该攻击，因为模块仅在屏幕刷新时进行监听。
updates.current_state_en: Ledger has confirmed that an affected user's device contained a hardware implant, prompting reseller CryptoBilis to suspend sales of its entire hardware wallet inventory while the supply-chain investigation proceeds.
updates.current_state_zh: Ledger已确认一名受影响用户的设备中含有硬件植入物，促使经销商CryptoBilis暂停其全部硬件钱包库存的销售，供应链调查仍在进行中。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Ledger has confirmed that an affected user's device contained a hardware implant, prompting reseller CryptoBilis to suspend sales of its entire hardware wallet inventory while the supply-chain investigation proceeds.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Ledger has confirmed that an affected user's device contained a hardware implant, prompting reseller CryptoBilis to suspend sales of its entire hardware wallet inventory while the supply-chain investigation proceeds.
updates.market_impact_en: The confirmed implant hits the reseller channel for self-custody hardware in Southeast Asia, where buyers relying on CryptoBilis-distributed devices face custody and asset-security exposure rather than exchange-level risk. It also feeds broader scrutiny of hardware wallet supply-chain verification, which could affect demand patterns for devices bought through third-party resellers versus direct channels.
updates.market_impact_zh: 已确认的植入模块直接冲击东南亚自托管硬件的经销渠道，依赖 CryptoBilis 分销设备的用户面临的是托管与资产安全风险，而非交易所层面的风险。此事也会加剧对硬件钱包供应链验证的审视，可能影响用户通过第三方经销商与官方直营渠道购买设备的偏好结构。

CryptoBilis is listed as an official Ledger reseller for Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines.

updates.market_impact_en: The report bears on the self-custody hardware-wallet segment: if devices bought through third-party resellers can carry implants that defeat standard attestation checks, risk perception shifts toward direct-from-vendor purchasing and can affect demand for wallets distributed through reseller channels, feeding into the broader self-custody security narrative.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该事件影响自托管硬件钱包这一细分领域：若通过第三方经销商购买的设备可能携带可绕过标准验证的植入装置，风险认知将转向官方直购渠道，并可能影响经销商渠道的硬件钱包需求，进而波及更广泛的自托管安全叙事。

updates.current_state_en: The Ledger hardware wallet supply chain implant incident remains under investigation: Ledger confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in one affected user's device, CryptoBilis has suspended all hardware wallet sales, and independent estimates put suspected losses at about $93.2 million across 315 wallets on six chains, while Genuine Check only verifies the secure element and cannot detect physical implants that leave it intact.
updates.current_state_zh: Ledger硬件钱包供应链植入事件仍在调查中：Ledger确认一名受影响用户的设备存在未经授权的硬件植入，CryptoBilis已暂停所有硬件钱包销售；独立估计称疑似盗损约9320万美元，涉及六条链上315个钱包，而Genuine Check仅能验证安全元件，无法识别保持安全元件完好的物理植入。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Ledger has confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in one affected customer's wallet — a case that exposes a blind spot in its Genuine Check authenticity verification that only attests the secure element — while independent investigators estimate $93.2M in suspected thefts across 315 wallets on six chains and authorized reseller CryptoBilis suspends all hardware wallet sales pending the investigation.

updates.what_changed_en: Independent investigators updated the suspected theft estimate to about $93.2 million across 315 wallets on six chains, and disclosed that Ledger's Genuine Check only verifies the secure element and cannot detect physical implants when that element remains intact; Tibane Labs also documented three generations of Nano X implants, though its specimens came from Japanese marketplaces rather than CryptoBilis.
updates.what_changed_zh: 独立调查将疑似盗损估计更新为约9320万美元、涉及六条链上315个钱包，并披露Ledger Genuine Check仅验证安全元件，无法检测安全元件仍完好的物理植入；Tibane Labs还记录了三代Nano X植入物，但其样本购自日本市场而非CryptoBilis。

updates.current_state_en: The Ledger hardware-wallet supply-chain implant and theft incident remains under investigation: Ledger confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in at least one device and says all confirmed cases involve devices sold by CryptoBilis; independent estimates range from about $93.2 million across 315 wallets on six chains to $94.5 million across 521 addresses on seven chains, Tether has frozen $10 million in USDT, about $81 million remains traceable onchain, and some funds moved through Tornado Cash and Zcash; Ledger advised CryptoBilis customers not to set up unused devices and told those already using one to move assets to a new device with a newly generated recovery phrase.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Ledger says confirmed CryptoBilis-linked compromises are limited while investigators trace as much as $93.2M in stolen crypto from affected hardware wallets and Tether freezes $10M in USDT, urging customers to avoid unused devices and migrate funds to newly generated recovery phrases.

updates.what_changed_zh: OneKey的免费更换计划明确涵盖已使用设备，并将申请截止日期定为12月31日；通过CryptoBilis购买的OneKey设备更换资格范围为3月1日至10月12日。

updates.current_state_en: The CryptoBilis-linked Ledger wallet drain incident now spans multiple regions, with spyware-tampered devices alleged in Asia, Europe, and South America; Ledger confirmed the October 9 incident affected a limited number of CryptoBilis devices, losses exceed $86 million (Bitquery previously estimated $93.2 million with about $10 million frozen), Ledger continues to investigate and offers no repayment plan to affected buyers; former CryptoBilis CEO says the firm was acquired and he stepped down; a buyer reports a second tampered Ledger device from MediaMarkt, names distributor Aqipa, calls for a recall, and sends the device to Ledger for analysis.
updates.current_state_zh: CryptoBilis 相关 Ledger 钱包盗取事件已涉及多地区，间谍软件篡改设备在亚洲、欧洲和南美被指认；Ledger 确认 10 月 9 日事件影响有限数量的 CryptoBilis 设备，损失超过 8600 万美元（Bitquery 此前估计 9320 万美元，约 1000 万美元被冻结），Ledger 仍在调查且未向受影响买家提供赔偿计划；CryptoBilis 前 CEO 称公司已被收购并已卸任；一名买家报告从 MediaMarkt 发现第二台被篡改的 Ledger 设备，点名经销商 Aqipa，呼吁召回，并将设备送交 Ledger 分析。
updates.detailed_summary_en: A buyer reports finding a second tampered Ledger hardware wallet from MediaMarkt, names distributor Aqipa, and calls for a recall while the device is sent to Ledger for analysis.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: A buyer reports finding a second tampered Ledger hardware wallet from MediaMarkt, names distributor Aqipa, and calls for a recall while the device is sent to Ledger for analysis.
updates.title_en: Buyer Reports Second Tampered Ledger From MediaMarkt, Calls for Recall
updates.title_zh: 买家报告从MediaMarkt购买的第二台被篡改的Ledger，呼吁召回
updates.what_changed_en: A buyer reports a second tampered Ledger device from MediaMarkt, names distributor Aqipa, calls for a recall, and sends the device to Ledger for analysis.
