updates.current_state_en: The CryptoBilis-linked Ledger wallet drain incident now spans multiple regions, with spyware-tampered devices alleged in Asia, Europe, and South America; Ledger confirmed the October 9 incident affected a limited number of CryptoBilis devices, losses exceed $86 million (Bitquery previously estimated $93.2 million with about $10 million frozen), Ledger continues to investigate and offers no repayment plan to affected buyers; former CryptoBilis CEO says the firm was acquired and he stepped down, and CryptoBilis has ceased all hardware wallet sales; in a 72-hour update, Ledger said all confirmed cases involve CryptoBilis devices, its own systems and direct channels are unaffected, it is working with authorities, and it warned resellers not to restock returned products; a buyer reports a second tampered Ledger device from MediaMarkt, names distributor Aqipa, calls for a recall, and sends the device to Ledger for analysis.
updates.current_state_zh: CryptoBilis 相关 Ledger 钱包盗取事件已涉及多地区，间谍软件篡改设备在亚洲、欧洲和南美被指认；Ledger 确认 10 月 9 日事件影响有限数量的 CryptoBilis 设备，损失超过 8600 万美元（Bitquery 此前估计 9320 万美元，约 1000 万美元被冻结），Ledger 仍在调查且未向受影响买家提供赔偿计划；CryptoBilis 前 CEO 称公司已被收购并已卸任，CryptoBilis 已停止全部硬件钱包销售；Ledger 在 72 小时更新中称所有已确认案例均涉 CryptoBilis 设备，自身系统与直销渠道未受影响，正与主管部门合作并警告经销商不得重新上架退回产品；一名买家报告从 MediaMarkt 发现第二台被篡改的 Ledger 设备，点名经销商 Aqipa，呼吁召回，并将设备送交 Ledger 分析。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Ledger's 72-hour update states that every confirmed case in the suspected $87M wallet-draining incident traces back to hardware wallets sold by reseller CryptoBilis, which has now stopped all hardware wallet sales, while Ledger says its own systems and direct channels are unaffected.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Ledger's 72-hour update states that every confirmed case in the suspected $87M wallet-draining incident traces back to hardware wallets sold by reseller CryptoBilis, which has now stopped all hardware wallet sales, while Ledger says its own systems and direct channels are unaffected.
updates.title_en: Ledger Says All Confirmed Cases in Suspected $87M Drain Tied to Reseller CryptoBilis
updates.title_zh: Ledger称疑似8700万美元盗币事件中所有已确认案例均与经销商CryptoBilis有关
updates.what_changed_en: Ledger's 72-hour update says every confirmed case in the wallet-draining incident involves hardware wallets sold by reseller CryptoBilis; CryptoBilis has ceased all hardware wallet sales; Ledger says its own systems and direct channels are unaffected, is working with authorities, and reminds authorized resellers never to restock returned products.
updates.what_changed_zh: Ledger 在 72 小时更新中表示，钱包盗取事件所有已确认案例均涉及经销商 CryptoBilis 售出的硬件钱包；CryptoBilis 已停止全部硬件钱包销售；Ledger 称自身系统和直销渠道未受影响，正与主管部门合作，并提醒授权经销商不得将退回产品重新上架。

updates.current_state_en: Ledger has confirmed hardware implants in CryptoBilis-channel devices; the implant reads the screen to capture the 24-word seed phrase during initialization and exfiltrates it over LTE/eSIM without touching the Secure Element or transaction signing; all confirmed losses from the October 9 incident are linked to CryptoBilis-channel devices, while other channels remain unverified; CryptoBilis has suspended sales of Ledger products; Ledger says the total affected-user count and loss amount are not yet confirmed, online figures are unverified, and it advises users not to initialize uninitialized devices and for already-configured users to move assets and generate new seed phrases; the investigation continues.
updates.current_state_zh: Ledger 确认 CryptoBilis 渠道设备存在硬件植入，植入物通过读取屏幕截取 24 个助记词并经 LTE/eSIM 外传，且不触碰 Secure Element 或交易签名；10 月 9 日事件所有已确认损失均与 CryptoBilis 渠道设备有关，其他渠道暂未核实；CryptoBilis 已暂停销售 Ledger 产品；Ledger 称受影响用户总数及损失金额尚未确认，网上数字未经官方核实，建议未初始化设备不要设置、已设置用户转移资产并生成新助记词，调查仍在继续。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Ledger confirmed that some hardware wallets sold by reseller CryptoBilis contained unauthorized implants that read the screen to capture 24-word seed phrases during initialization and exfiltrate them over LTE via an embedded eSIM, with all confirmed losses from the October 9 theft linked to that sales channel.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Ledger confirmed that some hardware wallets sold by reseller CryptoBilis contained unauthorized implants that read the screen to capture 24-word seed phrases during initialization and exfiltrate them over LTE via an embedded eSIM, with all confirmed losses from the October 9 theft linked to that sales channel.
updates.title_en: Ledger确认经销商CryptoBilis设备遭硬件植入，助记词被LTE外传
updates.title_zh: Ledger确认经销商CryptoBilis设备遭硬件植入，助记词被LTE外传
updates.what_changed_en: Ledger's security team released the latest investigation update on the hardware implant incident, confirming that some Ledger devices sold by CryptoBilis contained unauthorized hardware implanted inside the casing that can read the screen and capture the 24-word seed phrase during initialization, then exfiltrate it over LTE via an embedded microcontroller and eSIM; the component does not modify the Secure Element or Ledger OS and does not interfere with transaction signing. Ledger also said it has not confirmed the total number of affected users or loss amount, and circulating online figures are unverified.
updates.what_changed_zh: Ledger 安全团队发布硬件植入事件最新调查进展，确认 CryptoBilis 销售的部分 Ledger 设备外壳内被植入未授权硬件，可在初始化时读取屏幕并截取 24 个助记词，再通过内置微控制器与 eSIM 经 LTE 外传；该组件不修改 Secure Element 或 Ledger OS，也不干预交易签名。Ledger 同时表示尚未确认受影响用户总数及损失金额，网上流传数字未经官方核实。

updates.current_state_en: Ledger detailed how malicious LTE-enabled implants embedded in Ledger hardware wallets sold by reseller CryptoBilis captured users' 24-word recovery phrases via an eSIM and transmitted them over cellular networks, prompting CryptoBilis to halt sales and Trezor and OneKey to cut ties with the reseller.
updates.current_state_zh: Ledger详细说明了经销商CryptoBilis所售Ledger硬件钱包中被植入的、支持LTE的恶意植入物如何通过eSIM捕获用户的24词助记词并通过蜂窝网络传输，促使CryptoBilis停止销售，Trezor和OneKey也与该经销商断绝关系。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Ledger detailed how malicious LTE-enabled implants embedded in Ledger hardware wallets sold by reseller CryptoBilis captured users' 24-word recovery phrases via an eSIM and transmitted them over cellular networks, prompting CryptoBilis to halt sales and Trezor and OneKey to cut ties with the reseller.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Ledger detailed how malicious LTE-enabled implants embedded in Ledger hardware wallets sold by reseller CryptoBilis captured users' 24-word recovery phrases via an eSIM and transmitted them over cellular networks, prompting CryptoBilis to halt sales and Trezor and OneKey to cut ties with the reseller.

updates.what_changed_en: Ledger detailed how malicious LTE-enabled implants embedded in Ledger hardware wallets sold by reseller CryptoBilis captured users' 24-word recovery phrases via an eSIM and transmitted them over cellular networks, prompting CryptoBilis to halt sales and Trezor and OneKey to cut ties with the reseller.
updates.what_changed_zh: Ledger详细说明了经销商CryptoBilis所售Ledger硬件钱包中被植入的、支持LTE的恶意植入物如何通过eSIM捕获用户的24词助记词并通过蜂窝网络传输，促使CryptoBilis停止销售，Trezor和OneKey也与该经销商断绝关系。

updates.current_state_en: Mark Karpelès confirmed via teardown images and video that a Ledger Flex purchased at Singapore airport's Metapod contained an implanted board and wiring that could steal the user's seed phrase, the latest evidence of an expanding hardware-wallet supply-chain compromise.
updates.current_state_zh: Mark Karpelès通过拆解图片和视频确认，在新加坡机场Metapod购买的一台Ledger Flex内含植入的电路板和线路，可窃取用户的助记词，这是硬件钱包供应链遭入侵范围扩大的最新证据。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Mark Karpelès confirmed via teardown images and video that a Ledger Flex purchased at Singapore airport's Metapod contained an implanted board and wiring that could steal the user's seed phrase, the latest evidence of an expanding hardware-wallet supply-chain compromise.

updates.title_zh: 新加坡机场所购Ledger Flex被确认植入间谍模块，硬件钱包供应链风险扩大

updates.current_state_en: Ledger has confirmed hardware implants in CryptoBilis-channel devices; the implant reads the screen to capture the 24-word seed phrase during initialization and exfiltrates it over LTE/eSIM without touching the Secure Element or transaction signing; all confirmed losses are linked to CryptoBilis-channel devices, while other channels are being investigated; CryptoBilis has suspended sales of Ledger products; MediaMarktSaturn has removed all Ledger products from its stores and online platforms and is in contact with the manufacturer; Ledger says the total affected-user count and loss amount are not yet confirmed, online figures are unverified, and it advises users not to initialize uninitialized devices and for already-configured users to move assets and generate new seed phrases; the investigation continues.

updates.detailed_summary_en: MediaMarktSaturn has removed all Ledger hardware wallets from its stores and online platforms after a buyer reported tampered devices containing unauthorized cables and cellular modules, widening Ledger's investigation beyond Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: MediaMarktSaturn has removed all Ledger hardware wallets from its stores and online platforms after a buyer reported tampered devices containing unauthorized cables and cellular modules, widening Ledger's investigation beyond Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis.

updates.title_zh: MediaMarktSaturn在篡改报告后下架Ledger产品
updates.what_changed_en: MediaMarktSaturn has removed all Ledger products from its stores and online platforms and is in contact with the manufacturer; this follows a buyer reporting two Ledger wallets purchased from separate MediaMarkt stores containing unauthorized cables and cellular modules, widening the investigation beyond CryptoBilis.
updates.what_changed_zh: MediaMarktSaturn 已将所有 Ledger 产品从门店和线上平台下架，并与制造商联系；此前一名买家报告在两家 MediaMarkt 门店购买的两台 Ledger 钱包内含未授权线缆和蜂窝模块，使调查范围扩大至 CryptoBilis 以外。

updates.current_state_en: Ledger is reviewing its consumer device sales policies and processes and assessing tamper-resistance protections, with its CTO advising users not to open suspicious wallets; the investigation has widened to channels such as MediaMarktSaturn, CryptoBilis halted sales, Trezor and OneKey cut ties, and estimated losses are around $90 million.
updates.current_state_zh: Ledger正在审查其消费者设备销售政策与流程并评估防篡改保护措施，CTO建议用户不要自行拆开可疑钱包；调查已扩展至MediaMarktSaturn等渠道，CryptoBilis停止销售，Trezor和OneKey断绝关系，估计损失约9000万美元。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Ledger is reviewing its consumer device sales policies and assessment of tamper-resistance protections, and urging users not to open suspicious hardware wallets, after spyware-planted devices led to an estimated $90M in stolen crypto.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Ledger is reviewing its consumer device sales policies and assessment of tamper-resistance protections, and urging users not to open suspicious hardware wallets, after spyware-planted devices led to an estimated $90M in stolen crypto.
updates.title_en: Ledger审查设备销售政策和流程，评估设备防篡改保护措施
updates.title_zh: Ledger审查设备销售政策和流程，评估设备防篡改保护措施
updates.what_changed_en: Ledger CTO Charles Guillemet said the company is reviewing its consumer device sales policies and processes and assessing device tamper-resistance protections; it also urged users not to open suspicious hardware wallets themselves but to send them to Ledger for inspection. The report also mentioned an estimated $90 million in crypto stolen in the spyware-planting incident.
updates.what_changed_zh: Ledger首席技术官Charles Guillemet表示，公司正在审查面向消费者的设备销售政策和流程，并评估设备的防篡改保护措施；同时提醒用户不要自行拆开可疑硬件钱包，而应寄送Ledger检查。报道还提及此次植入间谍软件事件造成约9000万美元加密货币被盗。

updates.current_state_en: Ledger's Donjon security team confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in wallets sold by Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis that reads the 24-word recovery phrase from the device screen during setup and transmits it over LTE via a provisioned eSIM, with all confirmed losses from the suspected $86M drain tied to devices bought through that reseller.
updates.current_state_zh: Ledger的Donjon安全团队确认，东南亚经销商CryptoBilis销售的钱包中存在未经授权的硬件植入物，该植入物会在设置过程中从设备屏幕读取24词恢复短语，并通过预置eSIM经LTE传输，所有已确认的损失均与通过该经销商购买的设备有关，疑似被盗资金达8600万美元。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Ledger's Donjon security team confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in wallets sold by Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis that reads the 24-word recovery phrase from the device screen during setup and transmits it over LTE via a provisioned eSIM, with all confirmed losses from the suspected $86M drain tied to devices bought through that reseller.

updates.title_en: Ledger Finds LTE Implant That Stole Recovery Phrases in Suspected $86M Drain
updates.title_zh: Ledger发现LTE植入物在疑似8600万美元盗取事件中窃取恢复短语
updates.what_changed_en: Ledger's Donjon security team confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in wallets sold by Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis that reads the 24-word recovery phrase from the device screen during setup and transmits it over LTE via a provisioned eSIM, with all confirmed losses from the suspected $86M drain tied to devices bought through that reseller.
updates.what_changed_zh: Ledger的Donjon安全团队确认，东南亚经销商CryptoBilis销售的钱包中存在未经授权的硬件植入物，该植入物会在设置过程中从设备屏幕读取24词恢复短语，并通过预置eSIM经LTE传输，所有已确认的损失均与通过该经销商购买的设备有关，疑似被盗资金达8600万美元。

updates.current_state_en: The incident remains under monitoring; Ledger has coordinated with German retailer MediaMarkt Saturn to suspend online and in-store sales while investigating a German user's suspected implant report. Ledger said there were no reported fund losses tied to that report and no signs of compromise to its infrastructure, systems, or services, with customer support and Donjon reviewing the report and inspecting devices. The previously confirmed CryptoBilis reseller device implants and suspected $86M drain remain part of the same supply-chain security incident.
updates.current_state_zh: 事件仍处于监控中；Ledger已与德国零售商MediaMarkt Saturn协调暂停其线上及线下门店销售，以调查一名德国用户报告的疑似植入物；Ledger称该报告相关事件暂无资金损失，亦无迹象表明其基础设施、系统或服务遭入侵，客服与Donjon团队正在审查报告并检查设备。此前已确认的CryptoBilis经销商设备植入物及疑似8600万美元损失仍属于同一供应链安全事件。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Ledger confirmed that MediaMarkt Saturn has suspended sales of its hardware wallets in Germany pending investigation into a user report of a suspected implanted device, with no funds lost and no sign of infrastructure compromise.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Ledger confirmed that MediaMarkt Saturn has suspended sales of its hardware wallets in Germany pending investigation into a user report of a suspected implanted device, with no funds lost and no sign of infrastructure compromise.
updates.title_en: Ledger：MediaMarkt暂停销售源于德国用户报告发现植入物，暂无资金损失
updates.title_zh: Ledger：MediaMarkt暂停销售源于德国用户报告发现植入物，暂无资金损失
updates.what_changed_en: New: Ledger officially confirmed it coordinated with MediaMarkt Saturn to suspend online and in-store sales in Germany pending investigation into a German user's suspected implant report; Ledger said there were no reported fund losses tied to that report and no signs of compromise to its infrastructure, systems, or services, with customer support reviewing the report and Donjon set to inspect devices.
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增：Ledger官方确认已与MediaMarkt Saturn协调暂停德国线上及线下门店销售，以配合一名德国用户疑似植入物报告的调查；Ledger表示该报告相关事件暂无资金损失，且无迹象表明其基础设施、系统或服务遭到入侵，客服正在审查报告，Donjon将检查设备。

updates.current_state_en: The incident remains under monitoring; the confirmed implant and suspected $86M drain remain tied to devices sold by CryptoBilis, which is not selling wallets during the investigation; MediaMarkt Saturn has suspended online and in-store Ledger sales in Germany; Karpelès’s teardowns also point to wallets sold by MediaMarkt, Singapore’s Metapod, and official Philippine reseller LazMall; Ledger says it has not verified a drain linked to devices bought elsewhere and is reviewing implant reports from other resellers and locations.
updates.current_state_zh: 事件仍处于监控中；已确认的植入物和疑似8600万美元资金流出仍与CryptoBilis销售的设备相关，CryptoBilis在调查期间停售；MediaMarkt Saturn已暂停德国线上及线下门店的Ledger销售；Karpelès的拆解分析还指向MediaMarkt、新加坡Metapod及菲律宾官方经销商LazMall销售的钱包；Ledger表示尚未核实其他渠道购买设备相关的资金流出，并正在审查其他经销商和地点的植入物报告。
updates.detailed_summary_en: German official Ledger reseller MediaMarkt has removed all Ledger products from stores and online platforms after spyware was found in wallets it sold, part of a supply-chain attack linked to an $86 million draining incident that has now surfaced across multiple official resellers.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: German official Ledger reseller MediaMarkt has removed all Ledger products from stores and online platforms after spyware was found in wallets it sold, part of a supply-chain attack linked to an $86 million draining incident that has now surfaced across multiple official resellers.
updates.title_en: German Ledger reseller pauses sales following $86M draining incident
updates.title_zh: 德国Ledger经销商在8600万美元盗取事件后暂停销售
updates.what_changed_en: The new report says Mark Karpelès has also found spyware in Ledger wallets sold by official Philippine reseller LazMall, further widening the affected-reseller scope; Ledger’s latest statement says it has not verified a drain linked to a signer bought elsewhere and is reviewing reports of implants in other signers and locations, while CryptoBilis remains not selling wallets during the investigation.
updates.what_changed_zh: 新报道称，Mark Karpelès 已在菲律宾官方经销商 LazMall 销售的 Ledger 钱包中也发现间谍软件，使受影响经销商范围进一步扩大；Ledger 最新声明称尚未核实来自其他渠道购买签名器的资金流出，并正在审查其他签名器和地点的植入物报告，同时 CryptoBilis 在调查期间继续停售。

updates.background_en: CryptoBilis is listed as an official Ledger reseller in Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines, and Ledger asked the company to pause all sales and shipments during the investigation. In May 2022, Trezor warned that counterfeit Model T wallets were being sold on a Russian marketplace by a non-authorized seller, with opened, resealed devices whose recovery phrases were predictable or predefined; its advice then was to buy only from its official shop or an authorized reseller. Trezor also said earlier this week that CryptoBilis was already off its seller list and that it had received no reports of tampered Trezor devices from that retailer.
updates.background_zh: CryptoBilis被列为Ledger在印度尼西亚、马来西亚和菲律宾的官方经销商，Ledger已要求该公司在调查期间暂停所有销售和发货。2022年5月，Trezor曾警告称，有未授权卖家在俄罗斯市场上销售假冒的Model T钱包，这些设备被拆开、重新封装并更换了内部元件，其生成的助记词可被预测或预先设定；当时Trezor的建议是只从官方商店或授权经销商购买。Trezor本周早些时候还表示，CryptoBilis此前已被移出其卖家名单，且未收到来自该零售商处被篡改Trezor设备的报告。
updates.current_state_en: After Ledger's Donjon team confirmed a spy implant in hardware wallets sold via reseller CryptoBilis that captures seed phrases and exfiltrates them over LTE — with $86M in suspected thefts traced onchain — Trezor moved to cut its own authorized reseller network by January 1, 2027 as a precaution.
updates.current_state_zh: 在Ledger的Donjon团队确认，通过经销商CryptoBilis售出的硬件钱包中被植入间谍程序，可捕获助记词并通过LTE外传——链上追踪到疑似被盗资金达8600万美元——之后，Trezor出于预防考虑，决定在2027年1月1日前削减其自有授权经销商网络。
updates.detailed_summary_en: After Ledger's Donjon team confirmed a spy implant in hardware wallets sold via reseller CryptoBilis that captures seed phrases and exfiltrates them over LTE — with $86M in suspected thefts traced onchain — Trezor moved to cut its own authorized reseller network by January 1, 2027 as a precaution.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: After Ledger's Donjon team confirmed a spy implant in hardware wallets sold via reseller CryptoBilis that captures seed phrases and exfiltrates them over LTE — with $86M in suspected thefts traced onchain — Trezor moved to cut its own authorized reseller network by January 1, 2027 as a precaution.
updates.market_impact_en: The incident transmits mainly through hardware-wallet distribution and self-custody trust: buyers of devices through third-party resellers face elevated counterparty risk, and wallet makers' reseller vetting, device sourcing and after-sale verification become the exposed segment rather than any specific token. Ledger's paused CryptoBilis sales and Trezor's shrinking reseller channel both shift volume toward direct-from-vendor purchases.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该事件主要通过硬件钱包分销渠道与自托管信任传导：通过第三方经销商购买设备的用户面临更高的交易对手风险，受影响的环节是钱包厂商的经销商审核、设备采购来源与售后验证，而非某一特定代币。Ledger暂停CryptoBilis销售、Trezor收缩经销商渠道，都会把销售转向厂商直销。

updates.title_en: Trezor Cuts Its Resellers After Ledger Finds Spy Implant in Crypto Wallets
updates.title_zh: Ledger发现加密钱包被植入间谍程序后，Trezor削减经销商
updates.what_changed_en: After Ledger's Donjon team confirmed a spy implant in hardware wallets sold via reseller CryptoBilis that captures seed phrases and exfiltrates them over LTE — with $86M in suspected thefts traced onchain — Trezor moved to cut its own authorized reseller network by January 1, 2027 as a precaution.
updates.what_changed_zh: 在Ledger的Donjon团队确认，通过经销商CryptoBilis售出的硬件钱包中被植入间谍程序，可捕获助记词并通过LTE外传——链上追踪到疑似被盗资金达8600万美元——之后，Trezor出于预防考虑，决定在2027年1月1日前削减其自有授权经销商网络。

updates.background_en: The investigation was disclosed on Oct 9 after users reported crypto asset thefts linked to Ledger devices bought through CryptoBilis, a reseller in the region; Ledger has said all confirmed losses involve devices sold through that reseller. Ledger said the only confirmed incidents remain contained in Southeast Asia and that it has not verified a drain linked to a device bought elsewhere. It added that it has no indication its own infrastructure, systems, services or direct sales channel have been compromised. Researchers have reported the implant in Ledger X devices since Sept 16, with tampered units offered at nearly half the original price.
updates.background_zh: 相关调查于 10 月 9 日公开，此前有用户报告称，通过区域经销商 CryptoBilis 购买的 Ledger 设备涉及加密资产被盗；Ledger 表示所有已确认的损失都涉及通过该经销商售出的设备。Ledger 称目前确认的相关事件仍局限于东南亚，尚未核实其他地区购买的设备与资金被盗有关。该公司还强调，没有迹象表明其自身基础设施、系统、服务或官方直销渠道遭到入侵。研究人员称，自 9 月 16 日起已发现 Ledger X 设备中被植入该装置，被篡改的设备以近原价一半的价格出售。
updates.current_state_en: Ledger has expanded its sales suspension request to resellers in six Southeast Asian countries and Hong Kong, with devices removed from shelves and the investigation ongoing; Ledger says confirmed incidents remain contained to Southeast Asia and it has not verified a drain linked to a device bought elsewhere.
updates.current_state_zh: Ledger已将销售暂停请求扩大至六个东南亚国家和香港的经销商，设备下架，调查仍在进行；Ledger称已确认事件仍限于东南亚，且未核实其他地区购买设备相关的资金流出。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Ledger asked resellers and distributors across six Southeast Asian countries plus Hong Kong to suspend sales and remove its hardware wallets from shelves while it investigates confirmed device-tampering incidents in the region.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Ledger asked resellers and distributors across six Southeast Asian countries plus Hong Kong to suspend sales and remove its hardware wallets from shelves while it investigates confirmed device-tampering incidents in the region.
updates.market_impact_en: The disruption sits in the physical retail and reseller channel for Ledger devices in Southeast Asia and Hong Kong, so the transmission runs through supply-chain integrity and self-custody sentiment rather than protocol liquidity. Ledger says its direct sales channel is unaffected, while rival Trezor's stated plan to end reseller authorizations from Jan 1, 2027 as a precautionary measure could shift hardware-wallet demand between vendors and sales channels.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次影响集中在 Ledger 设备在东南亚及香港的线下零售与经销渠道，传导路径主要作用于供应链完整性和自托管信心，而非协议流动性。Ledger 称其官方直销渠道未受影响；与此同时，竞争对手 Trezor 表示出于预防将于 2027 年 1 月 1 日终止对经销商的授权，这可能使硬件钱包需求在不同厂商和销售渠道之间发生转移。

updates.title_en: Ledger asks resellers to halt sales in Southeast Asia and Hong Kong
updates.title_zh: Ledger 要求经销商暂停在东南亚和香港的销售
updates.what_changed_en: Ledger requested resellers and distributors in Indonesia, Singapore, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia and Hong Kong to suspend sales and remove its hardware wallets from shelves while it investigates device tampering; this expands on the earlier request for reseller CryptoBilis to halt sales and shipments.
updates.what_changed_zh: Ledger要求印度尼西亚、新加坡、泰国、菲律宾、越南、马来西亚及香港的经销商暂停销售并下架硬件钱包，以调查设备篡改事件；此前仅要求经销商CryptoBilis停售和停止发货。

updates.current_state_en: Ledger has characterized the incident as a localized distribution-channel attack after devices left its control, requiring authorized resellers in Southeast Asia and Hong Kong to suspend sales and follow stricter return, storage, and reporting rules; inspections of devices from stores in Germany and elsewhere and warehouse samples found no tampering, with its chips/OS/servers uncompromised and investigation and law-enforcement tracing ongoing.
updates.current_state_zh: Ledger将事件定性为设备离开控制后的局部分销渠道攻击，要求东南亚及香港授权经销商暂停销售并执行更严格的退货、存放与上报规则；已检查德国等地门店及仓库样本未发现篡改，芯片/操作系统/服务器未受损，调查与执法追踪持续。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Ledger confirmed a localized distribution-channel attack in which criminals implanted hidden seed-phrase-stealing components into genuine devices resold through Southeast Asian distributors, and ordered authorized resellers in Southeast Asia and Hong Kong to suspend sales while tightening return, storage, and reporting rules.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Ledger confirmed a localized distribution-channel attack in which criminals implanted hidden seed-phrase-stealing components into genuine devices resold through Southeast Asian distributors, and ordered authorized resellers in Southeast Asia and Hong Kong to suspend sales while tightening return, storage, and reporting rules.
updates.title_en: Ledger回应硬件植入攻击：属局部分销渠道攻击，要求东南亚及香港授权渠道暂停销售
updates.title_zh: Ledger回应硬件植入攻击：属局部分销渠道攻击，要求东南亚及香港授权渠道暂停销售
updates.what_changed_en: Ledger formally characterized the incident as a localized distribution-channel attack after devices left its control, rather than a systemic supply-chain compromise, saying its chips, OS, and servers were not breached; it also tightened channel rules — returned devices cannot be resold even if seemingly new or unopened, products must not be displayed on shelves and must be stored in backrooms and delivered at purchase, and channels must promptly report anomalous products; Ledger added it bought and inspected devices at stores in Germany and elsewhere and checked warehouses and its own inventory samples without finding tampering, while working with law enforcement to trace funds.
updates.what_changed_zh: Ledger首次将事件正式定性为设备离开公司控制后的局部分销渠道攻击，而非系统性供应链攻击，并称芯片、操作系统及服务器未被攻破；同时收紧渠道规则：退货设备即便看似全新、未开封也不得再次出售，产品不得置于货架或展示区，须在后场存放并在购买时交付，渠道须及时上报异常产品；Ledger还表示已赴德国等地门店购买并拆检设备、检查仓库及自有库存样本，均未发现篡改，并正与执法机构追踪资金。

updates.current_state_en: Ledger disclosed that an organized syndicate spent months implanting malicious hardware into genuine Ledger devices and redistributing them through Southeast Asian resale channels to intercept seed phrases and drain user assets, while confirming its secure element chips, BOLOS OS, and server infrastructure were not compromised.
updates.current_state_zh: Ledger披露，一个有组织团伙花费数月时间将恶意硬件植入正版Ledger设备，并通过东南亚转售渠道重新分销，以拦截助记词并盗取用户资产；同时确认其安全芯片、BOLOS操作系统和服务器基础设施未遭入侵。

updates.background_en: The tampering reportedly involved a spy implant that blended into legitimate hardware without altering the secure chip or Ledger's firmware, so Ledger's Genuine Check still passed, according to BleepingComputer. A seed phrase is the master key that restores access to a crypto wallet, so a device that records it hands an attacker full control of the funds. The incident follows the Coldcard seed phrase debacle at the end of July.
updates.background_zh: 据BleepingComputer报道，此次篡改据称涉及一种混入正品硬件的间谍植入物，并未改动安全芯片或Ledger固件，因此Ledger的真伪校验（Genuine Check）仍然通过。助记词是恢复加密钱包的“主密钥”，因此记录助记词的设备会把资金控制权交给攻击者。此事发生在7月底Coldcard助记词风波之后。
updates.current_state_en: In the Ledger supply-chain implant incident, Chainalysis tallies over $103.4M in onchain thefts across 530 addresses, including a task-scammer who lost 60 BTC via three tampered Ledgers; Ledger maintains reseller suspension across Southeast Asia and Hong Kong, Trezor plans to cut far-flung resellers, and investigation and law-enforcement tracing continue.
updates.current_state_zh: Ledger 供应链植入事件中，Chainalysis 统计的链上被盗资金已超过 1.034 亿美元，涉及 530 个地址，并确认一名任务诈骗者因三台被篡改 Ledger 损失 60 BTC；Ledger 维持东南亚及香港经销商停售措施，Trezor 计划削减偏远地区经销商，调查与执法追踪持续。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Chainalysis reports a task-scammer lost 60 BTC (~$4.8M) after buying three tampered Ledger devices that recorded seed phrases, part of a broader supply chain attack in which thieves drained over $103.4M from 530 addresses, prompting Ledger to suspend its reseller network across South East Asia.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Chainalysis reports a task-scammer lost 60 BTC (~$4.8M) after buying three tampered Ledger devices that recorded seed phrases, part of a broader supply chain attack in which thieves drained over $103.4M from 530 addresses, prompting Ledger to suspend its reseller network across South East Asia.
updates.market_impact_en: The reseller suspension concentrates risk in the self-custody hardware wallet segment in South East Asia, where buyers relying on third-party resellers face custody exposure if a tampered device records their seed phrase; Ledger's statement limiting confirmed thefts to Asia is the main scope caveat. Separately, South Korea's move to block 27 unregistered exchange websites restricts domestic access through the web rather than apps, while Thailand's ETF rules open a regulated onshore channel for Bitcoin and Ether exposure.
updates.market_impact_zh: 经销商停售使东南亚自托管硬件钱包这一细分市场的风险集中显现——依赖第三方经销商的买家若买到会记录助记词的被篡改设备，其资产的托管安全将直接暴露；Ledger称已确认盗窃仅限于亚洲，是主要的范围限定。另外，韩国屏蔽27家未注册交易所网站，是在应用之外进一步限制本国用户的网页访问渠道；泰国的ETF规则则为比特币和以太坊敞口打开了一条受监管的境内通道。

updates.background_en: Ledger is a French hardware wallet maker founded in Paris in 2014; its devices store private keys offline. A recovery phrase, also called a seed phrase, is the backup that can restore a non-custodial wallet and all its keys on another device, which is why capturing it defeats the purpose of a hardware wallet. Supply-chain attacks target the less-secure links around a product — such as distribution and retail — rather than the manufacturer's own systems.
updates.background_zh: Ledger 是一家法国硬件钱包厂商，2014 年成立于巴黎，其设备将私钥离线保存。恢复短语（又称助记词）是可在另一台设备上恢复非托管钱包及其全部私钥的备份，因此一旦被窃取，硬件钱包的防护意义即被抵消。供应链攻击针对的往往是产品周边的薄弱环节——例如分销与零售渠道，而非厂商自身的系统。
updates.current_state_en: The Ledger hardware wallet supply-chain implant incident remains developing: Ledger has disclosed that a criminal group redistributed tampered devices through Southeast Asian distribution channels and tightened sales and delivery rules; Singapore police have now disclosed that some devices sold by local retailers contained malicious implants, with at least two cases since September 10 causing about S$3.5 million in losses, while Ledger reviews the cases, police investigations continue, and authorities and SEAL 911 trace funds.
updates.current_state_zh: Ledger硬件钱包供应链植入窃密组件事件仍在发展中：Ledger已披露犯罪团伙通过东南亚分销渠道转售被植入设备的做法并收紧销售和交付规则；新加坡警方最新披露当地零售商售出的部分设备含恶意植入，自9月10日以来至少两起案件造成约350万新加坡元损失，Ledger正复核案件，警方调查持续，同时与执法部门和SEAL 911追踪资金。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Singapore police disclosed that Ledger hardware wallets bought from local retailers contained malicious hardware implants designed to steal recovery phrases or private keys, with at least two cases since September 10 causing roughly S$3.5 million ($2.7 million) in losses while Ledger reviews the incidents and investigations continue.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Singapore police disclosed that Ledger hardware wallets bought from local retailers contained malicious hardware implants designed to steal recovery phrases or private keys, with at least two cases since September 10 causing roughly S$3.5 million ($2.7 million) in losses while Ledger reviews the incidents and investigations continue.
updates.market_impact_en: The incident bears on the hardware-wallet segment of self-custody: it exposes a retail-distribution channel risk rather than a flaw in the devices' firmware, which could shift user scrutiny toward where and how signing devices are sourced. Any broader market effect would run through sentiment around self-custody tooling rather than through asset prices directly.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该事件影响的是自托管领域的硬件钱包板块：暴露的是零售分销渠道风险，而非设备固件本身的缺陷，这可能使用户更加关注签名设备的购买来源与渠道。更广泛的市场影响主要经由围绕自托管工具的情绪传导，而非直接作用于资产价格。

events.current_state_en: Telegram's built-in Gram wallet has been rebranded as 'Money' and is now available to all of Telegram's 1B+ users, supporting Gram storage and transfers plus purchases of gifts and collectible usernames, with instant, network-fee-free transfers from Walt.
events.current_state_zh:
据 Walt 频道发文，Telegram 内置的 Gram 钱包已更名为「Money」，并开始向 Telegram 超 10 亿用户全面开放，此前该钱包仅对部分用户可用。Money 可用于存储和发送 Gram，以及购买礼物和收藏类用户名；用户可从 Walt 充值，转账即时到账且无网络费用。

此举将一款内嵌的、免网络费的托管钱包从部分用户扩展到 Telegram 全体用户，扩大了 Gram 存储与转账，以及礼物和收藏类用户名购买的使用范围。

该消息由 Walt 频道发布，来源指出该钱包此前仅对部分用户可用。Foresight News 此前报道，Wallet in Telegram 已更名为 Walt，继续提供交易、投资、收益产品、多链资产及跨链转账等服务。

updates.background_en: Telegram's original "Gram" was the native token of its Telegram Open Network, a project the U.S. SEC ruled illegal in 2020, leading Telegram to pay $18.5 million and return $1.2 billion. A CoinMarketCap listing now shows Gram as the token formerly known as Toncoin. Walt, which began as a Telegram wallet bot for buying Toncoin and Bitcoin, says it is trusted by 150 million users. Telegram introduced collectible usernames as tradable items in 2022.

events.current_state_en: A public disclosure details a Telegram Desktop vulnerability that let a single click exfiltrate a user's files and potentially take over their account, fixed on September 16 roughly three months after the June 25 report.
events.current_state_zh:
一名安全研究员发布文章，详述 Telegram Desktop 的一个漏洞：攻击者可将“任意文件读取”串联为“一键接管账号”，窃取 SSH 私钥、浏览器凭据存储以及云服务/API 令牌等本地文件。整个利用链的核心原语不变——始终是任意文件读取，变化的只是读取的目标。

该漏洞影响一款用户规模约十亿的即时通讯软件的桌面客户端，而一条只需一次点击的客户端利用链，可以把本地保存的凭据转化为账号接管。目前尚无与该披露相关的已证实大规模窃取事件被报道。

对该披露的报道指出，用户点击 Telegram 链接时 Telegram Desktop 可能已在运行，利用链涉及进程间通信（IPC）与 tg:// URL scheme。公开的概念验证演示了通过 Telegram 本身窃取文件，而被窃取的会话文件可能被攻击者用于复用受害者已登录的账号。
events.title_en: Telegram Desktop曝高危漏洞：点击恶意链接可一键窃取本地任意文件及会话，建议加密社区用户立即更新
events.title_zh: Telegram Desktop 高危漏洞可一键窃取本地文件及会话

updates.background_en: Telegram Desktop has drawn security advisories before, including a 2023 issue in the same HTML export feature that allowed arbitrary file reads; reporting says that issue was fixed in Desktop Beta 6.9.4 and Stable 7.0.1, though HTML exports created with older versions may remain unsafe. Earlier reporting also documented Telegram account hijacking via a separate voicemail route.
updates.background_zh: Telegram Desktop 此前已多次出现安全公告，其中包括 2023 年同一 HTML 导出功能中允许任意文件读取的问题；有报道称该问题已在 Desktop Beta 6.9.4 和 Stable 7.0.1 中修复，但由更早版本生成的 HTML 导出文件可能仍不安全。此前的报道还记录过通过另一条语音信箱路径劫持 Telegram 账号的方法。
updates.community_discussion_en: Commenters broadly treated the case as an illustration of a deeper design problem: one quoted the maxim that any sufficiently complex input format is indistinguishable from bytecode, and another argued software should not by default get access to all files and unrestricted internet access. A recurring complaint was that Telegram regularly re-enables in-app or account settings users had disabled, leaving users unsure of their exposure; others said they sandbox Telegram without SSH keys and tokens or avoid registering the tg:// scheme, and some prefer web versions over installing desktop software.
updates.community_discussion_zh: 评论区普遍将其视为更深层设计问题的例证：有人引用“任何足够复杂的输入格式都与字节码无异”的说法，也有人主张软件不应默认获得全部文件访问权和不受限制的联网能力。常见的抱怨是 Telegram 会定期重新开启用户已关闭的应用内或账号设置，令用户无法确认自身的暴露面；另一些人表示已将 Telegram 放入沙箱且不存放 SSH 密钥与令牌，或干脆不注册 tg:// scheme，还有人宁愿使用网页版而不安装桌面软件。
updates.current_state_en: Security researcher beaksec disclosed a high-severity Telegram Desktop flaw (CVE-2026-107181) in versions 7.2.8 and earlier that lets attackers use crafted tg:// links to read and exfiltrate arbitrary local files — including tdata session files, enabling account takeover — which is patched in 7.2.9, prompting an urgent update call for crypto community users.

对该披露的报道指出，用户点击 Telegram 链接时 Telegram Desktop 可能已在运行，利用链涉及进程间通信（IPC）与 tg:// URL scheme。公开的概念验证演示了通过 Telegram 本身窃取文件，而被窃取的会话文件可能被攻击者用于复用受害者已登录的账号。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Security researcher beaksec disclosed a high-severity Telegram Desktop flaw (CVE-2026-107181) in versions 7.2.8 and earlier that lets attackers use crafted tg:// links to read and exfiltrate arbitrary local files — including tdata session files, enabling account takeover — which is patched in 7.2.9, prompting an urgent update call for crypto community users.

updates.market_impact_en: Telegram is widely used by crypto communities and traders, and a one-click chain that harvests browser credential stores and API tokens touches custody and key-management risk for crypto users running the desktop client. The exposure runs through local credential theft rather than protocol or exchange mechanics, and with no confirmed theft reported there is no observable market effect yet.
updates.market_impact_zh: Telegram 被加密社区和交易者广泛使用，而这条可一键抓取浏览器凭据存储与 API 令牌的利用链，涉及使用桌面客户端用户的资产托管与密钥管理风险。其传导途径是本地凭据窃取，而非协议或交易所机制；由于尚无已证实的窃取事件，目前还看不到可观察到的市场影响。

events.current_state_en: Tether briefly blacklisted and froze four THORChain USDT vault addresses holding about 1.45 million USDT, pausing trading; the addresses were unfrozen hours later, trading resumed, and neither side explained the action.
events.current_state_zh: Tether 短暂黑名单并冻结 THORChain 四个 USDT 金库地址约 145 万 USDT，导致交易暂停；数小时后地址被解冻，交易恢复，双方未解释原因。
events.title_en: Tether Blacklists Four THORChain Vaults Holding 1.45 Million USDT
events.title_zh: THORChain 高管指责 Tether 暂时冻结 USDT 金库

updates.background_en: Tether's blacklist is enforced at the smart contract level through an addBlackList function that only Tether can call, and the issuer has frozen over $4.4 billion in USDT across more than 1,200 addresses, according to Valken. THORChain settles Tron assets through native vaults rather than bridge contracts. Earlier this week, cross-border payments platform Conduit Technology sued Tether, alleging it froze $2.76 million in USDT in a wallet tied to a 2024 investigation by Brazilian authorities, and two Thai nationals sued in August over an alleged freeze of $42.4 million following an "informal request" from US Homeland Security Investigations.
updates.background_zh: 据 Valken 介绍，Tether 的黑名单在智能合约层面通过只有 Tether 可调用的 addBlackList 函数执行，该发行方已冻结逾 44 亿美元、涉及 1200 多个地址的 USDT。THORChain 通过原生金库而非桥接合约结算 Tron 资产。本周早些时候，跨境支付平台 Conduit Technology 起诉 Tether，指其冻结了一个与巴西当局 2024 年调查相关钱包中价值 276 万美元的 USDT；两名泰国公民也在 8 月起诉 Tether，称其在美国国土安全调查局（HSI）的「非正式请求」下冻结了 4240 万美元的 USDT。
updates.current_state_en: Tether blacklisted four THORChain vaults holding 1.45 million USDT, prompting THORChain to halt Tron swaps and liquidity-provider operations without prior notice.
updates.current_state_zh: Tether 将四个持有 145 万 USDT 的 THORChain 金库列入黑名单，促使 THORChain 在未事先通知的情况下暂停 Tron 兑换和流动性提供者操作。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Tether blacklisted four THORChain vaults holding 1.45 million USDT, prompting THORChain to halt Tron swaps and liquidity-provider operations without prior notice.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Tether blacklisted four THORChain vaults holding 1.45 million USDT, prompting THORChain to halt Tron swaps and liquidity-provider operations without prior notice.
updates.market_impact_en: THORChain's Tron vaults hold native USDT-TRC20 settled without bridge contracts, so an issuer-level freeze directly blocks swaps, deposits and signing for that segment until it is reversed, showing that Tether-issued liquidity carries an issuer-controlled kill switch. The episode leaves a censorship-risk overhang on DeFi protocols and venues that depend on USDT on Tron, and on RUNE exposure to THORChain's cross-chain liquidity.
updates.market_impact_zh: THORChain 的 Tron 金库持有原生 USDT-TRC20，不经桥接合约结算，因此发行方层面的冻结会在解除前直接阻断该板块的兑换、充值与签名，表明 Tether 发行的流动性带有发行方可控的「开关」。该事件使依赖 Tron 上 USDT 的 DeFi 协议与交易场所继续承受审查风险，也波及通过 RUNE 暴露于 THORChain 跨链流动性的市场参与者。

updates.background_en: Tokenized deposits are digital representations of conventional bank deposits issued on a blockchain, with each token corresponding 1:1 to fiat currency held at a commercial bank. Anvita Flow is described as an on-chain agentic collaboration network where AI agents can register, discover services and settle payments. In an Oct. 8 report titled "Breaking The Wall," Citrini Research argued that autonomous AI agents could increase demand for programmable, always-on financial infrastructure, while Augustus Bank CEO Ferdinand Dabitz argued in a May interview that traditional clearing banks rely on decades-old systems built for human operations.

events.title_en: Aero Sets Oct. 21 Merger Launch and Token Conversion Terms
events.title_zh: Aero 确定 10 月 21 日启动合并并公布代币转换条款

updates.background_en: Aerodrome Finance is a decentralized exchange and liquidity hub on the Base L2 network, offering low-fee swaps and liquidity provision. Velodrome Finance is a decentralized exchange on the Optimism network with its own native token, VELO. The merger combines the two protocols' tokens under the AERO name.
updates.background_zh: Aerodrome Finance 是 Base 二层网络上的去中心化交易所和流动性枢纽，提供低手续费兑换和流动性提供服务。Velodrome Finance 是 Optimism 网络上的去中心化交易所，拥有自己的原生代币 VELO。此次合并将两个协议的代币统一到 AERO 名下。
updates.current_state_en:
Aerodrome and Velodrome have fixed Oct. 21 as the launch date for their merger and published the token conversion terms: AERO converts one-for-one, while VELO converts at roughly 0.044 new AERO per token. Existing locks retain their remaining duration.

The terms give holders of two widely used DEX tokens a defined path into a single token, consolidating Aerodrome's Base liquidity hub with Velodrome's Optimism operations. The VELO ratio also sets how much new AERO existing VELO exposure will represent.

The VELO conversion rate is stated as approximately 0.044 new AERO per token, while AERO is a one-for-one conversion. Locked positions are not shortened or extended by the merger — they keep their remaining duration.
updates.current_state_zh:
Aerodrome 与 Velodrome 已将 10 月 21 日定为合并启动日，并公布了代币转换条款：AERO 按 1:1 转换，VELO 每枚约可兑换 0.044 枚新 AERO。现有锁仓将保留其剩余期限。

这些条款为两种广泛使用的 DEX 代币持有者提供了转向单一代币的明确路径，将 Aerodrome 在 Base 上的流动性枢纽与 Velodrome 在 Optimism 上的业务合并。VELO 的兑换比例也确定了现有 VELO 头寸将对应多少新 AERO。

VELO 的兑换比例表述为每枚约 0.044 枚新 AERO，而 AERO 为 1:1 转换。锁仓头寸不因合并而缩短或延长，仍保留剩余期限。
updates.detailed_summary_en:

The terms give holders of two widely used DEX tokens a defined path into a single token, consolidating Aerodrome's Base liquidity hub with Velodrome's Optimism operations. The VELO ratio also sets how much new AERO existing VELO exposure will represent.

The VELO conversion rate is stated as approximately 0.044 new AERO per token, while AERO is a one-for-one conversion. Locked positions are not shortened or extended by the merger — they keep their remaining duration.
updates.detailed_summary_zh:

这些条款为两种广泛使用的 DEX 代币持有者提供了转向单一代币的明确路径，将 Aerodrome 在 Base 上的流动性枢纽与 Velodrome 在 Optimism 上的业务合并。VELO 的兑换比例也确定了现有 VELO 头寸将对应多少新 AERO。

VELO 的兑换比例表述为每枚约 0.044 枚新 AERO，而 AERO 为 1:1 转换。锁仓头寸不因合并而缩短或延长，仍保留剩余期限。
updates.market_impact_en: The conversion terms directly affect holders of AERO and VELO and the lock contracts that carry voting and reward rights, since the ratio determines how VELO-denominated positions map into the merged AERO token. Both tokens trade on-chain on Base and Optimism, so any liquidity migration between the two networks would flow through those venues and their pools.
updates.market_impact_zh: 转换条款直接影响 AERO 与 VELO 持有者以及承载投票权和奖励权的锁仓合约，因为该比例决定了以 VELO 计价的头寸将如何映射为合并后的 AERO 代币。两种代币分别在 Base 和 Optimism 上链上交易，因此两条网络之间若发生流动性迁移，将经由这些交易场所及其资金池传导。

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Aero completed its twice-delayed merger launch and replaced its ve(3,3) model with a revenue-linked tokenomics system, ending weekly voting and fixed emissions while expanding across seven chains.
updates.market_impact_en: AERO is the incentive token steering liquidity across Base DEX pools, so shifting emissions from vote-bribe-driven weekly cycles to a revenue-linked formula alters the demand channel for lockers and the way liquidity is directed across venues; the seven-chain expansion widens where those incentives can be deployed.
updates.market_impact_zh: AERO 是引导 Base 各 DEX 池流动性流向的激励代币，排放从由投票贿赂驱动的每周周期转向与收入挂钩的公式，会改变锁仓者的需求渠道以及流动性在不同场所间的导向方式；拓展至七条链则扩大了这些激励可部署的范围。

events.title_en: SkyAI, which holds over 2M $SOL($220M), appears to be dumping $SOL at a loss!
events.title_zh: 持有超200万枚$SOL（约2.2亿美元）的SkyAI疑似正在亏损抛售$SOL！

updates.background_en: SkyAI is described in crypto media coverage as a prominent holder in the Solana ecosystem managing significant amounts of SOL. The transfer was surfaced through Arkham Intelligence, a public blockchain explorer and analytics platform that labels and tracks on-chain entities. Exchange inflows are widely used by on-chain analysts as a proxy for possible selling, but they do not by themselves prove that a sale occurred.
updates.background_zh: 加密货币媒体报道称，SkyAI是Solana生态中持有大量SOL的知名大户。此次转账信息来自Arkham Intelligence——一个对链上实体进行标注和追踪的公开区块链浏览器与分析平台。链上分析师普遍将“转入交易所”视为可能抛售的代理指标，但这本身并不能证明卖出现已发生。
updates.current_state_en: On-chain data shows SkyAI, a holder of over 2M SOL (~$220M), has moved 568,000 SOL (~$63.87M) to exchanges in three days, apparently realizing a loss of roughly $46M against a ~$194 average entry.
updates.current_state_zh:
链上数据显示，持有超过200万枚SOL（约合2.2亿美元）的SkyAI在过去三天内向交易所转入了56.8万枚SOL（约合6387万美元）。其平均买入价约为194美元，若这些代币被卖出，预计将产生约4600万美元的亏损。

这一转账规模让SOL交易者关注到一个大型单一持有者的潜在抛压，不过抛售行为是根据转入交易所的资金流推断的，并未得到该实体的确认。

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Nasdaq-listed SOL treasury firm SkyAI is liquidating its SOL reserves, selling roughly 1.25 million SOL (~$138M) over five days — including a 211,623 SOL transfer to Coinbase Prime — to fund a buyback of 95% of its outstanding shares.
updates.market_impact_en: The transfers are routed to Coinbase Prime, an institutional trading and custody venue, so the roughly 1.25 million SOL represents a large, concentrated pool of sell-side supply for SOL over a short window. The unwind also feeds sentiment around the digital-asset-treasury model, where other listed SOL treasury holders are exposed to scrutiny over balance-sheet capacity and share-price discounts to holdings.
updates.market_impact_zh: 相关转账经由面向机构的交易与托管平台 Coinbase Prime 进行，因此这约 125 万枚 SOL 构成短期内规模较大且集中的 SOL 卖方供给。此次减持也会影响市场对数字资产财库（DAT）模式的情绪，其他上市的 SOL 财库公司可能因此面临对其资产负债表承受能力及股价相对持仓折价的审视。

updates.background_en: A cash tender offer is a public offer to buy shares directly from holders for cash at a fixed price and for a limited time. A pre-funded warrant grants the holder the right to acquire shares at a nominal exercise price, with the funding effectively provided at issuance; such instruments are commonly issued alongside financing transactions. SkyAI's disclosure follows a period in which several listed companies accumulated large SOL positions as corporate treasury assets.
updates.background_zh: 现金要约收购是向股东公开发出的、以固定价格在限定时间内用现金直接回购股份的要约。预融资权证赋予持有人以名义行权价取得股份的权利，其行权资金在发行时即已预付，这类工具常用于融资交易中。SkyAI此次披露之前，已有多家上市公司将大量SOL作为企业财库资产进行配置。
updates.current_state_en: SkyAI remains in an ongoing SOL liquidation: it has disclosed selling 1 million SOL for about $107M and may sell further; on-chain outflows since early October total about 1.57M SOL (~$175M), with unrealized losses over $160M on a ~$194 average cost basis, while the previously announced buyback of 95% of shares continues to be funded.
updates.current_state_zh: SkyAI 仍在持续清算其 SOL 储备：已披露出售 100 万枚 SOL 套现约 1.07 亿美元，并可能继续出售；链上累计转出约 157 万枚 SOL（约 1.75 亿美元），按约 194 美元均价计算浮亏超过 1.6 亿美元，原有回购 95% 股份的资金安排仍在推进。
updates.detailed_summary_en: SkyAI has sold 1 million SOL for roughly $107 million and signaled further sales, with on-chain data showing 1.57 million SOL (~$175M) moved out since early October and an unrealized loss exceeding $160 million on a ~$194 average cost basis.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: SkyAI has sold 1 million SOL for roughly $107 million and signaled further sales, with on-chain data showing 1.57 million SOL (~$175M) moved out since early October and an unrealized loss exceeding $160 million on a ~$194 average cost basis.
updates.market_impact_en: The disclosed sales and the company's stated willingness to keep selling put identifiable sell-side supply into SOL spot markets, where this holder's treasury position was one of the largest corporate ones. The separate $3.00-per-share cash tender offer affects the equity and pre-funded warrant side rather than the token, and the size of the unrealized loss is likely to weigh on sentiment toward corporate SOL treasury strategies.
updates.market_impact_zh: 已披露的出售以及公司表示可能继续抛售，为SOL现货市场带来了可识别的新增卖方供给，而该持有方的财库头寸曾是规模最大的企业持仓之一。每股3.00美元的现金要约收购作用于股票与预融资权证层面，而非代币本身；逾1.6亿美元的未实现亏损规模，可能影响市场对企业SOL财库策略的情绪。

updates.background_en: Digital asset treasury (DAT) companies hold crypto on their balance sheets as a listed-market vehicle, and the Solana segment has seen intensifying accumulation, with firms such as Forward Industries and DFDV reporting multi-million SOL positions. SkyAI's situation centers on how a listed treasury vehicle discloses and executes sales of its core reserve, and on the Form 8-K, the SEC filing companies use to report major events to shareholders.
updates.background_zh: 数字资产储备型公司（DAT）以持币作为上市公司资产，Solana 板块的储备积累竞争近期加剧，Forward Industries、DFDV 等公司均公布过数百万枚 SOL 的持仓。SkyAI 此次事件的核心，在于上市储备型公司如何披露和执行其核心储备的出售，以及 Form 8-K 这一用于向股东报告重大事件的 SEC 申报文件。
updates.current_state_en: SkyAI remains in an ongoing SOL liquidation: it disclosed selling 1M SOL for about $107M, on-chain outflows since early October total about 1.57M SOL (~$175M), an 8-K shows holdings down to ~600K SOL, with unrealized losses over $160M on a ~$194 average cost basis; its Oct 11 $3.00/share cash tender offer to buy back 95% of shares is now publicly opposed by 9.99% holder Bastion Trading, which demands full disclosure, an independent review, board changes, and a higher price of at least $3.50/share.
updates.current_state_zh: SkyAI 仍在持续清算其 SOL 储备：已披露出售 100 万枚 SOL 套现约 1.07 亿美元，链上自 10 月初以来累计转出约 157 万枚 SOL（约 1.75 亿美元），8-K 显示持仓已降至约 60 万枚，按约 194 美元均价计算浮亏超过 1.6 亿美元；公司 10 月 11 日宣布每股 3.00 美元现金要约收购以回购 95% 股份，但大股东 Bastion Trading 公开反对并要求全面披露、独立审查、改组董事会及提高要约价至至少 3.50 美元。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Nasdaq-listed Solana treasury firm SkyAI has offloaded roughly 1.75M SOL (~$175M) since early October, cutting holdings ~70% and crystallizing large losses, while 9.99% holder Bastion Trading is demanding full disclosure, an independent review, board changes, and a higher tender price before supporting the company's cash offer.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Nasdaq-listed Solana treasury firm SkyAI has offloaded roughly 1.75M SOL (~$175M) since early October, cutting holdings ~70% and crystallizing large losses, while 9.99% holder Bastion Trading is demanding full disclosure, an independent review, board changes, and a higher tender price before supporting the company's cash offer.
updates.market_impact_en: The disposal places roughly 1.57 million SOL of previously treasury-held supply into the market, a direct channel to SOL liquidity and supply. The contested tender offer also bears on the premium-to-NAV and financing capacity of listed SOL treasury vehicles, which can transmit to sentiment across the DAT segment.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次处置将约 157 万枚此前由公司金库持有的 SOL 投放至市场，构成对 SOL 流动性与供给的直接渠道。被质疑的要约收购还关系到上市 SOL 储备型公司的溢价水平与融资能力，并可能通过情绪渠道传导至整个 DAT 板块。

updates.current_state_en: The old XRP Ledger payment-engine vulnerability was fixed in xrpld 3.4.1; the Foundation confirmed the fix did not involve inflation and XRP supply remains fixed at 100 billion. The flaw was discovered and responsibly disclosed by Cayden Liao and Veria AI, the fix was distributed via emergency coordination and later ratified through the normal amendment vote, with no unauthorized XRP minting or fund loss.
updates.current_state_zh: XRP Ledger 的旧支付引擎漏洞已在 xrpld 3.4.1 中修复，基金会确认修复不涉及增发，XRP 供应量仍固定为 1000 亿枚；漏洞由 Cayden Liao 与 Veria AI 发现并负责任披露，修复经紧急协调分发后已通过正常修正案投票正式生效，未发生未授权 XRP 铸造或资金损失。
updates.detailed_summary_en: The XRP Ledger Foundation clarified that the xrpld 3.4.1 security fix addressed a hard-to-trigger rule-bypass vulnerability rather than any XRP inflation, affirming the 100 billion fixed supply and outlining its coordinated disclosure and amendment ratification process.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The XRP Ledger Foundation clarified that the xrpld 3.4.1 security fix addressed a hard-to-trigger rule-bypass vulnerability rather than any XRP inflation, affirming the 100 billion fixed supply and outlining its coordinated disclosure and amendment ratification process.
updates.title_en: XRP Ledger基金会澄清安全修复疑问：未增发XRP，供应量仍固定
updates.title_zh: XRP Ledger基金会澄清安全修复疑问：未增发XRP，供应量仍固定
updates.what_changed_en: The XRP Ledger Foundation clarified that the xrpld 3.4.1 fix addressed a rule-bypass vulnerability requiring hundreds of deliberately crafted operations, not XRP inflation; total supply remains fixed at 100 billion, with about 99.986 billion currently circulating. It also said the flaw was responsibly disclosed by Cayden Liao and Veria AI, public binaries were released on September 25, and 3.4.1 later became a required version through a normal amendment vote with over 80% support sustained for two weeks.
updates.what_changed_zh: XRP Ledger 基金会澄清 xrpld 3.4.1 修复的是需数百次刻意构造操作才能触发的规则绕过漏洞，而非 XRP 增发；XRP 总供应量固定为 1000 亿枚，当前流通约 999.86 亿枚。基金会还说明该漏洞由 Cayden Liao 与 Veria AI 负责任披露，并于 9 月 25 日发布公开二进制文件，后续通过超过 80% 支持持续两周的正常修正案投票使 3.4.1 成为必要版本。

updates.current_state_en: The old XRP Ledger payment-engine vulnerability is fixed in xrpld 3.4.1, which became a required version through a normal amendment vote; the Foundation and developers are publicly responding to questions about the emergency patch bypassing normal governance and XRPL's decentralization, with no unauthorized XRP minting or fund loss confirmed.
updates.current_state_zh: XRP Ledger 的旧支付引擎漏洞已在 xrpld 3.4.1 中修复，3.4.1 已通过正常修正案投票成为必需版本；基金会与开发者正公开回应关于紧急补丁绕过常规治理和网络中心化程度的质疑，确认无未授权 XRP 铸造或资金损失。
updates.detailed_summary_en: XRP Ledger developers defended their Sept. 25 emergency patch for a bug that could have created XRP beyond the network's fixed supply, saying they bypassed the usual two-week validator vote because publishing the fix first would have exposed the flaw to attackers, a move that has raised questions about how decentralized XRPL really is.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: XRP Ledger developers defended their Sept. 25 emergency patch for a bug that could have created XRP beyond the network's fixed supply, saying they bypassed the usual two-week validator vote because publishing the fix first would have exposed the flaw to attackers, a move that has raised questions about how decentralized XRPL really is.

updates.what_changed_en: The XRP Ledger Foundation and developers publicly defended the Sept. 25 emergency patch, saying waiting for the usual two-week validator vote would have exposed the flaw; they rejected centralization claims, stressing the decision was joint among the Foundation, RippleX, core developers and validators, and that 3.4.1 later became required via a normal amendment vote with over 80% support sustained for two weeks.
updates.what_changed_zh: XRP Ledger 基金会与开发者公开为 9 月 25 日紧急补丁辩护，称若等待常规两周验证者投票会提前暴露漏洞；他们否认中心化指控，强调决定由基金会、RippleX、核心开发者和验证者共同做出，且 3.4.1 后来通过正常修正案投票以超过 80% 支持持续两周成为必需版本。

updates.current_state_en: The XRP Ledger Foundation continued disclosing details of the supply-cap-related bug, explaining it stayed hidden for years because normal ledger parameters never triggered it; the XRP supply cap was not broken and no exploitation occurred.

updates.current_state_en: The XRP Ledger disclosed and patched an integer overflow in the payment engine that had been dormant since 2015 and is not triggered by normal payments; the 3.4.1 fix shipped on Sept. 25, and more than 80% of trusted validators were running it that day; there is no evidence the bug was ever exploited.
updates.current_state_zh: XRP Ledger 已披露并修复支付引擎中的整数溢出漏洞，该漏洞自 2015 年起潜伏且普通支付不会触发；3.4.1 补丁于 9 月 25 日发布，超过 80% 可信验证者当日已运行该补丁；无证据表明漏洞曾被利用。

updates.what_changed_en: Newly disclosed that the flaw was an integer overflow in the payment engine, present since the engine was written in 2015; an attacker could consume hundreds of specially crafted order-book offers to overflow the buyer's owed amount and underpay, while the ledger's built-in 'no XRP created' safety check used the same broken arithmetic and failed to catch it. The bug was reported through the XRPL bug bounty program in September.
updates.what_changed_zh: 新披露该漏洞是支付引擎中的整数溢出，自 2015 年支付引擎编写以来一直存在；攻击者通过消耗数百个特制订单簿报价可使买方应付款项溢出并少付，而账本内置的“未创建 XRP”安全检查使用同样的错误算术，因此无法拦截。漏洞由 XRPL 漏洞赏金计划于 9 月报告。

events.current_state_en:
Ripple's xrpld 3.4.1 disclosure details a critical payment-engine integer overflow that could have minted spendable XRP from thin air (patched 25 September, no exploitation found) and a batch-transaction encapsulation validation flaw addressed by the fixBatchV1_2 amendment, activated on mainnet on 9 October.

Subsequently, ZachXBT publicly criticized the XRP Ledger Foundation for paying only $250,000 to the white-hat hacker who reported the payment-engine flaw, arguing the low bounty discourages responsible disclosure.
events.current_state_zh:
Ripple 发布 xrpld 3.4.1 漏洞披露报告，涵盖两项问题。支付引擎中的严重级别整数溢出影响 3.4.0 及更早版本，可凭空铸造可花费的 XRP，该问题随 9 月 25 日发布的 xrpld 3.4.1 修复生效。另一项为批量交易内部封装校验漏洞（fixBatchV1_2 修正案），影响 3.3.0 与 3.4.0，已在 3.4.1 中修复，并于 10 月 9 日在主网激活。

报告称，未发现支付引擎漏洞在任何公开网络被利用的证据，批量交易问题也未造成资金损失或私钥泄露。但报告警告，若在未修复情况下激活 BatchV1_1，存在网络活性中断或账本中留下畸形记录的风险。

此后，ZachXBT 公开批评 XRP Ledger 基金会仅向报告该支付引擎漏洞的白帽黑客支付 25 万美元赏金，认为赏金过低会鼓励攻击者直接利用漏洞窃取资金。
events.title_en: 【Ripple 披露两项漏洞修复：支付引擎整数溢出可凭空铸造 XRP，批量交易封装校验亦存共识风险】

updates.background_en: XLS-56 batch transactions let a group of up to eight transactions be applied atomically in a single "outer" wrapper, with one network fee paid for the whole group. An independent report said the public mainnet Amendments ledger entry at validated ledger 107541231 contained both BatchV1_1 and fixBatchV1_2. The payment engine issue was submitted by Cayden Liao and Veria AI through the XRPL bug bounty program, with a proof of concept.
updates.background_zh: XLS-56 批量交易允许最多 8 笔内部交易通过一个“外层”封装原子化执行，整组交易只需支付一笔网络手续费。一份独立报告称，公开主网 Amendments 账本条目在已验证账本 107541231 中同时包含 BatchV1_1 与 fixBatchV1_2。支付引擎问题由 Cayden Liao 与 Veria AI 通过 XRPL 漏洞赏金计划提交，并提供了概念验证。

报告称，支付引擎在汇总跨多个挂单的金额时使用 64 位整数且缺少溢出检查，当求和超过上限时会回绕，向挂单方贷记全额、仅向买方收取回绕后的金额。利用该问题需构造数百笔恶意挂单，成本约数百枚 XRP 的储备与手续费，普通支付无法触发该路径。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Ripple's xrpld 3.4.1 disclosure details a critical payment-engine integer overflow that could have minted spendable XRP from thin air (patched 25 September, no exploitation found) and a batch-transaction encapsulation validation flaw addressed by the fixBatchV1_2 amendment, activated on mainnet on 9 October.

updates.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through XRP supply integrity and sentiment: an unpatched mint path on the XRP Ledger would have called into question the fixed supply assumptions that underpin XRP pricing and custody on exchanges, even though the report found no exploitation and no fund loss. The batch-transaction fix matters for the venues and applications planning to rely on XLS-56 atomic execution, since an unfixed flaw risked liveness interruption.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导路径主要经由 XRP 的供应完整性与市场情绪：若该铸造路径未被修复，将动摇支撑 XRP 定价与交易所托管的固定供应假设，尽管报告称未发现被利用、也无资金损失。批量交易修复则关系到计划依赖 XLS-56 原子化执行的场所与应用，因为未修复的缺陷存在活性中断风险。

events.current_state_en: LeCun's AMI Labs and academic collaborators released H-JEPA, a hierarchical world model in which each planning level learns its own environment features, raising maze-navigation success from 18.0% to 73.3% over a single-layer baseline with less planning compute, with paper, code, and pretrained weights made public.
events.current_state_zh:
杨立坤创办的 AMI Labs 联合多所高校公布 H-JEPA，一种分层预测未来、规划动作的世界模型：高层负责远期目标，低层将其细化为具体动作，且每个层级学习自己的环境特征。论文、代码和预训练权重均已公开；在 Visual AntMaze 仿真迷宫中，三个规划层级的 H-JEPA 成功率达到 73.3%，单层 LeWorldModel 为 18.0%，且前者所需的规划计算量更少。

这一发布把杨立坤早在 2022 年提出的构想变成了可以端到端训练的实现方案，而 Visual AntMaze 上的成功率为 73.3%，明显高于单层基线且规划计算量更少。与此前各层共用同一套特征的 HWM 不同，H-JEPA 让每个层级学习自己的环境特征。

规划层级并非越多越好：在模拟推物体的 Push-T 任务中，三层模型反而不如两层。团队还用真实机器人录像数据集 DROID 进行了离线测试，预测动作轨迹比单层模型更接近专家示范。

updates.background_en: JEPA, or Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture, is a self-supervised approach that learns by predicting abstract representations of inputs instead of reconstructing raw pixels or generating tokens. H-JEPA extends this line: it first converts images into abstract environment features and combines them with actions to predict future states without frame-by-frame video generation. The closest prior method is HWM, which also uses multiple prediction horizons and passes upper-level predictions down as subgoals but keeps all levels in one shared latent space.
updates.background_zh: JEPA（联合嵌入预测架构）是一种自监督学习思路，通过预测输入的抽象表征来学习，而不必重建原始像素或生成 token。H-JEPA 延续了这一方向：先把画面转成抽象的环境特征，再结合动作预测未来状态，不必逐帧生成视频。此前的 HWM 同样使用多个预测视野，并把高层预测作为子目标下传，但所有层级共用同一套潜在空间。

events.current_state_en: Security researcher Cyber Scrilla uncovered a fraudulent Ledger phishing site and app ranking atop Google Search results, logging more than 1 million visits in 30 days to trick users into surrendering their 24-word recovery phrases.
events.current_state_zh:
据 Bitcoin News 报道，安全研究员 Cyber Scrilla 发现一个假冒 Ledger 的钓鱼网站及应用程序位居 Google 搜索结果顶部，Google 显示该站在过去 30 天内的访问量超过 100 万次。该页面意在诱骗用户提交其 24 个单词的助记词（恢复短语）。

Ledger 方面警告称，攻击者能够高度模仿其网站、内容和应用程序，诱使用户输入掌控自托管钱包的 24 个单词助记词。该钓鱼活动出现之际，另有一项针对与一家东南亚经销商相关、估计约 8600 万美元钱包失窃案的调查仍在进行中。

此次警示之前，网络安全公司 Zscaler 在 9 月的一项调查中发现，有恶意 Google 广告冒充 Ledger，并将用户重定向至虚假的钱包验证页面。来源未报告该具体钓鱼活动造成的已确认损失。
events.title_en: Fake Ledger Phishing Site Tops Google Search Results with Over 1M Monthly Visits
events.title_zh: 假冒 Ledger 钓鱼网站登顶 Google 搜索结果，月访问量超 100 万次

updates.background_en: Ledger's support documentation states that its users are continuously targeted by phishing attacks on social media, search engines and via email. Separately, Ledger is investigating potential wallet tampering after reports that more than $86 million in crypto may have been stolen from hundreds of wallets linked to devices sold by CryptoBilis, a Southeast Asian reseller; reporting cited estimates ranging from roughly $72 million to $93 million. A wallet linked by MistTrack to the CryptoBilis/Ledger thefts routed 464 ETH into Tornado Cash in 23 deposits on Oct. 10, according to Ethereum records.
updates.background_zh: Ledger 的支持文档指出，其用户持续在社交媒体、搜索引擎和电子邮件中遭遇钓鱼攻击。与此同时，Ledger 正在调查潜在的硬件钱包篡改问题：有报道称，与东南亚经销商 CryptoBilis 所售设备相关的数百个钱包中，可能有逾 8600 万美元加密资产被盗，相关报道提及的估算区间约为 7200 万至 9300 万美元。据以太坊链上记录，MistTrack 标记为与 CryptoBilis／Ledger 窃案相关的一个钱包在 10 月 10 日通过 23 笔交易将 464 ETH 转入 Tornado Cash。

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Security researcher Cyber Scrilla uncovered a fraudulent Ledger phishing site and app ranking atop Google Search results, logging more than 1 million visits in 30 days to trick users into surrendering their 24-word recovery phrases.
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission channel here is user-level security and sentiment toward self-custody hardware wallets rather than any protocol, exchange or token exposure, since no smart contract or venue is implicated. It reinforces the operational risk that recovery-phrase theft, not protocol exploits, remains the main loss vector for self-custody holders.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此事的传导渠道是用户层面的安全与对自托管硬件钱包的信心，而非任何协议、交易所或代币敞口，因为事件未涉及任何智能合约或交易场所。它再次凸显：对自托管持有者而言，助记词被盗而非协议漏洞，仍是主要的资产损失途径。

events.current_state_en: Raydium's (RAY) sharp price swings are attributed to a new Coinbase listing combined with fresh SEC guidance affecting the token's market access and trading backdrop.
events.current_state_zh:
据 CoinMarketCap 的一篇解读文章，Raydium 的 RAY 代币出现剧烈价格波动，文章将原因归结为 Coinbase 新上线该代币，以及美国证监会（SEC）发布的新指引影响了该代币的市场准入与交易环境。该内容属于波动性解读，而非交易所或监管机构的原始公告。

文章将 RAY 的价格波动与美国头部交易所上线该代币联系起来，这有望拓宽该代币的可交易渠道；同时文章称 SEC 的指引影响了其市场准入。

该文定位为波动性解读，而非上线或监管指引的第一手公告。搜索结果显示，CoinGecko 数据中 Raydium 的市值约为 5.4 亿美元，在代币中排名约第 111 位。
events.title_en: Raydium Volatility Explained: Coinbase Listing and SEC Guidance
events.title_zh: Raydium 波动性解析：Coinbase 上线与 SEC 指引

updates.background_en: Raydium is a decentralized exchange and automated market maker built on Solana, and RAY is its governance token, used for transaction fees, staking and liquidity-pool rewards. Coinbase states that it applies a standard listing process before enabling transfers and moving an asset into trading mode. The SEC has recently issued guidance aimed at token issuers.
updates.background_zh: Raydium 是构建在 Solana 上的去中心化交易所和自动做市商，RAY 是其治理代币，用于支付交易手续费、质押以及流动性池奖励。Coinbase 表示会对资产执行标准上线流程，之后才开放转账并进入交易状态。SEC 近期发布了面向代币发行方的指引。

events.current_state_en: DistroKid has confirmed it is quietly removing artists' songs in response to UMG's lawsuit alleging the distributor operates an 'AI-slop pipeline,' prompting complaints from affected musicians.
events.current_state_zh:
DistroKid 向 The Verge 确认，正在下架艺人的歌曲，此举是对环球音乐集团（UMG）相关指控的直接回应——UMG 已于9月起诉这家分销商。受影响的音乐人表示，他们的作品在未获通知的情况下被下架。

这些下架动作显示，一场尚未判决的版权诉讼已直接转化为独立艺人作品目录的移除。已经发行过作品的艺人首当其冲，承担了最直接的影响。

UMG 在9月的诉讼中指控 DistroKid 运营一条“AI 垃圾内容流水线”，并允许未经授权的 UMG 歌曲混音版本上传至流媒体平台；DistroKid 否认了这些指控，并表示将为自己辩护。据该公司称，此次下架是对上述指控的回应，而非法院命令的结果。

events.current_state_en: Nvidia is in early-stage talks to acquire or increase investment in open-weights AI developer Reflection AI, which was valued at $25B in March, with deal forms including an acqui-hire or expanded equity and compute agreements.
events.current_state_zh:
据 BlockBeats 10 月 11 日援引英国《金融时报》报道，知情人士透露，英伟达正就收购美国开放权重模型开发商 Reflection AI 或加大对其投资展开谈判。交易可能采取多种形式，包括「人才收购」、进一步股权投资，或达成向该公司提供更多芯片及算力的协议，两家公司可能在未来几周内达成协议。

英伟达已是 Reflection 的最大股东之一，而「人才收购」结构可使其在不经历全面收购通常所需的漫长监管审查的情况下，吸纳该公司员工并获得其技术许可。

谈判仍处于初期阶段，尚未达成协议。Reflection 在今年 3 月的一轮融资中估值达到 250 亿美元。

updates.background_en: Reflection AI describes itself as a developer of open-weights models — models whose trained weights are released for others to access and build on. Acqui-hiring, a portmanteau of "acquisition" and "hire" coined in 2005, refers to buying a company primarily for its human capital rather than its products or customers. Nvidia is the dominant supplier of AI accelerators, giving it influence over how compute is allocated across the AI industry.

updates.current_state_en: Filecoin's six-year genesis token vesting period ends on October 14, ending ~68.3M FIL annual vesting releases and cutting total annual new FIL supply by roughly 77% (from 88.9M to 20.6M tokens, about 9.7% to 2.2% of circulating supply), while storage-provider block rewards remain unaffected with 25% liquid and 75% vesting over 180 days.

events.current_state_en: Nasdaq-listed SVRN has acquired FastNEAR, the NEAR RPC, archival and data infrastructure provider that serves over 3.5 billion requests and 100+ TB of data monthly, making it SVRN's first operating business alongside its asset treasury, with founders Evgeny Kuzyakov and Mike Purvis joining the company.
events.current_state_zh:
纳斯达克上市公司 SVRN 宣布收购 NEAR RPC、归档及数据基础设施提供商 FastNEAR，具体收购金额未披露。FastNEAR 将成为 SVRN 的全资子公司，也是其资产储备业务之外的首个运营业务，FastNEAR 联合创始人 Evgeny Kuzyakov 和 Mike Purvis 将加入 SVRN。

这笔交易意味着上市公司从单纯的资产储备持有转向实际运营加密基础设施，同时把被广泛使用的 NEAR 端点与数据服务的运营主体交到一家纳斯达克上市公司手中。

FastNEAR 每月处理超 35 亿次请求，并提供超 100 TB 数据服务。收购完成后，其 RPC 服务、归档基础设施及 NEARDATA 将继续由原团队运营，SVRN 计划进一步投资于系统可靠性和服务容量。
events.title_en: 【纳斯达克上市公司 SVRN 收购 NEAR 基础设施提供商 FastNEAR】
events.title_zh: 【纳斯达克上市公司 SVRN 收购 NEAR 基础设施提供商 FastNEAR】

updates.background_en: FastNEAR describes itself as a high-performance NEAR Protocol infrastructure provider offering an RPC gateway, including a free public tier, as well as NEARDATA, which provides streaming access to NEAR blockchain blocks and data via REST APIs. NEAR documentation lists Neardata as the direct replacement for the discontinued NEAR Lake S3 indexing service for new projects.
updates.background_zh: FastNEAR 自我定位为高性能 NEAR Protocol 基础设施提供商，提供 RPC 网关（含免费公共节点）以及 NEARDATA——通过 REST API 提供 NEAR 区块链区块和数据的流式访问。NEAR 官方文档将 Neardata 列为新项目替代已停止索引新块的 NEAR Lake（AWS S3 存储桶）的方案。

updates.market_impact_en: The deal concentrates a widely used NEAR RPC, archival and NEARDATA provider under a Nasdaq-listed owner, which could affect how NEAR ecosystem developers and applications source endpoint access and block data if service terms or capacity change; it also adds a public-equity channel into crypto infrastructure operations. Any effect on the NEAR token would come indirectly through infrastructure reliability and ecosystem sentiment rather than through token supply or a listing event.

events.current_state_en: A CFTC rule change is poised to affect Coinbase and two other trading platforms, drawing regulatory and stock-market attention.
events.current_state_zh:
Simply Wall Street 的一篇分析文章指出，美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）的一项规则变动将影响 Coinbase 及另外两家交易平台，引发监管与股市关注。该文以股票分析为定位，标题与摘要中并未点名另外两家平台。

按照CFTC自身的说明，拟议的《加密资产交易规则》（Regulation CTX）与《加密资产市场规则》（Regulation CAM）将为提供加密资产交易的CFTC注册交易所设定要求，这正是美国上市加密交易平台可能受影响的合规传导渠道。

这份名为《加密资产交易规则与加密资产市场规则》的拟议规则包已于2026年9月17日提交白宫信息与监管事务办公室（OIRA）进行监管审查。CFTC在公开发表的声明中表示，这些规则不会要求加密资产必须在CFTC注册平台上交易，并称若无国会立法，该机构无权施加此类要求。
events.title_en: Coinbase Stock and 2 Trading Platforms Facing a CFTC Rule Shift
events.title_zh: Coinbase股票及另外两家交易平台面临CFTC规则变动

updates.background_en: Coinbase has been assembling a CFTC-regulated US derivatives stack: on September 28, 2026 the CFTC registered Coinbase Clearing LLC as a Derivatives Clearing Organization, which the company said completed its derivatives platform alongside its futures commission merchant and designated contract market. The CTX and CAM package remains a proposal under review, not a final rule.
updates.background_zh: Coinbase一直在搭建受CFTC监管的美国衍生品业务体系：2026年9月28日，CFTC将Coinbase Clearing LLC注册为衍生品清算机构（DCO），公司称这与其期货佣金商（FCM）和指定合约市场（DCM）共同构成了完整的衍生品平台。CTX与CAM规则包目前仍处于审查中的提案阶段，尚未成为最终规则。

updates.market_impact_en: The transmission path is regulatory rather than direct: rules setting requirements for CFTC-registered venues that list crypto assets could bear on compliance costs and product scope at US-facing platforms and, through sentiment, on related crypto equities; the package is still under review, so the scope of any impact depends on the final rule text.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导路径是监管层面的，而非直接的市场冲击：为提供加密资产交易的CFTC注册平台设定要求，可能影响面向美国市场的交易平台的合规成本与产品范围，并通过市场情绪波及相关加密概念股；该规则包仍在审查之中，实际影响范围取决于最终规则文本。

events.current_state_en: A tariff threat from Trump against China triggered the largest liquidation event ever recorded in crypto markets, as leveraged positions were wiped out across exchanges.
events.current_state_zh:
据 Startup Fortune 报道，美国总统特朗普对中国的关税威胁引发了加密市场有记录以来规模最大的爆仓事件，各交易所的杠杆头寸被强制平仓。报道将此次连环爆仓归因于这一宏观冲击，而非加密行业自身的任何事件。

该事件被描述为加密史上规模最大的爆仓，而触发因素来自行业之外——华盛顿的政策威胁，而非加密领域自身的故障。

爆仓是指在保证金耗尽后杠杆头寸被强制平仓，这在加密市场的高波动环境中时有发生。报道称此次平仓波及多家交易所的杠杆头寸。
events.title_en: Trump's China tariff threat triggered crypto's largest liquidation ever

updates.background_en: Leverage allows a trader to control a position much larger than the capital posted, so a comparatively small adverse price move can consume the collateral behind a trade and force an exit. These cascades typically concentrate on derivatives venues that list perpetual futures, dated futures and options, where open interest and leverage build up.
updates.background_zh: 杠杆让交易者能用较少的本金控制远大于本金的仓位，因此价格出现相对较小的不利波动，就可能耗尽一笔交易的抵押资金并触发强制平仓。这类连环爆仓通常集中在提供永续合约、交割合约和期权的衍生品交易所，也是未平仓合约和杠杆最集中的地方。
updates.current_state_en: A tariff threat from Trump against China triggered the largest liquidation event ever recorded in crypto markets, as leveraged positions were wiped out across exchanges.
updates.current_state_zh:
据 Startup Fortune 报道，美国总统特朗普对中国的关税威胁引发了加密市场有记录以来规模最大的爆仓事件，各交易所的杠杆头寸被强制平仓。报道将此次连环爆仓归因于这一宏观冲击，而非加密行业自身的任何事件。

该事件被描述为加密史上规模最大的爆仓，而触发因素来自行业之外——华盛顿的政策威胁，而非加密领域自身的故障。

爆仓是指在保证金耗尽后杠杆头寸被强制平仓，这在加密市场的高波动环境中时有发生。报道称此次平仓波及多家交易所的杠杆头寸。
updates.detailed_summary_en: A tariff threat from Trump against China triggered the largest liquidation event ever recorded in crypto markets, as leveraged positions were wiped out across exchanges.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: A tariff threat from Trump against China triggered the largest liquidation event ever recorded in crypto markets, as leveraged positions were wiped out across exchanges.
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission channel runs through derivatives liquidity: forced closures of leveraged positions consume margin and thin order books on perpetual and futures venues, transmitting a macro-political shock from outside crypto into crypto pricing. The scale described implies broad, cross-venue deleveraging rather than an event confined to one asset or platform.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道在于衍生品流动性：杠杆头寸被强制平仓会消耗保证金并使永续合约与期货交易所的订单簿变薄，从而把来自加密市场之外的宏观政治冲击传导进加密资产价格。报道所述的规模意味着这是一次跨交易所的广泛去杠杆，而非局限于单一资产或单一平台的事件。

updates.background_en: The report lands as U.S. financial heavyweights push into tokenization: the NYSE plans to reach crypto investors through Blockchain.com, NYSE owner ICE is working with OKX on 24/7 tokenized stock trading under the SEC's new innovation exemption, Securitize has brought tokenized Nvidia, Apple and Amazon shares to Solana, Cboe struck an S&P deal for tokenized options, and Coinbase launched tokenized stocks for non-U.S. users on Base in August. Earlier this year, the IMF warned that tokenized finance and stablecoins could amplify financial crises.
updates.background_zh: 报告发布之际，美国金融巨头正加速进入代币化领域：纽约证券交易所计划通过Blockchain.com触达加密投资者；纽交所母公司ICE正与OKX合作，在美国证券交易委员会（SEC）新的创新豁免框架下开展24/7代币化股票交易；Securitize已将代币化的英伟达、苹果和亚马逊股票引入Solana，并计划接入更多区块链网络；Cboe与标普达成代币化期权协议；Coinbase则于8月在Base上为美国以外用户推出代币化股票。今年早些时候，IMF曾警告代币化金融与稳定币可能放大金融危机。
updates.current_state_en: The IMF's latest Global Financial Stability Report finds that tokenized stocks see genuine retail demand — most trading happens outside U.S. market hours and in fractional amounts — but these tokens are about 1.5 times more volatile and less liquid than the underlying equities, with systemic risk still contained and regulators urged to consider circuit breakers for 24/7 trading.
updates.current_state_zh:
国际货币基金组织（IMF）最新《全球金融稳定报告》发现，超过50%的代币化股票交易发生在美国常规交易时段之外，约80%的交易不足一整股；同时代币化股票的波动率约为标的股票的1.5倍，流动性也明显更差。该报告覆盖了11个交易平台、365天内流动性最好的五只代币化美股，认为目前系统性风险仍然有限，并敦促监管机构考虑为24/7交易设置熔断机制。

IMF表示已敦促监管机构考虑为24/7交易引入熔断机制，并更密切地监测代币化市场与传统市场之间的联系，同时指出目前系统性风险仍然有限。鉴于该市场仍处于早期阶段，IMF还称其结论“应谨慎解读”。

代币化股票市场规模约23亿美元且高度集中，Ondo Finance与Backed Finance的xStocks合计占据逾70%份额；两者发行的均为合成代币，提供价格敞口但不涉及直接持股。传统市场重新开盘时，常规股票吸收了其代币化对应资产隔夜价格波动的87%至99%，而去中心化交易所上的代币化价格偏离传统市场更大。
updates.detailed_summary_en: The IMF's latest Global Financial Stability Report finds that tokenized stocks see genuine retail demand — most trading happens outside U.S. market hours and in fractional amounts — but these tokens are about 1.5 times more volatile and less liquid than the underlying equities, with systemic risk still contained and regulators urged to consider circuit breakers for 24/7 trading.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The IMF's latest Global Financial Stability Report finds that tokenized stocks see genuine retail demand — most trading happens outside U.S. market hours and in fractional amounts — but these tokens are about 1.5 times more volatile and less liquid than the underlying equities, with systemic risk still contained and regulators urged to consider circuit breakers for 24/7 trading.
updates.market_impact_en: The report focuses regulatory attention on market-structure questions for tokenized equities — 24/7 trading hours, circuit breakers and links to traditional venues — which could shape disclosure and trading rules for issuers such as Ondo Finance and Backed Finance and for the exchanges and DEXs where their tokens trade. Its finding that tokenized markets remain small, concentrated and thinly liquid bears on how much contagion risk these venues pose to underlying equity markets.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该报告将监管注意力引向代币化股票的市场结构问题——24/7交易时段、熔断机制以及与传统交易场所的联动——这可能影响Ondo Finance、Backed Finance等发行方以及其代币所交易的中心化与去中心化平台的披露与交易规则。报告指出代币化市场规模小、集中度高且流动性薄弱，这关系到此类场所对标的股票市场构成多大传染风险。

updates.what_changed_en: The IMF’s October GFSR dedicates its first special chapter to tokenization: tokenized RWA public market (ex repo/stablecoins) was ~$65B as of end-July (credit ~$30.4B, MMFs ~$17.5B, equities ~$2.3B) with tokenized repo 30-day average daily volume at $303B; it warns tokenized assets could become a new channel for leverage and liquidity/maturity mismatches, and flags stablecoin/tokenized-deposit settlement concentration/credit risks.

events.current_state_en: Terence Tao's Caltech 2026 slide deck 'Math 2.0' examines how AI is transforming mathematical research, prompting broad discussion about AI-designed drugs, mechanized proof, and the changing role of human mathematicians.
events.current_state_zh:
陶哲轩（Terence Tao）公开了其在加州理工学院 2026 年演讲《数学 2.0》的幻灯片，梳理了历史上的“数学 1.0”状态，以及 AI 正在给数学带来的当前状态。随演讲发布的博客文章日期为 2026 年 10 月 10 日，并指出该演讲被推迟到 10 月，且因近期事件而大幅修改。

这份幻灯片提供了一位知名数学家对 AI 如何改变数学实践与理论的框架性看法，相关 Hacker News 讨论帖获得了异常高的参与度（288 分、349 条评论）。

幻灯片刻意提到了“逆伽罗瓦问题挑战（2026）”，其第一阶段 IGP24 是一场众包竞赛，目标是找出覆盖 24 次多项式全部 25,000 个可能伽罗瓦群的实例。陶哲轩的博文被归入 math.GM 分类，类型标注为 talk（演讲）。
events.title_en: Terence Tao: Math 2.0 [pdf]
events.title_zh: 陶哲轩：数学 2.0 [pdf]

updates.background_en: Tao is a Fields Medalist mathematician, and his personal blog is where he posts talk notes and commentary. His blog states that the Caltech talk was postponed and substantially revised following recent events, and Hacker News commenters link its content to an October 8 batch of AI-produced mathematical solutions.
updates.background_zh: 陶哲轩是菲尔兹奖得主数学家，其个人博客是他发布演讲笔记与评论的场所。博文称该加州理工演讲被推迟，并因近期事件而大幅调整；Hacker News 的评论者则将演讲内容与 10 月 8 日一批由 AI 生成的数学解答联系起来。
updates.community_discussion_en: Commenters debated Tao's medical analogy: dekhn, who says he works in drug discovery and AI, called the cancer-medicine slide poorly informed and noted that models of how drugs work remain incomplete, while squidmaster argued "Tao is out of his lane" because many medicines lack fully understood mechanisms, citing general anesthesia. thomasahle recast Tao's argument in software terms — pure mathematics as a "codebase" of theory, definitions and proofs, with open problems as "lighthouses not destinations" — and said current math AI is not a "good citizen". samuelknight summarized reactions to the October 8 AI batch as researchers finding years-old problems solved, having to rewrite just-submitted grant requests, and mourning the loss of a field.
updates.community_discussion_zh: 评论者就陶哲轩使用的医学类比展开争论：自称从事药物发现与 AI 工作的 dekhn 认为其中关于癌症医学的幻灯片“信息不足”，并指出关于药物作用机制的模型与叙述仍极不完整；squidmaster 则认为陶哲轩“越界了”，因为许多药物（如全身麻醉剂）的作用机制本就没有完全弄清。thomasahle 用软件术语重新表述了陶哲轩的论点——纯数学是在构建和维护由理论、定义与证明组成的“代码库”，未解问题是“灯塔而非终点”——并称当前这一代数学 AI 还不是“好公民”。samuelknight 总结了人们对 10 月 8 日那批 AI 成果的反应：有人多年未解的问题被解决，有人不得不重写刚提交的基金申请，也有人像失去故友一般哀叹一个领域的逝去。
