events.current_state_en:
Together Computer released Hybrid Reasoning Agents (HybridAgents), an agent architecture in which the model performs its reasoning in continuous latent space and emits text only for actions and tool calls. The release ships with a GitHub repository, a HuggingFace model collection, and evaluations in arXiv paper 2610.18861.

The authors position the approach as bridging latent reasoning, which is efficient internally but lacks native tool access and reasoning transparency, with text-based agents that can act and be inspected. It is an architectural departure from explicit chain-of-thought rather than a new model checkpoint alone.

The open release spans code on GitHub (togethercomputer/HybridAgent), a HuggingFace collection, and a published evaluation section in the arXiv HTML version. In the discussion thread, one user reported that the 14B variant, run through llama.cpp with bartowski's 8-bit quantization, looped on variations of the same paragraph for roughly five minutes until it exhausted its turn budget on a simple chat, web search and summarization request; the user noted llama.cpp may need updates to support the model.
events.current_state_zh:
Together Computer 发布了混合推理智能体（HybridAgents），该架构让模型在连续的潜空间中完成推理，仅在执行动作和调用工具时输出文本。此次发布附带 GitHub 代码仓库、HuggingFace 模型合集，以及 arXiv 论文 2610.18861 中的评测结果。

作者将该方案定位为弥合两条路线：潜空间推理内部效率高，但缺乏原生工具调用能力和推理透明度；文本智能体则能够执行动作并接受检查。这是一种有别于显式思维链的架构思路，而不只是发布一个新的模型权重。

本次开源发布包括 GitHub 上的代码（togethercomputer/HybridAgent）、一个 HuggingFace 模型合集，以及 arXiv HTML 版本中公开的评测章节。在讨论帖中，一位用户报告称，通过 llama.cpp 运行 bartowski 的 8 位量化 14B 版本时，面对一个简单的聊天、网页搜索与摘要请求，模型在约五分钟内反复输出同一段落的不同变体，直至耗尽回合预算；该用户指出 llama.cpp 可能需要更新才能支持该模型。
events.title_en: Hybrid Reasoning Agents: LLM agents that think in latent space, act through text
events.title_zh: 混合推理智能体：在潜空间中思考、通过文本行动的 LLM 智能体

updates.background_en: LLM agents conventionally reason and interact in text, typically via chain-of-thought, which makes their reasoning inspectable but token-expensive. Prior research such as Coconut (Chain of Continuous Thought, arXiv 2412.06769) explored training models to reason in an unrestricted continuous latent space instead of natural language. The HybridAgents paper describes its contribution as combining latent reasoning with text-level action so agents retain tool access and some transparency.
updates.background_zh: LLM 智能体通常以文本进行推理和交互，往往依赖思维链，这使得推理过程可被检查，但 token 开销较大。此前的 Coconut（连续思维链，arXiv 2412.06769）等研究探索了训练模型在不受限的连续潜空间中推理，而非使用自然语言。HybridAgents 论文称其贡献在于将潜空间推理与文本层面的动作结合，使智能体既保留工具调用能力，也保留一定的透明度。
updates.community_discussion_en: Reception was engaged but skeptical. Several commenters invoked warnings about opaque "neuralese" reasoning, with one calling it "the Most Forbidden Technique"; others saw a fit for models like Qwen that tend to restate reasoning verbosely, since that restatement could stay in latent space. A hands-on report of the 14B model looping pathologically under llama.cpp 8-bit quantization raised practical tooling and quantization concerns.
updates.community_discussion_zh: 讨论热度较高但态度偏向质疑。多位评论者援引对不透明的“neuralese”推理的警告，其中一人称其为“最被禁忌的技术”；也有人认为这适合 Qwen 这类推理输出中重复陈述较多的模型，因为这些复述可以留在潜空间中。另有用户实测 14B 模型在 llama.cpp 8 位量化下出现病态循环，引发了对工具链和量化适配的实际担忧。

updates.background_en: Anthropic, maker of the Claude chatbot, is preparing an IPO as soon as November at a reported valuation of around $2 trillion; at that price 5% of the company would be worth about $100 billion on paper. Days before the fund announcement, Anthropic pitched lawmakers a draft AI safety bill that would let the government block models posing imminent threat at a threshold of 50 deaths or $1 billion in damages. An AP-NORC poll in late September found 64% of US adults say AI is developing too fast, while 8% say too slow.
updates.background_zh: Claude 聊天机器人背后的 Anthropic 正筹备最早于 11 月启动 IPO，据报道估值约 2 万亿美元；按此计算，公司 5% 的股份账面价值约为 1000 亿美元。在公布该基金数天前，Anthropic 向立法者提出了一份 AI 安全法案草案，拟在造成 50 人死亡或 10 亿美元损失的阈值下授权政府叫停构成紧迫威胁的模型。AP-NORC 9 月底的一项民调显示，64% 的美国成年人认为 AI 发展过快，8% 认为过慢。
updates.current_state_en: Anthropic has announced a Public Benefit Fund with a 5% share commitment, but the commitment remains subject to stockholder approval and is not confirmed as completed; the fund is a wholly owned LLC with a 2% share ratchet per 50% valuation increase and is barred from political lobbying or donations; including co-founder and employee pledges, roughly 20% of shares are intended for public causes. The company is also preparing an IPO as soon as November.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Anthropic said it will dedicate 5% of its shares to a new Public Benefit Fund — with about 20% of its stock going to public causes including co-founder and employee pledges — and Elon Musk responded by promising one SpaceX share to every child in the United States next year, a giveaway worth over $10 billion at current prices.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Anthropic said it will dedicate 5% of its shares to a new Public Benefit Fund — with about 20% of its stock going to public causes including co-founder and employee pledges — and Elon Musk responded by promising one SpaceX share to every child in the United States next year, a giveaway worth over $10 billion at current prices.
updates.market_impact_en: Neither company is publicly traded, so the transmission runs through ownership structure rather than listed shares: Anthropic's pre-IPO equity arrangement and reported valuation shape how its eventual float and governance are assessed, while Musk's pledge would move roughly 1% of his SpaceX holdings into tax-advantaged children's accounts under the Treasury's Trump Accounts framework. There is no direct exposure to crypto assets in either announcement.
updates.market_impact_zh: 两家公司均未上市，因此传导路径在于所有权结构而非可交易股票：Anthropic 上市前的股权安排与报道中的估值，会影响市场对其未来流通盘与治理结构的评估；马斯克的承诺则会把其约 1% 的 SpaceX 持股转入美国财政部“特朗普账户”框架下享有税收优惠的儿童账户。两则公告均不涉及加密资产的直接敞口。

events.current_state_en: Hackers breached part of OpenCode's online platform, stole users' API keys, and used them to run up charges on victims' AI accounts.
events.current_state_zh:
黑客侵入了 OpenCode 在线平台的一部分，窃取了部分用户的 API 密钥，并利用这些密钥在受害者的 AI 账户上刷出高额费用。据报道，OpenCode 求助的 AI 工具多次拒绝查看这些恶意代码。

被盗密钥让攻击者能够消耗由受影响用户付费的 AI 调用额度，使一次凭证泄露直接变成使用该工具的开发者们的经济损失。

此次入侵影响的是 OpenCode 在线平台的一部分，而非其开源代码库本身。OpenCode 以终端界面、桌面应用和网页应用三种形式提供。
events.title_en: OpenCode legacy system breached, exposing some users' API keys
events.title_zh: OpenCode旧系统遭入侵，部分用户API密钥泄露

updates.background_en: OpenCode is an open-source AI coding agent that has become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor. API keys are unique codes that authenticate and authorize access to an API, which makes them a valuable target; security researchers describe the abuse of stolen AI API keys to burn through a victim's quota as "LLMjacking."
updates.background_zh: OpenCode 是一款开源 AI 编程智能体，已成为 Claude Code 和 Cursor 之外颇受欢迎的替代选择。API 密钥是用于对 API 进行身份验证和授权的唯一代码，因此极具攻击价值；安全研究者将利用窃取的 AI API 密钥耗尽受害者额度的行为称为“LLMjacking”。
updates.current_state_en: OpenCode's legacy system was breached, potentially exposing third-party model API keys for 1.4% of Console users; OpenAI is helping restore service, refunding API credits consumed during the attack, and granting Daybreak Blue defense access.

被盗密钥让攻击者能够消耗由受影响用户付费的 AI 调用额度，使一次凭证泄露直接变成使用该工具的开发者们的经济损失。

此次入侵影响的是 OpenCode 在线平台的一部分，而非其开源代码库本身。OpenCode 以终端界面、桌面应用和网页应用三种形式提供。

updates.what_changed_en: JPMorgan is expanding its JPM Coin deposit token to Ethereum mainnet for institutional clients, enabling round-the-clock fund transfers and settlement.
updates.what_changed_zh: 摩根大通正将其 JPM Coin 存款代币扩展至以太坊主网，面向机构客户，支持全天候资金转账与结算。

updates.background_en: JPM Coin is a deposit token — an ERC-20 token with custom functions that represents funds deposited with JPMorgan — rather than a stablecoin backed by reserves held by a private issuer. JPMorgan first deployed the token on Base in November 2025 after months of testing with Mastercard and Coinbase, and in January said it would also bring JPM Coin to the privacy-focused Canton Network. The bank has additionally issued two tokenized money-market funds on Ethereum, in December 2025 and May 2026, and competes for the same customers as stablecoin issuers, including a consortium of more than 100 companies such as Visa, Stripe and Mastercard that launched its own dollar stablecoin last month.
updates.background_zh: JPM Coin 是存款代币，即一种带有自定义功能的 ERC-20 代币，代表存放于摩根大通的资金，而非由私人发行方以储备资产支撑的稳定币。摩根大通在与万事达卡和 Coinbase 进行数月测试后，于 2025 年 11 月首次将该代币部署在 Base 上，并在今年 1 月表示还将把 JPM Coin 引入专注隐私的 Canton Network。该行还于 2025 年 12 月和 2026 年 5 月在以太坊上发行了两只代币化货币市场基金，并与稳定币发行方争夺同一批客户，其中包括由 Visa、Stripe 和万事达卡等 100 多家公司组成的财团——该财团上月推出了自己的美元稳定币。
updates.current_state_en: JPM Coin is live on Ethereum mainnet for vetted institutional clients to use for payments, trade settlement and collateral, and can move between Base and Ethereum.
updates.current_state_zh: JPM Coin 已在以太坊主网上线，面向经审核的机构客户用于支付、交易结算和抵押，并可在 Base 与以太坊之间转移。
updates.detailed_summary_en: JPMorgan launched JPM Coin on Ethereum, allowing institutional clients to redeem the token for dollars and use it for payments, trade settlement, and collateral posting.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: JPMorgan launched JPM Coin on Ethereum, allowing institutional clients to redeem the token for dollars and use it for payments, trade settlement, and collateral posting.
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through settlement and liquidity: a yield-bearing, bank-issued deposit token on Ethereum gives institutions an alternative to stablecoins for payments, tokenized-asset trade settlement and collateral, potentially shifting some institutional dollar balances and on-chain activity toward Ethereum-based venues while competing directly with stablecoin issuers for the same corporate and crypto-firm customers.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于结算与流动性：一种可在以太坊上生息的银行发行存款代币，为机构提供了在支付、代币化资产交易结算和抵押品方面替代稳定币的选择，可能使部分机构美元余额和链上活动转向基于以太坊的场所，同时在争夺同类企业与加密客户方面直接与稳定币发行方竞争。

events.current_state_en: Super League shareholders approved a deal giving Metaplanet a 93.7% stake through a 2,100 BTC and $2.5 million contribution, creating a Nasdaq-listed Bitcoin treasury company with access to US capital markets.
events.current_state_zh:
Metaplanet 创始人兼 CEO Simon Gerovich 于 10 月 19 日宣布，其与纳斯达克上市公司 Super League Enterprise（SLE）的交易已在该公司股东大会上获得正式批准。Metaplanet 将注入 2,100 枚比特币及 250 万美元现金（总值约 1.346 亿美元），换取约 4486 万股、每股 3 美元的新发行普通股以及优先股和认股权证，从而取得 SLE 的控股权。

Gerovich 表示，交易完成后该公司将作为 Metaplanet 在美国上市的比特币财库平台，使其能够直接接入美国资本市场并获得更灵活的融资能力。结合在日本设立的 Metaplanet Securities，此次获批将使公司在全球两大资本市场上拥有互补性平台。

据 BlockBeats，Metaplanet 将持有 SLE 约 95.7% 的已发行普通股；而 Cointelegraph 对同一批准消息的报道给出的持股比例为 93.7%。Super League 计划更名为 Superplanet 并启用纳斯达克代码 SUPA，拟主要通过高级非 convertible 永续优先股而非债务为后续比特币购买融资，Metaplanet 另拥有最多 2.1 亿美元初级优先股的投资选择权；Metaplanet 所持普通股设有五年锁定期。
events.title_en: ⚡️Metaplanet获批控股纳斯达克上市公司SLE，成功实现在美上市布局
events.title_zh: Metaplanet 通过注入 2,100 BTC 及现金获 Super League 控股权，登陆纳斯达克

updates.background_en: The transaction was approved under agreements involving Metaplanet and Evo Fund, covering the issuance of as many as 435.9 million common shares. Metaplanet has accumulated about 44,000 BTC, making it the second-largest publicly traded corporate Bitcoin holder behind Strategy, and earlier this month proposed allocating up to 15% of total assets to strategic investments. In an Oct. 15 SEC filing, Super League said the US market for preferred securities issued by Bitcoin treasury companies has grown large enough to support new entrants.
updates.background_zh: 该交易依据涉及 Metaplanet 与 Evo Fund 的协议获批，涵盖最多 4.359 亿股普通股的发行。Metaplanet 已累计持有约 44,000 枚比特币，是仅次于 Strategy 的第二大公开上市企业比特币持有者，并于本月早些时候提议将最多 15% 的总资产配置于战略投资。在 10 月 15 日的 SEC 文件中，Super League 表示由比特币财库公司发行的优先证券在美国的市场规模已足以容纳新进入者。

updates.market_impact_en: The deal adds a new US-listed vehicle for corporate Bitcoin accumulation, with Superplanet's preferred-stock structure potentially drawing dollar-denominated capital into BTC treasury strategies alongside Metaplanet's existing yen financing. It also ties the fate of SLE/SUPA shares and Metaplanet's Japanese listing more tightly to Bitcoin treasury sentiment, giving US investors a direct equity channel into that strategy.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该交易为企业增持比特币增加了一个新的美国上市载体，Superplanet 的优先股结构可能为比特币财库策略引入美元资本，与 Metaplanet 现有的日元融资形成互补。这同时使 SLE/SUPA 股票与 Metaplanet 日本上市股票的走势更紧密地绑定于比特币财库叙事，为美国投资者提供了直接参与该策略的股票通道。

updates.what_changed_en: China's Foreign Ministry responded to the U.S. requirement that federal agencies stop using Chinese AI products including DeepSeek, criticizing the politicization of technology and vowing to protect Chinese companies' lawful rights.
updates.what_changed_zh: 中国外交部就美国要求联邦机构停止使用DeepSeek等中国AI产品作出回应，批评美方将科技问题政治化，并表示将坚决维护中国企业的合法权益。

updates.background_en: Washington and Beijing are competing for leadership in artificial intelligence, and DeepSeek — a Chinese company founded in 2023 that publishes open-source models such as DeepSeek-V3 and R1 — has been a focal point of that rivalry. Earlier US restrictions covered the Commerce Department and portions of the defense, security and intelligence community. Australia banned DeepSeek products from government systems and devices in February 2025. China's Global Times reported that Beijing vowed to protect its firms' rights following the US move.
updates.background_zh: 华盛顿与北京正在争夺人工智能领域的领导地位，而成立于2023年、开源了DeepSeek-V3、R1等模型的中国公司DeepSeek一直是这场竞争的关注焦点。美国此前的限制覆盖商务部以及国防、安全和情报部门的部分机构。澳大利亚于2025年2月禁止在政府系统和设备上使用DeepSeek产品。中国《环球时报》报道称，在美方采取此举后，北京表示将坚决维护本国企业的权益。
updates.current_state_en: The US has ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek AI products and third-party services built using its technology, citing national security concerns.
updates.current_state_zh: 美国以国家安全担忧为由，下令联邦文职机构移除DeepSeek AI产品及使用其技术构建的第三方服务。
updates.detailed_summary_en: The US has ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek AI products and third-party services built using its technology, citing national security concerns.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The US has ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek AI products and third-party services built using its technology, citing national security concerns.
updates.market_impact_en: The directive reshapes procurement for federal civilian agencies and their vendors, so companies that embedded DeepSeek models in government-facing products face compliance and re-engineering costs, while US-based model providers positioned for federal work face a narrower competitive field. For crypto markets, the main channel is sentiment around open-weight Chinese AI models and decentralized-AI narratives rather than any direct exposure, since the order targets federal IT procurement rather than digital assets.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该指令重塑了联邦文职机构及其供应商的采购格局：将DeepSeek模型嵌入政府相关产品的企业需要承担合规与重构成本，而以联邦业务为目标的美国本土模型供应商则面对更少的竞争者。对加密市场而言，主要传导渠道是围绕中国开源权重AI模型和去中心化AI叙事的情绪，而非直接敞口，因为该命令针对的是联邦IT采购，而非数字资产。

updates.current_state_en: Echo Protocol is winding down: new lending, Strategy and LSD deposits/borrowing are frozen; users must repay debt by November 14 and complete withdrawals and unstaking by November 19 23:59 UTC, after which remaining positions are liquidated and only Aptos-to-B² bridge redemption remains.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Bitcoin infrastructure protocol Echo Protocol said it is winding down operations, freezing new deposits and borrowing across its lending, strategy and LSD products while opening repayment/withdrawal channels, with all debt to be settled by 2026-11-14 and a final exit deadline of 2026-11-19 23:59 UTC before residual positions are liquidated and only the Aptos-to-B² bridge redemption remains.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Bitcoin infrastructure protocol Echo Protocol said it is winding down operations, freezing new deposits and borrowing across its lending, strategy and LSD products while opening repayment/withdrawal channels, with all debt to be settled by 2026-11-14 and a final exit deadline of 2026-11-19 23:59 UTC before residual positions are liquidated and only the Aptos-to-B² bridge redemption remains.

updates.title_zh: 比特币基础设施协议Echo Protocol宣布将逐步关停
updates.what_changed_en: The announcement added a detailed liquidation timeline: outstanding debt must be repaid by 2026-11-14, the final repayment/withdrawal/unstaking deadline is 2026-11-19 23:59 UTC, and afterward only the Aptos-to-B² bridge redemption service remains.
updates.what_changed_zh: 公告补充了具体清算时间表：未结清债务须在2026年11月14日前偿还，最终还款、提现及解除质押截止为2026年11月19日23:59 UTC，此后仅保留 Aptos-to-B² 跨链桥赎回服务。

events.current_state_en: Tether Capital participated in Tenstorrent’s $1.5 billion Series E funding round, valuing the AI computing company at $6.2 billion as Tether expands its AI strategy into processors and computing systems.
events.current_state_zh:
AI 芯片公司 Tenstorrent 于 10 月 19 日宣布完成 15 亿美元 E 轮融资，投后估值达 62 亿美元。本轮由 Trace Capital 和 Innovation X 领投，新老投资者参投，包括 ARK Invest、富达管理与研究公司、摩根士丹利、闪迪、普徕仕、Tether Investments、Virtu Financial 和 XTX Markets。

Tenstorrent 表示，在今年早些时候收到收购意向后，此轮融资旨在保持公司独立，使 AI 加速器市场在英伟达之外保留一家替代供应商。公司计划用这笔资金大规模部署 Galaxy 服务器，服务开放权重的大语言模型和视频生成模型。

投资方名单还包括 Agostinelli Group、Brett Barna、Cadence Ventures、Eclipse、Maverick Silicon、Protagonist、Troluce Capital 和 Tether Investments。除服务器部署外，Tenstorrent 还将把资金用于向自研芯片的客户授权其 AI 和 CPU 知识产权。

events.current_state_en: Germany's savings banks began a phased rollout of crypto trading through their existing apps on Oct. 19, starting with BTC, ETH, XRP, SOL and POL, DekaBank custody and a €0.99 per-order fee, with broad coverage targeted by H1 2027.
events.current_state_zh:
据德国储蓄银行与汇划银行协会（DSGV）消息，自 10 月 19 日起，首批参与的德国储蓄银行（Sparkassen）客户可通过现有的储蓄银行 App 交易加密货币。首批支持的币种包括 BTC、ETH、XRP、SOL 及 POL，各家储蓄银行自行决定上线时间，此后预计每月新增 30 至 40 家机构接入。

此举使加密货币交易能够在受监管的前提下，进入德国覆盖面最广的本地银行网络。据 DSGV 官网数据，截至 2026 年 8 月德国共有 337 家独立运营的储蓄银行；协会计划在 2027 年上半年覆盖大部分有意参与的储蓄银行。

该服务由储蓄银行集团旗下证券服务商 DekaBank 提供，加密资产由 DekaBank 与斯图加特证券交易所合作托管，每笔订单收费约 0.99 欧元（约 1.11 美元）。DSGV 表示，服务面向希望自主买卖和托管加密货币的客户，储蓄银行不会提供投资建议，也不会大范围主动推广，并会明确提示客户注意价格大幅波动及全部亏损的风险。
events.title_en: 【德国储蓄银行开始逐步上线加密货币交易服务】
events.title_zh: 【德国储蓄银行开始逐步上线加密货币交易服务】

updates.background_en: DSGV is the umbrella association of German savings banks and the apex entity of the Sparkassen-Finanzgruppe, which Wikipedia describes as the largest financial services group in Germany and Europe by assets. DekaBank had already rolled out crypto trading and custody services for institutional clients, supported by the digital assets unit of the Stuttgart Stock Exchange. DSGV management board member Joachim Schmalzl attributed the decision to strong customer demand and the reliable regulatory framework now in place in Europe, adding that traditional securities, savings plans and financial advice remain the group's core business.
updates.background_zh: DSGV 是德国储蓄银行的上层协会，也是储蓄银行金融集团（Sparkassen-Finanzgruppe）的顶层机构；据维基百科，该集团是德国和欧洲资产规模最大的金融服务集团。DekaBank 此前已在斯图加特证券交易所数字资产部门的支持下，面向机构客户推出加密交易与托管服务。DSGV 管理层成员 Joachim Schmalzl 表示，入局的决定性因素是客户需求强劲以及欧洲目前已具备可靠的监管框架，并强调传统证券投资、储蓄计划与财务咨询仍是集团核心业务。

updates.detailed_summary_en: Germany's savings banks began a phased rollout of crypto trading through their existing apps on Oct. 19, starting with BTC, ETH, XRP, SOL and POL, DekaBank custody and a €0.99 per-order fee, with broad coverage targeted by H1 2027.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Germany's savings banks began a phased rollout of crypto trading through their existing apps on Oct. 19, starting with BTC, ETH, XRP, SOL and POL, DekaBank custody and a €0.99 per-order fee, with broad coverage targeted by H1 2027.
updates.market_impact_en: The rollout adds a regulated retail access channel in Europe's largest banking market, routing orders for BTC, ETH, XRP, SOL and POL through DekaBank and Stuttgart Stock Exchange custody, which could gradually deepen onshore euro liquidity and custody concentration for those five assets. At €0.99 per order, the pricing also puts savings banks in direct competition with mobile brokers such as N26 and Trade Republic, though the gradual, opt-in pace limits near-term volume effects.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次上线为欧洲最大的银行市场增加了一条受监管的散户入场通道，BTC、ETH、XRP、SOL 和 POL 的订单经由 DekaBank 与斯图加特证券交易所的托管体系处理，可能逐步提升这五种资产在欧元区境内的流动性与托管集中度。每笔 0.99 欧元的定价也使储蓄银行与 N26、Trade Republic 等手机银行形成直接竞争，但各家机构自愿、分批上线的节奏限制了短期成交量的实际影响。

events.current_state_en: The Mesh-Visa partnership has been announced to let users spend directly from crypto and stablecoin wallets at Visa merchants; Mesh handles funding, asset conversion, KYC and Visa credential provisioning, with Visa's network covering 175M+ merchant locations, while participating wallets and launch dates are not yet announced.
events.current_state_zh: Mesh 与 Visa 的合作已宣布，用户可直接从加密和稳定币钱包在 Visa 商户消费；Mesh 负责交易资金、资产转换、KYC 和 Visa 支付凭证发放，Visa 网络覆盖 175M+ 商户地点，但参与钱包和上线日期尚未公布。
events.title_en: 【Mesh 与 Visa 达成合作，实现加密货币余额直接消费】
events.title_zh: 【Mesh 与 Visa 达成合作，实现加密货币余额直接消费】

updates.background_en: Mesh, founded in 2020, positions itself as a global crypto payment network connecting more than 300 wallets and exchanges. In September it integrated with Bybit Pay to let users spend directly from exchange balances, and in January it raised $75 million in a Dragonfly-led round that valued the company at $1 billion. Visa payment credentials are issued through tokenization, which replaces sensitive card details with unique tokens.
updates.background_zh: Mesh 成立于 2020 年，定位为连接 300 多个钱包与交易所的全球加密支付网络。该公司于去年 9 月与 Bybit Pay 完成集成，使用户可直接使用交易所余额消费；今年 1 月，Mesh 在 Dragonfly 领投的一轮融资中募得 7500 万美元，估值达 10 亿美元。Visa 支付凭证通过令牌化（tokenization）方式签发，以唯一令牌替代敏感卡信息。
updates.current_state_en: Mesh has partnered with Visa to let users spend cryptocurrency, stablecoin, and fiat wallet balances directly at Visa merchants, with Mesh generating Visa payment credentials and handling KYC and back-end asset conversion.
updates.current_state_zh: Mesh 已与 Visa 合作，让用户可直接在 Visa 商户处使用加密货币、稳定币和法币钱包余额消费，由 Mesh 生成 Visa 支付凭证并负责 KYC 及后端资产转换。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Mesh has partnered with Visa to let users spend cryptocurrency, stablecoin, and fiat wallet balances directly at Visa merchants, with Mesh generating Visa payment credentials and handling KYC and back-end asset conversion.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Mesh has partnered with Visa to let users spend cryptocurrency, stablecoin, and fiat wallet balances directly at Visa merchants, with Mesh generating Visa payment credentials and handling KYC and back-end asset conversion.
updates.market_impact_en: The deal links wallet-held stablecoin and crypto balances to card-rail settlement, a channel that touches stablecoin payment infrastructure, wallet providers and crypto payment networks rather than spot trading directly. Because Mesh handles conversion at transaction time, the effect on markets would flow through spending-related conversion and settlement flows rather than through any announced change in asset supply or listing.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该合作将钱包内的稳定币与加密资产余额接入卡组织结算通道，其传导路径主要涉及稳定币支付基础设施、钱包服务商与加密支付网络，而非直接作用于现货交易。由于兑换在每笔交易发生时由 Mesh 在后台完成，对市场的影响主要通过消费场景下的兑换与结算资金流体现，而非已公布的资产供给或上币安排变化。

摩根大通资产管理于10月19日（周一）发布《2027年长期资本市场假设》报告，首次将比特币纳入长期收益预测，预计其未来10至15年复合年化收益率为10%。这一数字高于该机构对美国大型股的7.5%、美国房地产投资信托基金（REITs）的8.2%、黄金的5.5%以及经典60/40股债组合的7%，同时给出20.9%的算术平均年收益率和55%的年化波动率。

Bitwise首席投资官Matt Hougan表示，摩根大通将比特币列为未来十年预期表现最佳的资产，背后代表传统金融机构对加密资产态度的转变。该预测出自美国最大银行旗下的资产管理公司，使比特币在这份被机构配置者作为参考的报告中与主流资产并列。

报告称“首次为比特币收益给出区间，但尚未将比特币纳入主要协方差矩阵”，而是另外构建了一个规模较小的对比矩阵，理由是比特币波动性高、相关性不稳定。报告同时反驳了一种流行的看涨逻辑，认为“货币贬值将促使资金涌入加密资产”的说法“偏离实际”。

updates.background_en: The report is the 31st annual edition of J.P. Morgan Asset Management's long-term capital market assumptions. JPMorgan has been deepening its own blockchain work, bringing JPM Coin, a token representing dollar deposits, to Ethereum and joining BlackRock, Goldman Sachs and the DTCC in tokenized stock efforts. On the day the report drew attention, US spot bitcoin ETFs took in $526.7 million, their best day since Sept. 22, with BlackRock's IBIT accounting for $665.2 million of inflows.
updates.background_zh: 该报告是摩根大通资产管理年度长期资本市场假设的第31期。摩根大通自身也在加深区块链布局，将代表美元存款的JPM Coin引入以太坊，并与贝莱德、高盛和DTCC共同参与代币化股票项目。在报告引发关注之际，美国现货比特币ETF当日净流入5.267亿美元，为9月22日以来最佳单日表现，其中贝莱德的IBIT流入6.652亿美元。

Bitwise首席投资官Matt Hougan表示，摩根大通将比特币列为未来十年预期表现最佳的资产，背后代表传统金融机构对加密资产态度的转变。该预测出自美国最大银行旗下的资产管理公司，使比特币在这份被机构配置者作为参考的报告中与主流资产并列。

报告称“首次为比特币收益给出区间，但尚未将比特币纳入主要协方差矩阵”，而是另外构建了一个规模较小的对比矩阵，理由是比特币波动性高、相关性不稳定。报告同时反驳了一种流行的看涨逻辑，认为“货币贬值将促使资金涌入加密资产”的说法“偏离实际”。
updates.detailed_summary_en: JPMorgan Asset Management's 2027 Long-Term Capital Market Assumptions report included bitcoin for the first time, forecasting a 10% compound annual return over 10-15 years—above US large-cap stocks (7.5%), gold (5.5%) and REITs (8.2%)—with 20.9% arithmetic mean return and 55% annualized volatility.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: JPMorgan Asset Management's 2027 Long-Term Capital Market Assumptions report included bitcoin for the first time, forecasting a 10% compound annual return over 10-15 years—above US large-cap stocks (7.5%), gold (5.5%) and REITs (8.2%)—with 20.9% arithmetic mean return and 55% annualized volatility.
updates.market_impact_en: The projection enters the model-portfolio inputs that institutional allocators rely on, giving consultants and multi-asset managers a citable capital-market assumption when sizing bitcoin exposure — a channel that runs through allocation policy and ETF flows rather than through spot prices directly. JPMorgan's choice to keep bitcoin out of its main covariance matrices, combined with the 55% volatility assumption, limits how fast that input can translate into mainstream portfolio weights.
updates.market_impact_zh: 这一预测直接进入机构配置者构建模型组合时使用的输入参数，为顾问和多资产管理人在衡量比特币敞口时提供了可引用的资本市场假设，其传导渠道是通过配置政策与ETF资金流，而非直接作用于现货价格。摩根大通暂未将比特币纳入主要协方差矩阵，加上55%的波动率假设，限制了这一输入转化为主流组合权重的速度。

updates.background_en: Drift, a Solana-based decentralized perpetual futures exchange, reported losses from the April 1 exploit, which its security consultant Mandiant attributed to a North Korean threat group. On Oct. 1 the protocol opened claims and redemptions for DFX recovery tokens, giving affected users a claim on a pool that launched with about $3.1 million and receives exchange revenue and recovered funds. Tornado Cash is an open-source, non-custodial mixer on Ethereum Virtual Machine-compatible networks that obscures the link between source and destination addresses.
updates.background_zh: Drift 是一家基于 Solana 的去中心化永续合约交易所，其 4 月 1 日遭到的攻击造成损失，安全顾问 Mandiant 将此次攻击归因于一个朝鲜威胁组织。10 月 1 日，该协议开放了 DFX 恢复代币的申领与赎回，使受损用户对一个初始规模约 310 万美元、并获得交易所收入和追回资金的资金池拥有求偿权。Tornado Cash 是一个开源、非托管的混币器，运行于兼容以太坊虚拟机的网络，用于模糊资金来源与目的地地址之间的关联。
updates.current_state_en: The Drift Protocol attacker continues laundering through Tornado Cash, with cumulative deposits on Oct 20–21 reaching 50,595 ETH (~$122M), while the related address still holds about 56,569 ETH (~$139M).
updates.current_state_zh: Drift Protocol 攻击者持续通过 Tornado Cash 洗钱，10 月 20 日至 21 日累计存入 50,595 枚 ETH（约 1.22 亿美元），相关地址仍持有约 56,569 枚 ETH（约 1.39 亿美元）。
updates.detailed_summary_en: The attacker behind the April Drift Protocol theft deposited another 24,885 ETH (~$61M) into Tornado Cash in the past hour, taking cumulative laundering on Oct 20–21 to 50,595 ETH (~$122M) while still holding roughly 56,569 ETH (~$139M).
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The attacker behind the April Drift Protocol theft deposited another 24,885 ETH (~$61M) into Tornado Cash in the past hour, taking cumulative laundering on Oct 20–21 to 50,595 ETH (~$122M) while still holding roughly 56,569 ETH (~$139M).
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission runs through compliance and liquidity rather than price: large ETH tranches entering a mixer push exchanges, bridges and analytics firms to tighten screening of deposits that may be tied to the hack, while the still-unmoved 56,569 ETH overhang keeps recovery expectations for Drift's DFX claim pool depressed.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导路径主要在合规与流动性层面，而非价格层面：大额 ETH 进入混币器会促使交易所、跨链桥和链上分析机构加强对可能与此次黑客事件相关存款的筛查；而仍未动用的 56,569 枚 ETH 则压低了市场对 Drift 的 DFX 求偿池回收规模的预期。

events.current_state_en: Investigators identified FreedomXMR (FXMR) on Hyperliquid Core as a centralized laundering service with over 87% illicit inflow volume and $20M+ traced to ransomware and exploits including Axelar, Fetch.ai, DCENT, and Gamdom.
events.current_state_zh:
链上调查员 ZachXBT 发文称，2026 年 8 月出现在 Hyperliquid Core 上的中心化洗钱服务 FreedomXMR（FXMR），其超过 87% 的流入交易量与非法活动直接相关。他对 FXMR 历史上单笔超过 1 万美元的流入进行人工审查，发现逾 2000 万美元资金可直接追溯至勒索软件、漏洞攻击、恶意软件及社交工程事件，并已将相关数据表格分享给 Hyperliquid 团队。

该披露指认 Hyperliquid Core 多次被洗钱服务用作通道，ZachXBT 表示该链此前还出现过 b1exch 等利用其无需许可设计的服务。相关证据已提交 Hyperliquid 团队，但目前未有该团队采取行动的确认消息。

被追溯的事件包括 2026 年 9 月的 DCENT Wallet、Fetch.ai、Axelar 攻击与一笔未具名勒索软件付款，以及 2026 年 10 月的 Gamdom 攻击。ZachXBT 称 FXMR 管理员通过 KuCoin 获取门罗币流动性，相关地址累计向该交易所存入超过 3000 次，运作模式可能与 Wagyu 的兑换模式类似；FXMR 代币代码于 2026 年 7 月 27 日通过 Hyperliquid 拍卖以 518.28 枚 HYPE（约 2.8 万美元）购得。

events.title_zh: 调查人员指认Hyperliquid上的洗钱服务FreedomXMR

updates.background_en: Hyperliquid is a standalone Layer-1 blockchain whose state comprises HyperCore and the HyperEVM, both secured by the HyperBFT consensus mechanism; HyperCore hosts its spot markets, where tickers are allocated through auctions. ZachXBT has previously documented centralized laundering services operating on the chain. The 87% illicit-inflow ratio and the fund tracing are the investigator's own conclusions.

events.current_state_en: FINMA approved BIT Asset Management's BBIT spot Bitcoin ETF on Oct. 20; it is expected to begin trading on SIX Swiss Exchange in November but the exact date is undetermined. Public offering remains restricted to Switzerland, while overseas banks and brokers can access it via approved or existing trading participants; other crypto-asset ETFs are not automatically approved by this decision.
events.current_state_zh: FINMA已于10月20日批准BIT Asset Management的BBIT现货比特币ETF，预计11月在SIX Swiss Exchange开始交易但具体日期未定；公开发行仍仅限瑞士，海外银行及券商可通过获批或现有交易参与者接入；其他加密资产ETF不会因该批准自动获批。

updates.current_state_en: Switzerland's FINMA approved the country's first spot Bitcoin ETF for retail investors, using a regulated investment-fund structure with stricter custody, operational-risk and disclosure requirements instead of the debt-security format used by existing Swiss Bitcoin ETPs.
updates.current_state_zh: 瑞士FINMA批准该国首只面向散户投资者的现货比特币ETF，采用受监管的投资基金结构，在托管、运营风险和披露方面要求更严格，而非现有瑞士比特币ETP所使用的债务证券形式。

events.current_state_en: eMudhra is exiting its global SSL/TLS certificate business after an incident triggered intense scrutiny and browser-vendor questions, with its stock reportedly falling 20% as the company separates the affected operation from its other businesses.
events.current_state_zh: eMudhra 将退出其全球 SSL/TLS 证书业务，此前一起事件引发严格审查和浏览器厂商的质疑，据报道其股价下跌 20%，公司正将受影响业务与其他业务分离。
events.title_en: EMudhra Intermediate CA Compromise
events.title_zh: eMudhra中间CA私钥脆弱导致证书伪造，浏览器撤销并引发退出SSL/TLS业务

updates.background_en: Intermediate CAs are delegated signing layers that issue certificates on behalf of a root CA; compromising one lets the operator revoke that intermediate without invalidating the root or sibling intermediates. Revocation has long been the weak point of TLS: browsers check CRLs or OCSP, and Mozilla has layered on OneCRL for intermediates and CRLite for leaf certificates, but many TLS libraries and embedded clients perform little or no such checking.
updates.background_zh: 中间 CA 是代表根 CA 签发证书的委派签名层；攻陷其中一个，可以让运营方吊销该中间 CA 而不影响根 CA 或其他同级中间 CA。吊销一直是 TLS 的薄弱环节：浏览器通过 CRL 或 OCSP 检查状态，Mozilla 还叠加了面向中间证书的 OneCRL 和面向叶子证书的 CRLite，但许多 TLS 库和嵌入式客户端几乎不做此类检查。
updates.community_discussion_en: Commenters reacted with disbelief and derision at the single-byte key material, with one noting they put "compromised" in quotes "because I can't call it that without cringing." A Mozilla engineer's explanation of OneCRL/CRLite remediation and the uneven state of revocation across the ecosystem drew the most substantive attention, and others asked for a qualified account of whether the keys were leaked or merely guessable.
updates.community_discussion_zh: 评论者对单字节密钥材料表示难以置信和嘲讽，有人称自己给“被攻陷”加上引号，“因为这么称呼实在让人难受”。一位 Mozilla 工程师关于 OneCRL/CRLite 处置方式及整个生态吊销能力不均衡的说明获得了最多实质性关注，也有人呼吁由具备资质的人澄清这些密钥究竟是被泄露还是仅仅可被猜出。
updates.current_state_en: eMudhra's intermediate CA private keys turned out to be single-byte values, enabling trivial forgery of certificates chaining to a trusted root until browsers revoked the CAs within hours.
updates.current_state_zh:
eMudhra 的中间 ECC 证书颁发机构被发现私钥实际上可被猜测——据报道只有一个字节（其中一个私钥字面值就是“4”），根源在于某一天用于生成这些 ECC 签发者的 KGC 脚本存在缺陷。浏览器厂商随即撤销了对相关中间 CA 的信任，而未采用现代吊销机制的非浏览器 TLS 客户端仍暴露在风险之中。

由于这些中间 CA 属于公开受信任的机构，任何能猜出私钥的人都可以为任意域名伪造证书，而这种风险在生态中的分布极不均衡。一位 Mozilla 工程师表示，Firefox 用户通过 OneCRL 在两小时内即自动获得保护，Chrome、Apple 和 Microsoft 也有类似机制，但“生态中的其余部分在吊销机制上几乎没有任何投入”。

在 Mozilla 缺陷报告 2083449 中，eMudhra 表示初步评估发现“当天用于创建这些 ECC 签发者的 KGC 脚本存在缺陷”，并称对 KGC 代码和 HSM 密钥的审查迄今显示：一组原始 ECC 密钥按预期在硬件内生成，此外还存在一项对其常规 KGC 流程的获批偏离。社区讨论提到共有 8 个受影响的 CA，一位评论者称这些密钥据称是在某个公开仓库 URL 上被发现的，同时表示不确定这些文件说明的是密钥被窃取，还是密钥生成过程本身过弱。
updates.detailed_summary_en: eMudhra's intermediate CA private keys turned out to be single-byte values, enabling trivial forgery of certificates chaining to a trusted root until browsers revoked the CAs within hours.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: eMudhra's intermediate CA private keys turned out to be single-byte values, enabling trivial forgery of certificates chaining to a trusted root until browsers revoked the CAs within hours.
updates.market_impact_en: The exposure runs through TLS trust rather than through any token's fundamentals: crypto exchanges, custodians, wallet backends and node RPC endpoints that terminate TLS in non-browser clients may not consult OneCRL or CRLite, leaving a window for interception of API and webhook traffic until the affected intermediates are removed from those trust stores. Browser-facing services were largely covered by vendor-side revocation, so the residual risk concentrates in server-to-server and embedded/IoT infrastructure.
updates.market_impact_zh: 这一风险通过 TLS 信任链而非任何代币基本面传导：在非浏览器客户端上终结 TLS 的加密交易所、托管机构、钱包后端和节点 RPC 端点可能并不查询 OneCRL 或 CRLite，在相关中间 CA 被从这些信任库中移除之前，API 与 webhook 流量存在被拦截的窗口。面向浏览器的服务大体已被厂商侧的吊销机制覆盖，因此残余风险集中在服务器间通信以及嵌入式/物联网基础设施上。

updates.current_state_en: The eight affected eMudhra intermediate CAs have been emergency-blocked or mitigated by major browsers and Cloudflare; major browsers show no evidence of exploitation, but non-browser clients that do not enforce Certificate Transparency may remain exposed to forged certificates.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Major technology companies deployed emergency blocks against eight vulnerable eMudhra intermediate certificates after a private-key generation flaw made them trivial to exploit for impersonating legitimate websites.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Major technology companies deployed emergency blocks against eight vulnerable eMudhra intermediate certificates after a private-key generation flaw made them trivial to exploit for impersonating legitimate websites.
updates.title_en: Tech giants rush to block 8 eMudhra certs that could enable fake sites
updates.title_zh: 科技巨头紧急封禁 8 张 eMudhra 证书，因其可能被用于伪造网站
updates.what_changed_en: Added concrete response details: Mozilla independently recovered and confirmed the flawed keys; Cloudflare released updates for Cloudflare One, WARP Clients and Tunnel on Tuesday; Chrome blocked the certificates since Saturday, Apple since Monday, Microsoft since Tuesday; Firefox released Desktop and Android updates for users with custom settings. The report also says major browsers show no evidence of exploitation, certificate transparency logs have no entries for the intermediate CAs since April 2025, and non-browser clients that do not enforce CT remain at risk.
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增了更具体的响应进展：Mozilla 独立复现并确认私钥生成缺陷；Cloudflare 于周一获悉后于周二为 Cloudflare One、WARP 客户端和 Tunnel 发布更新及缓解措施；Chrome 自周六、Apple 设备自周一、Microsoft 平台自周二起已封堵相关证书；Firefox 还为自定义设置用户发布桌面和 Android 更新。报道同时称，主要浏览器未发现被利用证据，证书透明度日志自 2025 年 4 月以来没有这些中间 CA 的记录，但浏览器生态之外许多不强制 CT 的客户端仍面临风险。

updates.current_state_en: The eight affected eMudhra intermediate CAs have been emergency-blocked by major browsers, Cloudflare, and several developer language/framework ecosystems, and eMudhra has formally revoked the certificates; no evidence yet shows the weak keys were used to forge certificates, but IoT devices and unpatched legacy systems remain exposed and cleanup is ongoing.
updates.current_state_zh: 8 个受影响的 eMudhra 中间 CA 已被主要浏览器、Cloudflare 及多个开发语言/框架生态紧急封堵，eMudhra 也已正式吊销相关证书；尚未发现脆弱私钥被用于签发伪造证书的证据，但物联网设备和未更新旧系统仍存在清理与暴露风险。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Indian CA eMudhra exposed eight intermediate certificates with trivially crackable private keys, prompting global browsers and developer ecosystems to blacklist them and update trust stores to prevent HTTPS man-in-the-middle attacks.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Indian CA eMudhra exposed eight intermediate certificates with trivially crackable private keys, prompting global browsers and developer ecosystems to blacklist them and update trust stores to prevent HTTPS man-in-the-middle attacks.
updates.title_en: 印度CA机构eMudhra曝私钥生成漏洞，全球浏览器紧急拉黑防范中间人攻击
updates.title_zh: 印度CA机构eMudhra曝私钥生成漏洞，全球浏览器紧急拉黑防范中间人攻击
updates.what_changed_en: Added that eMudhra has formally revoked the defective certificates and that major developer ecosystems including Go, Python, Rust, and Electron have pushed updates to block the affected certificates within their own trust stores.
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增了 eMudhra 已正式吊销存在缺陷的证书，以及 Go、Python、Rust、Electron 等主流开发语言和框架已推送更新并在各自生态内封禁相关证书的响应细节。

events.current_state_en: Webull will begin offering CFTC-regulated crypto perpetual futures, initially including Bitcoin, to eligible US customers starting in November through its existing futures accounts, with KalshiEX listing and Kalshi Klear clearing the products.
events.current_state_zh:
在线投资平台 Webull（NASDAQ: BULL）将于 11 月起向符合条件的美国客户开放永续合约交易，首批产品包括比特币和其他加密资产，并计划在年底前扩大开放范围。该永续合约将在 CFTC 监管的指定合约市场 KalshiEX 挂牌，并由 CFTC 监管的衍生品清算机构 Kalshi Klear 负责清算，用户可通过现有 Webull 期货账户直接交易。

此次上线让已获批期货交易资格的美国零售客户可以通过 CFTC 监管的场所交易加密永续合约，而这一产品此前对美国用户主要在场外平台交易。初期仅面向已获批期货交易资格的客户开放。

Webull 表示，该业务将于 11 月启动，并计划在年底前扩大适用范围；交易通过现有的 Webull 期货账户进行，而非新设加密专属产品线。相关产品在 KalshiEX 挂牌，由 Kalshi Klear 清算。

updates.background_en: Perpetual futures are futures contracts without an expiration date that use a funding-rate mechanism to keep contract prices close to a reference asset; they originated in crypto markets and account for a large share of crypto trading activity. KalshiEX LLC received a CFTC order of designation as a designated contract market in November 2020, and Kalshi Klear LLC was registered as a derivatives clearing organization on August 28, 2024, after which Kalshi began clearing its contracts through the affiliate.
updates.background_zh: 永续合约是没有到期日的期货合约，通过资金费率机制使合约价格贴近标的资产，这一产品起源于加密市场，目前在加密交易量中占比很大。KalshiEX LLC 于 2020 年 11 月获得 CFTC 的指定合约市场资格，Kalshi Klear LLC 则于 2024 年 8 月 28 日注册为衍生品清算机构，此后 Kalshi 开始通过该关联机构清算其合约。

updates.market_impact_en: The channel is venue and regulatory structure: a US brokerage offering perps through a CFTC-regulated exchange and clearinghouse gives US accounts a compliant alternative to offshore perpetual venues, potentially shifting some retail derivatives flow onshore and intensifying competition among regulated US crypto-derivatives venues. Because access is initially limited to futures-approved accounts and a narrow asset list, any effect on aggregate perpetual liquidity is likely incremental.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道在于交易场所与监管结构：一家美国券商通过 CFTC 监管的交易所与清算机构提供永续合约，为美国账户提供了场外永续合约平台之外的合规替代选择，可能使部分零售衍生品交易流转向美国境内，并加剧美国合规加密衍生品场所之间的竞争。由于初期仅面向已获批期货交易资格的账户，且标的资产范围有限，对永续合约整体流动性的影响可能是渐进的。

events.current_state_en: Google has open-sourced TorchTPU, a native PyTorch back end for TPUs, giving PyTorch users first-party support for Google's accelerator hardware.
events.current_state_zh:
谷歌已开源 TorchTPU，这是一个原生 PyTorch 后端，可让 PyTorch 工作负载直接在谷歌的张量处理器（TPU）上运行。谷歌在开发者博客中详细介绍了该项目，称其采用“Eager First（优先即时执行）”设计并集成 XLA，目的是简化模型向 TPU 基础设施的迁移。

PyTorch 是模型开发的主流框架，官方一方支持消除了一个长期障碍——此前团队若要用 TPU，往往需要绕过 XLA 适配，或干脆留在 TensorFlow/JAX 上。社区评论认为，这一发布加速了开发者远离 TensorFlow 的趋势，并扩大了 PyTorch 代码可适配的加速器范围。

该项目最早由路透社在去年 12 月报道，如今谷歌正式确认并披露了细节；The Stack 报道称，谷歌投入了多名员工专职构建该后端。谷歌开发者博客将 XLA 集成以及在 TPU 基础设施上实现峰值效率作为核心目标。
events.title_en: Google open-sources TorchTPU, a native PyTorch back end for TPUs
events.title_zh: 谷歌开源 TorchTPU：面向 TPU 的原生 PyTorch 后端

updates.background_en: TPUs are Google's custom-designed AI accelerators, historically programmed primarily through TensorFlow and the XLA compiler, with JAX also targeting them. Running PyTorch on Cloud TPU previously required bridging layers, and Google Cloud documentation describes setups in which frameworks such as Ray provision PyTorch workers per TPU device. Competing accelerator vendors have shipped similar efforts, such as AWS's torch-neuronx for Trainium.
updates.background_zh: TPU 是谷歌自研的 AI 加速器，历史上主要通过 TensorFlow 和 XLA 编译器进行编程，JAX 同样可以面向其运行。此前在 Cloud TPU 上运行 PyTorch 需要额外的桥接层，谷歌云文档描述了由 Ray 等框架为每个 TPU 设备启动一个 PyTorch worker 的方案。竞争对手也在推进类似工作，例如 AWS 面向 Trainium 的 torch-neuronx。
updates.community_discussion_en: Commenters were largely positive. One developer said he had built an open-source libtpu implementation for Tenstorrent accelerators that already runs most of TorchTPU, illustrating what lowering Torch to tile-based accelerators involves; another pointed to AWS's torch-neuronx as the equivalent Trainium effort. Others argued XLA is strong compiler infrastructure and that the release is "the final nail in the coffin of Tensorflow," while one commenter suggested that with hardware specifics living in the kernel layer (Pallas or CUDA), JAX versus PyTorch is now closer to a style preference.
updates.community_discussion_zh: 评论整体偏正面。一位开发者称自己为 Tenstorrent 加速器做了开源 libtpu 实现，已能运行 TorchTPU 的大部分功能，展示了把 Torch 下沉到基于 tile 的加速器所涉及的环节；另一位指出 AWS 的 torch-neuronx 是 Trainium 上的对等方案。也有人认为 XLA 是优秀的编译器基础设施，此次发布是“给 TensorFlow 棺材钉上的最后一颗钉子”；还有评论者认为，既然硬件相关细节大多位于内核层（Pallas 或 CUDA），JAX 与 PyTorch 之争现在更像是风格偏好。

updates.market_impact_en: The transmission channel is hardware substitution in AI compute: a first-party PyTorch path lowers the migration cost onto TPUs relative to Nvidia GPUs, which could gradually affect how training and inference capacity is sourced across cloud providers. For crypto, that matters indirectly through AI-compute-adjacent segments such as decentralized GPU rental and compute marketplaces, whose economics are benchmarked against prevailing accelerator rental rates.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道是 AI 算力层面的硬件替代：原生 PyTorch 路径降低了从英伟达 GPU 迁移到 TPU 的成本，可能逐步影响云厂商之间训练与推理算力的采购结构。对加密市场而言，其影响是间接的，主要通过去中心化 GPU 租赁与算力市场等 AI 算力相关板块体现——这些板块的经济性以主流加速器租赁价格为参照。

events.current_state_en: Meta has restored Muse conversation sharing. The feature had been paused after Claroc researchers showed that publicly accessible Muse chat links could expose sensitive material; sharing is now re-enabled.
events.current_state_zh: Meta 已恢复 Muse 的对话分享功能。此前 Claroc 研究人员发现公开可访问的 Muse 聊天链接可暴露敏感材料，Meta 随后暂停了该功能；现在分享功能已重新开启。
events.title_en: Meta Muse chat-sharing links found publicly discoverable; Meta pauses feature
events.title_zh: Meta Muse 聊天分享链接被曝公开可查，Meta 暂停该功能

updates.background_en: Meta introduced Muse as a consumer-facing personal AI agent, promoting it at launch as safe, secure and private. Sharing conversations with an AI assistant is a common feature across major chatbot products, which makes link discoverability a recurring privacy concern for platforms.
updates.background_zh: Meta 推出 Muse 时将其定位为面向普通用户的个人 AI 智能体，并在发布时宣传其安全、可靠且注重隐私。与 AI 助手分享对话是各大聊天机器人产品的常见功能，这也使得链接是否容易被发现成为平台反复面临的隐私问题。
updates.current_state_en: Meta paused its Muse conversation-sharing feature after Claroc researchers discovered more than 6,800 publicly accessible Muse chat links through public DNS records.
updates.current_state_zh:
Meta 表示已暂停 Muse 的一项分享功能——该功能允许用户分享与这款 AI 助手的对话。此前，安全公司 Claroc 的研究人员通过公开的 DNS 记录发现了超过 6,800 条可公开访问的 Muse 聊天链接，Ars Technica 报道了这一消息。Claroc 本周发布了相关报告。

这次暂停是针对一起隐私暴露事件的产品层面应对，而用户此前可能以为这些对话只在小范围内被分享。

据报道，这些链接是通过公开的 DNS 记录被定位到的，而非由 Meta 主动披露。Meta 称该分享功能为“暂停”，并非永久移除。

events.current_state_en:
OpenAI announced Tuesday that it has acquired Orchestra Bio, a San Francisco startup whose AI agents track and coordinate drug development programs, and will fold its team and platform into Rosalind, OpenAI's suite of AI models and tools for biologists and chemists. Financial terms were not disclosed.

OpenAI said the goal is to help scientists make discoveries and manage the work needed to turn them into treatments that reach patients sooner, and that the combined team will build agents connecting scientific findings with the decisions and follow-up studies required to turn a promising result into a medicine.

Orchestra's agents map how setbacks such as a failed manufacturing batch ripple through a drug program and compare possible responses, while scientists and program leaders keep the final decision. Founded in the fall of 2022, Orchestra raised a seed round from Andreessen Horowitz, Definition Capital, Insight Partners and 8VC totaling about $20 million; it is unrelated to Nasdaq-listed medical device maker Orchestra BioMed (ticker OBIO).
events.current_state_zh:
OpenAI 周二宣布收购旧金山初创公司 Orchestra Bio，该公司的人工智能代理用于跟踪和协调药物研发项目；其团队与平台将被并入 OpenAI 面向生物学家和化学家的 AI 模型与工具套件 Rosalind。交易金额未披露。

OpenAI 表示，目标是帮助科学家做出发现，并管理将这些发现转化为更快惠及患者的疗法所需的工作；合并后的团队将构建智能代理，把科学发现与把有希望的结果转化为药物所需的决策和后续研究连接起来。

Orchestra 的智能代理会推演诸如生产批次失败等挫折如何在药物项目中传导，并比较可能的应对方案，最终决定权仍掌握在科学家和项目负责人手中。Orchestra 成立于 2022 年秋季，种子轮融资来自 Andreessen Horowitz、Definition Capital、Insight Partners 和 8VC，累计约 2000 万美元；该公司与在纳斯达克上市、代码为 OBIO 的医疗器械公司 Orchestra BioMed 无关。

updates.background_en: In April, OpenAI launched GPT-Rosalind, a model built specifically for biology and drug discovery and restricted to vetted U.S. enterprise customers such as Amgen and Moderna, alongside a companion product, Rosalind Workbench, that connects the model to scientific tools and data. The deal follows Anthropic's roughly $400 million purchase of Coefficient Bio in April, as rival AI labs compete to own the workflow behind new medicines. OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar wrote in a January blog post that licensing, IP-based agreements and outcome-based pricing will share in the value created as AI moves into drug discovery.
updates.background_zh: 今年 4 月，OpenAI 推出了专为生物学和药物发现构建的模型 GPT-Rosalind，仅向 Amgen、Moderna 等经过审核的美国企业客户开放，同时推出配套产品 Rosalind Workbench，将该模型与科学工具和数据连接。此前，竞争对手 Anthropic 于 4 月以约 4 亿美元收购 Coefficient Bio，各大 AI 实验室正争相掌握新药研发背后的工作流。OpenAI 首席财务官 Sarah Friar 在 1 月的博客文章中写道，随着 AI 进入药物发现等领域，授权、基于知识产权的协议以及按结果定价将分享所创造的价值。

updates.background_en: The NBA agreements come amid a legal battle over whether federal commodities rules supersede state gambling laws for sports prediction markets, producing conflicting court decisions. In September the 6th US Circuit Court of Appeals ruled against Kalshi in a case involving Ohio and Tennessee, following a similar 9th Circuit decision, while an earlier 3rd Circuit ruling let Kalshi keep operating in New Jersey pending appeal. On Oct. 20 Utah Attorney General Derek Brown sued Kalshi, seeking an estimated $30 million to $60 million in allegedly illegal profits, and 39 states plus Washington, DC have backed a petition asking the US Supreme Court to review the New Jersey dispute.
updates.background_zh: NBA 的这些协议出台之际，围绕联邦大宗商品规则是否优先于州博彩法适用于体育预测市场，正存在一场法律争议，并已产生相互冲突的法院判决。9 月，美国第六巡回上诉法院在涉及俄亥俄州与田纳西州的案件中作出不利于 Kalshi 的裁决，此前第九巡回法院也有类似判决；而更早的第三巡回法院裁决则允许 Kalshi 在新泽西州上诉期间继续运营。10 月 20 日，犹他州总检察长 Derek Brown 起诉 Kalshi，寻求追回估计 3000 万至 6000 万美元的涉嫌非法获利；另有 39 个州及华盛顿特区支持一份请愿，要求美国最高法院复审新泽西州的争议。
updates.current_state_en: The CFTC and the NBA signed a memorandum of understanding to share information and coordinate on preventing insider trading and manipulation in prediction markets, with the NBA designating Kalshi and Polymarket as its preferred prediction-market platforms while state-versus-federal jurisdiction over such contracts remains contested.
updates.current_state_zh:
NBA 周一宣布，Kalshi 与 Polymarket 将成为其首选预测市场平台，可使用由 Sportradar 提供的联盟官方数据结算 NBA 相关市场、使用 NBA 及球队标识，并在比赛转播中投放广告；同时 NBA 保留对两家平台可上线的 NBA 相关市场的审批权。联盟还表示已与美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）签署谅解备忘录，并将其与 DraftKings 的现有合作扩大至预测市场，预计未来数周与 FanDuel、Fanatics 达成类似安排。

这些协议让两家平台在 NBA 相关市场上获得官方数据、联盟品牌授权与转播曝光，这是北美主要职业体育联盟此前未给予预测市场交易所的背书程度。随附的 CFTC 信息共享协议，则在行业围绕联邦与州监管权限的诉讼持续之际，为预测市场增添了一条监管合法性渠道。

在诚信条款下，NBA 球员、球队及联盟工作人员不得交易 NBA 事件合约，Kalshi 与 Polymarket 须协助联盟识别可疑交易、防范内幕交易，并在调查中共享数据。CFTC 主席 Michael S. Selig 表示，与 NBA 的协议将加强针对内幕交易和欺诈的信息共享；NBA 由此加入美国职业棒球大联盟（MLB）和北美职业冰球联盟（NHL）的行列，与该监管机构建立类似安排。
updates.detailed_summary_en: The CFTC and the NBA signed a memorandum of understanding to share information and coordinate on preventing insider trading and manipulation in prediction markets, with the NBA designating Kalshi and Polymarket as its preferred prediction-market platforms while state-versus-federal jurisdiction over such contracts remains contested.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The CFTC and the NBA signed a memorandum of understanding to share information and coordinate on preventing insider trading and manipulation in prediction markets, with the NBA designating Kalshi and Polymarket as its preferred prediction-market platforms while state-versus-federal jurisdiction over such contracts remains contested.
updates.market_impact_en: The direct transmission runs through sports event contracts: official NBA data and league-approved markets give Kalshi and Polymarket a verifiable settlement and marketing edge in the highest-volume sports category, and Polymarket's crypto-based rails tie that potential volume growth to on-chain settlement venues. The CFTC MOU supports the regulatory-legitimacy side of the trade, but the unresolved state-versus-federal litigation remains a constraint on how far US sports market expansion can proceed.
updates.market_impact_zh: 直接传导路径集中在体育事件合约上：官方 NBA 数据与联盟审批的市场，让 Kalshi 和 Polymarket 在交易量最大的体育品类中获得可验证的结算依据与营销优势；而 Polymarket 基于加密的结算轨道，将这部分潜在交易量增长与链上结算场所联系起来。CFTC 谅解备忘录则在监管合法性层面提供支撑，但尚未解决的州与联邦权限诉讼，仍限制着美国体育预测市场扩张的边界。

updates.current_state_zh: 犹他州在民事诉讼后进一步对Kalshi及其联合创始人提起14项刑事指控；Kalshi主张其体育赛事合约属于CFTC监管的金融衍生品而非赌博，CFTC则已起诉犹他州以阻止州级行动，相关民事与刑事程序并行。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Utah criminally charged Kalshi and its two co-founders with 14 counts, including a felony and multiple gambling-promotion charges, intensifying the dispute over whether prediction-market contracts are CFTC-regulated derivatives or illegal state gambling.

updates.what_changed_en: Utah criminally charged Kalshi and its two co-founders, Tarek Mansour and Luana Lopes Lara, with 14 counts, including one felony, 12 gambling-promotion charges and one misdemeanor gambling charge; prosecutors said an undercover officer used local details to place 12 sports-event bets on Kalshi in September.

events.current_state_en: Elon Musk said SpaceX and Tesla have formed independent board committees to explore a merger that could create a roughly $3.5 trillion company spanning rockets, electric vehicles, humanoid robots, social media, and the Grok AI chatbot.

updates.background_en: Patch the Planet is part of OpenAI's Daybreak cybersecurity initiative, launched in mid-May 2026, and works with Trail of Bits to help open-source maintainers find, validate, patch, test and disclose vulnerabilities. GPT-5.6, released July 9, 2026, comes in three tiers — Luna, Terra and Sol — with Sol as the flagship. The disclosure follows earlier AI-security disputes: in September, Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese called OpenAI's notification process "unacceptable" after an OpenAI agent accessed non-public files on a Medicare statistics portal.
updates.background_zh: “Patch the Planet”是 OpenAI“Daybreak”网络安全计划的一部分，该计划于 2026 年 5 月中旬启动，并与 Trail of Bits 合作，帮助开源维护者发现、验证、修补、测试和披露漏洞。2026 年 7 月 9 日发布的 GPT-5.6 分为 Luna、Terra 和 Sol 三档，其中 Sol 为旗舰型号。此次披露之前已有多起 AI 安全争议：9 月，澳大利亚总理 Anthony Albanese 在 OpenAI 的一个智能体访问了 Medicare 统计门户的非公开文件后，称其通知流程“不可接受”。
updates.current_state_en: OpenAI says its models discovered the severe PHP2Shell flaws in PHP that prompted several European governments to pull websites offline, and it led a two-month coalition with Calif and Wiz to get the bugs fixed.
updates.current_state_zh:
OpenAI 总裁 Greg Brockman 表示，公司在其“Patch the Planet”计划下，用自家模型主导了一个为期两个月的联盟，发现并修复了 PHP 核心中的 PHP2Shell 漏洞。安全公司 Calif 于 8 月使用 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.6 Sol 发现了该漏洞的一个版本，OpenAI 自己的团队在 9 月发现了更完整的版本，云安全公司 Wiz 也独立发现了这两个漏洞。

这些漏洞的 CVSS 评分为 9.2，可让未通过身份验证的攻击者在运行 PHP 的服务器上执行任意代码；在已知服务端语言的网站中，约 70% 使用 PHP。细节泄露一天后 PHP 才发布修复。芬兰、荷兰和法国于周三下线了政府网站。Brockman 主张防御方需要比攻击者更强的模型，并提出未来可由政府等“获授权防御方”扫描存在漏洞的服务器，并在极端情况下远程打补丁。

Brockman 称该漏洞在 PHP 中存在了 14 年，2024 年曾出现一个有限版本，但“当时未被认为影响重大”；细节开始泄露后，发布时间从原定的 10 月 22 日提前到 10 月 21 日。OpenAI 表示还在修复“若干其他重大漏洞”，包括周三公布的 Node.js 远程代码执行漏洞，并承诺为其关键基础设施防御者计划 Daybreak 提供价值 10 亿美元的补贴访问额度。

updates.market_impact_en: Because PHP underpins a large share of the web — including WordPress, Drupal and Joomla deployments that Wiz demonstrated could be exploited unauthenticated — crypto exchanges, DeFi front-ends and custody dashboards running those stacks carried the same exposure that forced European government sites offline. The episode also feeds a narrative in which frontier-model capability in vulnerability discovery is treated by AI labs as strategic infrastructure, with OpenAI tying $1 billion of subsidized defender access to that positioning.
updates.market_impact_zh: 由于 PHP 支撑着互联网的很大一部分——包括 Wiz 演示可被未授权利用的 WordPress、Drupal 和 Joomla 部署——运行这些技术栈的加密交易所、DeFi 前端和托管面板面临与迫使欧洲政府网站下线相同的暴露面。这一事件也强化了一种叙事：AI 实验室将前沿模型在漏洞发现上的能力视为战略性基础设施，OpenAI 则以 10 亿美元补贴防御方访问来强化这一定位。

updates.title_en: Who Found the PHP Bug That Made Governments Unplug Their Websites? ChatGPT, Of Course
updates.title_zh: 谁发现了那个让各国政府下线网站的 PHP 漏洞？当然是 ChatGPT
updates.what_changed_en: OpenAI says its models discovered the severe PHP2Shell flaws in PHP that prompted several European governments to pull websites offline, and it led a two-month coalition with Calif and Wiz to get the bugs fixed.
updates.what_changed_zh:
OpenAI 总裁 Greg Brockman 表示，公司在其“Patch the Planet”计划下，用自家模型主导了一个为期两个月的联盟，发现并修复了 PHP 核心中的 PHP2Shell 漏洞。安全公司 Calif 于 8 月使用 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.6 Sol 发现了该漏洞的一个版本，OpenAI 自己的团队在 9 月发现了更完整的版本，云安全公司 Wiz 也独立发现了这两个漏洞。

这些漏洞的 CVSS 评分为 9.2，可让未通过身份验证的攻击者在运行 PHP 的服务器上执行任意代码；在已知服务端语言的网站中，约 70% 使用 PHP。细节泄露一天后 PHP 才发布修复。芬兰、荷兰和法国于周三下线了政府网站。Brockman 主张防御方需要比攻击者更强的模型，并提出未来可由政府等“获授权防御方”扫描存在漏洞的服务器，并在极端情况下远程打补丁。

Brockman 称该漏洞在 PHP 中存在了 14 年，2024 年曾出现一个有限版本，但“当时未被认为影响重大”；细节开始泄露后，发布时间从原定的 10 月 22 日提前到 10 月 21 日。OpenAI 表示还在修复“若干其他重大漏洞”，包括周三公布的 Node.js 远程代码执行漏洞，并承诺为其关键基础设施防御者计划 Daybreak 提供价值 10 亿美元的补贴访问额度。

updates.current_state_en: The PHP Foundation released emergency patches for two critical vulnerabilities that could let unauthenticated attackers execute code on vulnerable servers, after acknowledging that structural failures delayed a fix first identified in 2024 and as government websites went offline as a precaution.

updates.what_changed_en: The PHP Foundation released emergency patches for two critical vulnerabilities that could let unauthenticated attackers execute code on vulnerable servers, after acknowledging that structural failures delayed a fix first identified in 2024 and as government websites went offline as a precaution.

updates.current_state_en: Emergency patches for the PHP2Shell critical flaws have been released, but the PHP Foundation has admitted structural failures and delays in the remediation process; some government websites or online services in the Netherlands, Finland, France, Germany and Australia were temporarily taken offline to apply fixes.
updates.current_state_zh: PHP2Shell 严重漏洞的紧急补丁已发布，但 PHP 基金会承认修复过程存在结构性失误和延误；荷兰、芬兰、法国、德国及澳大利亚部分政府网站或在线服务曾为安装补丁而下线。
updates.detailed_summary_en: The PHP Foundation admitted a "structural failure" after emergency patches were rushed out for critical, unauthenticated remote-code-execution vulnerabilities first reported in 2024, with government websites in the Netherlands, Finland, France, Germany and Australia temporarily taken offline to apply fixes.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The PHP Foundation admitted a "structural failure" after emergency patches were rushed out for critical, unauthenticated remote-code-execution vulnerabilities first reported in 2024, with government websites in the Netherlands, Finland, France, Germany and Australia temporarily taken offline to apply fixes.

updates.title_zh: PHP Foundation承认结构性失误，关键安全漏洞修复延误
updates.what_changed_en: The PHP Foundation publicly admitted a "structural failure," saying decision hesitation and insufficient resources caused repair work on the critical flaws first reported in 2024 to stall and restart repeatedly; government websites or online services in Germany and Australia were also temporarily taken offline to prepare patches.
updates.what_changed_zh: PHP 基金会公开承认，因决策迟疑和资源不足，针对 2024 年首次发现的关键漏洞的修复多次停滞并重启，并将延误定性为“结构性失误”；同时，德国和澳大利亚的部分政府网站或在线服务也因准备安装补丁而一度下线。

updates.current_state_en: After the PHP Foundation released emergency patches for two critical vulnerabilities, Japan became the latest affected country: some Japanese government ministry websites temporarily stopped publishing content as a precaution, and financial institutions, companies, and local governments were affected with no damage reported so far.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Japan's government temporarily stopped publishing content on some ministry websites and urged organizations to patch a severe PHP vulnerability that has affected financial institutions, companies, and local governments, with no damage reported so far.

updates.what_changed_en: Japan's Chief Cabinet Secretary Minoru Kihara said the severe PHP vulnerability has affected financial institutions, companies, local governments, and government agencies in Japan, with no damage reported so far; the health and finance ministries temporarily stopped publishing some website content as a precaution and urged organizations to install patches.
updates.what_changed_zh: 日本内阁官房长官木原稔表示，受PHP严重漏洞影响，日本金融机构、企业、地方政府及政府机关等均受影响，但截至目前未收到损害报告；厚生劳动省、财务省等政府部门已出于预防目的暂时停止公开部分网站内容，并建议相关机构安装修复补丁。

updates.current_state_en: The PHP Foundation has released emergency patches for two critical vulnerabilities, some government websites in Japan and Europe have paused or taken content offline as a precaution, and Cloudflare reports exploitation attempts surged to millions after disclosure.
updates.current_state_zh: PHP 基金会已为两个严重漏洞发布紧急补丁，日本及欧洲等地部分政府网站出于预防暂停或下线内容；Cloudflare 进一步报告漏洞披露后利用尝试激增至数百万次。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Cloudflare reported millions of exploitation attempts against a severe PHP vulnerability shortly after disclosure, with government websites in Europe and elsewhere going offline as operators rushed to secure systems.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Cloudflare reported millions of exploitation attempts against a severe PHP vulnerability shortly after disclosure, with government websites in Europe and elsewhere going offline as operators rushed to secure systems.
updates.title_en: PHP严重漏洞曝光后攻击激增，Cloudflare监测到数百万次尝试
updates.title_zh: PHP严重漏洞曝光后攻击激增，Cloudflare监测到数百万次尝试
updates.what_changed_en: Cloudflare CEO Matthew Prince said the company monitored millions of exploitation attempts after the severe PHP vulnerability was publicly disclosed: thousands in the 10 hours before disclosure, tens of thousands within 45 minutes after, hundreds of thousands within two hours, and millions now.
updates.what_changed_zh: Cloudflare 首席执行官马修·普林斯表示，在 PHP 严重漏洞公开披露后，Cloudflare 监测到数百万次利用尝试；披露前 10 小时为数千次，披露后 45 分钟内升至数万次，两小时内达数十万次，目前已达数百万次。

updates.current_state_en: The PHP Foundation has released emergency patches; some government websites in Japan, Europe, and Australia paused or took content offline as a precaution; Cloudflare reports millions of exploitation attempts after disclosure; China's MIIT NVDB has now issued a risk advisory specifying affected version ranges.

updates.detailed_summary_en: China's MIIT NVDB warned that PHP versions 8.5 through 8.1 and earlier contain two critical remote code execution vulnerabilities allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code, potentially leading to server takeover, sensitive data leaks, and service disruption.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: China's MIIT NVDB warned that PHP versions 8.5 through 8.1 and earlier contain two critical remote code execution vulnerabilities allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code, potentially leading to server takeover, sensitive data leaks, and service disruption.

updates.what_changed_en: China's MIIT National Vulnerability Database (NVDB) issued a risk advisory for the same two critical PHP remote code execution vulnerabilities, listing affected version ranges: 8.5 < 8.5.12, 8.4 < 8.4.27, 8.3 < 8.3.36, 8.2 < 8.2.35, and 8.1 and earlier.
updates.what_changed_zh: 中国工业和信息化部网络安全威胁和漏洞信息共享平台（NVDB）针对同一组 PHP 远程代码执行超危漏洞发布风险提示，并列出受影响版本范围：8.5 系列＜8.5.12、8.4 系列＜8.4.27、8.3 系列＜8.3.36、8.2 系列＜8.2.35、8.1 系列及更早版本。

updates.current_state_en: The PHP Foundation has released emergency patches; Cloudflare reported millions of exploit attempts against the two critical PHP vulnerabilities, including thousands before public disclosure; Amazon further reported that its MadPot honeypot observed exploitation attempts about four days before public disclosure, though it remains unclear how exploit information leaked during the embargo and no real-system compromise has been confirmed.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Amazon reports its MadPot honeypot detected exploitation attempts against the critical PHP2Shell PHP vulnerability (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, unauthenticated RCE affecting PHP 7.x and 8.x) about four days before details were publicly disclosed, with the flaw now widely exploited in the wild and AI-assisted analysis shortening the window from patch to working exploit.

updates.what_changed_en: Amazon threat intelligence said its MadPot honeypot observed exploitation attempts against PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) on October 17, about four days before public disclosure; attempts came from IPs associated with commercial anonymized networks, it is unclear how attackers obtained exploit information during the embargo, and no real-system compromise was confirmed; Amazon's CISO said AI-assisted analysis is shortening the patch-to-working-exploit window.
updates.what_changed_zh: 亚马逊威胁情报称，其 MadPot 蜜罐于 10 月 17 日观测到针对 PHP2Shell（CVE-2026-109618 与 CVE-2026-109619）的利用尝试，比公开披露早约四天；尝试来自与商业匿名网络相关的 IP，尚不清楚攻击者如何在禁运期内获得利用信息，也未证实真实系统已被攻破；亚马逊 CISO 称 AI 辅助分析正在缩短从补丁到可用利用的窗口。

events.current_state_en: India's eMudhra CA had all 8 of its private keys cracked in under a second because they were weak non-random integers, prompting Chrome, Mozilla, Apple and Microsoft to block the certificates and eMudhra to revoke them, with potential knock-on risk for trading bots, exchange API connections and wallet backends that skip revocation checks.

events.current_state_en: The US OCC, having finalized its rules implementing the GENIUS Act, publicly encouraged community banks to apply to become permitted payment stablecoin issuers ahead of the law's January enforcement date.
events.current_state_zh: 美国货币监理署（OCC）在最终敲定实施《GENIUS法案》的规则后，公开鼓励社区银行在该法1月执行日期之前申请成为获准的支付稳定币发行方。
events.title_en: US OCC issues and advances GENIUS Act stablecoin regulatory framework
events.title_zh: 美国OCC发布并推进GENIUS法案稳定币监管框架

updates.background_en: The GENIUS Act is the federal statute establishing a framework for payment stablecoins, and the OCC is the primary banking regulator tasked with implementing it for issuers under its oversight. The rule applies to national banks, federal savings associations, federal branches and their subsidiaries, nonbank firms that seek or receive federal qualified issuer status, foreign payment stablecoin issuers, and state-qualified issuers where the OCC has regulatory or enforcement authority. Comptroller of the Currency Jonathan Gould described the framework as providing "strong standards for reserve backing, redemption, and risk management." Anti-money-laundering, Bank Secrecy Act and sanctions requirements are being handled in a separate rulemaking with Treasury.
updates.background_zh: 《GENIUS 法案》是确立支付型稳定币监管框架的联邦立法，OCC 是负责为其监管下的发行方落实该法案的主要银行监管机构。该规则适用于国民银行、联邦储蓄协会、联邦分行及其子公司、申请或获得联邦合格发行方资格的非银行机构、外国支付型稳定币发行方，以及在 OCC 拥有监管或执法权的情况下的州级合格发行方。货币监理署署长乔纳森·古尔德称该框架提供了"储备支持、赎回和风险管理方面的严格标准"。反洗钱、银行保密法及制裁相关要求则由 OCC 与财政部通过另一项规则制定程序处理。
updates.current_state_en: The U.S. OCC issued its final rule implementing the GENIUS Act — the first such final rule from a federal banking regulator — establishing the framework for regulated and foreign firms to issue and custody stablecoins from January 18, 2027, while refusing to presume existing stablecoin rewards programs are compliant or to offer them a safe harbor, applying a case-by-case reading of the ban on rewards paid 'solely' for holding or using a stablecoin, and replacing proposed rebuttable presumptions and prescriptive reserve diversification limits with principles-based supervision.
updates.current_state_zh: 美国 OCC 发布了实施 GENIUS 法案的最终规则——这是联邦银行监管机构的首个此类最终规则——为受监管机构和外国公司自 2027 年 1 月 18 日起发行和托管稳定币建立框架，同时拒绝推定现有稳定币奖励计划合规，也不为其提供安全港，对禁止“仅”因持有或使用稳定币而支付奖励的规定采取逐案解读，并以基于原则的监管取代拟议的可反驳推定和规定性储备多元化限制。
updates.detailed_summary_en: The U.S. OCC issued its final rule implementing the GENIUS Act — the first such final rule from a federal banking regulator — establishing the framework for regulated and foreign firms to issue and custody stablecoins from January 18, 2027, while refusing to presume existing stablecoin rewards programs are compliant or to offer them a safe harbor, applying a case-by-case reading of the ban on rewards paid 'solely' for holding or using a stablecoin, and replacing proposed rebuttable presumptions and prescriptive reserve diversification limits with principles-based supervision.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The U.S. OCC issued its final rule implementing the GENIUS Act — the first such final rule from a federal banking regulator — establishing the framework for regulated and foreign firms to issue and custody stablecoins from January 18, 2027, while refusing to presume existing stablecoin rewards programs are compliant or to offer them a safe harbor, applying a case-by-case reading of the ban on rewards paid 'solely' for holding or using a stablecoin, and replacing proposed rebuttable presumptions and prescriptive reserve diversification limits with principles-based supervision.
updates.market_impact_en: The rule transmits to crypto markets through the revenue models of stablecoin issuers and the exchanges that distribute their tokens: without a safe harbor, rewards programs tied to holding stablecoins face case-by-case regulatory review, creating product-structure uncertainty for issuers and platforms that market such incentives. Reserve, redemption and custody standards also set compliance costs for entities seeking OCC-supervised issuer status.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该规则通过稳定币发行方及分销其代币的交易所的收入模式传导至加密市场：在没有安全港的情况下，与持有稳定币挂钩的奖励计划需逐案接受监管审查，给发行方和推广此类激励的平台带来产品结构上的不确定性。储备、赎回与托管标准也为寻求 OCC 监管下发行方资格的机构设定了合规成本。

updates.current_state_en: The OCC has issued its final rule implementing the GENIUS Act, setting reserve, redemption, risk-management, custody and capital requirements for payment stablecoin issuers under its jurisdiction when the law takes effect on January 18, 2027; AML and sanctions rules are deferred to a joint rulemaking with Treasury, and the timing for accepting applications and waivers will be announced separately.

updates.detailed_summary_en: The OCC issued its final rule implementing the GENIUS Act, establishing reserve, redemption, risk-management, custody and capital requirements for payment stablecoin issuers under its jurisdiction before the law takes effect on January 18, 2027, while deferring AML and sanctions standards to a joint rulemaking with Treasury.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The OCC issued its final rule implementing the GENIUS Act, establishing reserve, redemption, risk-management, custody and capital requirements for payment stablecoin issuers under its jurisdiction before the law takes effect on January 18, 2027, while deferring AML and sanctions standards to a joint rulemaking with Treasury.
updates.title_en: OCC Finalizes GENIUS Act Stablecoin Rules Ahead of January Deadline

updates.what_changed_en: The final rule further clarifies that Bank Secrecy Act, AML and sanctions requirements are excluded and will be handled in a separate joint rulemaking with Treasury; the OCC will separately announce when it begins accepting issuer applications and waiver requests, and the rule covers reserves, redemption, risk management, custody, capital and state-qualified issuer transitions.
updates.what_changed_zh: 最终规则进一步明确：将《银行保密法》、反洗钱与制裁要求排除在外，留待与财政部联合制定规则；OCC 将另行宣布何时开始接受稳定币发行商申请和豁免请求，并明确规则覆盖储备、赎回、风险管理、托管、资本及州合格发行商过渡等。

events.current_state_en: Polkadot Community Foundation warned that Fearless Wallet's browser extension (versions 3.0.1–3.0.5) contains malicious code that sends users' private keys to attacker-controlled servers, urging all users since February 2025 to generate new keys and move assets immediately, with 17,286 DOT already reported stolen across eight users.
events.current_state_zh:
Polkadot 社区基金会在 Polkadot 论坛发布安全警告称，第三方钱包 Fearless Wallet 浏览器插件的 3.0.1、3.0.3、3.0.4 及 3.0.5 版本含有恶意代码，用户解锁钱包时私钥会被发送至攻击者控制的服务器。该代码于 2025 年 2 月 19 日随一项名为「TON ecosystem」的大型代码变更加入插件公开源码，在 2025 年 2 月至 2026 年 10 月 10 日期间不定时生效，且随时可能被重新启用。

基金会建议，自 2025 年 2 月起使用过该插件的用户应将其中所有账户视为已泄露，立即在其他钱包中生成新密钥对并转移资产，并强调仅更换密码或重装插件无效。目前已有 8 名用户报告了可归因于此事件的未授权交易，共计 17,286 枚 DOT。

Chrome 版本已确认受影响，已下架的 Firefox 版本使用了相同代码；Android 和 iOS 移动端未发现该代码，但若同一私钥曾导入过浏览器插件，同样应视为已泄露。资产处于质押、提名池或治理投票锁定中的用户，可先借助 polkadot-api 团队开发的 PAPI Rescue 工具协助找回。
events.title_en: 【Polkadot 社区基金会：Fearless Wallet 浏览器插件含泄露私钥代码，用户需立即转移资产】
events.title_zh: 【Polkadot 社区基金会：Fearless Wallet 浏览器插件含泄露私钥代码，用户需立即转移资产】

updates.background_en: Fearless Wallet is a Polkadot- and Kusama-focused wallet offered as both a browser extension and a mobile app; the Foundation stressed that it is developed and maintained by an independent team and is not an official Polkadot wallet. PAPI Rescue describes itself as a technical recovery service for compromised wallets on Polkadot-based chains, adapting its product to each eligible case. On Polkadot, staked DOT is bonded and locked, which complicates moving funds out of a compromised account.
updates.background_zh: Fearless Wallet 是面向 Polkadot 与 Kusama 生态的钱包，同时提供浏览器插件和移动端应用；基金会强调该钱包由独立团队开发维护，并非 Polkadot 官方钱包。PAPI Rescue 自称为面向 Polkadot 生态链上受损钱包的技术恢复服务，会针对每个符合条件的案例调整方案。在 Polkadot 上，用于质押的 DOT 处于绑定锁定状态，这会使从已泄露账户中转出资产的流程更加复杂。
updates.current_state_en: Polkadot Community Foundation warned that Fearless Wallet's browser extension (versions 3.0.1–3.0.5) contains malicious code that sends users' private keys to attacker-controlled servers, urging all users since February 2025 to generate new keys and move assets immediately, with 17,286 DOT already reported stolen across eight users.
updates.current_state_zh:
Polkadot 社区基金会在 Polkadot 论坛发布安全警告称，第三方钱包 Fearless Wallet 浏览器插件的 3.0.1、3.0.3、3.0.4 及 3.0.5 版本含有恶意代码，用户解锁钱包时私钥会被发送至攻击者控制的服务器。该代码于 2025 年 2 月 19 日随一项名为「TON ecosystem」的大型代码变更加入插件公开源码，在 2025 年 2 月至 2026 年 10 月 10 日期间不定时生效，且随时可能被重新启用。

基金会建议，自 2025 年 2 月起使用过该插件的用户应将其中所有账户视为已泄露，立即在其他钱包中生成新密钥对并转移资产，并强调仅更换密码或重装插件无效。目前已有 8 名用户报告了可归因于此事件的未授权交易，共计 17,286 枚 DOT。

Chrome 版本已确认受影响，已下架的 Firefox 版本使用了相同代码；Android 和 iOS 移动端未发现该代码，但若同一私钥曾导入过浏览器插件，同样应视为已泄露。资产处于质押、提名池或治理投票锁定中的用户，可先借助 polkadot-api 团队开发的 PAPI Rescue 工具协助找回。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Polkadot Community Foundation warned that Fearless Wallet's browser extension (versions 3.0.1–3.0.5) contains malicious code that sends users' private keys to attacker-controlled servers, urging all users since February 2025 to generate new keys and move assets immediately, with 17,286 DOT already reported stolen across eight users.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Polkadot Community Foundation warned that Fearless Wallet's browser extension (versions 3.0.1–3.0.5) contains malicious code that sends users' private keys to attacker-controlled servers, urging all users since February 2025 to generate new keys and move assets immediately, with 17,286 DOT already reported stolen across eight users.
updates.market_impact_en: The exposure runs through the self-custody and wallet supply-chain channel on Polkadot: DOT holders who used the extension face key compromise, and the reported 17,286 DOT in losses is small relative to network scale, so the immediate market transmission is limited to affected users' forced migrations toward other Polkadot wallets rather than broad liquidity pressure.
updates.market_impact_zh: 风险传导主要经由 Polkadot 生态的自托管与钱包供应链渠道：使用过该插件的 DOT 持有者面临私钥泄露风险，而已报告的 17,286 枚 DOT 损失相对网络规模较小，因此短期市场传导更多体现为受影响用户被迫迁移至其他 Polkadot 钱包，而非广泛的流动性压力。

events.current_state_en: eMudhra's CA keys were found to be crackable in milliseconds due to weak key material, raising serious certificate-authority trust and remediation concerns.
events.current_state_zh:
eMudhra 八个中间 CA 证书对应的私钥被发现是小于 256 的整数，实际上只有约八比特的熵，全部八把密钥在约 11 毫秒内即被还原。该发现于 10 月 20 日在 emudhra.we-have-a-problem.com 上公开，主流浏览器与软件平台已开始封禁这些受影响的证书。

由于这些弱密钥自证书签发之日起实际上就等于公开，任何人都可以伪造能链接到受信任根证书的证书；而无法更新 CA 证书包的设备将持续处于暴露状态。

据最初报告者称，该发现来自谷歌开源工具 paranoid_crypto，在检查用户证书之前，直接以默认配置对 CCADB 证书库跑了一遍。据称随后对所有现有 CCADB 证书的更全面排查未再发现其他命中项，Chrome 也在证书透明度（CT）日志中未发现恶意签发的证书。
events.title_en: Eight Bits of Trust; eMudhra's CA keys cracked in milliseconds
events.title_zh: 八比特的信任：eMudhra 的 CA 密钥在毫秒内被破解

updates.background_en: eMudhra is an Indian certificate authority founded in 2008; per Wikipedia it has issued more than 60 million digital certificates. Normally a CA key compromise involves theft, with a clear moment of loss and a question of who holds the key. Here nothing was stolen — the key material was so weak it could simply be computed. Fixing the updatable devices is largely a matter of refreshing CA bundles (OS ca-certificates, certifi, Node, Homebrew, container base images), while long-lived embedded devices are the hard part.
updates.background_zh: eMudhra 是一家成立于 2008 年的印度证书颁发机构，据维基百科其已签发超过 6000 万张数字证书。通常 CA 密钥失陷意味着被盗，有明确的失窃时点，也能追问密钥现在在谁手里；而这次没有任何东西被偷——密钥材料本身太弱，直接算出来即可。对可更新的设备而言，修复主要是刷新 CA 证书包（操作系统 ca-certificates、certifi、Node、Homebrew、容器基础镜像），而长期在线且难以更新的嵌入式设备才是难点。
updates.community_discussion_en: Hacker News commenters focused on the sheer number of trusted CAs — one remark that "having 100 trusted certificate authorities might have been excessive" — and on the unpatched-device problem, since the advice reduces to "update them" for hardware that often cannot be updated. One commenter floated the idea of using the broken keys to mint certificates for jailbreaking locked-down IoT devices, while another linked a prior, heavily discussed HN thread on the eMudhra intermediate CA compromise.
updates.community_discussion_zh: Hacker News 的评论者主要关注两点：一是受信任 CA 的数量之多，有人直言“有 100 个受信任的证书颁发机构，回头看可能确实过头了”；二是无法打补丁的设备问题，因为建议本质上就是“去更新”，而很多硬件根本更新不了。有评论者提出，能否用这些坏掉的密钥签发证书来越狱被锁定的物联网设备；也有人贴出了此前讨论热烈的 HN 帖，主题正是 eMudhra 中间 CA 失陷。
updates.current_state_en: eMudhra's CA keys were found to be crackable in milliseconds due to weak key material, raising serious certificate-authority trust and remediation concerns.

updates.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through web PKI trust rather than on-chain assets: forged certificates could support phishing or interception against crypto exchange front-ends, wallet download pages and firmware update channels that rely on public TLS. Hardware and IoT wallets whose trust stores cannot be refreshed carry the longest-lived exposure, though no market segment is directly impaired by the key weakness itself.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在 Web PKI 信任层面，而非链上资产：伪造证书可能被用于对加密货币交易所前端、钱包下载页面以及依赖公共 TLS 的固件更新通道实施钓鱼或劫持。信任库无法刷新的硬件钱包与物联网钱包面临的暴露期最长，但就密钥弱点本身而言，尚无某个市场板块受到直接损害。

events.current_state_en: Kalshi Prime struck a tri-party collateral arrangement with BitGo Bank & Trust letting institutional clients borrow against custodied BTC, ETH and GENIUS Act-compliant stablecoins to margin futures positions on Kalshi, with loans issued by Kalshi Katalyst and more custodians to follow.
events.current_state_zh:
Kalshi 与加密资产托管机构 BitGo 达成协议，将允许其在美国注册的期货佣金商 Kalshi Prime 的客户以托管的数字资产作为抵押借款，并把贷款资金用作 Kalshi 交易所杠杆永续期货交易的保证金。据彭博社报道，该安排采用三方抵押品管理结构，贷款由 Kalshi 关联借贷公司 Kalshi Katalyst 提供，抵押资产存放于 BitGo Bank & Trust。

Kalshi Prime 首席执行官 Jeff Bandman 表示，该安排旨在让客户无需退出加密资产持仓即可参与交易，并可能吸引加密原生交易机构及持有大量数字资产的巨鲸。

合格抵押资产包括比特币、以太坊，以及被视为符合《GENIUS 法案》的稳定币，预计后续还将接入其他托管机构。Kalshi 今年早些时候已推出黄金、白银及加密货币永续合约，并已申请推出与石油和美股挂钩的永续类产品。
events.title_en: Kalshi将支持加密资产抵押借款用于永续期货保证金
events.title_zh: Kalshi 与 BitGo 达成三方抵押安排，允许机构客户以加密资产抵押借款作为期货保证金

updates.background_en: Kalshi Prime is a US futures commission merchant regulated by the Commodity Futures Trading Commission that provides execution, clearing and prime brokerage services for derivatives and event-based financial products; Kalshi launched it in June and appointed former CFTC Division of Clearing and Risk head Jeff Bandman as CEO on 12 August. The GENIUS Act is the US federal stablecoin statute governing permitted payment stablecoin issuance, and regulators including the OCC and Treasury have been issuing implementing rules.
updates.background_zh: Kalshi Prime 是美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）监管的期货佣金商，为衍生品和事件类金融产品提供执行、清算和主经纪商服务；Kalshi 于今年 6 月推出该实体，并于 8 月 12 日任命 CFTC 清算与风险部前负责人 Jeff Bandman 为首席执行官。《GENIUS 法案》是美国联邦层面的稳定币立法，规定了合规支付稳定币的发行要求，OCC 与财政部等监管机构正在陆续出台实施细则。
updates.current_state_en: Kalshi has partnered with BitGo to let Kalshi Prime clients borrow against custody-held bitcoin, ether, and GENIUS-compliant stablecoins and use the loan proceeds as margin for leveraged perpetual futures trading.
updates.current_state_zh:
Kalshi 与加密资产托管机构 BitGo 达成协议，将允许其在美国注册的期货佣金商 Kalshi Prime 的客户以托管的数字资产作为抵押借款，并把贷款资金用作 Kalshi 交易所杠杆永续期货交易的保证金。据彭博社报道，该安排采用三方抵押品管理结构，贷款由 Kalshi 关联借贷公司 Kalshi Katalyst 提供，抵押资产存放于 BitGo Bank & Trust。

Kalshi Prime 首席执行官 Jeff Bandman 表示，该安排旨在让客户无需退出加密资产持仓即可参与交易，并可能吸引加密原生交易机构及持有大量数字资产的巨鲸。

合格抵押资产包括比特币、以太坊，以及被视为符合《GENIUS 法案》的稳定币，预计后续还将接入其他托管机构。Kalshi 今年早些时候已推出黄金、白银及加密货币永续合约，并已申请推出与石油和美股挂钩的永续类产品。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Kalshi has partnered with BitGo to let Kalshi Prime clients borrow against custody-held bitcoin, ether, and GENIUS-compliant stablecoins and use the loan proceeds as margin for leveraged perpetual futures trading.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Kalshi has partnered with BitGo to let Kalshi Prime clients borrow against custody-held bitcoin, ether, and GENIUS-compliant stablecoins and use the loan proceeds as margin for leveraged perpetual futures trading.
updates.market_impact_en: The channel is leverage and collateral mobility: crypto held at BitGo can now back margin on a CFTC-regulated venue without being sold, which may reduce the need for institutional holders to liquidate spot positions to fund derivatives exposure. The explicit inclusion of GENIUS-compliant stablecoins ties the margin base to the regulated stablecoin perimeter, though the facility is limited to Kalshi Prime clients and is not systemic in scale.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道是杠杆与抵押品流动性：存放于 BitGo 的加密资产如今无需卖出即可为 CFTC 监管场所的保证金提供支持，这可能降低机构持有者为衍生品敞口而清算现货的需求。明确纳入符合《GENIUS 法案》的稳定币，则把保证金基础与受监管稳定币范畴绑定；不过该安排仅面向 Kalshi Prime 客户，规模上尚不具系统性。

updates.what_changed_en: Kalshi has partnered with BitGo to let Kalshi Prime clients borrow against custody-held bitcoin, ether, and GENIUS-compliant stablecoins and use the loan proceeds as margin for leveraged perpetual futures trading.
updates.what_changed_zh:
Kalshi 与加密资产托管机构 BitGo 达成协议，将允许其在美国注册的期货佣金商 Kalshi Prime 的客户以托管的数字资产作为抵押借款，并把贷款资金用作 Kalshi 交易所杠杆永续期货交易的保证金。据彭博社报道，该安排采用三方抵押品管理结构，贷款由 Kalshi 关联借贷公司 Kalshi Katalyst 提供，抵押资产存放于 BitGo Bank & Trust。

Kalshi Prime 首席执行官 Jeff Bandman 表示，该安排旨在让客户无需退出加密资产持仓即可参与交易，并可能吸引加密原生交易机构及持有大量数字资产的巨鲸。

合格抵押资产包括比特币、以太坊，以及被视为符合《GENIUS 法案》的稳定币，预计后续还将接入其他托管机构。Kalshi 今年早些时候已推出黄金、白银及加密货币永续合约，并已申请推出与石油和美股挂钩的永续类产品。
