updates.what_changed_zh: Node.js 发布安全更新，升级至 26.12.1、24.22.1 和 22.23.4 版本，修复 10 个漏洞，其中包括四个高危漏洞，如可远程利用的 Brotli 解码器越界写入和 TLS 证书主机名验证绕过。

updates.background_en: Brotli is a lossless compression algorithm developed by Jyrki Alakuijala and Zoltán Szabadka, combining LZ77, Huffman coding and second-order context modeling, and it is commonly offered as an HTTP content-encoding. CVE-2026-111497 was previously reported as a Brotli decoder flaw in Node.js, and researchers demonstrated a proof of concept on the official Node.js 24.22.0 Linux arm64 image by feeding crafted data to the bundled Brotli decoder.
updates.background_zh: Brotli 是由 Jyrki Alakuijala 与 Zoltán Szabadka 开发的无损压缩算法，结合了 LZ77、霍夫曼编码与二阶上下文建模，常被用作 HTTP 内容编码。CVE-2026-111497 此前被报道为 Node.js 中 Brotli 解码器的缺陷，研究人员曾向官方 Node.js 24.22.0 的 Linux arm64 镜像内置的 Brotli 解码器投喂构造数据，成功演示了概念验证利用。
updates.community_discussion_en: Commenters pushed back hard on the "HTTP2Shell" name, calling it broad and undescriptive and preferring "Broccoli2Shell" for the same vulnerability, noting it can be triggered through manual Brotli decoding without HTTP at all. Others questioned the severity framing: one commenter said the surprising part is how many implementations support Brotli-compressed request bodies, while another complained the coverage is sensationalized and does not make clear how many projects are affected in common configurations versus other, less critical uses of Brotli.
updates.community_discussion_zh: 评论者对“HTTP2Shell”这一命名提出强烈质疑，认为它过于宽泛、未能描述实际问题，更偏好用“Broccoli2Shell”指代同一漏洞，并指出即使不经过 HTTP、只要手工做 Brotli 解码也可能触发。也有人质疑严重性叙事：一位评论者称，真正令人意外的是竟有这么多实现支持 Brotli 压缩的请求体；另一位则抱怨报道过度渲染，且没有说清有多少项目是在常见配置下受影响，而不是 Brotli 的其他（虽有问题但远没那么严重）用法。
updates.current_state_en: The Node2Shell vulnerability has evolved into HTTP2Shell, tracked as Brotli CVE-2026-111497, an unauthenticated remote code execution issue in Brotli decoding that affects many Python HTTP libraries and applications and is now driving patching and deployment checks.
updates.current_state_zh:
编号为 CVE-2026-111497 的 Brotli 解码器漏洞此前以“Node2Shell”之名传播，如今又以“HTTP2Shell”的名义流传；相关报道称这是一个无需认证即可远程执行代码的漏洞，影响范围覆盖大量 HTTP 库与应用，而不只是 Node.js。Aikido 的文章称，其检测能力可以在代码仓库和容器镜像中标记出受影响的 Node.js 版本。

该漏洞位于 Brotli 解码环节，而这一压缩路径在 HTTP 处理中被广泛使用，因此受影响面并不局限于单一运行时；Vercel 表示其 WAF 已部署规则，用于检测并阻断针对该漏洞的利用尝试。

讨论中有评论者指出，Ubuntu 仍将 libbrotli1 的补丁标注为“审核中”、严重级别为中等，这拖慢了 libcurl 乃至 git 等一系列软件包的更新。也有评论者质疑：据称 2 月就已发布的修复，当时为何未被当作安全问题处理。
updates.detailed_summary_en: The Node2Shell vulnerability has evolved into HTTP2Shell, tracked as Brotli CVE-2026-111497, an unauthenticated remote code execution issue in Brotli decoding that affects many Python HTTP libraries and applications and is now driving patching and deployment checks.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The Node2Shell vulnerability has evolved into HTTP2Shell, tracked as Brotli CVE-2026-111497, an unauthenticated remote code execution issue in Brotli decoding that affects many Python HTTP libraries and applications and is now driving patching and deployment checks.
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission path is operational rather than price-driven: crypto services, node operators and self-hosted RPC or API infrastructure commonly run Node.js and other HTTP stacks built on libbrotli/libcurl, and a distro patch still under review leaves that dependency chain unpatched until maintainers ship updates. Exposure depends on whether internet-facing services enable Brotli-compressed request handling and on how quickly operators apply upstream fixes.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导路径更多体现为运营风险而非价格驱动：加密服务、节点运营方以及自托管的 RPC 或 API 基础设施普遍运行 Node.js 以及基于 libbrotli/libcurl 的其他 HTTP 栈，而发行版补丁仍在审核中，意味着在维护者发布更新前这条依赖链仍处于未修补状态。实际暴露程度取决于面向公网的服务是否启用了对 Brotli 压缩请求体的处理，以及运营方采用上游修复的速度。

updates.background_en: LiteLLM is an open-source AI gateway (LLM proxy) that puts an AI stack behind one OpenAI-compatible API, routing requests to models such as OpenAI and Anthropic and centrally managing API keys, with self-hosting including air-gapped deployments. This is the second supply chain attack on the project this year, after an earlier incident in March.
updates.background_zh: LiteLLM 是一款开源 AI 网关（LLM 代理），用一套兼容 OpenAI 的 API 统一接入 AI 技术栈，把请求路由到 OpenAI、Anthropic 等模型，并集中管理 API 密钥，支持包括完全离线在内的自托管部署。这是该项目今年第二次遭遇供应链攻击，今年 3 月就曾因另一场供应链攻击遭到投毒。
updates.community_discussion_en: Hacker News commenters focused on the systemic nature of the problem rather than the single package: one suggested using canarytokens to detect credential theft, another complained that permission pop-up fatigue and routine package installation have desensitized developers to risk, and a third questioned how a project with 55,000 commits in three years could be hit this way. One commenter, citing reports that three unique developer GitHub credentials were compromised, called the pattern systemic and said they would pin LiteLLM to a version before this one until further notice.
updates.community_discussion_zh: Hacker News 的讨论更多聚焦于问题的系统性而非单一软件包：有人建议使用 canarytokens 来检测凭证是否被盗；有人抱怨权限弹窗疲劳和日常化的软件包安装让开发者对风险变得麻木；还有人质疑一个三年内拥有 5.5 万次提交的项目为何会以这种方式被攻破。一位评论者援引“三名开发者的 GitHub 凭证被窃取”的说法，认为这是系统性问题，并表示会把 LiteLLM 固定在更早的版本直到有进一步消息。
updates.current_state_en: Malicious LiteLLM 1.107.0 PyPI packages and affected Docker images have been removed; JFrog advises affected users to rotate credentials and rebuild environments, with 1.106.2 confirmed as the safe rollback, while how the malicious code entered the release process remains unclear.
updates.current_state_zh: LiteLLM 1.107.0 的恶意 PyPI 包和受影响 Docker 镜像已被下架；JFrog 建议受影响用户轮换凭证并重建环境，已确认安全回退版本为 1.106.2，但恶意代码如何混入发布流程仍未查清。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Security firm JFrog discovered that LiteLLM version 1.107.0 and its official Docker images were compromised in a supply chain attack that installs credential-stealing malware and a persistent backdoor, affecting all PyPI platform packages and prompting advice to rotate credentials and rebuild environments.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Security firm JFrog discovered that LiteLLM version 1.107.0 and its official Docker images were compromised in a supply chain attack that installs credential-stealing malware and a persistent backdoor, affecting all PyPI platform packages and prompting advice to rotate credentials and rebuild environments.
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission channel is credential exposure: self-hosted LiteLLM instances commonly hold model API keys, cloud credentials and SSH keys in their databases and host environments, so crypto and AI-agent teams running such gateways may have had deployment infrastructure credentials exposed, requiring key rotation and environment rebuilds regardless of whether they invoked the library.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道是凭证暴露：自托管的 LiteLLM 实例通常在其数据库和主机环境中保存模型 API 密钥、云平台凭证和 SSH 私钥，因此运行此类网关的加密与 AI 智能体团队可能面临部署基础设施凭证外泄的风险，无论是否调用过该库，都需要轮换密钥并重建环境。

updates.what_changed_zh: JFrog 披露该供应链攻击还影响官方 Docker 镜像，PyPI 全部七个平台安装包均被植入木马；PyPI 已移除恶意版本，Docker Hub 已撤下受影响镜像；攻击者使用的发布源码指向名称仅差一个连字符的仿冒仓库；建议将凭证视为可能泄露、隔离并重建环境、轮换密钥，回退到 1.106.2。

updates.current_state_en: SlowMist reported that LiteLLM suffered another supply chain attack: malicious version 1.107.0 on PyPI and its Docker images auto-executes on Python startup to steal cloud credentials, AI API keys and SSH private keys and enables remote code execution, with users advised to avoid 1.107.0, rebuild from clean images, rotate credentials and pin 1.106.2.
updates.current_state_zh: SlowMist 报告称，LiteLLM 再次遭遇供应链攻击：PyPI 上的恶意版本 1.107.0 及其 Docker 镜像会在 Python 启动时自动执行，窃取云凭证、AI API 密钥和 SSH 私钥，并实现远程代码执行；建议用户避免使用 1.107.0，从干净镜像重建，轮换凭证并锁定 1.106.2。

events.current_state_en: Alpine Linux disclosed an attempted exploitation of CVE-2026-97229, an integer-overflow remote code execution flaw in Ruby's regular expression engine that GitLab only patches in its own packages, leaving source-built images on version 19.3.6 vulnerable until the image was rebuilt with Ruby 3.3.13 on October 27.
events.current_state_zh: Alpine Linux披露有人试图利用CVE-2026-97229，这是Ruby正则表达式引擎中的整数溢出远程代码执行漏洞，GitLab仅在其自有软件包中修复，导致源码构建的镜像在10月27日以Ruby 3.3.13重建前一直停留在19.3.6版本并存在漏洞。

events.current_state_en: Anthropic launched Claude Duet in research preview, a proactive agentic assistant built on Claude Opus 5.5 that runs in a cloud VM with its own browser, delivers daily briefings, executes multi-step business tasks across 6,000+ connectors, and requires explicit user approval for sensitive actions while prohibiting others such as securities trading and account transfers.
events.current_state_zh: Anthropic 推出研究预览版 Claude Duet，这是一款基于 Claude Opus 5.5 构建的主动式智能体助手，运行在自带浏览器的云虚拟机中，可提供每日简报、通过 6000 多个连接器执行多步骤业务任务，敏感操作需用户明确批准，同时禁止证券交易和账户转账等操作。
events.title_en: Anthropic launches Claude Duet AI assistant
events.title_zh: Anthropic发布Claude Duet AI助手

updates.background_en: Claude Duet enters a crowded agent market: Meta introduced Muse as a personal AI agent running on a dedicated "Muse Secure VM," and OpenAI launched Dots as always-on agents at its DevDay 2026 keynote on September 29, 2026. Anthropic's previous Claude offerings were primarily accessed through chat interfaces rather than a proactive, standalone agent app.
updates.background_zh: Claude Duet进入的是一个已相当拥挤的智能体市场：Meta推出Muse，将其定位为运行在专用“Muse Secure VM”上的个人AI智能体；OpenAI则在2026年9月29日的DevDay 2026主题演讲上发布了“始终在线”的Dots智能体。此前Anthropic的Claude产品主要通过对话界面使用，而非主动式的独立智能体应用。
updates.current_state_en: Anthropic introduced Claude Duet, a new AI personal-assistant product powered by Opus 5.5, prompting Hacker News discussion of its capabilities, use cases, and inference-cost advantages.
updates.current_state_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Duet，这是一款由 Opus 5.5 驱动的新 AI 个人助手产品，引发 Hacker News 对其能力、用例和推理成本优势的讨论。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Anthropic introduced Claude Duet, a new AI personal-assistant product powered by Opus 5.5, prompting Hacker News discussion of its capabilities, use cases, and inference-cost advantages.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Anthropic introduced Claude Duet, a new AI personal-assistant product powered by Opus 5.5, prompting Hacker News discussion of its capabilities, use cases, and inference-cost advantages.
updates.market_impact_en: The release feeds the competitive narrative around always-on AI agents from the three largest labs, a theme that typically moves sentiment in AI-adjacent crypto segments rather than any single token's fundamentals. Any transmission would run through narrative and attention flows toward agent-branded tokens and AI compute/inference-related assets, not through direct protocol exposure.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次发布强化了三大实验室围绕“始终在线”AI智能体的竞争叙事，这一主题通常影响的是与AI相关的加密板块情绪，而非某一代币的基本面。传导路径主要是叙事与资金关注度流向智能体概念代币及AI算力、推理相关资产，而非直接的协议层面敞口。

events.current_state_en: Meta's equity financing plan has been upsized to $97.5B, or up to about $103B including the greenshoe, comprising $25B of common stock, about $12.5B of Series A depositary shares and up to $60B through an at-the-market program; the $25B common stock offering drew about 5x oversubscription at $625 per share to fund AI investments.
events.current_state_zh: Meta的股权融资计划已上调至975亿美元，含超额配售最高约1030亿美元，由250亿美元普通股、约125亿美元A系列存托股及至多600亿美元按市价发行计划构成；其中250亿美元普通股发行获约5倍超额认购，定价每股625美元，用于支持AI投资。

updates.current_state_en: Meta's board approved a non-voting Class C stock — distributed one-for-one to existing holders from Jan. 19, 2027, effectively a 2-for-1 split — letting the company sell equity to fund a multi-hundred-billion-dollar AI buildout while preserving Mark Zuckerberg's voting control.

updates.what_changed_zh: Meta 启动约 350 亿美元的双承销股权发行——其中约 225 亿美元的 A 类普通股通过远期销售协议发行，约 125 亿美元的 A 系列强制可转换优先存托股份——据报道英伟达、AMD 和博通有意各自购买最多 50 亿美元的 Meta 股票，推动 META 盘前上涨 1.12%。

updates.current_state_en: Within Meta's roughly $35B equity offering, Nvidia will invest $3B; the companies are also expanding collaboration around the OpenShell reference architecture, Nvidia Sentry, Vera Rubin, Vera CPU, Spectrum-X and BlueField-4 deployments, and deepening work on MUSE models.
updates.current_state_zh: Meta的约350亿美元股权发行中，英伟达将投资30亿美元，双方还将围绕OpenShell参考架构、Nvidia Sentry及Vera Rubin、Vera CPU、Spectrum-X、BlueField-4等产品扩大合作，并深化MUSE模型合作。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Nvidia will invest $3 billion in a Meta equity issuance, with the two companies expanding their AI partnership across the OpenShell reference architecture, Nvidia Sentry, large-scale deployment of Vera Rubin, Vera CPU, Spectrum-X and BlueField-4, and deeper collaboration on MUSE models.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Nvidia will invest $3 billion in a Meta equity issuance, with the two companies expanding their AI partnership across the OpenShell reference architecture, Nvidia Sentry, large-scale deployment of Vera Rubin, Vera CPU, Spectrum-X and BlueField-4, and deeper collaboration on MUSE models.
updates.title_en: 英伟达将向Meta股权发行投资30亿美元，双方扩大AI基础设施与模型合作
updates.title_zh: 英伟达将向Meta股权发行投资30亿美元，双方扩大AI基础设施与模型合作
updates.what_changed_en: Nvidia will invest $3 billion in Meta's equity issuance, with the two companies expanding their AI infrastructure and model partnership.
updates.what_changed_zh: 英伟达将向Meta股权发行投资30亿美元，双方并扩大AI基础设施与模型合作。

updates.current_state_en: Meta's equity financing plan has been upsized to $97.5B, or up to about $103B including the greenshoe, comprising $25B of common stock, about $12.5B of Series A depositary shares and up to $60B through an at-the-market program to fund AI investments; Nvidia's previously announced $3B investment and expanded AI collaboration remain in place.
updates.current_state_zh: Meta的股权融资计划已上调至975亿美元，含超额配售最高约1030亿美元，由250亿美元普通股、约125亿美元A系列存托股及至多600亿美元按市价发行计划构成，用于支持AI投资；此前英伟达30亿美元投资及双方AI合作仍在推进。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Meta raised its planned stock offering to $97.5B — up to roughly $103B with the greenshoe — to finance artificial intelligence investments, increasing the common stock tranche to $25B alongside ~$12.5B of Series A depositary shares and up to $60B through an at-the-market program.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Meta raised its planned stock offering to $97.5B — up to roughly $103B with the greenshoe — to finance artificial intelligence investments, increasing the common stock tranche to $25B alongside ~$12.5B of Series A depositary shares and up to $60B through an at-the-market program.
updates.title_en: Meta小幅上调股票融资计划至975亿美元，最高融资额或达1030亿美元
updates.title_zh: Meta小幅上调股票融资计划至975亿美元，最高融资额或达1030亿美元
updates.what_changed_en: Meta raised its planned stock offering from about $95B to $97.5B, or up to roughly $103B including the greenshoe; it increased the common stock tranche from $22.5B to $25B while retaining about $12.5B of Series A depositary shares and an at-the-market program of up to $60B.
updates.what_changed_zh: Meta将股票融资计划规模从约950亿美元小幅上调至975亿美元，最高含超额配售可达约1030亿美元；普通股发行规模从225亿美元提高至250亿美元，并保留约125亿美元A系列存托股及至多600亿美元按市价发行计划。

updates.current_state_en: Meta's equity financing plan has been upsized to $97.5B, or up to about $103B including the greenshoe, comprising $25B of common stock, about $12.5B of Series A depositary shares and up to $60B through an at-the-market program; the $25B common stock offering drew about 5x oversubscription at $625 per share to fund AI investments.
updates.current_state_zh: Meta的股权融资计划已上调至975亿美元，含超额配售最高约1030亿美元，由250亿美元普通股、约125亿美元A系列存托股及至多600亿美元按市价发行计划构成；其中250亿美元普通股发行获约5倍超额认购，定价每股625美元，用于支持AI投资。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Meta's expanded $25B stock offering drew about 5x oversubscription at $625 per share, part of a planned ~$98B fundraising package to fund AI spending, with over half allocated to long-term and existing shareholders.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Meta's expanded $25B stock offering drew about 5x oversubscription at $625 per share, part of a planned ~$98B fundraising package to fund AI spending, with over half allocated to long-term and existing shareholders.
updates.title_en: Meta 250亿美元股票发行获约5倍超额认购
updates.title_zh: Meta 250亿美元股票发行获约5倍超额认购
updates.what_changed_en: Meta's expanded $25B common stock offering drew about 5x oversubscription, priced at $625 per share, a 2.7% discount to the prior Friday close; more than half of shares were allocated to long-term and existing shareholders, with the top 15 investors receiving about 70% of the offering.
updates.what_changed_zh: Meta扩大后的250亿美元普通股发行获得约5倍超额认购，定价为每股625美元，较发行前上周五收盘价折让2.7%；超过一半股份分配给长期持股投资者和现有股东，前15大投资者合计获约70%发行股份。

events.current_state_en: AI research lab Flapping Airplanes, founded roughly a year ago by Prod incubator co-founder and ThunderKittens/Megakernel author Ben Spector, raised a $1B Series A led by Index Ventures and Lux Capital at a $6B valuation, to pursue a GPU-kernel-level rewrite of AI training and inference that has already shown large efficiency gains over vLLM and SGLang.

updates.current_state_en: After disclosing unauthorized access to its environment-variable storage, Railway issued guidance for users with Google Cloud service-account keys to rotate credentials, redeploy, and audit cloud activity; the incident remains reported as possibly linked to the suspected Swell DAO admin-key compromise.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Railway issued security guidance telling users to disable and rotate potentially leaked Google Cloud service-account keys and audit for unauthorized activity, following its October 21 incident that is linked to the suspected compromise of Swell DAO's swETH/rswETH admin keys and malicious upgrade contracts that could drain ~2,500 ETH.

updates.what_changed_en: Railway issued follow-up guidance for users with Google Cloud service-account keys to disable and rotate potentially leaked keys, redeploy services, and audit cloud logs and billing; the report also links the incident to the suspected compromise of Swell DAO swETH/rswETH admin keys.
updates.what_changed_zh: Railway 发布后续安全指引，要求使用谷歌云服务账号密钥的用户禁用并轮换可能泄露的密钥、重新部署服务，并检查云审计日志与账单；报道还称该事件可能与 Swell DAO 的 swETH/rswETH 管理员密钥疑似泄露相关。

events.current_state_zh: CoinDCX 已正式确认 1599 万 USDT 损失源于被弃用的旧钱包基础设施及自动归集服务失效，并称损失由公司承担、当前系统未受影响；Salus 首席营销官公开质疑其说法。

updates.background_en: CoinDCX disclosed a $44 million hack in July 2025 that followed the compromise of a software engineer's company laptop used for side work. The exchange says wallet addresses created in January 2025 were compromised in that incident and have not been used by CoinDCX since. Blockchain investigators subsequently flagged roughly $16 million in suspicious movements tied to addresses said to be associated with the exchange.

updates.background_en: CoinDCX is an India-focused exchange that describes itself as serving more than 14 million users and says it lists among the widest range of cryptocurrencies available on Indian platforms. Indian exchanges have faced repeated security incidents, including WazirX, which suspended crypto trading in July 2024 after disclosing a breach. Coinbase operates in Europe through Irish-regulated entities, which makes the Central Bank of Ireland a key supervisor for its EU business.
updates.background_zh: CoinDCX 是一家以印度市场为主的交易所，自称拥有超过 1400 万用户，并表示其上币种类在印度平台中属于最多之列。印度交易所此前已多次遭遇安全事件，其中 WazirX 在 2024 年 7 月披露入侵事件后暂停了加密货币交易。Coinbase 通过受爱尔兰监管的实体在欧洲开展业务，因此爱尔兰央行是其欧盟业务的重要监管机构。
updates.current_state_en:
Indian crypto exchange CoinDCX has acknowledged a new security breach, confirming the incident only after the fact rather than at the time it occurred. Separately, Ireland's central bank issued another penalty against Coinbase's Irish entity, with reports citing a €3.25 million ($3.6 million) fine over safeguarding and outsourcing obligations.

The two disclosures land on the same exchange-risk themes — custody security and regulatory compliance — that supervisors have been tightening. Ireland's central bank framed the Coinbase action as customer protection, stating: "This action against Coinbase Ireland underlines the Central Bank's focus on ensuring that customers are at all times protected and that the integrity of the financial system is maintained."

The Coinbase penalty reported in the safeguarding and outsourcing case requires approval from Ireland's High Court before taking effect. Delano separately reported a €21.5 million penalty against Coinbase Europe for anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing failures, described as Ireland's first enforcement action in the crypto sector.
updates.current_state_zh:
印度加密货币交易所 CoinDCX 承认发生了一起新的安全入侵事件，但披露时间明显滞后于事件本身。与此同时，爱尔兰央行再次对 Coinbase 的爱尔兰实体开出罚单，相关报道称罚款金额为 325 万欧元（约 360 万美元），事由涉及客户资产保障与外包义务方面的违规。

这两则消息同时指向交易所风险的两大核心议题——托管安全与合规监管，而监管机构正持续收紧这两方面的要求。爱尔兰央行将针对 Coinbase 的执法行动定性为客户保护，并表示：“此次对 Coinbase Ireland 的行动凸显了央行确保客户始终受到保护、并维护金融体系完整性的关注。”

在客户资产保障与外包一案中，针对 Coinbase 的处罚需经爱尔兰高等法院批准后方可生效。Delano 另行报道称，Coinbase Europe 因反洗钱与反恐融资方面的缺失被处以 2150 万欧元罚款，并称这是爱尔兰在加密行业采取的首次执法行动。

updates.what_changed_en: CoinDCX published an announcement confirming that the October 21 abnormal activity originated from deprecated wallet infrastructure. That infrastructure had been compromised in the July 19, 2025 security incident and retired, but contained an unknown vulnerability. An automatic sweeping service failed for a period, allowing funds from users who mistakenly deposited to the deprecated address to accumulate, resulting in a 15.99 million USDT loss that the company will absorb. CoinDCX said current trading and wallet systems were unaffected, user funds are held in isolated cold wallets, deposits, withdrawals and trading operated normally over the past 72 hours, and it will strengthen monitoring of legacy systems; Salus CMO Darcy commented that this is a “clumsy lie.”

events.current_state_en: A compromised eMudhra intermediate certificate authority allowed private signing keys to be recovered from public certificates, enabling attackers to mint valid HTTPS certificates for any domain and prompting urgent certificate-store updates.
events.current_state_zh:
美国国家标准与技术研究院的国家漏洞数据库发布了 CVE-2026-111943，针对 eMudhra 中间证书颁发机构证书遭攻陷一事。此前，Mozilla 与谷歌 Chrome 根证书计划于 2026 年 10 月 20 日确认，eMudhra 的 8 个中间证书的私钥可以直接从公开证书中还原。Chrome 随后将 emSign ECC Root CA - G3 从 Chrome 根证书库中移除，以保护那些不接收 CRLSet 更新的使用方。

由于任何人都能从公开材料中推导出这些私钥，攻击者可以伪造出对任意域名都看似有效的证书，冒充银行、GitHub 或 PyPI 等站点，这迫使操作系统和浏览器厂商紧急推送信任库更新。

eMudhra 在事件声明中表示，受影响的中间证书是在 2025 年 4 月的一次密钥生成仪式中创建的，其根 CA 私钥和其他中间证书颁发机构未受影响，并称未签发任何终端实体证书。Mozilla 表示已在 UTC 21:48 独立还原出受影响证书的私钥，确认密钥生成过程存在缺陷且极易被利用。
events.title_en: CVE-2026-111943: Compromised Intermediate Certificate Authority
events.title_zh: CVE-2026-111943：中间证书颁发机构遭攻陷

updates.background_en: eMudhra is an India-based certificate authority that sells certificates under the emSign brand through companies in India, the United States and the Netherlands, and its roots are included in the Mozilla, Chrome and Apple root stores. According to The Register, it has issued more than 60 million certificates. Reports describe the flaw as originating in an HSM key-wrapping test script that produced a second set of weak P-384 key pairs during the April 2025 ceremony.
updates.background_zh: eMudhra 是一家总部位于印度的证书颁发机构，通过印度、美国和荷兰的公司以 emSign 品牌销售证书，其根证书被纳入 Mozilla、Chrome 和苹果的根证书库。据《The Register》报道，该公司已签发超过 6000 万张证书。有报道称，缺陷源自一个 HSM 密钥封装测试脚本，该脚本在 2025 年 4 月的仪式中生成了一套弱 P-384 密钥对。
updates.community_discussion_en: Commenters focused on operational fallout: Gentoo users were advised to upgrade app-misc/ca-certificates to 20260816.3.125 or higher, and one noted Red Hat customers still had only a workaround disabling two Comodo root certificates used to sign the eMudhra certificates, with the advisory marked ongoing. Others flagged that Python users may need separate steps, while one commenter argued the underlying eMudhra incident is older news that NIST is only now formally cataloguing.
updates.community_discussion_zh: 评论者主要关注实际运维影响：Gentoo 用户被建议将 app-misc/ca-certificates 升级到 20260816.3.125 或更高版本；有人指出 Red Hat 用户目前仍只有一项变通方案，即禁用两张用于签发 eMudhra 证书的 Comodo 根证书，相关安全公告仍标记为“进行中”。还有人提醒 Python 用户可能需要单独采取措施，也有评论者认为 eMudhra 事件本身属于旧闻，NIST 只是刚刚正式收录。

updates.detailed_summary_en: A compromised eMudhra intermediate certificate authority allowed private signing keys to be recovered from public certificates, enabling attackers to mint valid HTTPS certificates for any domain and prompting urgent certificate-store updates.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: A compromised eMudhra intermediate certificate authority allowed private signing keys to be recovered from public certificates, enabling attackers to mint valid HTTPS certificates for any domain and prompting urgent certificate-store updates.
updates.market_impact_en: The exposure runs through the web PKI trust layer: any crypto exchange, custodian, wallet provider or dApp front end that relies on standard HTTPS certificates or certificate-based service authentication may need to reissue certificates or update trust stores, and clients that fail to apply updates face impersonation risk in the interim.
updates.market_impact_zh: 风险传导路径位于 Web PKI 信任层：任何依赖标准 HTTPS 证书或基于证书的服务认证的加密货币交易所、托管机构、钱包服务商或 dApp 前端，都可能需要重新签发证书或更新信任库；在此期间，未及时应用更新的客户端将面临被冒充的风险。

updates.background_en: a16z's disclosed crypto bets include Coinbase, the Solana blockchain and Uniswap. In January the firm said it had raised more than $15 billion across its funds, and co-founder Ben Horowitz wrote that the mission "starts with winning the key architectures of the future—AI and crypto." Dixon has said long-horizon investing has been his focus since joining a16z in 2013, a theme that led to investments in Oculus and drone startups such as Skydio and Zipline.
updates.background_zh: a16z 已披露的加密投资包括 Coinbase、Solana 区块链和 Uniswap。今年 1 月，该公司表示其各只基金合计募资超过 150 亿美元，联合创始人 Ben Horowitz 在公司文章中称，使命“始于赢得未来的关键架构——AI 与加密”。Dixon 表示，自 2013 年加入 a16z 以来，长周期投资一直是他的重点，这一主题带来了对 Oculus 以及 Skydio、Zipline 等无人机初创公司的投资。
updates.current_state_en: a16z crypto has officially been renamed a16z Frontier, and its new fund will continue investing in crypto and related companies while expanding into broader frontier technology startups.

updates.detailed_summary_en: a16z crypto has renamed itself a16z Frontier and expanded its new fund's investment scope from crypto startups to broader frontier technology while continuing to invest in and advocate for crypto.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: a16z crypto has renamed itself a16z Frontier and expanded its new fund's investment scope from crypto startups to broader frontier technology while continuing to invest in and advocate for crypto.
updates.market_impact_en: The rename does not itself move capital or liquidity; its transmission path runs through crypto venture-funding sentiment and narrative, with a16z's retained crypto holdings (Coinbase, Solana and Uniswap among disclosed bets) and its regulatory advocacy remaining the direct points of exposure. Any tilt of capital toward AI and frontier tech would surface first in future funding rounds rather than in spot markets.
updates.market_impact_zh: 更名本身不会直接改变资金或流动性，其传导路径主要落在加密风险投资的情绪与叙事层面：a16z 保留的加密持仓（已披露的包括 Coinbase、Solana 和 Uniswap）及其监管倡导，是直接的风险敞口所在。若资金向 AI 与前沿科技倾斜，更可能先体现在后续融资轮次中，而非现货市场。

updates.what_changed_en: a16z officially announced that a16z crypto is renamed a16z Frontier and that the new fund's scope is expanded from crypto startups to broader frontier technology startups while continuing to invest in crypto and related companies and advocate for sensible crypto regulation; the fund is led by Chris Dixon, Marc Andreessen, Ben Horowitz, Eddy Lazzarin, and Guy Wuollet.
updates.what_changed_zh: a16z 正式公告将 a16z crypto 更名为 a16z Frontier，并把新基金投资范围从加密货币初创公司扩展至更广泛的前沿科技初创公司，同时继续投资加密货币及相关企业并倡导合理监管；新基金由 Chris Dixon、Marc Andreessen、Ben Horowitz、Eddy Lazzarin 和 Guy Wuollet 共同领导。

updates.background_en: a16z crypto has invested in crypto and blockchain startups across all stages since 2013, and the May fund — its fifth dedicated crypto vehicle — brought total crypto capital raised to $9.8 billion. The rebrand lands with bitcoin down on the year and capital competing against a dominant AI trade. The same newsletter cited BTC at $81.8k, ETH at $2,400 and $635 million in net outflows from bitcoin ETFs.
updates.background_zh: a16z crypto 自 2013 年起就在各个阶段投资加密与区块链初创公司；今年 5 月的那期基金是其第五只专项加密基金，使其加密领域累计募资额达到 98 亿美元。此次更名之际，比特币年内下跌，资本正与占据主导地位的 AI 交易争夺注意力。同一份简报还提到 BTC 报 81,800 美元、ETH 报 2,400 美元，以及比特币 ETF 净流出 6.35 亿美元。
updates.current_state_en: Andreessen Horowitz renamed its crypto fund 'a16z Frontier' and expanded its mandate to AI, autonomous machines and biology while maintaining that it will continue investing in crypto, alongside a market recap noting BTC at $81.8k and $635M in BTC ETF net outflows.
updates.current_state_zh: Andreessen Horowitz将其加密基金更名为“a16z Frontier”，并将授权范围扩展至AI、自主机器和生物学，同时表示将继续投资加密货币；市场回顾指出BTC报81.8万美元、BTC ETF净流出6.35亿美元。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Andreessen Horowitz renamed its crypto fund 'a16z Frontier' and expanded its mandate to AI, autonomous machines and biology while maintaining that it will continue investing in crypto, alongside a market recap noting BTC at $81.8k and $635M in BTC ETF net outflows.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Andreessen Horowitz renamed its crypto fund 'a16z Frontier' and expanded its mandate to AI, autonomous machines and biology while maintaining that it will continue investing in crypto, alongside a market recap noting BTC at $81.8k and $635M in BTC ETF net outflows.
updates.market_impact_en: The rebrand is a signal about how crypto venture capital allocates capital: if a flagship crypto fund formally widens its remit to AI and biology, crypto startups may face tougher competition for the same partner attention and dollars. The newsletter's simultaneous note of $635 million in bitcoin ETF net outflows reflects a separate channel — spot ETF demand — that has been weighing on sentiment, though the two items are reported side by side rather than as cause and effect.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次更名是加密风险资本配置方式的一个信号：当一只旗舰加密基金正式把职权范围扩大到人工智能和生物学时，加密初创公司可能在争夺同样的合伙人关注与资金时面临更激烈的竞争。简报同时提到比特币 ETF 净流出 6.35 亿美元，这反映的是另一条渠道，即现货 ETF 需求，它一直在拖累市场情绪；不过这两件事是被并列报道的，而非因果关系。

events.current_state_en: Uniswap v4 Aggregator Hooks are live on Ethereum mainnet, Base, and Robinhood Chain, initially supporting seven external sources including Curve, Fluid, and PancakeSwap; swaps routed through them incur protocol fees contributing to UNI burns.
events.current_state_zh: Uniswap v4 Aggregator Hooks 已上线，覆盖以太坊主网、Base 与 Robinhood Chain，首日支持 Curve、Fluid、PancakeSwap 等七个外部来源；经其路由的兑换将收取协议费并贡献于 UNI 销毁。
events.title_en: 【Uniswap Aggregator Hooks 上线，可封装外部流动性来源转化为 v4 流动性池】
events.title_zh: 【Uniswap Aggregator Hooks 上线，可封装外部流动性来源转化为 v4 流动性池】

updates.background_en: Uniswap v4 launched on mainnet in January 2025, introducing hooks, the singleton contract design and flash accounting. Hooks let developers attach custom logic to pools, and Aggregator Hooks is the first use of that mechanism to route into other protocols' liquidity rather than only Uniswap's own pools.
updates.background_zh: Uniswap v4 于 2025 年 1 月上线主网，引入 Hook、单例合约设计与闪 accounting（闪电记账）机制。Hook 允许开发者给资金池附加自定义逻辑，而 Aggregator Hooks 是首次用该机制将路由接入其他协议的流动性，而不仅是 Uniswap 自身资金池。
updates.current_state_en: Uniswap launched Aggregator Hooks, letting v4 wrap external liquidity sources such as Curve, Fluid, and PancakeSwap into v4 liquidity pools, live on Ethereum mainnet, Base, and Robinhood Chain via the Uniswap Web app and API.
updates.current_state_zh: Uniswap 推出 Aggregator Hooks，使 v4 能将 Curve、Fluid 和 PancakeSwap 等外部流动性来源接入 v4 流动性池，已通过 Uniswap Web 应用和 API 在以太坊主网、Base 和 Robinhood Chain 上线。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Uniswap launched Aggregator Hooks, letting v4 wrap external liquidity sources such as Curve, Fluid, and PancakeSwap into v4 liquidity pools, live on Ethereum mainnet, Base, and Robinhood Chain via the Uniswap Web app and API.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Uniswap launched Aggregator Hooks, letting v4 wrap external liquidity sources such as Curve, Fluid, and PancakeSwap into v4 liquidity pools, live on Ethereum mainnet, Base, and Robinhood Chain via the Uniswap Web app and API.
updates.market_impact_en: The release touches the DEX aggregator segment directly: Uniswap v4 can now absorb quotes from venues such as Curve, Fluid and PancakeSwap through its own router, so aggregator order flow and fee capture shift toward Uniswap's Web app and API. For UNI, the transmission channel is the protocol fee on externally routed swaps feeding the burn, making token supply sensitive to aggregator volume rather than only to Uniswap-native pool activity.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次发布直接作用于 DEX 聚合器这一细分市场：Uniswap v4 现在可以通过自身路由吸收 Curve、Fluid、PancakeSwap 等场所的报价，聚合器订单流与手续费捕获由此向 Uniswap 网页端与 API 转移。对 UNI 而言，传导渠道是经外部来源路由的兑换所缴纳的协议费进入销毁，使代币供应不仅取决于 Uniswap 原生池活动，也对聚合交易量敏感。

events.current_state_en: A Science study found Microsoft's new AI diagnostic system beat generalist doctors on difficult medical cases, though most of the improvement was attributed to the underlying AI models rather than Microsoft's system itself.
events.current_state_zh: 一项《科学》研究发现，微软的新AI诊断系统在疑难病例上胜过全科医生，不过大部分提升被归因于底层AI模型，而非微软系统本身。
events.title_en: Microsoft unveils AI diagnostic tool claimed to outperform doctors
events.title_zh: 微软发布AI医疗诊断工具，称其诊断准确率优于医生

updates.background_en: AI companies have long pitched healthcare as a flagship use case for their technology, and Suleyman has publicly framed the work as a push toward what he calls medical superintelligence. Earlier research has generally found generative AI diagnostic performance comparable to non-expert physicians but below expert-level reliability.
updates.background_zh: AI公司长期将医疗健康视为其技术的旗舰应用场景，苏莱曼也公开将这项工作描述为迈向其所称“医疗超级智能”的努力。此前的研究普遍发现，生成式AI的诊断表现与非专家级医生相当，但低于专家级的可靠性水平。
updates.current_state_en: Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman announced a new AI diagnostic tool that the company claims can diagnose medical conditions up to four times more accurately than human doctors.
updates.current_state_zh:
微软AI部门首席执行官穆斯塔法·苏莱曼宣布推出一款新的AI诊断系统，公司称其在诊断疾病方面比人类医生的准确率最高可达四倍。该说法基于2026年10月22日发表在《Science》上的同行评审研究。

该结果发表在同行评审期刊而非公司演示中，使微软的说法比一般产品发布更具分量。不过，对照对象是在疑难病例上的一般内科医生，而非专科医生。

微软该系统被称为“诊断编排器”（MAI-DxO），在《Science》研究中报告的准确率为83.2%。相关报道指出，性能提升的很大一部分似乎来自底层AI模型，而非微软的系统本身。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman announced a new AI diagnostic tool that the company claims can diagnose medical conditions up to four times more accurately than human doctors.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman announced a new AI diagnostic tool that the company claims can diagnose medical conditions up to four times more accurately than human doctors.
updates.market_impact_en: There is no direct transmission path to crypto markets: the announcement concerns a clinical diagnostic system with no token, custody, or on-chain component. Any effect would be indirect, via general AI-sector sentiment that AI-branded tokens sometimes track.

updates.what_changed_en: Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman announced a new AI diagnostic tool that the company claims can diagnose medical conditions up to four times more accurately than human doctors.
updates.what_changed_zh:
微软AI部门首席执行官穆斯塔法·苏莱曼宣布推出一款新的AI诊断系统，公司称其在诊断疾病方面比人类医生的准确率最高可达四倍。该说法基于2026年10月22日发表在《Science》上的同行评审研究。

该结果发表在同行评审期刊而非公司演示中，使微软的说法比一般产品发布更具分量。不过，对照对象是在疑难病例上的一般内科医生，而非专科医生。

微软该系统被称为“诊断编排器”（MAI-DxO），在《Science》研究中报告的准确率为83.2%。相关报道指出，性能提升的很大一部分似乎来自底层AI模型，而非微软的系统本身。

events.current_state_en: Dune launched real-time onchain market data feeds covering over 200 trading venues across 12 blockchains, delivering trade data about one second after execution for institutional clients.
events.current_state_zh:
Dune 于周四宣布推出实时市场数据源，覆盖以太坊、Solana、Base 和 XLayer 等 12 条区块链上的 200 多个链上交易场所，交易数据在成交后约一秒即可提供。该数据源覆盖去中心化交易所的现货交易，以及 Hyperliquid 和 Lighter 上的永续合约交易，并以标准化格式提供价格、成交规模和交易明细数据。

Dune 联合创始人兼首席执行官 Fredrik Haga 表示，多数机构首先关注链上市场，因为"没有这些数据，他们已经无法为这些资产正确定价"，意指市场数据是机构参与链上市场的入口。此次发布正值代币化股票市场快速扩张并面临日益严格审视之际。

Haga 表示，首批客户包括量化基金、做市商、资产管理机构和银行交易台，但以保密协议为由拒绝透露具体名称。据 Dune 介绍，这些机构使用该数据评估流动性、比较不同场所的价格，并在投入资金前评估交易策略。
events.title_en: Dune launches real-time data feeds covering 200 onchain trading venues
events.title_zh: Dune 推出覆盖 200 个链上交易场所的实时数据源

updates.background_en: The market for tokenized stocks has grown sharply over the past year: RWA.xyz data cited by the report puts distributed value at $3.58 billion, up from about $627 million a year earlier, a roughly 470% increase. Fragmentation and issuer pushback have accompanied that growth — OKX and NYSE parent Intercontinental Exchange announced plans on Oct. 4 for a tokenized stock trading platform through their OKXICE joint venture, and 16 companies including Microsoft, Alphabet and Goldman Sachs have since filed objections to having their shares traded there, without specifying reasons. In May, Tiger Research director Ryan Yoon warned that trading the same tokenized stocks across multiple blockchains could create price discrepancies, increase slippage and reduce market efficiency.
updates.background_zh: 过去一年，代币化股票市场大幅增长：报道援引 RWA.xyz 的数据称，其分布式价值已达 35.8 亿美元，高于一年前的约 6.27 亿美元，增幅约 470%。伴随增长的是市场碎片化和发行方的反对——OKX 与纽交所母公司洲际交易所（ICE）于 10 月 4 日宣布通过双方合资的 OKXICE 建设代币化股票交易平台，此后包括微软、Alphabet 和高盛在内的 16 家公司提交反对意见，但未说明理由。今年 5 月，Tiger Research 总监 Ryan Yoon 曾警告，同一代币化股票在多个区块链平台交易可能造成价格差异、 slippage 上升并降低市场效率。

updates.detailed_summary_en: Dune launched real-time onchain market data feeds covering over 200 trading venues across 12 blockchains, delivering trade data about one second after execution for institutional clients.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Dune launched real-time onchain market data feeds covering over 200 trading venues across 12 blockchains, delivering trade data about one second after execution for institutional clients.
updates.market_impact_en: The feeds give institutional desks standardized, near-real-time pricing across DEX spot venues and perpetual futures platforms such as Hyperliquid and Lighter, lowering the data-integration barrier that currently sits between traditional trading systems and onchain execution. Over time that channel could affect liquidity and market-making depth on the covered venues, and it links tokenized-equity pricing debates to onchain market-data infrastructure.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该数据源为机构交易台提供跨去中心化现货场所及 Hyperliquid、Lighter 等永续合约平台的标准化近实时价格，降低了目前横亘在传统交易系统与链上执行之间的数据接入门槛。这一渠道随时间可能影响被覆盖场所的流动性与做市深度，并将代币化股票的定价争议与链上市场数据基础设施联系起来。

events.current_state_en: New York Attorney General Letitia James is asking a court to order NovaTech founders Cynthia and Eddy Petion and related companies to pay $1.37 billion; the court entered a default liability judgment in August 2025, four promoters agreed to pay nearly $6 million intended to benefit victims, and a separate request seeks about $6.15 million over AWS Mining.
events.current_state_zh: 纽约总检察长Letitia James正请求法院判令NovaTech创始人Cynthia和Eddy Petion及关联公司支付1.37亿美元；此前法院已于2025年8月作出默认责任认定，四名推广者同意支付近600万美元用于受害者赔偿，另有涉及AWS Mining的约615万美元请求。
events.title_en: New York AG Seeks $1.37B From NovaTech Founders Over Alleged Crypto Ponzi Scheme

updates.current_state_en: New York's Attorney General is seeking $1.37 billion in disgorgement and prejudgment interest from NovaTech founders Cynthia and Eddy Petion, alleging they ran a crypto Ponzi scheme that took in $1.16 billion in deposits while trading only about $26 million and paying early investors with new money.
updates.current_state_zh: 纽约总检察长正寻求从NovaTech创始人Cynthia和Eddy Petion处追缴13.7亿美元的非法所得及判决前利息，指控二人运营加密货币庞氏骗局，吸收存款11.6亿美元，却仅进行约2600万美元的交易，并用新资金支付早期投资者。

updates.current_state_en: New York Attorney General Letitia James is asking a court to order NovaTech founders Cynthia and Eddy Petion and related companies to pay $1.37 billion; the court entered a default liability judgment in August 2025, four promoters agreed to pay nearly $6 million intended to benefit victims, and a separate request seeks about $6.15 million over AWS Mining.
updates.current_state_zh: 纽约总检察长Letitia James正请求法院判令NovaTech创始人Cynthia和Eddy Petion及关联公司支付1.37亿美元；此前法院已于2025年8月作出默认责任认定，四名推广者同意支付近600万美元用于受害者赔偿，另有涉及AWS Mining的约615万美元请求。
updates.detailed_summary_en: New York Attorney General Letitia James asked a court to order NovaTech founders Cynthia and Eddy Petion and related companies to pay $1.37 billion for operating a Ponzi scheme, following an August 2025 default judgment, while four promoters agreed to pay nearly $6 million in victim-benefiting settlements.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: New York Attorney General Letitia James asked a court to order NovaTech founders Cynthia and Eddy Petion and related companies to pay $1.37 billion for operating a Ponzi scheme, following an August 2025 default judgment, while four promoters agreed to pay nearly $6 million in victim-benefiting settlements.
updates.title_en: New York AG seeks $1.37B from NovaTech founders over Ponzi scheme
updates.title_zh: 纽约总检察长就庞氏骗局向NovaTech创始人追索13.7亿美元
updates.what_changed_en: The report adds that the court entered a default liability judgment in August 2025 against the NovaTech founders and related companies after they failed to respond; the $1.37 billion request includes about $1.13 billion in investor funds and $232.5 million in interest; four promoters agreed to pay nearly $6 million in settlements; and the AG separately seeks about $6.15 million including interest over AWS Mining.
updates.what_changed_zh: 新报道补充称，法院已于2025年8月因NovaTech创始人及关联公司未应诉而作出默认责任认定；纽约总检察长请求的1.37亿美元中包括约11.3亿美元投资者资金返还和2.325亿美元利息；另有四名推广者同意支付近600万美元和解金，且总检察长还就AWS Mining另行寻求约615万美元（含利息）。

updates.current_state_en: Phantom began rolling out in-app Kalshi prediction-market trading for US users on October 23, funding trades from Phantom Cash stablecoin balances with $0.02 per-contract fees and blocking certain market categories in Michigan, Nevada and Washington, relying on a conditional CFTC no-action letter covering broker registration.

events.current_state_en: Ant Group's BaiLing team released Ling-3.0-flash-Sante, an MIT-licensed open-weights medical model built on a 124B-parameter MoE architecture (about 5.1B active per token) that improved its HealthBench Professional score to 54.29 and complex medical reasoning to 76.92, while adding literature retrieval, tool calling and multi-agent collaboration for research workflows.

events.title_en: ⚡️Kalshi计划于12月推出追踪美国CPI与核心通胀指标期货合约
events.title_zh: ⚡️Kalshi计划于12月推出追踪美国CPI与核心通胀指标期货合约

updates.background_en: Kalshi is a New York-based, CFTC-regulated prediction market best known for binary event contracts. The company has been shifting clearing in-house to its own Kalshi Klear clearinghouse, which it describes as a tech-first derivatives clearinghouse, after previously relying on LedgerX. Inflation exposure has traditionally been traded through inflation swaps and inflation-linked bonds rather than exchange-listed CPI futures.
updates.background_zh: Kalshi 是一家总部位于纽约、受美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）监管的预测市场，以二元事件合约闻名。该公司此前依赖 LedgerX 进行清算，目前正将清算业务转入自有的 Kalshi Klear 清算所，并将其描述为「技术优先」的衍生品清算机构。通胀敞口传统上通过通胀互换和通胀挂钩债券进行交易，而非交易所上市的 CPI 期货。
updates.current_state_en: Kalshi is pitching large banks and hedge funds on a December launch of exchange-traded futures tracking US CPI and core inflation, with former Barclays trader Michael Ashton hired to design the contracts.
updates.current_state_zh: Kalshi正向大型银行和对冲基金推介于12月推出追踪美国CPI和核心通胀的交易所交易期货，并聘请前巴克莱交易员Michael Ashton设计合约。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Kalshi is pitching large banks and hedge funds on a December launch of exchange-traded futures tracking US CPI and core inflation, with former Barclays trader Michael Ashton hired to design the contracts.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Kalshi is pitching large banks and hedge funds on a December launch of exchange-traded futures tracking US CPI and core inflation, with former Barclays trader Michael Ashton hired to design the contracts.
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission path is indirect: no crypto asset is referenced by the contracts, but Kalshi's move into CFTC-regulated inflation derivatives expands the institutional product set of a venue that competes with crypto-native prediction markets, so the effect runs through prediction-market market structure and sentiment rather than through token fundamentals.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导路径是间接的：合约本身不涉及任何加密资产，但 Kalshi 进军受 CFTC 监管的通胀衍生品，扩大了这一与加密原生预测市场竞争的平台的机构产品线，因此影响更多体现在预测市场的市场结构与情绪层面，而非代币基本面。

events.current_state_en: A researcher publishes a detailed account of a successful iPhone hacking effort, covering the exploit chain used to gain deep access to iOS, with community debate on sandboxing, PDF attack surfaces, and the practical limits of jailbreaking under Apple's ecosystem controls.
events.current_state_zh:
Calif 博客发布的一篇安全研究文章宣布成功实现了针对 iPhone 的漏洞利用链，作者称这正是团队最初设定的攻击目标。该文在 Hacker News 上引发大量讨论，获得 607 分和 408 条评论。

评论者的关注点集中在两点：苹果的“锁定模式”是否真能防御这类攻击链；以及前沿 AI 红队模型的访问权限仅向少数获准机构开放——有评论者称这一准入计划更像是护城河而非安全保障。

现有材料将该成果描述为一项研究声明：并未同时报告在野利用或用户损失。参与讨论者认为演示在技术上令人印象深刻，但希望看到锁定模式在真实环境中有效性的证据。
events.title_en: Today, we hacked what we'd set out to hack: the iPhone
events.title_zh: 今天，我们攻破了最初就想攻破的目标：iPhone

updates.background_en: Lockdown Mode is an optional Apple security feature, available from iOS 16, iPadOS 16, watchOS 10 and macOS Ventura onward, that greatly reduces exposure to sophisticated attacks by restricting certain apps, features and network connections. iOS exploit chains typically combine a browser or WebKit entry point, a sandbox escape, privilege escalation and post-exploitation steps, which is why they are discussed alongside mobile hardening and rapid patching.
updates.background_zh: 锁定模式（Lockdown Mode）是苹果提供的一项可选安全功能，自 iOS 16、iPadOS 16、watchOS 10 和 macOS Ventura 起可用，通过限制部分应用、功能和网络连接，大幅降低遭受复杂攻击的风险。iOS 漏洞利用链通常会将浏览器或 WebKit 入口、沙箱逃逸、权限提升和后续利用步骤组合起来，因此常与移动设备加固和快速打补丁一起被讨论。
updates.community_discussion_en: Sentiment was impressed but skeptical. One commenter asked whether enabling Lockdown Mode helps at all against these exploits; another noted that iOS has repeatedly been compromised through PDF-based vectors, comparing it to the Pegasus ForcedEntry chain. Others lamented that researchers outside a closed circle cannot access frontier AI red-team models, and one user expressed resignation that jailbreaking an iPhone risks losing iCloud and iMessage access.
updates.community_discussion_zh: 整体情绪是“印象深刻但存疑”。一位评论者询问开启锁定模式是否对这些漏洞利用有任何帮助；另一位指出 iOS 多次被 PDF 类攻击向量攻破，并将其与 Pegasus 的 ForcedEntry 攻击链相比。还有人抱怨圈子外的研究者无法获得前沿 AI 红队模型，另有一位用户无奈表示，越狱 iPhone 可能会失去 iCloud 和 iMessage 访问权限。

评论者的关注点集中在两点：苹果的“锁定模式”是否真能防御这类攻击链；以及前沿 AI 红队模型的访问权限仅向少数获准机构开放——有评论者称这一准入计划更像是护城河而非安全保障。

现有材料将该成果描述为一项研究声明：并未同时报告在野利用或用户损失。参与讨论者认为演示在技术上令人印象深刻，但希望看到锁定模式在真实环境中有效性的证据。
updates.detailed_summary_en: A researcher publishes a detailed account of a successful iPhone hacking effort, covering the exploit chain used to gain deep access to iOS, with community debate on sandboxing, PDF attack surfaces, and the practical limits of jailbreaking under Apple's ecosystem controls.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: A researcher publishes a detailed account of a successful iPhone hacking effort, covering the exploit chain used to gain deep access to iOS, with community debate on sandboxing, PDF attack surfaces, and the practical limits of jailbreaking under Apple's ecosystem controls.
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through mobile custody: iPhones are a common host for crypto wallets and exchange apps, so demonstrated iOS exploit chains bear on the perceived security of self-custody and mobile trading setups, with Lockdown Mode as the main hardening control for high-risk users. Because this remains a research claim without reported in-the-wild exploitation, the direct market effect is limited to sentiment around mobile security practices.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于移动端资产托管：iPhone 是加密钱包和交易所应用的常见载体，因此被演示出的 iOS 漏洞利用链会影响市场对自托管和移动交易环境安全性的看法，而锁定模式是高危用户的主要加固手段。由于这仍只是一项研究声明、并未报告在野利用，直接的市场影响仅限于围绕移动安全实践的舆论层面。

events.current_state_en: Lido launched 0x02 CSM, letting permissionless node operators run 0x02 validators with up to 2048 ETH effective balance by posting only a bond of 32 ETH for the first key and 30 ETH for each subsequent key, under an initial cap of 0.01% of Lido Core TVL, or about 32 keys.
events.current_state_zh:
Lido 宣布上线 0x02 CSM，节点运营商可通过 Lido 协议无需许可地运行单个最大有效余额达 2048 ETH 的 0x02 验证器。运营商无需自行提供全部质押资金，只需缴纳保证金——首个验证器密钥需 32 ETH，后续每个密钥需 30 ETH——其余质押由 Lido 协议分配。

Lido 表示，与独立质押相比，验证器达到 2048 ETH 有效余额后，运营商的资本乘数约为 2.18 倍至 2.26 倍。该模块初期质押份额上限为 Lido Core TVL 的 0.01%，预计可为约 32 个验证器密钥提供初始存款，此后将逐步扩容。

现有 0x01 CSM 将继续并行运行，现有运营商无需切换。

updates.background_en: 0x02 validators follow EIP-7251, introduced in Ethereum's Pectra upgrade, which raised the maximum effective balance of a validator from 32 ETH to 2,048 ETH while keeping the 32 ETH minimum. Lido's documentation had previously described a separate 0x02 CSM module for compounding validators with balances up to 2,048 ETH as planned but not yet live.
updates.background_zh: 0x02 验证器基于 EIP-7251，该提案随以太坊 Pectra 升级引入，将验证器的最大有效余额从 32 ETH 提高到 2048 ETH，同时保留 32 ETH 的最低门槛。Lido 此前的文档曾提到计划推出独立的 0x02 CSM 模块，用于支持余额最高 2048 ETH 的复利验证器，但当时尚未上线。

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Lido launched 0x02 CSM, letting permissionless node operators run 0x02 validators with up to 2048 ETH effective balance by posting only a bond of 32 ETH for the first key and 30 ETH for each subsequent key, under an initial cap of 0.01% of Lido Core TVL, or about 32 keys.
updates.market_impact_en: The change touches the supply side of ETH staking: Lido is the largest liquid staking protocol, and a cheaper bond path for permissionless operators with consolidated 0x02 validators could alter how bonded stake scales and how LDO-linked economics are shared. With initial capacity capped at about 32 keys, immediate flow effects are limited and the main exposure is to staking-capacity and liquid-staking-token sentiment rather than near-term ETH liquidity.
updates.market_impact_zh: 这一变化影响 ETH 质押的供给侧：Lido 是规模最大的流动性质押协议，面向无需许可运营商、支持整合式 0x02 验证器的更低保证金路径，可能改变带保证金质押的扩张方式以及与 LDO 相关的经济分配。由于初期容量上限仅为约 32 个密钥，短期资金流动影响有限，主要暴露在于质押容量与流动性质押代币情绪层面，而非短期 ETH 流动性。

updates.what_changed_zh: Initia 联合创始人 Zon 表示，漏洞可能源于其基于 Cosmos SDK 的 MoveVM 中的 Day 0 漏洞，该漏洞允许攻击者在 Initia L1 上额外铸造代币，但原生代币 INIT 未受影响；在链暂停前，攻击者已通过增发并跨链转移的方式转出价值约 270 万美元的 AUSD、ETH 和 USDC。

updates.current_state_en: Initia's L1 mainnet and all Rollups remain paused; the team is coordinating with security researchers, validators and exchanges to assess impact, has not publicly confirmed the loss size or precise cause, and the restoration timeline is unclear; D2 Finance has disclosed details of the unbacked AUSD mint and cross-chain fund flows.

updates.what_changed_en: D2 Finance reported that the attacker exploited a Move function vulnerability to mint 2 million AUSD without backing and bridged approximately 1.4 million AUSD, 105 ETH and 1.08 million USDC to Ethereum, later consolidating about 1,135.5 ETH (~$2.73M); INIT briefly fell to around $0.115 before rebounding.
updates.what_changed_zh: D2 Finance 报告称，攻击者利用 Move 函数漏洞无抵押铸造 200 万 AUSD，并通过跨链转出约 140 万 AUSD、105 ETH 和 108 万 USDC 至以太坊，随后归集约 1,135.5 ETH（约 273 万美元）；INIT 价格短时跌至约 0.115 美元后回升。

updates.background_en: Initia is a blockchain network that lets developers choose among EVM, MoveVM and WasmVM within a single interoperable system; MoveVM is the virtual machine built for the Move language. LayerZero is a cross-chain messaging protocol used for asset movement between chains, while Noble and Circle's CCTP are rails for transferring USDC across networks. Initia said the security fix is expected to be completed and audited within a few days, and that a full post-mortem report will follow.
updates.background_zh: Initia 是一个允许开发者在同一互操作网络中选择 EVM、MoveVM 和 WasmVM 的区块链平台，MoveVM 是为 Move 语言构建的虚拟机。LayerZero 是用于跨链资产流转的消息协议，Noble 与 Circle 的 CCTP 则是跨网络转移 USDC 的通道。Initia 称安全修复预计将在数天内完成并通过审计，后续将发布完整事后复盘报告。
updates.current_state_en: Initia's L1 mainnet and all Rollups remain paused; the official disclosure confirms a MoveVM script-caching vulnerability was used to forge state and move about $2.7M, with related token total supply unaffected; a fix is expected within days and will be audited, asset recovery is ongoing, and a full postmortem has not yet been published.
updates.current_state_zh: Initia L1 主网及所有 Rollup 仍处于暂停状态；官方已确认漏洞为 MoveVM 脚本缓存漏洞，攻击者伪造状态转出约 270 万美元资产，相关代币总供应量未受影响；安全修复预计数日内完成并通过审计，资产追回进行中，完整事后复盘报告尚未发布。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Initia disclosed that attackers exploited a MoveVM script-caching vulnerability to forge state and drain about $2.7 million in WETH, AUSD0, and USDC, prompting a network-wide pause while fixes and asset recovery proceed.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Initia disclosed that attackers exploited a MoveVM script-caching vulnerability to forge state and drain about $2.7 million in WETH, AUSD0, and USDC, prompting a network-wide pause while fixes and asset recovery proceed.
updates.market_impact_en: The stolen assets left Initia through LayerZero, Noble and CCTP and were consolidated into 1,135.52 ETH on Ethereum, linking the loss to ETH liquidity and to the cross-chain messaging and USDC transfer rails involved. Although INIT's supply is unaffected, the continued L1 and Rollup pause halts on-chain activity and asset movement within the Initia ecosystem.
updates.market_impact_zh: 被盗资产经由 LayerZero、Noble 和 CCTP 转出 Initia，并在以太坊上归集为 1135.52 枚 ETH，使损失与 ETH 流动性以及相关跨链消息和 USDC 转账通道产生关联。尽管 INIT 供应量未受影响，L1 及 Rollup 仍处暂停状态，Initia 生态内的链上活动与资产流转随之中断。

updates.what_changed_en: Initia officially disclosed that the exploit was a MoveVM script-caching vulnerability that bypassed security checks and forged MoveVM state to credit unbacked WETH and USDC/iUSD-like assets without changing the related tokens' total supply; about $2.7M was moved out via LayerZero, Noble and CCTP and later consolidated into 1,135.52 ETH held at Ethereum address 0x358ef0130f7a5aa516dcd81bdc80b18cde41cac8; a security fix is expected within days and will be audited, asset recovery is ongoing, L1 and Rollups remain paused, and a full postmortem is pending.
updates.what_changed_zh: Initia 官方披露漏洞为 MoveVM 脚本缓存（script caching）漏洞，攻击者借此绕过安全检查并伪造 MoveVM 状态，记入无实际支撑的 WETH、iUSD/USDC 等资产，相关代币总供应量未发生变化；约 270 万美元资产经 LayerZero、Noble 和 CCTP 转出，随后兑换为 1,135.52 ETH 并存放于以太坊地址 0x358ef0130f7a5aa516dcd81bdc80b18cde41cac8；安全修复预计数日内完成并通过审计，资产追回工作仍在推进，L1 及 Rollup 继续暂停，完整事后复盘报告待发布。

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Initia plans to restore its L1 and rollups on November 2 with an audited MoveVM patch that isolates the attacker's remaining forged balances without rolling back transaction history, while restoring AUSD0, USDC.n, and WETH backing and rebalancing the DEX.
updates.title_en: 【Initia：L1 及 Rollup 计划于 11 月 2 日恢复运行，不回滚交易历史】
updates.title_zh: 【Initia：L1 及 Rollup 计划于 11 月 2 日恢复运行，不回滚交易历史】
updates.what_changed_en: Initia announced that its L1 and Rollups are scheduled to resume on November 2: the upgrade will deploy an independently audited MoveVM patch that isolates the attacker's remaining forged balances with additional safeguards and without rolling back transaction history; backing for AUSD0, USDC.n and WETH will be fully restored before restart with no user action required; the Initia DEX will pause briefly after restart for a designated account to rebalance pool prices to market with proceeds returned to affected LPs; bridges and exchanges will resume transfers after a period of network monitoring, and LayerZero OFT WETH and AUSD0 withdrawals will have a 24-hour delay.
updates.what_changed_zh: Initia 宣布 L1 及 Rollup 计划于 11 月 2 日恢复运行：升级将部署经独立审计的 MoveVM 补丁，隔离攻击者剩余的伪造余额并启用额外安全措施，且不回滚交易历史；AUSD0、USDC.n 及 WETH 的支撑资产将在重启前全部恢复，用户无需操作；Initia DEX 重启后将短暂暂停以由指定账户再平衡资金池价格并将收益返还受影响 LP；跨链桥与交易所将在网络监测一段时间后恢复转账，LayerZero OFT 版 WETH 及 AUSD0 提现时间设为 24 小时。

events.current_state_en: Kimi released K3.1 Pro and a K3.1 Pro Highspeed variant, pairing the launch with a stated policy of withholding open weights where they would push the frontier of offensive cyber capability, while commenters reported aggressive subscription quota limits and debated the open-weights rationale.
events.current_state_zh:
Kimi（月之暗面 Moonshot AI）发布 K3.1 Pro，并同时推出速度更快的“高速版”（Highspeed）变体，相关信息发布在 kimi.ai 的博客文章中。此次发布同时附带一项明确政策：不会开源那些会拓展进攻性网络能力绝对前沿的模型权重。

此次发布就哪些能力将被保留为闭源作出了明确的安全承诺，对于一家以开源权重著称的中国实验室而言，这是一个实质性的政策立场。同时有评论者反映，付费订阅套餐的额度很快就被耗尽。

根据被引用的政策表述，K3.1 Pro 的进攻性网络能力在设计上低于其研发管线所能达到的水平，并且仍落后于前沿闭源模型；同时该实验室表示计划逐步提升开源权重中可用的网络能力。评论者还讨论了 kimi.com 上的模型文档以及第三方模型对比页面。
events.title_en: Kimi K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed
events.title_zh: Kimi K3.1 Pro 与 K3.1 Pro 高速版

updates.background_en: Moonshot AI previously shipped Kimi K3, described on Hugging Face as a 2.8-trillion-parameter open-weight, native multimodal agentic model with a 1-million-token context window. The UK AI Safety Institute published a preliminary assessment of Kimi K3's cyber capabilities, and the K3 open-weight release drew scrutiny from frontier labs and policymakers over distillation and cyber-testing concerns.
updates.background_zh: 月之暗面此前发布了 Kimi K3，Hugging Face 页面将其描述为参数规模 2.8 万亿的开源权重原生多模态智能体模型，具备 100 万 token 上下文窗口。英国 AI 安全研究所（UK AISI）曾发布对 Kimi K3 网络能力的初步评估，而 K3 的开源发布也因蒸馏与网络测试等问题引发前沿实验室和政策制定者的关注。
updates.community_discussion_en: A commenter said a $99/month subscription hit its 5-hour quota within 47 minutes in a single session, and warned others to adjust expectations about usable limits. Others debated the open-weights rationale, asking why the lab would acknowledge it could produce stronger cyber capability but decline to do so, while one questioned how a 1–2TB closed frontier model could realistically be distilled. A developer reported K3.1 Pro as a large improvement over K3 and the highest-scoring open-weight model on their adversarial programming-language benchmark, though slower than Gemini 4 Argon and Fable 5.1.
updates.community_discussion_zh: 有评论者称，其每月 99 美元的订阅在一次会话中 47 分钟内就触及了 5 小时额度上限，并提醒他人调低对可用额度的预期。其他人则围绕开源权重的理由展开争论，质疑既然承认自己能够做出更强的网络能力为何又选择不做；也有人好奇，一个 1–2TB 的闭源前沿模型在现实中如何被蒸馏。一位开发者报告称，K3.1 Pro 相比 K3 有显著提升，在其对抗性编程语言基准上是得分最高的开源权重模型，但速度慢于 Gemini 4 Argon 和 Fable 5.1。

updates.detailed_summary_en: Kimi released K3.1 Pro and a K3.1 Pro Highspeed variant, pairing the launch with a stated policy of withholding open weights where they would push the frontier of offensive cyber capability, while commenters reported aggressive subscription quota limits and debated the open-weights rationale.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Kimi released K3.1 Pro and a K3.1 Pro Highspeed variant, pairing the launch with a stated policy of withholding open weights where they would push the frontier of offensive cyber capability, while commenters reported aggressive subscription quota limits and debated the open-weights rationale.
updates.market_impact_en: The release matters to the open-weight inference segment: a stronger Kimi model expands the pool of capable models that can be self-hosted or served by third-party providers, which pressures the economics of closed API access. The stated policy of withholding weights for frontier offensive-cyber capability also signals that open-weight distribution by Chinese labs is increasingly conditioned on safety and policy considerations, a factor for anyone building on those weights.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次发布对开源权重推理市场具有意义：更强的 Kimi 模型扩大了可自托管或由第三方托管的高能力模型池，从而对闭源 API 的经济性形成压力。与此同时，针对前沿进攻性网络能力保留权重不开源的政策表态，也表明中国实验室的开源分发正越来越多地受到安全与政策考量的约束，这对基于这些权重进行开发的团队是一项需要纳入考量的因素。

events.current_state_en: Israeli PM Netanyahu said he has requested a plan to use cryptocurrency and blockchain networks to bypass possible banking sanctions, while warning that U.S. defense aid will eventually end.
events.current_state_zh:
以色列总理内塔尼亚胡在周五播出的采访中表示，他已要求制定一项使用区块链的方案，以帮助以色列应对未来可能面临的经济制裁，包括对本国银行体系的限制。当被问及区块链能否作为应对制裁的替代方案时，他回应称这是可考虑的途径之一，但未透露由哪个机构负责、涉及哪条区块链或哪种数字货币，也未给出时间表。

这是美国盟友国家现任总理少有的公开把区块链与制裁应急预案联系起来的表态，使“主权国家用加密通道维持金融运转”这一议题被正式提上台面。但目前尚未公布任何政策、预算或执行机构。

内塔尼亚胡还警告称，美国对以色列的军事援助不可能无限期持续，以色列必须降低对外部支持的依赖；他表示未来数年将额外拨出4000亿谢克尔（约合1290亿美元）用于国防，并加强弹药和武器的本土生产能力。据援引10月23日播出的报道，该采访由以色列第10频道播出。
events.title_en: Netanyahu Considering Crypto Plan to Dodge Banking Sanctions on Israel
events.title_zh: 内塔尼亚胡称以色列正研究加密货币，以应对可能到来的制裁

updates.background_en: The remarks come as Western pressure on Israel increases and as governments and blockchain-analytics firms have documented growing use of digital assets by sanctioned states and actors to move value around banking restrictions. Iran has previously floated its own cryptocurrency proposals as a way to work around sanctions, a model that has drawn scrutiny from compliance and sanctions-enforcement bodies.
updates.background_zh: 此番表态之际，以色列面临的西方压力正在上升；各国政府与区块链分析机构也已记录到，受制裁国家和行为体越来越多地利用数字资产绕开银行限制转移价值。伊朗此前曾提出自己的加密货币方案以规避制裁，这一模式已引起合规与制裁执法机构的关注。

updates.market_impact_en: If a sovereign contingency plan moves from rhetoric to design, the exposure runs through sanctions-compliance rather than price: exchanges, custodians and stablecoin issuers handling Israeli or linked flows would face heightened screening expectations, while crypto's perceived role as a sanctions-resilience tool adds a geopolitical risk premium to the sector's regulatory narrative. Nothing has been enacted, so no market segment faces an immediate rule change.
updates.market_impact_zh: 如果主权层面的应急预案从表态走向设计，影响将主要经由制裁合规渠道而非价格传导：处理以色列相关资金流的交易所、托管机构和稳定币发行方可能面临更严格的审查要求；同时，加密资产被视为“抗制裁工具”这一叙事会给该行业的监管环境增添地缘政治风险溢价。目前尚无任何政策落地，因此暂无市场板块面临即时规则变化。

events.current_state_en: Block's Dessa is a full-duplex speech model trained solely on human conversation recordings that runs locally on MacBook Pro with M4 Max or higher; it is available only as early access to select AI safety researchers, with no parameter count, benchmark results, or model weights released.
events.current_state_zh: Block 的 Dessa 是一款全双工语音模型，完全基于人类对话录音训练，可在搭载 M4 Max 或更高芯片的 MacBook Pro 上本地运行；目前仅向少量 AI 安全研究人员提供早期访问，尚未公布参数量、标准测试成绩和权重。
events.title_en: Dessa: the most authentic full-duplex speech model ever built
events.title_zh: Dessa：迄今最真实的全身双工语音模型

updates.background_en: Full-duplex speech models process incoming audio while generating speech, allowing overlapping dialogue and dynamic turn-taking rather than strict turn-based exchanges. The NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 is a liquid-cooled, rack-scale system that links 36 Grace CPUs and 72 Blackwell GPUs via NVLink-C2C, introduced as part of NVIDIA's Blackwell platform.
updates.background_zh: 全双工语音模型在生成语音的同时处理输入音频，从而支持对话重叠和动态轮流发言，而非严格的轮流对话。NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 是液冷机架级系统，通过 NVLink-C2C 连接 36 颗 Grace CPU 与 72 颗 Blackwell GPU，属于 NVIDIA Blackwell 平台的一部分。
updates.community_discussion_en: Hacker News commenters were struck by the claim of low-latency local inference on a MacBook Pro paired with single-rack training, calling it an impressive feat for smaller-scale AI work. Others pushed back on the demos, arguing the model interrupts too aggressively and the added laugh in the first sample felt artificial, and several raised concern that such voices would be hard to distinguish from humans on a fraudulent call.
updates.community_discussion_zh: Hacker News 的评论者对“MacBook Pro 上低时延本地推理”加上“单机架训练”的说法印象深刻，认为这对非头部团队的 AI 工作而言是了不起的成就。也有人对演示提出质疑，认为模型打断得过于频繁，第一个示例中额外加入的笑声显得做作；还有多位评论者担心，这类语音在诈骗电话中几乎无法与真人区分。
updates.current_state_en: Block's Dessa is presented as the most authentic full-duplex speech model yet, combining low-latency expressive conversation with local inference on a MacBook Pro M4 Max and training on just one NVIDIA GB200 NVL72.
updates.current_state_zh:
Block 发布 Dessa，一款可同时聆听与说话的全双工语音模型，并称其为迄今最逼真的同类模型。该公司表示，Dessa 可在 MacBook Pro M4 Max 或更高配置的设备上本地运行，并且仅用一台 NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 完成训练。

如果这些说法成立，把自然的打断处理与低时延和消费级笔记本上的本地推理结合起来，将是语音 AI 在部署层面的一次重要进展，使实时语音智能体不再依赖云端基础设施。不过该发布属于厂商公告，尚未有第三方基准测试支撑。

Block 将该模型描述为兼具高表现力与低时延，并强调仅使用一台 GB200 NVL72 机架完成训练的效率。公告未提供独立的时延、质量或硬件需求测量数据。

updates.market_impact_en: The direct channel to crypto markets is voice-fraud risk: locally run, highly expressive duplex speech lowers the cost of impersonation attacks that target exchange account recovery, customer-support lines and wallet-holder verification. Any broader effect depends on whether voice-agent deployments shift toward on-device inference, which would reduce reliance on cloud voice infrastructure.
updates.market_impact_zh: 与加密市场最直接的传导渠道是语音诈骗风险：可在本地运行、表现力极强的全双工语音会降低冒充攻击的成本，而这类攻击针对的正是交易所账户找回、客服热线和钱包持有人身份核验。更广泛的影响则取决于语音智能体部署是否转向端侧推理，从而减少对云端语音基础设施的依赖。

updates.what_changed_zh:
Block 发布 Dessa，一款可同时聆听与说话的全双工语音模型，并称其为迄今最逼真的同类模型。该公司表示，Dessa 可在 MacBook Pro M4 Max 或更高配置的设备上本地运行，并且仅用一台 NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 完成训练。

如果这些说法成立，把自然的打断处理与低时延和消费级笔记本上的本地推理结合起来，将是语音 AI 在部署层面的一次重要进展，使实时语音智能体不再依赖云端基础设施。不过该发布属于厂商公告，尚未有第三方基准测试支撑。

Block 将该模型描述为兼具高表现力与低时延，并强调仅使用一台 GB200 NVL72 机架完成训练的效率。公告未提供独立的时延、质量或硬件需求测量数据。

events.current_state_en: Franklin Templeton added roughly $150 million in tokenized money-market fund shares to XRP Ledger, increasing sgBENJI supply there to about 193 million tokens worth approximately $200 million, all held in a single wallet.
events.current_state_zh:
据 CoinDesk 报道，富兰克林邓普顿（Franklin Templeton）向 XRP Ledger 新增约 1.5 亿美元的代币化货币市场基金份额，使该网络上的 sgBENJI 代币总量从约 4800 万枚增至 1.93 亿枚。按交易记录中每份 1.039 美元计算，总价值约 2 亿美元，且全部存放于单一钱包。

此举使该基金在 XRP Ledger 上的规模接近原来的四倍，意味着这家美国大型资产管理公司将代币化货币市场基金产品从最初的 Stellar 网络扩展到更多公链。

这些代币全部集中于单一钱包，报道提及了这一持仓结构，但未说明对应的托管方或具体客户。富兰克林邓普顿的 BENJI 是首只以公链作为登记系统的美国注册货币市场基金，sgBENJI 也被 RWA.xyz 作为代币化基金资产进行追踪。

updates.background_en: Franklin Templeton runs BENJI, a proprietary blockchain-integrated recordkeeping system that supports tokenized mutual fund shares on public blockchain infrastructure, including hot and cold wallet setups through its Benji Investments app. BENJI launched on Stellar, and in April 2026 the firm and the Stellar Development Foundation marked five years of the product. In a separate arrangement, DBS and Franklin Templeton announced trading and lending solutions for sgBENJI on DBS Digital Exchange using Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin, with DBS to explore accepting sgBENJI as collateral.
updates.background_zh: 富兰克林邓普顿运营 BENJI 这一自有的区块链集成登记系统，可在公链基础设施上支持代币化共同基金份额，并通过 Benji Investments 应用提供热钱包与冷钱包环境。BENJI 最初在 Stellar 上线，2026 年 4 月该公司与 Stellar 发展基金会共同纪念该产品推出五周年。另有一项安排中，星展银行（DBS）与富兰克林邓普顿宣布在 DBS Digital Exchange 上使用 Ripple 的 RLUSD 稳定币进行 sgBENJI 的交易与借贷方案，星展银行还将探索允许 sgBENJI 作为抵押品。

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Franklin Templeton added roughly $150 million in tokenized money-market fund shares to XRP Ledger, increasing sgBENJI supply there to about 193 million tokens worth approximately $200 million, all held in a single wallet.
updates.market_impact_en: The addition expands the tokenized Treasury/money-market segment on XRP Ledger, where the size of on-chain RWA supply is a key input for stablecoin and lending activity; sgBENJI's integration with RLUSD on DBS Digital Exchange and planned collateral use give the token a potential role in XRPL-based liquidity and credit, though the single-wallet concentration limits any immediate circulation effect.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次增发扩大了 XRP Ledger 上的代币化国债/货币市场基金板块，而链上 RWA 规模是衡量该网络稳定币与借贷活跃度的重要变量；sgBENJI 在 DBS Digital Exchange 上已与 RLUSD 打通，并计划用于抵押，使其可能在 XRPL 的流动性与信贷场景中发挥作用，不过全部集中于单一钱包也意味着短期内流通层面的影响有限。

events.current_state_en: Swell paused swETH and rswETH deposits and withdrawals after the tokens' contract exchange rates ran abnormally high, with an analyst suspecting compromised admin keys and a not-yet-executed malicious upgrade contract affecting around 2,500 ETH.
events.current_state_zh:
以太坊质押协议 Swell 已暂停 swETH 与 rswETH 的存款和取款，直至两个代币的净资产值（NAV）与汇率得到修正。数据显示，swETH 与 rswETH 合约报告的汇率分别约为 1.203 ETH 和 1.138 ETH，比正常水平高出约 6% 和 5%。

链上分析师 Spreek 怀疑相关代币的管理私钥已被攻破，并指认出一份可能影响约 2,500 ETH 的恶意升级合约，但该升级尚未被执行。暂停存取款意味着两种代币的持有者暂时无法通过该协议赎回资产。

Swell 表示，目前没有 ETH 从受影响合约中被转出，确切原因仍在调查中。截至报道时，被怀疑的恶意升级尚未执行。
events.title_en: Swell Pauses swETH and rswETH Deposits and Withdrawals Amid Abnormally High Cont
events.title_zh: 合约汇率异常偏高，Swell 暂停 swETH 与 rswETH 的存取款

updates.background_en: swETH is Swell's liquid staking token, a tradable receipt for ETH staked on Ethereum that accrues value through a rising exchange rate rather than rebasing; rswETH is the restaked version, whose underlying ETH is also deployed in restaking markets. Because these tokens price via a contract-reported exchange rate, an abnormal rate feeds directly into DeFi valuations and collateral calculations. Swell has expanded from pure liquid staking into restaking as part of its product line.
updates.background_zh: swETH 是 Swell 的流动性质押代币，代表在以太坊上质押的 ETH 的可交易凭证，其价值通过不断上升的汇率而非再基准（rebase）来累积；rswETH 则是再质押版本，其底层 ETH 同时被投入再质押市场。由于这类代币通过合约报告的汇率定价，汇率异常会直接影响到 DeFi 估值与抵押品计算。Swell 已从纯粹的流动性质押扩展到再质押业务。
updates.current_state_en: Swell paused swETH and rswETH deposits and withdrawals after the tokens' contract exchange rates ran abnormally high, with an analyst suspecting compromised admin keys and a not-yet-executed malicious upgrade contract affecting around 2,500 ETH.
updates.current_state_zh:
以太坊质押协议 Swell 已暂停 swETH 与 rswETH 的存款和取款，直至两个代币的净资产值（NAV）与汇率得到修正。数据显示，swETH 与 rswETH 合约报告的汇率分别约为 1.203 ETH 和 1.138 ETH，比正常水平高出约 6% 和 5%。

链上分析师 Spreek 怀疑相关代币的管理私钥已被攻破，并指认出一份可能影响约 2,500 ETH 的恶意升级合约，但该升级尚未被执行。暂停存取款意味着两种代币的持有者暂时无法通过该协议赎回资产。

Swell 表示，目前没有 ETH 从受影响合约中被转出，确切原因仍在调查中。截至报道时，被怀疑的恶意升级尚未执行。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Swell paused swETH and rswETH deposits and withdrawals after the tokens' contract exchange rates ran abnormally high, with an analyst suspecting compromised admin keys and a not-yet-executed malicious upgrade contract affecting around 2,500 ETH.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Swell paused swETH and rswETH deposits and withdrawals after the tokens' contract exchange rates ran abnormally high, with an analyst suspecting compromised admin keys and a not-yet-executed malicious upgrade contract affecting around 2,500 ETH.
updates.market_impact_en: swETH and rswETH are widely used as DeFi collateral, so a paused redemption window plus a mispriced exchange rate can disrupt lending-market valuations and secondary-market pricing for the two tokens while the fix is pending. The flagged exposure of roughly 2,500 ETH is confined to Swell's own contracts rather than a protocol-wide or market-wide event at this stage.
updates.market_impact_zh: swETH 与 rswETH 被广泛用作 DeFi 抵押品，因此在修复完成前，赎回通道暂停叠加汇率错报，可能扰动相关借贷市场的估值以及这两种代币的二级市场价格。目前被指出的风险敞口约为 2,500 ETH，局限于 Swell 自身合约，尚不属于波及整个协议或全市场的事件。

events.current_state_en: Cerebras detailed how it deploys trillion-parameter frontier AI models on its wafer-scale systems, covering pipeline streaming and hardware utilization for high-throughput inference.
events.current_state_zh:
Cerebras 发布技术博客，说明其如何在其晶圆级系统上部署并服务万亿参数前沿模型，内容涵盖流水线架构、晶圆之间仅通过以太网 RDMA 传递激活值的互连策略，以及不同于 GPU 批处理的持续请求流式处理方式。该文章在 Hacker News 引发讨论（223 分、69 条评论），对其基准测试方法与预填充性能的说法提出质疑。

该文罕见地公开描述了如何在非 GPU 的晶圆级硬件上服务前沿规模模型，而 Hacker News 的评论者对其性能论证的部分内容提出了直接质疑。

评论者指出，文章引用了全精度基准测试结果，但实际服务的模型采用的是 4 比特量化；文章也未说明预填充阶段如何在 RDMA 互连上保持高速。还有人追问，所谓“不同于 GPU 批处理”的流式行为究竟是 GPU 的硬件限制，还是缺少相应的软件支撑框架。
events.title_en: Cerebras Deploys Trillion-Parameter AI Models
events.title_zh: Cerebras 部署万亿参数 AI 模型

updates.background_en: Cerebras builds wafer-scale engines — the WSE-3, and the WSE-3T that powers its CS-4 rack-scale system — and sells access to them through AI training and inference cloud APIs. Serving models of trillion-parameter scale typically involves disaggregated prefill and decode workers that exchange KV-cache data over a network, a pattern the Cerebras post discusses for its own hardware.
updates.background_zh: Cerebras 研发晶圆级引擎——包括 WSE-3，以及用于驱动 CS-4 机架级系统的 WSE-3T——并通过 AI 训练云与推理云 API 对外提供算力访问。服务万亿参数级模型通常需要将预填充与解码拆分为不同的工作节点，并通过网络交换 KV 缓存数据，Cerebras 的文章正是围绕其自有硬件讨论这一模式。
updates.community_discussion_en: Sentiment was skeptical but technically engaged. One user said Cerebras is fast in practice but often wrong on the models they can access (GPT OSS 120B, Qwen3 27B) and that OpenRouter offers better models at roughly one-fifth the throughput; others challenged the use of full-precision benchmarks alongside 4-bit serving and the unexplained prefill latency over the interconnect.
updates.community_discussion_zh: 讨论整体持怀疑态度，但技术性较强。一位用户表示，Cerebras 在实际使用中速度确实很快，但对其可访问的模型（GPT OSS 120B、Qwen3 27B）来说答案经常出错，而 OpenRouter 提供的模型更好、吞吐约为其五分之一；其他人则质疑文章一边引用全精度基准、一边以 4 比特精度服务模型，以及互连上未加解释的预填充延迟。

updates.detailed_summary_en: Cerebras detailed how it deploys trillion-parameter frontier AI models on its wafer-scale systems, covering pipeline streaming and hardware utilization for high-throughput inference.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Cerebras detailed how it deploys trillion-parameter frontier AI models on its wafer-scale systems, covering pipeline streaming and hardware utilization for high-throughput inference.
updates.market_impact_en: The claims sit on the inference-cost side of the AI compute market: if wafer-scale serving delivers the stated throughput, it competes with GPU-based serving stacks for hosted inference of large open-weight models, a segment where per-token pricing is the main competitive lever. The disputed benchmark and prefill points mean the efficiency comparison remains unverified by independent measurement.
updates.market_impact_zh: 相关说法落在 AI 算力市场的推理成本环节：若晶圆级服务能达到其所称的吞吐，它将在大型开放权重模型的托管推理上与基于 GPU 的服务栈展开竞争，而该领域的主要竞争杠杆正是每 token 价格。由于基准测试与预填充性能存在争议，这一效率对比尚未经过独立测度验证。

If approved, this would be the fourth postponement since 2020.

events.current_state_en: Paradigm has open-sourced evm2, an audited Rust EVM with built-in JIT compilation that claims up to 2x the execution speed of revm and allows customizing opcodes, gas rules, transaction types and precompiles, with planned adoption across Foundry, Reth and Tempo.
events.current_state_zh:
Paradigm 合伙人兼首席技术官 Georgios Konstantopoulos 在 X 上表示，团队即将推出一款已完成审计、内置即时编译（JIT）的新 EVM，名为 evm2，代码已在 GitHub 公开。evm2 是一个用 Rust 编写的 EVM 实现，开发者可在不改动核心代码的情况下自定义操作码、Gas 规则、交易类型和预编译合约；其 README 页面称执行速度最高可达当前主流 Rust EVM 实现 revm 的 2 倍。

据 Konstantopoulos 的说法，evm2 未来将应用于 Foundry、Reth、Tempo 以及所有采用其技术栈的 EVM 生态项目，而这三者目前均基于 revm 构建。

审计被描述为已完成，但发布口径是“即将推出”，而非已经上线。2 倍的速度数字来自仓库 README 的表述，并非经独立验证的基准测试结果。

events.title_zh: 【Paradigm CTO：内置 JIT 编译的新 EVM 已完成审计】

updates.background_en: Reth is the Ethereum execution client developed by Paradigm, Foundry is an EVM smart-contract development framework, and Tempo is a payments chain incubated by Stripe and Paradigm. All three are currently built on revm, a widely used Rust EVM implementation that is integrated into Reth, multiple Layer 2 networks and much of the ecosystem's tooling and block-building infrastructure.
updates.background_zh: Reth 是 Paradigm 开发的以太坊执行客户端，Foundry 是 EVM 智能合约开发框架，Tempo 是 Stripe 与 Paradigm 孵化的支付公链。三者目前均基于 revm 构建，而 revm 是被广泛使用的 Rust EVM 实现，已被集成进 Reth、多个 Layer 2 网络以及生态内大量工具与区块构建基础设施中。
updates.current_state_en: Paradigm has open-sourced evm2, an audited Rust EVM with built-in JIT compilation that claims up to 2x the execution speed of revm and allows customizing opcodes, gas rules, transaction types and precompiles, with planned adoption across Foundry, Reth and Tempo.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Paradigm has open-sourced evm2, an audited Rust EVM with built-in JIT compilation that claims up to 2x the execution speed of revm and allows customizing opcodes, gas rules, transaction types and precompiles, with planned adoption across Foundry, Reth and Tempo.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Paradigm has open-sourced evm2, an audited Rust EVM with built-in JIT compilation that claims up to 2x the execution speed of revm and allows customizing opcodes, gas rules, transaction types and precompiles, with planned adoption across Foundry, Reth and Tempo.
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through execution-client and developer-tooling performance rather than through any asset: faster EVM execution and configurable gas rules or precompiles affect node operators, block builders and teams building on Reth, Foundry or Tempo. Because this is an infrastructure release and not a live protocol change, it does not directly alter on-chain supply, custody or liquidity conditions.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于执行客户端与开发者工具的性能，而非某一资产本身：更快的 EVM 执行速度以及可自定义的 Gas 规则和预编译合约，会影响节点运营方、区块构建者以及基于 Reth、Foundry 或 Tempo 开发的团队。由于这是一次基础设施层面的发布而非线上协议变更，它不会直接改变链上供应、托管或流动性状况。

events.current_state_en: Hyperliquid will list 11 USDC-denominated HIP-1 spot markets for EQX Labs-issued tokenized US stocks and ETFs, including S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 trackers and single-name exposure to Nvidia, Tesla, Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, Meta, Micron and SpaceX, with trading opening October 26 at 21:30 Beijing time.
events.current_state_zh:
Hyperliquid 将上线由 EQX Labs 发行的代币化美股与 ETF，首批共 11 个以 USDC 计价的 HIP-1 现货市场，标的包括追踪标普 500 与纳斯达克 100 的 EQSPY、EQQQQ，以及对应英伟达、特斯拉、苹果、微软、亚马逊、Alphabet、Meta、美光与 SpaceX 的单一标的。相关代币已在 Hyperliquid 主网注册上线，但撮合交易要到北京时间 10 月 26 日 21:30（美东时间同日 9:30）才正式开启。

此次上线使这一大型链上衍生品交易平台新增代币化股票资产类别，让主要美股与指数追踪标的在传统交易时段之外也能在链上交易。不过交易尚未开始，流动性和监管反应均未经过检验。

EQX 称每个代币由真实股份 1:1 支持，但法律结构为英属维尔京群岛隔离组合公司发行的有限追索权债务凭证，而非直接持有股票，且不对美国人士开放。

updates.background_en: Hyperliquid operates 300+ perpetual and spot markets fully onchain and non-custodial, according to its own platform description. Tokenized equities have expanded over the past year through products such as Backed Finance's xStocks, which are backed 1:1 by underlying equities held in custody and distributed via venues including Kraken and Bybit.
updates.background_zh: 据 Hyperliquid 平台自述，其运营 300 多个永续与现货市场，全部在链上运行且为非托管模式。过去一年代币化股票持续扩张，例如 Backed Finance 的 xStocks 由托管持有的标的股票 1:1 支持，并通过 Kraken、Bybit 等平台分发。

updates.detailed_summary_en: Hyperliquid will list 11 USDC-denominated HIP-1 spot markets for EQX Labs-issued tokenized US stocks and ETFs, including S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 trackers and single-name exposure to Nvidia, Tesla, Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, Meta, Micron and SpaceX, with trading opening October 26 at 21:30 Beijing time.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Hyperliquid will list 11 USDC-denominated HIP-1 spot markets for EQX Labs-issued tokenized US stocks and ETFs, including S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 trackers and single-name exposure to Nvidia, Tesla, Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, Meta, Micron and SpaceX, with trading opening October 26 at 21:30 Beijing time.
updates.market_impact_en: The move channels spot demand for US equity and index exposure into Hyperliquid's USDC-settled order books, tying the venue's spot liquidity and HYPE-denominated activity to tokenized-equity flows that can run around the clock. The BVI debt-note structure and exclusion of US persons mean the exposure sits with offshore and non-US participants, leaving the product's regulatory footing a variable for the broader tokenized-equity segment.
updates.market_impact_zh: 这一举措把对美股与指数敞口的现货需求引入 Hyperliquid 以 USDC 结算的订单簿，使该平台的现货流动性与以 HYPE 计价的活动同可全天候运行的代币化股票资金流挂钩。BVI 债务凭证结构与排除美国人士意味着敞口主要落在离岸及非美国参与者身上，产品监管基础仍是整个代币化股票赛道的一个变量。

events.current_state_en: Keystone is remediating the October 20 website breach: the authentication key was stolen, old-key device authentication is invalid, and 18,835 inventory devices are to be destroyed; all shipments are suspended and affected devices are quarantined across all warehouses, including Amazon; it confirmed 25,964 buyer records and 12,873 checkout records were leaked and has requested Shopify delete related data; logistics data retention is cut to 90 days with on-request deletion after order receipt; devices delivered before October 20 are considered safe, while devices delivered afterward require additional verification.
events.current_state_zh: Keystone 正在处置 10 月 20 日官网入侵事件：认证密钥被窃，旧密钥设备认证失效，18,835 台库存设备将销毁；所有发货已暂停，受影响设备在包括亚马逊在内的所有仓库被隔离；已确认 25,964 条买家记录及 12,873 条结账记录泄露，并请求 Shopify 删除相关数据；物流数据保留期缩短至 90 天并支持收货后按请求删除；10 月 20 日前交付设备仍视为安全，此后交付设备需额外验证。
