According to Chainalysis, an Ethereum chain reorganization on the morning of October 31 (EDT) caused THORChain to mistakenly issue a double refund to a user who had deposited 10 ETH, prompting an emergency pause.

The pause blocks cross-chain swaps for all users across most of THORChain's bridges. Chainalysis said the halt also inadvertently delayed the laundering of a significant amount of funds stolen from Binance.

Chainalysis attributed the trigger specifically to an Ethereum chain reorganization, a event in which previously accepted blocks are replaced by a competing chain. No loss figures for the incident have been confirmed in the supplied material.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
在报告出现退款机制错误后，THORChain 的跨链兑换功能在 12 条支持的链上仍处于暂停状态。据 Chainalysis 称，10 月 31 日上午（美国东部时间）以太坊发生的一次链重组，导致 THORChain 错误地向一名存入 10 ETH 的用户进行了双重退款，从而触发了紧急暂停。

此次暂停使所有用户在 THORChain 的大部分桥上无法进行跨链兑换。Chainalysis 表示，这一暂停也意外延缓了一笔从 Binance 窃取的大额资金的洗钱活动。

Chainalysis 将触发原因具体归结为以太坊链重组，即此前已被接受的区块被竞争链上的区块所取代的事件。在现有材料中，尚未确认该事件造成的损失金额。

item.author: The Defiant
item.content: Aave Freezes tBTC Reserve After Threshold Pauses Minting and Redemptions  The Defiant

metadata.background: tBTC is Threshold Network's decentralized wrapped-Bitcoin token: users deposit BTC and receive an ERC-20 representation minted by a node network, which can then be bridged to chains such as Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, Polygon and Solana. It competes with custodial wrappers such as WBTC and cbBTC on the strength of its trust model rather than a single custodian. Aave is one of the venues where wrapped bitcoin is posted as collateral for borrowing.
metadata.background_en: tBTC is Threshold Network's decentralized wrapped-Bitcoin token: users deposit BTC and receive an ERC-20 representation minted by a node network, which can then be bridged to chains such as Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, Polygon and Solana. It competes with custodial wrappers such as WBTC and cbBTC on the strength of its trust model rather than a single custodian. Aave is one of the venues where wrapped bitcoin is posted as collateral for borrowing.
metadata.background_zh: tBTC 是 Threshold Network 推出的去中心化封装比特币：用户存入 BTC 后，由节点网络铸造对应的 ERC-20 代币，随后可跨链至 Arbitrum、Base、Optimism、Polygon 和 Solana 等网络。它以信任模型而非单一托管方为卖点，与 WBTC、cbBTC 等托管型封装资产形成竞争。Aave 是封装比特币被用作借款抵押品的平台之一。
metadata.detailed_summary:
Threshold paused minting and redemptions of tBTC, its wrapped-Bitcoin asset, and Aave responded by freezing its tBTC reserve as a precautionary measure against bad debt and collateral risk. The halt affects a wrapped-Bitcoin asset that is integrated across multiple DeFi venues, including Aave's lending market.

Aave's action makes the disruption visible on the largest lending venue where tBTC is used, since a reserve freeze is an asset-specific risk action rather than a routine parameter adjustment. Losses from the Threshold halt have not been quantified.

On Aave, a reserve freeze disables new supply and borrow operations for a single market while leaving repayments and withdrawals active, so existing tBTC positions can still be unwound subject to liquidity. Threshold's bridge relies on a decentralized set of node operators using threshold cryptography to mint and redeem tBTC.
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Threshold paused minting and redemptions of tBTC, its wrapped-Bitcoin asset, and Aave responded by freezing its tBTC reserve as a precautionary measure against bad debt and collateral risk. The halt affects a wrapped-Bitcoin asset that is integrated across multiple DeFi venues, including Aave's lending market.

Aave's action makes the disruption visible on the largest lending venue where tBTC is used, since a reserve freeze is an asset-specific risk action rather than a routine parameter adjustment. Losses from the Threshold halt have not been quantified.

On Aave, a reserve freeze disables new supply and borrow operations for a single market while leaving repayments and withdrawals active, so existing tBTC positions can still be unwound subject to liquidity. Threshold's bridge relies on a decentralized set of node operators using threshold cryptography to mint and redeem tBTC.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Threshold 暂停了其封装比特币资产 tBTC 的铸造与赎回，Aave 随后冻结了 tBTC 储备，作为防范坏账与抵押品风险的一项预防性措施。此次暂停涉及的封装比特币资产已被多个 DeFi 平台集成，其中包括 Aave 的借贷市场。

Aave 的举措使这一中断在其 tBTC 被使用的主要借贷平台上直接显现，因为冻结储备属于针对单一资产的风险处置，而非例行的参数调整。Threshold 暂停所造成的损失目前尚未量化。

在 Aave 上，冻结储备会关闭单一市场的新增存款与借款操作，但保留还款与提现功能，因此现有 tBTC 头寸在流动性允许的情况下仍可退出。Threshold 的跨链桥依赖一组使用门限密码学的去中心化节点运营商来完成 tBTC 的铸造与赎回。
metadata.gn_query: site:thedefiant.io
metadata.market_impact_en: The transmission runs through collateral and liquidity: tBTC posted on Aave can no longer be newly supplied or borrowed against, and a prolonged mint/redeem halt would leave redemptions of the underlying BTC dependent on the bridge resuming. Related exposure sits in wrapped-Bitcoin markets more broadly, where WBTC, cbBTC and tBTC compete for the same collateral demand and where sentiment reacts to any bridge-level disruption.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于抵押品与流动性：已在 Aave 上的 tBTC 无法新增存入或用于新借款，而若铸造与赎回长期暂停，底层 BTC 的兑付将取决于跨链桥能否恢复。相关敞口更广泛地存在于封装比特币市场——WBTC、cbBTC 与 tBTC 争夺同一块抵押需求，且市场情绪对任何跨链桥层面的中断都较为敏感。

metadata.detailed_summary:
DeepSeek has open-sourced its Agent base architecture, according to QbitAI, which framed the release around AI agents that can autonomously locate bugs and submit pull requests. Search descriptions identify the released component as DeepSeek Harness, an open-source agent runtime rather than a new model.

An open-source agent runtime from a major model lab gives developers a self-hostable base for building coding agents instead of assembling that scaffolding themselves or depending on a vendor's hosted product.

Descriptions of the harness say it is built on Cordis's “everything is a plugin” architecture and provides sessions, tools, workspaces, sandboxing, plugins, agent loops, plus web and terminal interfaces; experimental items listed include agent teams, auto approval review and scheduled tasks. The QbitAI item itself carries little technical detail beyond the autonomous bug-finding and PR-submission claim.

头部模型厂商开源 Agent 运行时，意味着开发者可以直接在可自托管的底座上构建编码智能体，而不必自行拼装这套脚手架，也不必依赖厂商的托管产品。

对这套 Harness 的介绍称，它基于 Cordis 的“一切皆插件”架构，提供会话、工具、工作区、沙箱、插件、Agent 循环以及网页与终端界面；被标注为实验性的功能包括 Agent 团队、自动审批审核和定时任务。量子位的报道本身除“自主找 Bug 并提交 PR”之外，技术细节较少。

item.content: BTCPay Server Urges Shutdown After Reports of Hot-Wallet Sweeps  The Defiant

metadata.background: BTCPay Server is a free, open-source, self-hosted Bitcoin payment processor that lets merchants accept payments without fees or intermediaries, with keys remaining in the merchant's hands — which typically means running a Bitcoin node. A "sweep" normally describes moving excess funds out of an operational hot wallet into a safer destination; in this case the sweeps are reported as unauthorized. BTCPay's own incident write-up frames the fix around version 2.4.2 and LND macaroon regeneration.

metadata.background_zh: BTCPay Server 是一款免费、开源、自托管的比特币支付处理器，让商户无需手续费和中介即可收款，私钥始终掌握在商户手中——这通常意味着要自行运行一个比特币节点。“扫空”（sweep）通常指将运营热钱包中的多余资金转移到更安全的地址；而在本次事件中，这些转移被报告为未经授权。BTCPay 官方的事件说明将修复措施集中在 2.4.2 版本与重新生成 LND macaroon 上。
metadata.detailed_summary:
BTCPay Server, the open-source self-hosted Bitcoin payment processor, advised operators to shut down their instances after reports that hot wallets tied to the software were being swept, indicating an active security incident affecting Bitcoin merchants. The project's guidance also directed operators to update to version 2.4.2, which refreshes LND and regenerates its admin macaroon.

Merchants running their own BTCPay instances hold the keys to the funds those servers control, so an active draining incident exposes them to direct loss until they shut down or update. BTCPay is a widely used self-hosted alternative to custodial payment processors, giving the advisory an unusually large operational footprint.

The incident appears tied to a Lightning credential flaw in versions before 2.4.2 that let attackers obtain the credentials controlling a store's Lightning funds. The project said operators unsure whether an update applied correctly should re-run it via the user interface or btcpay-update.sh; the exact loss magnitude and root cause have not been resolved in reporting.

自行运行 BTCPay 实例的商户掌握着服务器所控制资金的私钥，因此在资金被持续盗取的情况下，在关闭或升级之前他们将直接面临损失风险。BTCPay 是托管式支付处理器之外被广泛采用的自托管方案，这使得该警告涉及的运营范围异常广泛。

该事件似乎与 2.4.2 之前版本中的一个闪电网络凭证漏洞有关，攻击者可借此获取控制商店闪电网络资金的凭证。该项目表示，若运营者不确定升级是否已正确生效，应通过用户界面或 btcpay-update.sh 重新执行更新；目前报道中尚未厘清具体损失规模与根本原因。

item.author: Startup Fortune
item.content: Coinbase's Third-Party Vendor Problem Strikes Again With Amplitude Leak  Startup Fortune

metadata.background: Amplitude is a cloud-based product analytics platform that companies use to study user behavior, which means customer data is routinely transmitted to and stored by such vendors. Third-party vendor risk has become a recurring theme in crypto security, since an incident at an outside provider can expose exchange customer data even when the exchange's own infrastructure is untouched.
metadata.background_en: Amplitude is a cloud-based product analytics platform that companies use to study user behavior, which means customer data is routinely transmitted to and stored by such vendors. Third-party vendor risk has become a recurring theme in crypto security, since an incident at an outside provider can expose exchange customer data even when the exchange's own infrastructure is untouched.
metadata.background_zh: Amplitude 是一家基于云的产品分析平台，企业用它研究用户行为，这意味着客户数据会被常规性地传输并存储在这类供应商处。第三方供应商风险已成为加密行业安全议题中的常见主题：即便交易所自身基础设施未被攻破，外部服务商出事仍可能导致交易所客户数据外泄。
metadata.detailed_summary:
Coinbase acknowledged a security incident at Amplitude, its third-party product analytics provider, which exposed contact information belonging to a small subset of Coinbase customers alongside other Amplitude customers. Coinbase says its own platform was not breached, and the company has pushed back on circulating claims that 70,000 users were affected.

The incident extends a pattern the source headline frames as recurring for Coinbase: customer data leaving the exchange through outside vendors rather than through a breach of Coinbase's own systems. Exposed contact details give attackers material for phishing and social-engineering attempts aimed at exchange users.

According to The CyberSec Guru, Coinbase disclosed the Amplitude incident on October 28. Reporting also notes that Coinbase's position is that it "has not had a data breach," with the impact attributed to Amplitude and limited to a small subset of customer contact data.

item.ai_summary: A freeze on Bitcoin redemptions has raised solvency and collateral-quality concerns for an Aave market holding roughly $136 million in exposure.
item.author: CryptoSlate
item.content: Bitcoin redemption freeze puts $136 million Aave market under scrutiny  CryptoSlate

metadata.background: Aave is a decentralized money market where users supply and borrow crypto assets from shared liquidity pools, and assets deposited as collateral can be liquidated if their value falls. Bitcoin is not native to EVM chains, so users typically convert BTC into a wrapped, 1:1 representation issued by a custodian or bridge before depositing it as collateral. Those tokens depend on the issuer honoring redemptions for native BTC, which is the mechanism now in question.
metadata.background_en: Aave is a decentralized money market where users supply and borrow crypto assets from shared liquidity pools, and assets deposited as collateral can be liquidated if their value falls. Bitcoin is not native to EVM chains, so users typically convert BTC into a wrapped, 1:1 representation issued by a custodian or bridge before depositing it as collateral. Those tokens depend on the issuer honoring redemptions for native BTC, which is the mechanism now in question.
metadata.background_zh: Aave 是一个去中心化货币市场，用户通过共享流动性池存入和借出加密资产，作为抵押品存入的资产在价值下跌时可能被清算。比特币并非 EVM 链的原生资产，因此用户通常先将 BTC 转换为由托管方或跨链桥发行的 1:1 封装代币，再作为抵押品存入。这类代币依赖发行方按承诺兑付原生 BTC 的赎回机制，而这一机制目前正是问题所在。
metadata.detailed_summary:
A freeze on Bitcoin redemptions has put an Aave lending market holding roughly $136 million in exposure under scrutiny, according to CryptoSlate. The halt raises questions about the solvency of the Bitcoin-pegged asset's issuer and the quality of collateral backing that market.

If holders of the affected Bitcoin-pegged asset cannot redeem it for native BTC, the collateral backing loans on that Aave market may be worth less than its on-chain price implies, exposing lenders on that market to potential shortfalls.

The $136 million figure refers to the size of the Aave market's exposure, not a confirmed loss. The freeze concerns redemption of a Bitcoin-pegged token used as collateral rather than a failure of Aave itself.

如果该比特币锚定资产的持有者无法将其兑换为原生 BTC，那么该 Aave 市场上作为贷款抵押品的资产，其实际价值可能低于链上价格所反映的水平，从而使该市场的贷款方面临潜在缺口。

1.36 亿美元指的是该 Aave 市场的敞口规模，而非已确认的损失。此次冻结涉及的是作为抵押品的比特币锚定代币的赎回，而非 Aave 协议本身出现故障。

metadata.background: Tokenized equities are blockchain-based representations of shares intended to broaden access and add liquidity. OKX-ICE has been offering tokenized versions of U.S. stocks, drawing objections from issuers whose shares are involved. The debate has unfolded as tokenized stock trading gains traction outside the U.S. while domestic corporate resistance hardens.
metadata.background_en: Tokenized equities are blockchain-based representations of shares intended to broaden access and add liquidity. OKX-ICE has been offering tokenized versions of U.S. stocks, drawing objections from issuers whose shares are involved. The debate has unfolded as tokenized stock trading gains traction outside the U.S. while domestic corporate resistance hardens.
metadata.background_zh: 代币化股票是以区块链形式表示的股份，旨在扩大投资渠道并提升流动性。OKX-ICE 一直在提供美国股票的代币化版本，引发相关发行企业的反对。这一争论的背景是，代币化股票交易在美国以外逐渐升温，而美国本土企业的抵制则在加强。
metadata.detailed_summary:
The number of companies objecting to their shares being traded as tokens on the OKX-ICE venue has risen to 50, according to The Defiant, with Nvidia among the objectors. The figure is up from the 26 objections reported earlier, when Oracle, IBM, Intel and IonQ joined the list.

The widening list signals growing corporate pushback against tokenized equities, a segment that has been expanding in international markets even as U.S. companies resist domestic issuance of tokens tied to their shares.

Earlier reporting put the objection count at 26, after Oracle, IBM, Intel and IonQ objected to their stock trading as tokens on the OKX-ICE venue. Coverage of those objections has focused on SEC rules concerning issuer consent for tokenized equities.

Earlier reporting put the objection count at 26, after Oracle, IBM, Intel and IonQ objected to their stock trading as tokens on the OKX-ICE venue. Coverage of those objections has focused on SEC rules concerning issuer consent for tokenized equities.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:

反对名单的扩大表明企业对代币化股票的抵制正在加强。这一品类在国际市场持续扩张，但美国企业对在本土发行锚定自身股票的代币持抗拒态度。

此前的报道称反对企业为 26 家，当时甲骨文、IBM、英特尔和 IonQ 反对其股票在 OKX-ICE 平台以代币形式交易。相关报道的关注点集中在 SEC 关于代币化股票需获得发行方同意的规则上。

metadata.background_zh: 加密货币交易所近年越来越多地部署基于AI的系统，实时分析交易数据并标记可疑行为，这一领域也出现了整合，例如Chainalysis收购AI欺诈检测公司Alterya。币安的披露则描述了一次经由可信内部系统、而非外部防御层发起的攻击。
metadata.detailed_summary:
Binance's incident report described a monthslong campaign in which attackers used fake job interviews to compromise an engineer's work computer and then exploited unauthorized access to an internal wallet signing service to initiate transactions outside the normal withdrawal process. The exchange's report put the figure at roughly $6.3 billion, while coverage of the theft cited about $6 billion.

Binance said it has rebuilt the affected wallet system in a new environment in response to the incident, making the breach a direct test of how exchange-controlled signing infrastructure is secured.

According to Binance's account, the attack unfolded quickly on the evening of the theft, with the attacker reaching the internal signing service rather than the standard withdrawal path. The compromised engineer's machine also hosted an internal AI tool, which the report tied to the intrusion.

The letter provides asset-specific regulatory clarity for Canton Coin by placing it within the SEC staff's 'digital commodity' framing.

item.content: Ex-FBI agent pleads guilty to stealing $2.47 million in crypto from wallets tied to 35 investigations  The Block --- From telegram --- 前FBI特工承认盗取约247万美元加密货币，面临最高20年监禁 BlockBeats 消息，11 月 7 日，据美国司法部公告，前联邦调查局（FBI）特工 Patrick Steven Yaroch 于 11 月 5 日承认电信欺诈和洗钱罪。他利用职务权限获取 FBI 调查中收集的加密货币凭证，实施约 100 笔欺诈性转账，涉及 35 项独立调查，非法获利约 247.44 万美元。 据法庭文件，Yaroch 窃取的资产来自调查对象、敌对国家行为体控制的钱包，以及至少一个 FBI 为行动创建的钱包。他通过兑换币种和多次转账掩盖资金来源，并将部分资金用于偿还个人债务。司法部称，其行为损害了多项调查及相关情报来源和方法。该案定于 2027 年 3 月 4 日量刑，他面临最高 20 年监禁。 原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/376128 --- From telegram --- 【前 FBI 特工承认盗取约 247 万美元加密货币，面临最高 20 年监禁】 Foresight News 消息，据美国司法部公告，前联邦调查局（FBI）特工 Patrick Steven Yaroch 于 11 月 5 日承认电信欺诈和洗钱罪。他利用职务权限获取 FBI 调查中收集的加密货币凭证，实施约 100 笔欺诈性转账，涉及 35 项独立调查，非法获利约 247.44 万美元。据法庭文件，Yaroch 窃取的资产来自调查对象、敌对国家行为体控制的钱包，以及至少一个 FBI 为行动创建的钱包。他通过兑换币种和多次转账掩盖资金来源，并将部分资金用于偿还个人债务。司法部称，其行为损害了多项调查及相关情报来源和方法。该案定于 2027 年 3 月 4 日量刑，他面临最高 20 年监禁。 https://foresightnews.pro/news/h5Detail/117119 --- From rss --- Ex-FBI counterintelligence agent stole almost $2.5M in crypto Yaroch paid off his debts and intended to use the proceeds to finance a new life in Portugal, where he planned to buy a vineyard. A former FBI counterintelligence agent admitted to wire fraud and money laundering in stealing almost $2.5 million in cryptocurrency from unidentified adversarial nations and wallets that were under investigation. Patrick Steven Yaroch, 37, used his investigative positions with access to FBI systems to steal cryptocurrency, then exchange and launder it through financial transactions to conceal its source and ownership. Yaroch made about 100 fraudulent transfers related to 35 FBI investigations, gaining $2,474,380.66 in proceeds, according to a news release from the US Attorney’s Office, Eastern District of Virginia on Thursday. He had earlier admitted to unauthorized transfers that involved about $1 million in digital assets, which was reported by Cointelegraph in August. Yaroch paid off his debts and intended to use the proceeds to finance a new life in Portugal, where he planned to buy a vineyard, according to the statement. The former agent admitted that his actions had compromised FBI investigations related to criminal groups and adversarial nations. Yaroch faces up to 20 years in prison. His sentencing is set for March 4, 2027. Magazine: AI agent disputes head to ‘Internet Court’ — and a jury of AI agents

metadata.detailed_summary:
Former FBI counterintelligence agent Patrick Steven Yaroch pleaded guilty on November 5 to wire fraud and money laundering for stealing approximately $2.47 million in cryptocurrency. He executed about 100 fraudulent transfers from digital wallets associated with 35 separate federal investigations.

The US Department of Justice stated that Yaroch's actions compromised multiple investigations and intelligence sources related to criminal groups and adversarial nations. This incident highlights significant security risks regarding the custody of seized digital assets within law enforcement agencies.

Yaroch used the stolen funds to pay off personal debts and intended to finance a new life in Portugal, including purchasing a vineyard. He is scheduled for sentencing on March 4, 2027, and faces up to 20 years in prison.

美国司法部表示，Yaroch的行为损害了多项针对犯罪集团和敌对国家的调查及相关情报来源。该事件突显了执法机构在扣押数字资产保管方面存在的重大安全风险。

Yaroch利用被盗资金偿还个人债务，并计划用剩余资金在葡萄牙开启新生活，包括购买葡萄园。他定于2027年3月4日接受量刑，面临最高20年的监禁。

item.ai_summary: New Ethereum state-gas rules introduced in EIP-8037 compel decentralized applications to overhaul their billing mechanisms to comply with updated network standards.
item.author: CryptoSlate
item.content: EIP-8037 state-gas rules force Ethereum dApps to rewrite billing  CryptoSlate

metadata.background: EIP-8037 builds upon EIP-2780, which defined intrinsic gas as state-independent. The update aims to better manage state growth by separating execution costs from state creation costs, aligning with broader efforts to optimize Ethereum's scalability and state management.
metadata.background_en: EIP-8037 builds upon EIP-2780, which defined intrinsic gas as state-independent. The update aims to better manage state growth by separating execution costs from state creation costs, aligning with broader efforts to optimize Ethereum's scalability and state management.
metadata.background_zh: EIP-8037 建立在 EIP-2780 的基础上，后者将内在 Gas 定义为与状态无关。该更新旨在通过将执行成本与状态创建成本分离，更好地管理状态增长，符合优化以太坊可扩展性和状态管理的更广泛努力。
metadata.detailed_summary:
EIP-8037 introduces new state-gas rules that increase state creation costs, compelling decentralized applications to overhaul their billing mechanisms. This protocol update separates gas accounting into distinct dimensions, requiring developers to adjust how transaction fees are calculated and charged.

This change fundamentally alters the cost structure for on-chain state creation, directly impacting the operational expenses and pricing models of Ethereum-based applications. Failure to adapt billing logic could lead to transaction failures or unexpected costs for users.

Under EIP-8037, intrinsic gas remains state-independent and is charged entirely in execution-gas, while state creation costs are now treated as a separate dimension. The cumulative gas used across all previous transactions plus the current transaction's contribution must not exceed the block gas limit for each dimension.
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
EIP-8037 introduces new state-gas rules that increase state creation costs, compelling decentralized applications to overhaul their billing mechanisms. This protocol update separates gas accounting into distinct dimensions, requiring developers to adjust how transaction fees are calculated and charged.

This change fundamentally alters the cost structure for on-chain state creation, directly impacting the operational expenses and pricing models of Ethereum-based applications. Failure to adapt billing logic could lead to transaction failures or unexpected costs for users.

Under EIP-8037, intrinsic gas remains state-independent and is charged entirely in execution-gas, while state creation costs are now treated as a separate dimension. The cumulative gas used across all previous transactions plus the current transaction's contribution must not exceed the block gas limit for each dimension.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
EIP-8037 引入了新的状态 Gas 规则，提高了状态创建成本，迫使去中心化应用程序彻底改革其计费机制。该协议更新将 Gas 核算分为不同的维度，要求开发者调整交易费用的计算和收取方式。

这一变化从根本上改变了链上状态创建的成本结构，直接影响基于以太坊的应用程序的运营支出和定价模型。如果不调整计费逻辑，可能导致交易失败或用户面临意外成本。

根据 EIP-8037，内在 Gas 仍与状态无关，完全在执行 Gas 中收取，而状态创建成本现在被视为一个独立的维度。每个维度的所有先前交易累计 Gas 使用量加上当前交易的贡献不得超过区块 Gas 限制。

item.author: The Block
item.content: Bitcoin ETFs flip negative for 2026 after $1.28 billion outflow week, worst since June  The Block

metadata.background: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs, approved in early 2024, allow investors to gain exposure to Bitcoin through traditional brokerage accounts. They have accumulated over 1.29 million BTC, representing approximately 6-7% of Bitcoin's total capped supply. Prior to this week, 2026 net flows had already shrunk significantly, with June 2026 seeing record outflows that nearly erased the year's gains.
metadata.background_en: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs, approved in early 2024, allow investors to gain exposure to Bitcoin through traditional brokerage accounts. They have accumulated over 1.29 million BTC, representing approximately 6-7% of Bitcoin's total capped supply. Prior to this week, 2026 net flows had already shrunk significantly, with June 2026 seeing record outflows that nearly erased the year's gains.
metadata.background_zh: 美国现货比特币ETF于2024年初获批，允许投资者通过传统经纪账户投资比特币。这些ETF已累计持有超过129万枚BTC，约占比特币总上限供应量的6-7%。在本周之前，2026年的净流入已大幅萎缩，2026年6月曾出现创纪录的流出，几乎抹平了当年的净流入。
metadata.detailed_summary:
U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs experienced $1.28 billion in net outflows last week, marking the largest weekly withdrawal since June 2024. This outflow has turned the aggregate net flows for all U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs in 2026 negative.

The reversal to negative net flows for the year signals a significant shift in institutional capital movement away from these regulated investment vehicles, which had previously been a major source of demand for Bitcoin.

The data is sourced from Farside Investors, a widely referenced provider of ETF flow data. The outflows occurred across multiple funds, including major products like iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) and Fidelity Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund (FBTC).

年度净流入转为负值，标志着机构资金正显著从这些受监管的投资工具中撤出，而这些工具此前是比特币需求的主要来源之一。

item.content: Zero-click iOS exploits drain $4M USDT from active TRON wallets  CryptoSlate

metadata.background: Zero-click iOS exploits, such as those used in the 'Operation Triangulation' campaign reported by Kaspersky, can infect devices without any user action. TRON wallets have faced security issues before, with a separate vulnerability reportedly compromising over 14,000 wallets holding $31.5 million in assets in late 2024.

metadata.detailed_summary:
A zero-click iOS exploit has been used to steal approximately $4 million in USDT from active TRON wallets, according to a report from CryptoSlate.

This incident highlights a sophisticated attack vector that can compromise wallets without requiring any user interaction, posing a significant threat to mobile crypto asset security.

Blockchain analytics firm Bitquery traced the stolen USDT across 365 TRON addresses, with one record showing over 519,000 USDT transferred to a collector address on October 25.

metadata.background_zh: 参议院银行委员会负责监督美国的银行和证券政策，包括与稳定币、数字资产交易所和托管规则相关的立法。该委员会近期推动了如《清晰法案》等法案的进展，该法案旨在明确美国证券交易委员会（SEC）和商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）对加密资产的监管权限。
metadata.detailed_summary:
U.S. Senator Elizabeth Warren, a prominent crypto critic, is in line to potentially chair the Senate Banking Committee starting in January 2027, according to recent reports.

As chair, Warren would wield significant influence over the committee's agenda, potentially prioritizing stricter oversight and legislation for the cryptocurrency industry.

The potential change is tied to the committee's seniority rules and would not occur until 2027. Warren has previously sponsored the Digital Asset Anti-Money Laundering Act, which seeks to impose stricter regulations on the industry.
